    var roles = ViewBag.Roles as List<Fashion_store.Models.VaiTro> ?? new List<Fashion_store.Models.VaiTro>();
    string currentType = ViewBag.CurrentAccountType ?? "ALL";
    bool isAdmin = ViewBag.IsAdmin is bool adminValue && adminValue;
    int? CalculateAge(DateTime? dateOfBirth)
    {
        if (!dateOfBirth.HasValue) return null;
        var today = DateTime.Today;
        var age = today.Year - dateOfBirth.Value.Year;
        if (dateOfBirth.Value.Date > today.AddYears(-age)) age--;
        return age;
    }
}

    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.2/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
    <script>
        // ==========================================
        // 1. Quáº£n lÃ½ Tag Sá»Ÿ thÃ­ch khÃ¡ch hÃ ng (ThÃªm / XÃ³a tag tá»« danh má»¥c CSDL)
        // ==========================================
        function addTag(prefix) {
            const selectElem = document.getElementById('selectDm_' + prefix);
            if (!selectElem) return;
            const dmId = selectElem.value;
            if (!dmId) return;

            const selectedOption = selectElem.options[selectElem.selectedIndex];
            const dmName = selectedOption.getAttribute('data-name') || selectedOption.text;

            const tagBox = document.getElementById('tagBox_' + prefix);
            if (!tagBox) return;

            // Kiá»ƒm tra trÃ¹ng láº·p
            if (tagBox.querySelector(`[data-dm-id="${dmId}"]`)) {
                return;
            }

            // XÃ³a thÃ´ng bÃ¡o rá»—ng náº¿u cÃ³
            const emptyMsg = tagBox.querySelector('.no-tag-msg');
            if (emptyMsg) {
                emptyMsg.remove();
            }

            // Táº¡o tháº» Tag badge (KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ gÃµ sá»­a chá»¯, chá»‰ thÃªm/xÃ³a)
            // Táº¡o tháº» Tag badge tá»‘i giáº£n chuáº©n Admin
            const tagSpan = document.createElement('span');
            tagSpan.className = 'tag-item-admin';
            tagSpan.setAttribute('data-dm-id', dmId);
            tagSpan.id = `tag_item_${prefix}_${dmId}`;
            tagSpan.innerHTML = `
                <span>${dmName}</span>
                <button type="button" class="btn-remove-tag" onclick="removeTag('${prefix}', ${dmId})" title="XÃ³a tag">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i>
                </button>
                <input type="hidden" name="SoThichIds" value="${dmId}" />
            `;

            tagBox.appendChild(tagSpan);

            // Disable option trong select Ä‘á»ƒ khÃ´ng chá»n trÃ¹ng
            selectedOption.disabled = true;
            selectedOption.text = dmName + ' (ÄÃ£ thÃªm)';
            selectElem.selectedIndex = 0;
        }

        function removeTag(prefix, dmId) {
            const tagBox = document.getElementById('tagBox_' + prefix);
            const tagSpan = document.getElementById(`tag_item_${prefix}_${dmId}`) || (tagBox ? tagBox.querySelector(`[data-dm-id="${dmId}"]`) : null);
            if (tagSpan) {
                tagSpan.remove();
            }

            // Má»Ÿ láº¡i option trong dropdown
            const selectElem = document.getElementById('selectDm_' + prefix);
            if (selectElem) {
                for (let i = 0; i < selectElem.options.length; i++) {
                    if (selectElem.options[i].value == dmId) {
                        const origName = selectElem.options[i].getAttribute('data-name');
                        const isActive = selectElem.options[i].dataset.active === 'true';
                        selectElem.options[i].disabled = !isActive;
                        if (origName) {
                            selectElem.options[i].text = isActive ? origName : origName + ' (Ngá»«ng hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng)';
                        }
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }

            // Náº¿u khÃ´ng cÃ²n tag nÃ o, hiá»ƒn thá»‹ láº¡i ghi chÃº
            if (tagBox && tagBox.querySelectorAll('[data-dm-id]').length === 0) {
                tagBox.innerHTML = '<span class="text-muted small fst-italic no-tag-msg">ChÆ°a cÃ³ sá»Ÿ thÃ­ch nÃ o</span>';
            }
        }

        // ==========================================
        // 2. Logic kiá»ƒm tra sá»‘ tuá»•i khÃ¡ch hÃ ng > 16
        // ==========================================
        function checkAgeValidity(inputElem, errorElemId) {
            const errorElem = document.getElementById(errorElemId);
            if (!inputElem.value) {
                if (errorElem) errorElem.style.display = 'none';
                inputElem.setCustomValidity('');
                return true;
            }

            const birthDate = new Date(inputElem.value);
            const today = new Date();
            let age = today.getFullYear() - birthDate.getFullYear();
            const monthDiff = today.getMonth() - birthDate.getMonth();
            if (monthDiff < 0 || (monthDiff === 0 && today.getDate() < birthDate.getDate())) {
                age--;
            }

            if (age <= 16) {
                const msg = `KhÃ¡ch hÃ ng pháº£i cÃ³ Ä‘á»™ tuá»•i lá»›n hÆ¡n 16 (tuá»•i hiá»‡n táº¡i: ${age} tuá»•i).`;
                if (errorElem) {
                    errorElem.textContent = msg;
                    errorElem.style.display = 'block';
                }
                inputElem.setCustomValidity(msg);
                return false;
            } else {
                if (errorElem) errorElem.style.display = 'none';
                inputElem.setCustomValidity('');
                return true;
            }
        }

        // ==========================================
        // 3. KhÃ³a / Má»Ÿ khÃ³a tÃ i khoáº£n Ajax
        // ==========================================
        function toggleAccountStatus(id, switchElem) {
            const labelElem = document.getElementById('status_text_' + id);
            fetch('/Admin/Account/ToggleStatus/' + id, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                }
            })
            .then(res => res.json())
            .then(data => {
                if (data.success) {
                    if (data.newStatus) {
                        labelElem.textContent = 'Hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng';
                        labelElem.className = 'text-success';
                    } else {
                        labelElem.textContent = 'Bá»‹ khÃ³a';
                        labelElem.className = 'text-danger';
                    }
                } else {
                    alert(data.message || 'Thao tÃ¡c tháº¥t báº¡i.');
                    switchElem.checked = !switchElem.checked;
                }
            })
            .catch(err => {
                alert('Lá»—i káº¿t ná»‘i mÃ¡y chá»§.');
                switchElem.checked = !switchElem.checked;
            });
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

        function setProductImagePreview(kind, path) {
            const isThumbnail = kind === 'thumbnail';
            const preview = document.getElementById(isThumbnail ? 'prodThumbnailPreview' : 'prodDetailPreview');
            const pathLabel = document.getElementById(isThumbnail ? 'prodThumbnailPath' : 'prodDetailPath');
            const pathInput = document.getElementById(isThumbnail ? 'prodThumbnailPathInput' : 'prodDetailPathInput');
            if (!preview || !pathLabel) return;

            preview.dataset.savedPath = path || '';
            if (pathInput) pathInput.value = path || '';
            preview.onerror = () => { preview.style.display = 'none'; };
            if (path) {
                preview.src = path;
                preview.style.display = 'block';
                pathLabel.textContent = path;
            } else {
                preview.removeAttribute('src');
                preview.style.display = 'none';
                pathLabel.textContent = isThumbnail ? 'ChÆ°a cÃ³ áº£nh thumbnail.' : 'ChÆ°a cÃ³ áº£nh chi tiáº¿t.';
            }
        }

        [['thumbnail', 'prodThumbnailImage'], ['detail', 'prodDetailImage']].forEach(([kind, inputId]) => {
            const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
            input?.addEventListener('change', () => {
                const file = input.files?.[0];
                if (!file) {
                    setProductImagePreview(kind, document.getElementById(kind === 'thumbnail' ? 'prodThumbnailPreview' : 'prodDetailPreview')?.dataset.savedPath || '');
                    return;
                }

                const preview = document.getElementById(kind === 'thumbnail' ? 'prodThumbnailPreview' : 'prodDetailPreview');
                const pathLabel = document.getElementById(kind === 'thumbnail' ? 'prodThumbnailPath' : 'prodDetailPath');
                const pathInput = document.getElementById(kind === 'thumbnail' ? 'prodThumbnailPathInput' : 'prodDetailPathInput');
                if (pathInput) pathInput.value = '';
                preview.src = URL.createObjectURL(file);
                preview.style.display = 'block';
                pathLabel.textContent = `áº¢nh sáº½ thay tháº¿: ${file.name}`;
            });
        });

        [['thumbnail', 'prodThumbnailPathInput'], ['detail', 'prodDetailPathInput']].forEach(([kind, inputId]) => {
            document.getElementById(inputId)?.addEventListener('input', event => {
                const path = event.target.value.trim();
                const fileInput = document.getElementById(kind === 'thumbnail' ? 'prodThumbnailImage' : 'prodDetailImage');
                if (fileInput) fileInput.value = '';
                setProductImagePreview(kind, path);
            });
        });

        // Má»Ÿ Modal Sá»­a Sáº£n Pháº©m (Tá»± Ä‘á»™ng táº£i danh sÃ¡ch toÃ n bá»™ cÃ¡c size & tá»“n kho)
        async function openEditProductModal(id, tenSP, maDM, chatLieu, moTa) {
            window._productStockModified = false;
            document.getElementById('modalProductTitle').innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-pen-to-square me-2 text-warning"></i> Cáº¬P NHáº¬T MáºªU ÃO #' + id;
            document.getElementById('prodMaSP').value = id;
            document.getElementById('prodTenSP').value = tenSP;
            document.getElementById('prodMaDM').value = maDM;

            if (document.getElementById('prodTrangThai')) document.getElementById('prodTrangThai').value = 'true';
            document.getElementById('prodThumbnailImage').value = '';
            document.getElementById('prodDetailImage').value = '';
            setProductImagePreview('thumbnail', '');
            setProductImagePreview('detail', '');

            // áº¨n form khá»Ÿi táº¡o biáº¿n thá»ƒ má»›i, Hiá»‡n danh sÃ¡ch biáº¿n thá»ƒ thá»±c táº¿
            document.getElementById('initialVariantSection').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('editVariantsSection').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('addVariantInEditBox').style.display = 'none';

            // Táº£i danh sÃ¡ch biáº¿n thá»ƒ cá»§a Ã¡o qua AJAX
            await loadProductVariantsForEdit(id);

        // Táº£i danh sÃ¡ch toÃ n bá»™ biáº¿n thá»ƒ cá»§a 1 Ã¡o vÃ  tÃ­nh tá»•ng tá»“n kho
        async function loadProductVariantsForEdit(productId) {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/Admin/Product/GetVariants?productId=' + productId);
                const data = await res.json();
                if (!data.success) {
                    alert('KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y thÃ´ng tin biáº¿n thá»ƒ: ' + (data.message || ''));
                    return;
                }

                const firstVariantImage = data.variants?.find(variant => variant.hinhAnh)?.hinhAnh || '';
                setProductImagePreview('thumbnail', data.hinhAnh || firstVariantImage);
                setProductImagePreview('detail', data.hinhAnhMoTa || '');

                let totalStock = 0;
                const tbody = document.getElementById('editModalVariantsTbody');
                tbody.innerHTML = '';

                if (!data.variants || data.variants.length === 0) {
                    tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" class="text-muted py-3">Máº«u Ã¡o nÃ y chÆ°a cÃ³ biáº¿n thá»ƒ nÃ o. HÃ£y báº¥m nÃºt thÃªm má»›i bÃªn dÆ°á»›i.</td></tr>';
                } else {
                    data.variants.forEach(v => {
                        totalStock += Number(v.soLuongTon || 0);
                        const tr = document.createElement('tr');
                        tr.innerHTML = `
                            <td><span class="badge bg-dark">Size ${v.kichThuoc}</span></td>
                            <td><span class="badge bg-light text-dark border">${v.mauSac}</span></td>
                            <td class="font-monospace fw-semibold small text-muted">${v.sku}</td>
                            <td class="text-end">
                                <input type="number" id="vPrice_${v.maSL}" class="form-control form-control-sm text-end d-inline-block" style="width: 105px;" value="${v.giaBan}" step="10000" />
                            </td>
                            <td>
                                <input type="number" id="vStock_${v.maSL}" class="form-control form-control-sm text-center fw-bold d-inline-block" style="width: 75px;" value="${v.soLuongTon}" min="0" />
                            </td>
                            <td>
                                <div class="d-inline-flex gap-1">
                                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-success px-2" onclick="saveVariantFromEditModal(${v.maSL}, ${productId}, '${v.kichThuoc}', '${v.mauSac}', '${v.sku}')" title="LÆ°u sá»‘ lÆ°á»£ng & giÃ¡">
                                        <i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i>
                                    </button>
                                    ${data.variants.length > 1 ? `
                                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger px-2" onclick="deleteVariantFromEditModal(${v.maSL}, ${productId}, '${v.sku}')" title="XÃ³a size nÃ y">
                                        <i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can"></i>
                                    </button>` : ''}
                                </div>
                            </td>
                        `;
                        tbody.appendChild(tr);
                    });
                }

                document.getElementById('editModalTotalStock').textContent = 'Tá»•ng tá»“n: ' + totalStock.toLocaleString('vi-VN') + ' cÃ¡i';
            } catch (err) {
                console.error(err);
                alert('Lá»—i táº£i dá»¯ liá»‡u biáº¿n thá»ƒ: ' + err.message);
            }
        }

        // LÆ°u cáº­p nháº­t tá»“n kho & giÃ¡ cá»§a biáº¿n thá»ƒ ngay trong modal Sá»­a
        async function saveVariantFromEditModal(maSL, maSP, size, color, sku) {
            const stockInput = document.getElementById('vStock_' + maSL);
            const priceInput = document.getElementById('vPrice_' + maSL);
            const stock = stockInput ? parseInt(stockInput.value) : 0;
            const price = priceInput ? parseFloat(priceInput.value) : 250000;

            if (isNaN(stock) || stock < 0) {
                alert('Sá»‘ lÆ°á»£ng tá»“n khÃ´ng thá»ƒ Ã¢m.');
                return;
            }

            const formData = new FormData();
            formData.append('__RequestVerificationToken', getCsrfToken());
            formData.append('MaSL', maSL);
            formData.append('MaSP', maSP);
            formData.append('SKU', sku);
            formData.append('KichThuoc', size);
            formData.append('MauSac', color);
            formData.append('GiaBan', price);
            formData.append('SoLuongTon', stock);
            formData.append('TrangThai', 'true');

            try {
                const res = await fetch('/Admin/Product/SaveVariant', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' },
                    body: formData
                });
                const data = await res.json();
                if (data.success) {
                    window._productStockModified = true;
                    await loadProductVariantsForEdit(maSP);
                } else {
                    alert('Lá»—i: ' + (data.message || 'KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ lÆ°u biáº¿n thá»ƒ'));
                }
            } catch (err) {
                alert('Lá»—i gá»­i yÃªu cáº§u: ' + err.message);
            }
        }

        // XÃ³a má»™t biáº¿n thá»ƒ trong modal Sá»­a
        async function deleteVariantFromEditModal(maSL, maSP, sku) {
            if (!confirm('Báº¡n cÃ³ cháº¯c cháº¯n muá»‘n xÃ³a biáº¿n thá»ƒ SKU: ' + sku + '?')) return;

            const formData = new FormData();
            formData.append('__RequestVerificationToken', getCsrfToken());
            formData.append('id', maSL);

            try {
                const res = await fetch('/Admin/Product/DeleteVariant', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' },
                    body: formData
                });
                const data = await res.json();
                if (data.success) {
                    window._productStockModified = true;
                    await loadProductVariantsForEdit(maSP);
                } else {
                    alert('Lá»—i: ' + (data.message || 'KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ xÃ³a'));
                }
            } catch (err) {
                alert('Lá»—i gá»­i yÃªu cáº§u: ' + err.message);
            }
        }

        // ThÃªm biáº¿n thá»ƒ má»›i trong modal Sá»­a
        async function submitNewVariantInEditModal() {
            const maSP = document.getElementById('prodMaSP').value;
            const size = document.getElementById('newV_KichThuoc').value;
            const color = document.getElementById('newV_MauSac').value.trim();
            let sku = document.getElementById('newV_SKU').value.trim();
            const price = parseFloat(document.getElementById('newV_GiaBan').value) || 250000;
            const stock = parseInt(document.getElementById('newV_SoLuongTon').value) || 0;

            if (!color) {
                alert('Vui lÃ²ng nháº­p mÃ u sáº¯c.');
                return;
            }
            if (!sku) {
                sku = 'SP' + maSP + '-' + size.toUpperCase() + '-' + Date.now().toString().slice(-4);
            }

            const formData = new FormData();
            formData.append('__RequestVerificationToken', getCsrfToken());
            formData.append('MaSP', maSP);
            formData.append('SKU', sku);
            formData.append('KichThuoc', size);
            formData.append('MauSac', color);
            formData.append('GiaBan', price);
            formData.append('SoLuongTon', stock);
            formData.append('TrangThai', 'true');

            try {
                const res = await fetch('/Admin/Product/SaveVariant', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' },
                    body: formData
                });
                const data = await res.json();
                if (data.success) {
                    window._productStockModified = true;
                    document.getElementById('newV_SKU').value = '';
                    document.getElementById('addVariantInEditBox').style.display = 'none';
                    await loadProductVariantsForEdit(maSP);
                } else {
                    alert('Lá»—i: ' + (data.message || 'KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ thÃªm biáº¿n thá»ƒ'));
                }
            } catch (err) {
                alert('Lá»—i: ' + err.message);
            }
        }

        function openEditCategoryModal(id, ten, moTa, trangThai) {
            document.getElementById('modalCatTitle').innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-pen-to-square me-2"></i> Cáº¬P NHáº¬T DANH Má»¤C #' + id;

        document.getElementById('modalAddCategory').addEventListener('hidden.bs.modal', function () {
            document.getElementById('modalCatTitle').innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-tags me-2"></i> THÃŠM Má»šI DANH Má»¤C ÃO';
            document.getElementById('catMaDM').value = '';
            document.getElementById('catTenDM').value = '';
            document.getElementById('catMoTa').value = '';
            document.getElementById('catTrangThai').checked = true;
        });

        function getCsrfToken() {
            var input = document.querySelector('input[name="__RequestVerificationToken"]');
            return input ? input.value : '';
        }

        document.querySelectorAll('form[data-delete-product]').forEach(form => {
            form.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
                event.preventDefault();
                const button = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
                if (button) button.disabled = true;
                try {
                    const response = await fetch(form.action, {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' },
                        body: new FormData(form)
                    });
                    const result = await response.json();
                    if (!response.ok || !result.success) throw new Error(result.message || 'KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ áº©n sáº£n pháº©m.');
                    form.closest('tr')?.remove();
                    const message = document.getElementById('product-action-message');
                    message.className = 'alert alert-success';
                    message.textContent = result.message;
                    message.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
                } catch (error) {
                    const message = document.getElementById('product-action-message');
                    message.className = 'alert alert-danger';
                    message.textContent = error.message || 'KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ áº©n sáº£n pháº©m.';
                } finally {
                    if (button) button.disabled = false;
                }
            });
        });

[ApiController]
[Route("api/auth")]
public class AuthController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly AppDbContext _db;
    private readonly JwtHelper    _jwt;

    public AuthController(AppDbContext db, JwtHelper jwt)
    {
        _db  = db;
        _jwt = jwt;
    }

    [HttpGet("availability")]
    [AllowAnonymous]
    public async Task<IActionResult> CheckAvailability([FromQuery] string? username, [FromQuery] string? email)
    {
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(username))
        {
            var value = username.Trim();
            if (value.Length < 4 || value.Length > 50 || value.Any(char.IsWhiteSpace))
                return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(new { available = false, field = "username", reason = "TÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p pháº£i cÃ³ tá»« 4 Ä‘áº¿n 50 kÃ½ tá»± vÃ  khÃ´ng chá»©a khoáº£ng tráº¯ng." }));
            var exists = await _db.TaiKhoans.AnyAsync(account => account.TenDangNhap.ToLower() == value.ToLower());
            return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(new { available = !exists, field = "username", reason = exists ? "TÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p Ä‘Ã£ tá»“n táº¡i." : null }));
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(email))
        {
            var value = email.Trim();
            if (!new System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.EmailAddressAttribute().IsValid(value))
                return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(new { available = false, field = "email", reason = "Email khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡." }));
            var exists = await _db.KhachHangs.AnyAsync(customer => customer.Email.ToLower() == value.ToLower());
            return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(new { available = !exists, field = "email", reason = exists ? "Email Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Æ°á»£c sá»­ dá»¥ng." : null }));
        }

        return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Cáº§n cung cáº¥p tÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p hoáº·c email Ä‘á»ƒ kiá»ƒm tra."));
    }

    // POST /api/auth/login
    [HttpPost("login")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Login([FromBody] LoginRequest req)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(req.TenDangNhap) || req.TenDangNhap.Any(char.IsWhiteSpace))
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Vui lÃ²ng nháº­p tÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p há»£p lá»‡."));

        var tk = await _db.TaiKhoans
            .Include(t => t.VaiTro)
            .Include(t => t.KhachHang)
            .Include(t => t.QuanLy)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(t => t.TenDangNhap == req.TenDangNhap);

        if (tk is null)
            return Unauthorized(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("TÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i trong há»‡ thá»‘ng."));

        var customer = tk.KhachHang;
        if (tk.MaVaiTro != 2 || customer is null)
            return Unauthorized(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("TÃ i khoáº£n Admin hoáº·c Quáº£n lÃ½ khÃ´ng thá»ƒ Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p táº¡i trang khÃ¡ch hÃ ng."));

        if (!tk.TrangThai || customer.DaXoa)
            return Unauthorized(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("TÃ i khoáº£n Ä‘Ã£ bá»‹ khÃ³a. Vui lÃ²ng liÃªn há»‡ bá»™ pháº­n há»— trá»£."));

        bool passwordMatches;
        if (tk.MatKhau.StartsWith("$2", StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            try { passwordMatches = BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.Verify(req.MatKhau, tk.MatKhau); }
            catch { passwordMatches = false; }
        }
        else
        {
            passwordMatches = string.Equals(req.MatKhau, tk.MatKhau, StringComparison.Ordinal);
            if (passwordMatches) tk.MatKhau = BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.HashPassword(req.MatKhau);
        }

        if (!passwordMatches)
            return Unauthorized(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Máº­t kháº©u khÃ´ng chÃ­nh xÃ¡c. Vui lÃ²ng kiá»ƒm tra láº¡i."));

        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        string hoTen = customer.HoTen;
        string? email = customer.Email;
        string token  = _jwt.GenerateToken(tk, hoTen, email);

        bool hasPreferences = await _db.KhachHangSoThiches.AnyAsync(x => x.MaKH == customer.MaKH);
        var resp = new LoginResponse(token, tk.MaTK, tk.TenDangNhap, hoTen, tk.VaiTro.TenVaiTro, email, hasPreferences);
        return Ok(ApiResponse<LoginResponse>.Ok(resp, "ÄÄƒng nháº­p thÃ nh cÃ´ng!"));
    }

    // POST /api/auth/register  (KhÃ¡ch hÃ ng tá»± Ä‘Äƒng kÃ½)
    [HttpPost("register")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Register([FromBody] RegisterRequest req)
    {
        var username = req.TenDangNhap?.Trim();
        var fullName = req.HoTen?.Trim();
        var email = req.Email?.Trim();

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(username) || username.Length < 4 || username.Length > 50 || username.Any(char.IsWhiteSpace))
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("TÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p pháº£i cÃ³ tá»« 4 Ä‘áº¿n 50 kÃ½ tá»± vÃ  khÃ´ng chá»©a khoáº£ng tráº¯ng."));

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(req.MatKhau) || req.MatKhau.Length < 8)
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Máº­t kháº©u pháº£i cÃ³ Ã­t nháº¥t 8 kÃ½ tá»±."));

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fullName) || fullName.Length > 100)
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Há» tÃªn lÃ  báº¯t buá»™c vÃ  khÃ´ng quÃ¡ 100 kÃ½ tá»±."));

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(email) || email.Length > 100 || !new System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.EmailAddressAttribute().IsValid(email))
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Email khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡."));

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(req.SoDienThoai)
            && (req.SoDienThoai.Length is < 9 or > 11 || req.SoDienThoai.Any(character => !char.IsDigit(character))))
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Sá»‘ Ä‘iá»‡n thoáº¡i chá»‰ Ä‘Æ°á»£c chá»©a 9 Ä‘áº¿n 11 chá»¯ sá»‘."));

        if (req.NgaySinh > DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.Today))
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("NgÃ y sinh khÃ´ng thá»ƒ náº±m trong tÆ°Æ¡ng lai."));

        if (await _db.TaiKhoans.AnyAsync(t => t.TenDangNhap.ToLower() == username.ToLower()))
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("TÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p Ä‘Ã£ tá»“n táº¡i."));

        if (await _db.KhachHangs.AnyAsync(k => k.Email.ToLower() == email.ToLower()))
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Email Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Æ°á»£c sá»­ dá»¥ng."));

        var selectedIds = (req.MaDMs ?? new List<int>()).Distinct().ToList();
        var categories = await _db.DanhMucs
            .Where(category => selectedIds.Contains(category.MaDM) && category.TrangThai)
            .ToListAsync();
        if (categories.Count != selectedIds.Count)
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("CÃ³ sá»Ÿ thÃ­ch khÃ´ng cÃ²n há»£p lá»‡ trong danh má»¥c hiá»‡n táº¡i."));

        var vaiTroKH = await _db.VaiTros.FirstOrDefaultAsync(v => v.MaVaiTro == 2);

        if (vaiTroKH is null)
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y vai trÃ² khÃ¡ch hÃ ng trong cÆ¡ sá»Ÿ dá»¯ liá»‡u."));

        await using var transaction = await _db.Database.BeginTransactionAsync();

        var tk = new TaiKhoan
        {
            TenDangNhap = username,
            MatKhau     = BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.HashPassword(req.MatKhau),
            MaVaiTro    = vaiTroKH.MaVaiTro,
            TrangThai   = true,
            NgayTao     = DateTime.Now
        };
        _db.TaiKhoans.Add(tk);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        var kh = new KhachHang
        {
            MaTK        = tk.MaTK,
            HoTen       = fullName,
            Email       = email,
            SoDienThoai = req.SoDienThoai,
            NgaySinh    = req.NgaySinh,
            GioiTinh    = req.GioiTinh,
            DiaChi      = req.DiaChi,
            NgayDangKy  = DateTime.Now
        };
        _db.KhachHangs.Add(kh);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        if (categories.Count > 0)
        {
            _db.KhachHangSoThiches.AddRange(categories.Select(category => new KhachHangSoThich
            {
                MaKH = kh.MaKH,
                MaDM = category.MaDM
            }));
            await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        }

        await transaction.CommitAsync();

        // Reload with navigation
        await _db.Entry(tk).Reference(t => t.VaiTro).LoadAsync();
        string token = _jwt.GenerateToken(tk, kh.HoTen, kh.Email);
        bool hasPreferences = await _db.KhachHangSoThiches.AnyAsync(x => x.MaKH == kh.MaKH);
        var resp = new LoginResponse(token, tk.MaTK, tk.TenDangNhap, kh.HoTen, "KhachHang", kh.Email, hasPreferences);
        return Ok(ApiResponse<LoginResponse>.Ok(resp, "ÄÄƒng kÃ½ thÃ nh cÃ´ng!"));
    }

    // POST /api/auth/change-password
    [Authorize]
    [HttpPost("change-password")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> ChangePassword([FromBody] ChangePasswordRequest req)
    {
        var maTK = int.Parse(User.FindFirst("maTK")!.Value);
        var tk   = await _db.TaiKhoans.FindAsync(maTK);
        if (tk is null) return NotFound();

        if (!BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.Verify(req.MatKhauCu, tk.MatKhau))
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Máº­t kháº©u hiá»‡n táº¡i khÃ´ng Ä‘Ãºng."));

        tk.MatKhau = BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.HashPassword(req.MatKhauMoi);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(null!, "Äá»•i máº­t kháº©u thÃ nh cÃ´ng."));
    }
}

using FashionCRM.API.Data;
using FashionCRM.API.DTOs;
using FashionCRM.API.Models;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace FashionCRM.API.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/danhgia")]
public class DanhGiaController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly AppDbContext _db;
    public DanhGiaController(AppDbContext db) => _db = db;

    // GET /api/danhgia?maSP=1
    [HttpGet]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetBySanPham([FromQuery] int maSP, [FromQuery] int page = 1, [FromQuery] int pageSize = 10)
    {
        var query = _db.DanhGias.Include(d => d.KhachHang).Where(d => d.MaSP == maSP);
        var total = await query.CountAsync();
        var items = await query.OrderByDescending(d => d.NgayDanhGia)
            .Skip((page - 1) * pageSize).Take(pageSize)
            .Select(d => new DanhGiaDto(d.MaDG, d.MaKH, d.KhachHang.HoTen, d.MaSP, d.SoSao, d.NoiDung, d.NgayDanhGia))
            .ToListAsync();

        var avgStar = total > 0 ? await query.AverageAsync(d => (double)d.SoSao) : 0;
        return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(new { Items = items, TotalItems = total, Page = page, PageSize = pageSize, DiemTrungBinh = Math.Round(avgStar, 1) }));
    }

    // GET /api/danhgia/my
    [HttpGet("my")]
    [Authorize]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetMy()
    {
        if (!User.IsInRole("KhachHang")) return Forbid();

        var maTkRaw = User.FindFirst("maTK")?.Value;
        if (!int.TryParse(maTkRaw, out var maTK))
            return Unauthorized(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("PhiÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡."));

        var kh = await _db.KhachHangs.FirstOrDefaultAsync(k => k.MaTK == maTK);
        if (kh is null) return NotFound(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y thÃ´ng tin khÃ¡ch hÃ ng."));

        var reviews = await _db.DanhGias
            .Include(d => d.SanPham)
            .Where(d => d.MaKH == kh.MaKH)
            .OrderByDescending(d => d.NgayDanhGia)
            .ToListAsync();
        var items = reviews.Select(d => new
        {
            d.MaDG, d.MaKH, HoTenKH = kh.HoTen, d.MaSP,
            TenSP = d.SanPham.TenSP, d.SoSao, d.NoiDung, d.NgayDanhGia
        }).ToList();

        return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(items));
    }

    // GET /api/danhgia/eligible-products â€” sáº£n pháº©m chÆ°a Ä‘Æ°á»£c khÃ¡ch hÃ ng Ä‘Ã¡nh giÃ¡
    [HttpGet("eligible-products")]
    [Authorize]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetEligibleProducts()
    {
        if (!User.IsInRole("KhachHang")) return Forbid();
        if (!int.TryParse(User.FindFirst("maTK")?.Value, out var maTK)) return Unauthorized();
        var kh = await _db.KhachHangs.Include(customer => customer.TaiKhoan)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(customer => customer.MaTK == maTK && !customer.DaXoa);
        if (kh == null || !kh.TaiKhoan.TrangThai) return Unauthorized(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("TÃ i khoáº£n khÃ¡ch hÃ ng khÃ´ng hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng."));

        var reviewedIds = (await _db.DanhGias.Where(review => review.MaKH == kh.MaKH)
            .Select(review => review.MaSP).ToListAsync()).ToHashSet();
        var items = await _db.SanPhams.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(product => product.TrangThai && !product.DaXoa && !reviewedIds.Contains(product.MaSP))
            .OrderBy(product => product.TenSP)
            .Select(product => new { product.MaSP, product.TenSP })
            .ToListAsync();
        return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(new { Items = items }));
    }

    // POST /api/danhgia
    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Create([FromBody] DanhGiaCreateDto dto)
    {
        if (!User.IsInRole("KhachHang"))
            return Forbid();

        if (dto.SoSao < 1 || dto.SoSao > 5)
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Sá»‘ sao pháº£i tá»« 1 Ä‘áº¿n 5."));

        if (!int.TryParse(User.FindFirst("maTK")?.Value, out var maTK)) return Unauthorized();
        var kh = await _db.KhachHangs.Include(customer => customer.TaiKhoan)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(customer => customer.MaTK == maTK && !customer.DaXoa);
        if (kh is null || !kh.TaiKhoan.TrangThai) return Unauthorized(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("TÃ i khoáº£n khÃ¡ch hÃ ng khÃ´ng hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng."));

        if (!await _db.SanPhams.AnyAsync(product => product.MaSP == dto.MaSP && product.TrangThai && !product.DaXoa))
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Sáº£n pháº©m khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i hoáº·c Ä‘Ã£ ngá»«ng kinh doanh."));

        if (await _db.DanhGias.AnyAsync(d => d.MaKH == kh.MaKH && d.MaSP == dto.MaSP))
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Báº¡n Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Ã¡nh giÃ¡ sáº£n pháº©m nÃ y rá»“i."));

        var dg = new DanhGia { MaKH = kh.MaKH, MaSP = dto.MaSP, SoSao = dto.SoSao, NoiDung = dto.NoiDung?.Trim(), NgayDanhGia = DateTime.Now };
        _db.DanhGias.Add(dg);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(new { dg.MaDG }, "ÄÃ¡nh giÃ¡ thÃ nh cÃ´ng!"));
    }

    // DELETE /api/danhgia/{id}
    [HttpDelete("{id:int}")]
    [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Delete(int id)
    {
        var dg = await _db.DanhGias.FindAsync(id);
        if (dg is null) return NotFound(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y Ä‘Ã¡nh giÃ¡."));
        _db.DanhGias.Remove(dg);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(null!, "ÄÃ£ xÃ³a Ä‘Ã¡nh giÃ¡."));
    }
}

using FashionCRM.API.Data;
using FashionCRM.API.DTOs;
using FashionCRM.API.Models;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace FashionCRM.API.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/danhmuc")]
public class DanhMucController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly AppDbContext _db;
    public DanhMucController(AppDbContext db) => _db = db;

    [HttpGet]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetAll([FromQuery] bool? trangThai)
    {
        var query = _db.DanhMucs.Include(d => d.SanPhams).AsQueryable();
        bool isStaff = User.IsInRole("Admin") || User.IsInRole("QuanLy");
        if (isStaff && trangThai.HasValue) query = query.Where(d => d.TrangThai == trangThai);
        else if (!isStaff) query = query.Where(d => d.TrangThai);

        var items = await query.OrderBy(d => d.MaDM)
            .Select(d => new DanhMucDto(d.MaDM, d.TenDM, d.MoTa, d.TrangThai,
                d.SanPhams.Count(s => s.TrangThai)))
            .ToListAsync();
        return Ok(ApiResponse<IEnumerable<DanhMucDto>>.Ok(items));
    }

    [HttpGet("{id:int}")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetById(int id)
    {
        var detailQuery = _db.DanhMucs.Include(x => x.SanPhams).Where(x => x.MaDM == id);
        if (!User.IsInRole("Admin") && !User.IsInRole("QuanLy")) detailQuery = detailQuery.Where(x => x.TrangThai);
        var d = await detailQuery.FirstOrDefaultAsync();
        if (d is null) return NotFound(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y danh má»¥c."));
        return Ok(ApiResponse<DanhMucDto>.Ok(new DanhMucDto(d.MaDM, d.TenDM, d.MoTa, d.TrangThai,
            d.SanPhams.Count(s => s.TrangThai))));
    }

    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Create([FromBody] DanhMucCreateDto dto)
    {
        if (await _db.DanhMucs.AnyAsync(d => d.TenDM == dto.TenDM))
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("TÃªn danh má»¥c Ä‘Ã£ tá»“n táº¡i."));
        var dm = new DanhMuc { TenDM = dto.TenDM, MoTa = dto.MoTa, TrangThai = true };
        _db.DanhMucs.Add(dm);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(new { dm.MaDM }, "ThÃªm danh má»¥c thÃ nh cÃ´ng."));
    }

    [HttpPut("{id:int}")]
    [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Update(int id, [FromBody] DanhMucCreateDto dto)
    {
        var dm = await _db.DanhMucs.FindAsync(id);
        if (dm is null) return NotFound(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y."));
        dm.TenDM = dto.TenDM; dm.MoTa = dto.MoTa;
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(null!, "Cáº­p nháº­t thÃ nh cÃ´ng."));
    }

    [HttpPatch("{id:int}/toggle")]
    [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Toggle(int id)
    {
        var dm = await _db.DanhMucs.FindAsync(id);
        if (dm is null) return NotFound(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y."));
        dm.TrangThai = !dm.TrangThai;
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(new { dm.TrangThai },
            dm.TrangThai ? "ÄÃ£ hiá»ƒn thá»‹ danh má»¥c." : "ÄÃ£ áº©n danh má»¥c."));
    }

    [HttpDelete("{id:int}")]
    [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Delete(int id)
    {
        var dm = await _db.DanhMucs.Include(d => d.SanPhams).FirstOrDefaultAsync(d => d.MaDM == id);
        if (dm is null) return NotFound(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y."));
        if (dm.SanPhams.Any()) return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ xÃ³a danh má»¥c Ä‘ang cÃ³ sáº£n pháº©m."));
        _db.DanhMucs.Remove(dm);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(null!, "ÄÃ£ xÃ³a danh má»¥c."));
    }
}

using FashionCRM.API.Data;
using FashionCRM.API.DTOs;
using FashionCRM.API.Models;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace FashionCRM.API.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/khachhang")]
[Authorize]
public class KhachHangController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly AppDbContext _db;
    public KhachHangController(AppDbContext db) => _db = db;

    // GET /api/khachhang?page=1&pageSize=10&search=...&gioiTinh=...
    [HttpGet]
    [Authorize(Roles = "Admin,QuanLy")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetAll(
        [FromQuery] QueryParams q,
        [FromQuery] string? gioiTinh,
        [FromQuery] bool? trangThai)
    {
        var query = _db.KhachHangs
            .Include(k => k.TaiKhoan)
            .AsQueryable();

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(q.Search))
            query = query.Where(k =>
                k.HoTen.Contains(q.Search) ||
                k.Email.Contains(q.Search) ||
                (k.SoDienThoai != null && k.SoDienThoai.Contains(q.Search)));

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(gioiTinh))
            query = query.Where(k => k.GioiTinh == gioiTinh);

        if (trangThai.HasValue)
            query = query.Where(k => k.TaiKhoan.TrangThai == trangThai.Value);

        query = q.SortBy switch
        {
            "hoTen"      => q.SortDir == "asc" ? query.OrderBy(k => k.HoTen) : query.OrderByDescending(k => k.HoTen),
            "ngayDangKy" => q.SortDir == "asc" ? query.OrderBy(k => k.NgayDangKy) : query.OrderByDescending(k => k.NgayDangKy),
            _            => query.OrderByDescending(k => k.NgayDangKy)
        };

        var total = await query.CountAsync();
        var items = await query
            .Skip((q.Page - 1) * q.PageSize)
            .Take(q.PageSize)
            .Select(k => new KhachHangDto(
                k.MaKH, k.HoTen, k.Email, k.SoDienThoai,
                k.NgaySinh, k.GioiTinh, k.DiaChi, k.SoThich,
                k.NgayDangKy, k.TaiKhoan.TrangThai))
            .ToListAsync();

        return Ok(ApiResponse<PagedResult<KhachHangDto>>.Ok(new PagedResult<KhachHangDto>
        {
            Items = items, TotalItems = total, Page = q.Page, PageSize = q.PageSize
        }));
    }

    // GET /api/khachhang/me
    [HttpGet("me")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetCurrentCustomer()
    {
        if (!User.IsInRole("KhachHang")) return Forbid();
        var maTkRaw = User.FindFirst("maTK")?.Value;

    public async Task<IActionResult> SaveMyPreferences([FromBody] PreferenceUpdateDto dto)
    {
        if (!User.IsInRole("KhachHang")) return Forbid();
        if (!int.TryParse(User.FindFirst("maTK")?.Value, out var maTK)) return Unauthorized();
        var kh = await _db.KhachHangs
            .Include(customer => customer.TaiKhoan)
            .Include(customer => customer.KhachHangSoThiches)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(customer => customer.MaTK == maTK && !customer.DaXoa);
        if (kh == null || !kh.TaiKhoan.TrangThai) return Unauthorized(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("TÃ i khoáº£n khÃ´ng hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng."));

        var ids = (dto?.MaDMs ?? new List<int>()).Distinct().ToList();
        var categories = await _db.DanhMucs
            .Where(category => ids.Contains(category.MaDM) && category.TrangThai)
            .ToListAsync();
        if (ids.Count == 0 || categories.Count != ids.Count)
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("CÃ³ sá»Ÿ thÃ­ch khÃ´ng cÃ²n há»£p lá»‡ trong danh má»¥c hiá»‡n táº¡i."));

        _db.KhachHangSoThiches.RemoveRange(kh.KhachHangSoThiches);
        _db.KhachHangSoThiches.AddRange(categories.Select(category => new KhachHangSoThich
        {
            MaKH = kh.MaKH,
            MaDM = category.MaDM
        }));
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(new
        {
            HasPreferences = true,
            SoThich = string.Join(", ", categories.Select(category => category.TenDM))
        }, "ÄÃ£ lÆ°u sá»Ÿ thÃ­ch cá»§a báº¡n."));

    // POST /api/khachhang  (Quáº£n lÃ½ thÃªm thá»§ cÃ´ng)
    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize(Roles = "Admin,QuanLy")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Create([FromBody] KhachHangCreateDto dto)
    {
        var account = await _db.TaiKhoans.FirstOrDefaultAsync(item => item.MaTK == dto.MaTK);
        if (account == null || account.MaVaiTro != 2 || await _db.KhachHangs.AnyAsync(customer => customer.MaTK == dto.MaTK))
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("HÃ£y chá»n tÃ i khoáº£n khÃ¡ch hÃ ng chÆ°a cÃ³ há»“ sÆ¡."));
        if (await _db.KhachHangs.AnyAsync(k => k.Email == dto.Email))
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Email Ä‘Ã£ tá»“n táº¡i."));

        var kh = new KhachHang
        {
            MaTK = dto.MaTK, HoTen = dto.HoTen, Email = dto.Email,
            SoDienThoai = dto.SoDienThoai, NgaySinh = dto.NgaySinh,
            GioiTinh = dto.GioiTinh, DiaChi = dto.DiaChi, SoThich = dto.SoThich,
            NgayDangKy = DateTime.Now
        };
        _db.KhachHangs.Add(kh);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(new { kh.MaKH }, "ThÃªm khÃ¡ch hÃ ng thÃ nh cÃ´ng."));
    }

    // POST /api/khachhang/create-with-account  (Quáº£n lÃ½ thÃªm khÃ¡ch hÃ ng má»›i)
    [HttpPost("create-with-account")]
    [Authorize(Roles = "Admin,QuanLy")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> CreateWithAccount([FromBody] KhachHangCreateWithAccountDto dto)
    {
        if (await _db.TaiKhoans.AnyAsync(t => t.TenDangNhap == dto.TenDangNhap))
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("TÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p Ä‘Ã£ tá»“n táº¡i."));
        if (await _db.KhachHangs.AnyAsync(k => k.Email == dto.Email))
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Email Ä‘Ã£ tá»“n táº¡i."));

        await using var transaction = await _db.Database.BeginTransactionAsync();
        try
        {
            var tk = new TaiKhoan
            {
                TenDangNhap = dto.TenDangNhap,
                MatKhau = BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.HashPassword(dto.MatKhau),
                MaVaiTro = 2,
                TrangThai = true,
                NgayTao = DateTime.Now
            };
            _db.TaiKhoans.Add(tk);
            await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

            var kh = new KhachHang
            {
                MaTK = tk.MaTK, HoTen = dto.HoTen, Email = dto.Email,
                SoDienThoai = dto.SoDienThoai, NgaySinh = dto.NgaySinh,
                GioiTinh = dto.GioiTinh, DiaChi = dto.DiaChi, SoThich = dto.SoThich,
                NgayDangKy = DateTime.Now
            };
            _db.KhachHangs.Add(kh);
            await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
            await transaction.CommitAsync();

            return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(new { kh.MaKH, tk.MaTK }, "ThÃªm khÃ¡ch hÃ ng thÃ nh cÃ´ng."));
        }
        catch
        {
            await transaction.RollbackAsync();
            throw;
        }
    }

    // PUT /api/khachhang/me
    [HttpPut("me")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> UpdateCurrentCustomer([FromBody] KhachHangUpdateDto dto)
    {
        if (!User.IsInRole("KhachHang")) return Forbid();
        var maTkRaw = User.FindFirst("maTK")?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(maTkRaw) || !int.TryParse(maTkRaw, out var maTk))
            return Unauthorized(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("PhiÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡."));

        var kh = await _db.KhachHangs
            .Include(k => k.TaiKhoan)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(k => k.MaTK == maTk);
        if (kh is null) return NotFound(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y thÃ´ng tin khÃ¡ch hÃ ng."));

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dto.Email) && !string.Equals(kh.Email, dto.Email, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            && await _db.KhachHangs.AnyAsync(k => k.Email == dto.Email && k.MaKH != kh.MaKH))
        {
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Email nÃ y Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Æ°á»£c sá»­ dá»¥ng bá»Ÿi tÃ i khoáº£n khÃ¡c."));
        }

        kh.HoTen = dto.HoTen?.Trim() ?? kh.HoTen;
        kh.Email = dto.Email?.Trim() ?? kh.Email;
        kh.SoDienThoai = dto.SoDienThoai;
        kh.NgaySinh = dto.NgaySinh;
        kh.GioiTinh = dto.GioiTinh;
        kh.DiaChi = dto.DiaChi;
        kh.SoThich = dto.SoThich;

        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(new
        {
            kh.MaKH,
            kh.HoTen,
            kh.Email,
            kh.SoDienThoai,
            kh.NgaySinh,
            kh.GioiTinh,
            kh.DiaChi,
            kh.SoThich
        }, "Cáº­p nháº­t thÃ´ng tin cÃ¡ nhÃ¢n thÃ nh cÃ´ng."));
    }

    public async Task<IActionResult> ToggleLock(int id)
    {
        var tk = await _db.TaiKhoans
            .Include(t => t.KhachHang)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(t => t.KhachHang != null && t.KhachHang.MaKH == id);
        if (tk is null) return NotFound(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y."));
        if (tk.KhachHang!.DaXoa) return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("KhÃ¡ch hÃ ng Ä‘Ã£ bá»‹ xÃ³a."));
        if (User.IsInRole("QuanLy") && tk.MaVaiTro != 2)
            return Forbid();
        tk.TrangThai = !tk.TrangThai;
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(new { tk.TrangThai }, tk.TrangThai ? "ÄÃ£ má»Ÿ khÃ³a tÃ i khoáº£n." : "ÄÃ£ khÃ³a tÃ i khoáº£n."));
    }

using FashionCRM.API.Data;
using FashionCRM.API.DTOs;
using FashionCRM.API.Models;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace FashionCRM.API.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/khaosat")]
[Authorize]
public class KhaoSatController : ControllerBase
{
    private static readonly string[] QuestionTypes = { "Má»™t lá»±a chá»n", "Nhiá»u lá»±a chá»n", "Tá»± luáº­n", "ÄÃ¡nh giÃ¡ sao" };
    private readonly AppDbContext _db;

    public KhaoSatController(AppDbContext db) => _db = db;

    [HttpGet]
    [Authorize(Roles = "Admin,QuanLy")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetAll([FromQuery] QueryParams q)
    {
        var query = _db.KhaoSats.Include(k => k.CauHois).Include(k => k.PhieuKhaoSats).AsQueryable();
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(q.Search)) query = query.Where(k => k.TenKhaoSat.Contains(q.Search));
        var total = await query.CountAsync();
        var items = await query.OrderByDescending(k => k.NgayBatDau)
            .Skip(Math.Max(0, q.Page - 1) * Math.Clamp(q.PageSize, 1, 100)).Take(Math.Clamp(q.PageSize, 1, 100))
            .Select(k => new KhaoSatDto(
                k.MaKS, k.MaQL, k.TenKhaoSat, k.MoTa, k.NgayBatDau, k.NgayKetThuc, k.TrangThai,
                k.CauHois.Count, k.PhieuKhaoSats.Count(p => p.TrangThai == "ÄÃ£ hoÃ n thÃ nh"),
                k.PhieuKhaoSats.Count))
            .ToListAsync();

        return Ok(ApiResponse<PagedResult<KhaoSatDto>>.Ok(new PagedResult<KhaoSatDto>
        {
            Items = items, TotalItems = total, Page = q.Page, PageSize = Math.Clamp(q.PageSize, 1, 100)
        }));
    }

    [HttpGet("my")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetMy()
    {
        if (!User.IsInRole("KhachHang")) return Forbid();
        if (!int.TryParse(User.FindFirst("maTK")?.Value, out var maTK)) return Unauthorized();

        var kh = await _db.KhachHangs.Include(k => k.TaiKhoan)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(k => k.MaTK == maTK && !k.DaXoa);
        if (kh == null || !kh.TaiKhoan.TrangThai) return Unauthorized(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("TÃ i khoáº£n khÃ¡ch hÃ ng khÃ´ng hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng."));

        var now = DateTime.Now;
        var eligibleSurveyIds = await _db.KhaoSats
            .Where(survey => survey.TrangThai && survey.NgayKetThuc >= now)
            .Select(survey => survey.MaKS)
            .ToListAsync();
        var assignedIds = await _db.PhieuKhaoSats.Where(ticket => ticket.MaKH == kh.MaKH)
            .Select(ticket => ticket.MaKS).ToListAsync();
        var missingTickets = eligibleSurveyIds.Except(assignedIds).Select(surveyId => new PhieuKhaoSat
        {
            MaKS = surveyId,
            MaKH = kh.MaKH,
            NgayBatDau = now,
            TrangThai = "Äang lÃ m"
        }).ToList();
        if (missingTickets.Count > 0)
        {
            _db.PhieuKhaoSats.AddRange(missingTickets);
            await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        }

        var tickets = await _db.PhieuKhaoSats
            .Include(ticket => ticket.KhaoSat).ThenInclude(survey => survey.CauHois).ThenInclude(question => question.LuaChons)
            .Include(ticket => ticket.TraLois)
            .Where(ticket => ticket.MaKH == kh.MaKH)
            .OrderByDescending(ticket => ticket.KhaoSat.NgayBatDau)
            .ToListAsync();

        return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(tickets.Select(ticket => new
        {
            ticket.MaPhieuKS,
            ticket.TrangThai,
            IsOpen = ticket.KhaoSat.TrangThai && ticket.KhaoSat.NgayBatDau <= now && ticket.KhaoSat.NgayKetThuc >= now,
            KhaoSat = new KhaoSatDto(
                ticket.KhaoSat.MaKS, ticket.KhaoSat.MaQL, ticket.KhaoSat.TenKhaoSat, ticket.KhaoSat.MoTa,
                ticket.KhaoSat.NgayBatDau, ticket.KhaoSat.NgayKetThuc, ticket.KhaoSat.TrangThai,
                ticket.KhaoSat.CauHois.Count,
                ticket.KhaoSat.PhieuKhaoSats.Count(x => x.TrangThai == "ÄÃ£ hoÃ n thÃ nh")),
            CauHois = ticket.KhaoSat.CauHois.OrderBy(question => question.ThuTu).Select(question => new
            {
                question.MaCauHoi, question.NoiDung, question.LoaiCauHoi, question.BatBuoc,
                LuaChons = question.LuaChons.OrderBy(option => option.ThuTu).Select(option => new { option.MaLuaChon, option.NoiDung }),
                TraLois = ticket.TraLois.Where(answer => answer.MaCauHoi == question.MaCauHoi)
                    .Select(answer => new { answer.MaLuaChon, answer.NoiDungTraLoi, answer.SoSao })
            })
        }).ToList()));
    }

    [HttpGet("{id:int}/detail")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetDetail(int id)
    {
        var survey = await _db.KhaoSats
            .Include(item => item.CauHois).ThenInclude(question => question.LuaChons)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(item => item.MaKS == id);
        if (survey == null) return NotFound(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y kháº£o sÃ¡t."));

        if (User.IsInRole("KhachHang"))
        {
            if (!int.TryParse(User.FindFirst("maTK")?.Value, out var maTK)) return Unauthorized();
            var customerId = await _db.KhachHangs.Where(customer => customer.MaTK == maTK && !customer.DaXoa)
                .Select(customer => (int?)customer.MaKH).FirstOrDefaultAsync();
            if (customerId == null || !await _db.PhieuKhaoSats.AnyAsync(ticket => ticket.MaKS == id && ticket.MaKH == customerId))
                return Forbid();
        }
        else if (!User.IsInRole("Admin") && !User.IsInRole("QuanLy")) return Forbid();

        return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(new
        {
            survey.MaKS, survey.TenKhaoSat, survey.MoTa, survey.NgayBatDau, survey.NgayKetThuc,
            survey.TrangThai,
            CauHois = survey.CauHois.OrderBy(question => question.ThuTu).Select(question => new
            {
                question.MaCauHoi, question.NoiDung, question.LoaiCauHoi, question.ThuTu, question.BatBuoc,
                LuaChons = question.LuaChons.OrderBy(option => option.ThuTu).Select(option => new { option.MaLuaChon, option.NoiDung })
            })
        }));
    }

    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Create([FromBody] KhaoSatCreateDto dto)
    {
        if (dto == null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dto.TenKhaoSat) || dto.TenKhaoSat.Trim().Length > 200)
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("TÃªn kháº£o sÃ¡t báº¯t buá»™c vÃ  khÃ´ng quÃ¡ 200 kÃ½ tá»±."));
        if (dto.NgayBatDau < DateTime.Now.AddMinutes(-1) || dto.NgayKetThuc <= dto.NgayBatDau)
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Thá»i gian kháº£o sÃ¡t khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡."));
        if (dto.CauHois == null || dto.CauHois.Count == 0)
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("BÃ i kháº£o sÃ¡t cáº§n Ã­t nháº¥t má»™t cÃ¢u há»i."));

        foreach (var question in dto.CauHois)
        {
            if (question == null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(question.NoiDung) || question.NoiDung.Trim().Length > 1000
                || !QuestionTypes.Contains(question.LoaiCauHoi, StringComparer.Ordinal))
                return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("CÃ¢u há»i thiáº¿u ná»™i dung hoáº·c cÃ³ loáº¡i khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡."));
            if (question.LoaiCauHoi is "Má»™t lá»±a chá»n" or "Nhiá»u lá»±a chá»n")
            {
                var options = question.LuaChons?.Where(value => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)).Select(value => value.Trim()).ToList() ?? new();
                if (options.Count < 2 || options.Count > 100 || options.Any(value => value.Length > 500)
                    || options.Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).Count() != options.Count)
                    return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("CÃ¢u há»i lá»±a chá»n cáº§n Ã­t nháº¥t hai phÆ°Æ¡ng Ã¡n khÃ¡c nhau."));
            }
        }

        if (!int.TryParse(User.FindFirst("maTK")?.Value, out var accountId)) return Unauthorized();
        var manager = await _db.QuanLys.FirstOrDefaultAsync(item => item.MaTK == accountId);
        if (manager == null) return Forbid();

        var survey = new KhaoSat
        {
            MaQL = manager.MaQL,
            TenKhaoSat = dto.TenKhaoSat.Trim(),
            MoTa = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dto.MoTa) ? null : dto.MoTa.Trim(),
            NgayBatDau = dto.NgayBatDau,
            NgayKetThuc = dto.NgayKetThuc,
            TrangThai = true,
            CauHois = dto.CauHois.Select((question, index) => new CauHoiKhaoSat
            {
                NoiDung = question.NoiDung.Trim(),
                LoaiCauHoi = question.LoaiCauHoi,
                ThuTu = question.ThuTu > 0 ? question.ThuTu : index + 1,
                BatBuoc = question.BatBuoc,
                LuaChons = (question.LuaChons ?? new()).Where(option => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(option)).Select(option => option.Trim()).Select((option, optionIndex) => new LuaChonCauHoi
                {
                    NoiDung = option.Trim(),
                    ThuTu = optionIndex + 1
                }).ToList()
            }).ToList()
        };

        await using var transaction = await _db.Database.BeginTransactionAsync();
        _db.KhaoSats.Add(survey);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        var activeCustomers = await _db.KhachHangs
            .Where(customer => !customer.DaXoa && customer.TaiKhoan.TrangThai && customer.TaiKhoan.MaVaiTro == 2)
            .Select(customer => customer.MaKH)
            .ToListAsync();
        _db.PhieuKhaoSats.AddRange(activeCustomers.Select(customerId => new PhieuKhaoSat
        {
            MaKS = survey.MaKS,
            MaKH = customerId,
            NgayBatDau = DateTime.Now,
            TrangThai = "Äang lÃ m"
        }));
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        await transaction.CommitAsync();

        var message = $"ÄÃ£ táº¡o kháº£o sÃ¡t vÃ  phÃ¡t phiáº¿u cho {activeCustomers.Count} khÃ¡ch hÃ ng Ä‘ang hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng.";
        return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(new { survey.MaKS }, message));
    }

    [HttpPost("{id:int}/send")]
    [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> SendToCustomers(int id, [FromBody] List<int>? maKHList)
    {
        var survey = await _db.KhaoSats.FirstOrDefaultAsync(item => item.MaKS == id);
        if (survey == null) return NotFound(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y kháº£o sÃ¡t."));
        if (!survey.TrangThai || survey.NgayKetThuc < DateTime.Now)
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ phÃ¡t phiáº¿u cho kháº£o sÃ¡t Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Ã³ng hoáº·c háº¿t háº¡n."));

        var selected = (maKHList ?? new()).Distinct().ToList();
        var customers = await _db.KhachHangs
            .Where(customer => selected.Contains(customer.MaKH) && !customer.DaXoa
                && customer.TaiKhoan.TrangThai && customer.TaiKhoan.MaVaiTro == 2)
            .Select(customer => customer.MaKH).ToListAsync();
        var existing = await _db.PhieuKhaoSats.Where(ticket => ticket.MaKS == id && customers.Contains(ticket.MaKH))
            .Select(ticket => ticket.MaKH).ToListAsync();
        var newIds = customers.Except(existing).ToList();
        _db.PhieuKhaoSats.AddRange(newIds.Select(customerId => new PhieuKhaoSat
        {
            MaKS = id, MaKH = customerId, NgayBatDau = DateTime.Now, TrangThai = "Äang lÃ m"
        }));
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(new { Sent = newIds.Count }, $"ÄÃ£ phÃ¡t phiáº¿u cho {newIds.Count} khÃ¡ch hÃ ng Ä‘ang hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng."));
    }

    [HttpPost("{id:int}/close")]
    [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Close(int id)
    {
        var survey = await _db.KhaoSats.FindAsync(id);
        if (survey == null) return NotFound(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y kháº£o sÃ¡t."));
        survey.TrangThai = false;
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(new { survey.MaKS }, "ÄÃ£ Ä‘Ã³ng kháº£o sÃ¡t."));
    }

    [HttpPost("submit")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Submit([FromBody] SubmitSurveyDto dto)
    {
        if (!User.IsInRole("KhachHang")) return Forbid();
        if (dto == null || dto.MaPhieuKS <= 0 || dto.TraLois == null)
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Dá»¯ liá»‡u cÃ¢u tráº£ lá»i khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡."));
        if (!int.TryParse(User.FindFirst("maTK")?.Value, out var maTK)) return Unauthorized();

        var customer = await _db.KhachHangs.Include(item => item.TaiKhoan)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(item => item.MaTK == maTK && !item.DaXoa);
        if (customer == null || !customer.TaiKhoan.TrangThai) return Unauthorized(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("TÃ i khoáº£n khÃ¡ch hÃ ng khÃ´ng hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng."));

        var ticket = await _db.PhieuKhaoSats
            .Include(item => item.KhaoSat).ThenInclude(survey => survey.CauHois).ThenInclude(question => question.LuaChons)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(item => item.MaPhieuKS == dto.MaPhieuKS && item.MaKH == customer.MaKH);
        if (ticket == null) return NotFound(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y phiáº¿u kháº£o sÃ¡t cá»§a báº¡n."));
        if (ticket.TrangThai == "ÄÃ£ hoÃ n thÃ nh") return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Phiáº¿u Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Æ°á»£c ná»™p trÆ°á»›c Ä‘Ã³."));
        var now = DateTime.Now;
        if (!ticket.KhaoSat.TrangThai || ticket.KhaoSat.NgayBatDau > now || ticket.KhaoSat.NgayKetThuc < now)
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Kháº£o sÃ¡t chÆ°a má»Ÿ hoáº·c Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Ã³ng/háº¿t háº¡n."));

        var questions = ticket.KhaoSat.CauHois.ToList();
        var unknownQuestionIds = dto.TraLois.Select(answer => answer.MaCauHoi).Distinct()
            .Except(questions.Select(question => question.MaCauHoi)).ToList();
        if (unknownQuestionIds.Count > 0) return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("CÃ³ cÃ¢u há»i khÃ´ng thuá»™c kháº£o sÃ¡t nÃ y."));

        foreach (var question in questions)
        {
            var answers = dto.TraLois.Where(answer => answer.MaCauHoi == question.MaCauHoi).ToList();
            if (question.LoaiCauHoi == "Má»™t lá»±a chá»n")
            {
                if (answers.Count > 1 || (question.BatBuoc && (answers.Count == 0 || !answers[0].MaLuaChon.HasValue)))
                    return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("CÃ¢u há»i má»™t lá»±a chá»n cáº§n Ä‘Ãºng má»™t phÆ°Æ¡ng Ã¡n."));
                if (answers.Any(answer => !question.LuaChons.Any(option => option.MaLuaChon == answer.MaLuaChon)))
                    return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("PhÆ°Æ¡ng Ã¡n khÃ´ng thuá»™c cÃ¢u há»i Ä‘Ã£ chá»n."));
            }
            else if (question.LoaiCauHoi == "Nhiá»u lá»±a chá»n")
            {
                if (question.BatBuoc && answers.Count == 0)
                    return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Vui lÃ²ng tráº£ lá»i Ä‘áº§y Ä‘á»§ cÃ¡c cÃ¢u há»i báº¯t buá»™c."));
                if (answers.Any(answer => !answer.MaLuaChon.HasValue || !question.LuaChons.Any(option => option.MaLuaChon == answer.MaLuaChon))
                    || answers.Select(answer => answer.MaLuaChon).Distinct().Count() != answers.Count)
                    return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("CÃ³ phÆ°Æ¡ng Ã¡n nhiá»u lá»±a chá»n khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡."));
            }
            else if (question.LoaiCauHoi == "ÄÃ¡nh giÃ¡ sao")
            {
                if (answers.Count > 1 || (question.BatBuoc && answers.Count == 0)
                    || answers.Any(answer => !answer.SoSao.HasValue || answer.SoSao < 1 || answer.SoSao > 5))
                    return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("ÄÃ¡nh giÃ¡ sao pháº£i tá»« 1 Ä‘áº¿n 5."));
            }
            else if (question.LoaiCauHoi == "Tá»± luáº­n")
            {
                if (answers.Count > 1 || (question.BatBuoc && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(answers.FirstOrDefault()?.NoiDungTraLoi))
                    || answers.Any(answer => (answer.NoiDungTraLoi?.Length ?? 0) > 4000))
                    return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("CÃ¢u tráº£ lá»i tá»± luáº­n khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡ hoáº·c vÆ°á»£t quÃ¡ 4.000 kÃ½ tá»±."));
            }
        }

        _db.TraLoiKhaoSats.AddRange(dto.TraLois.Select(answer => new TraLoiKhaoSat
        {
            MaPhieuKS = ticket.MaPhieuKS,
            MaCauHoi = answer.MaCauHoi,
            MaLuaChon = answer.MaLuaChon,
            NoiDungTraLoi = answer.NoiDungTraLoi?.Trim(),
            SoSao = answer.SoSao,
            NgayNop = now
        }));
        ticket.TrangThai = "ÄÃ£ hoÃ n thÃ nh";
        ticket.NgayNop = now;
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(null!, "Ná»™p kháº£o sÃ¡t thÃ nh cÃ´ng."));
    }
}

public record SubmitSurveyDto(int MaPhieuKS, List<TraLoiDto> TraLois);
public record TraLoiDto(int MaCauHoi, int? MaLuaChon, string? NoiDungTraLoi, int? SoSao);

using FashionCRM.API.Data;
using FashionCRM.API.DTOs;
using FashionCRM.API.Models;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace FashionCRM.API.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/phanhoi")]
[Authorize]
public class PhanHoiController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly AppDbContext _db;
    public PhanHoiController(AppDbContext db) => _db = db;

    [HttpGet]
    [Authorize(Roles = "Admin,QuanLy")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetAll([FromQuery] QueryParams q, [FromQuery] string? trangThai, [FromQuery] string? loai, [FromQuery] int? soSao)
    {
        var query = _db.PhanHois
            .AsNoTracking()
            .AsQueryable();

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(trangThai)) query = query.Where(p => p.TrangThai == trangThai);
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(loai))      query = query.Where(p => p.LoaiPhanHoi == loai);
        if (soSao.HasValue) query = query.Where(p => p.SoSao == soSao.Value);

        var ordered = q.SortDir == "asc"
            ? query.OrderBy(p => p.NgayGui)
            : query.OrderByDescending(p => p.NgayGui);
        var rows = await ordered.Select(p => new PhanHoiDto(
            p.MaPH, p.MaKH, p.KhachHang.HoTen,
            p.MaSP, p.SanPham != null ? p.SanPham.TenSP : null,
            p.TieuDe, p.NoiDung, p.LoaiPhanHoi, p.SoSao,
            p.TrangThai, p.PhanHoiQuanLy, p.NgayGui, p.NgayXuLy))
            .ToListAsync();
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(q.Search))
        {
            string term = NormalizeSearchText(q.Search);
            if (term.Length > 0)
                rows = rows.Where(item => NormalizeSearchText($"{item.HoTenKH} {item.TenSP} {item.TieuDe} {item.NoiDung} {item.PhanHoiQuanLy}").Contains(term)).ToList();
        }

        int page = Math.Max(q.Page, 1);
        int pageSize = Math.Clamp(q.PageSize, 1, 100);
        var total = rows.Count;
        var items = rows.Skip((page - 1) * pageSize).Take(pageSize).ToList();

        return Ok(ApiResponse<PagedResult<PhanHoiDto>>.Ok(
            new PagedResult<PhanHoiDto> { Items = items, TotalItems = total, Page = page, PageSize = pageSize }));
    }

    // GET /api/phanhoi/my  â€” khÃ¡ch hÃ ng xem cá»§a mÃ¬nh
    [HttpGet("my")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetMy()
    {
        var maTK = int.Parse(User.FindFirst("maTK")!.Value);
        var kh   = await _db.KhachHangs.FirstOrDefaultAsync(k => k.MaTK == maTK);
        if (kh is null) return NotFound();

        var items = await _db.PhanHois
            .Include(p => p.SanPham)
            .Where(p => p.MaKH == kh.MaKH)
            .OrderByDescending(p => p.NgayGui)
            .Select(p => ToDto(p))
            .ToListAsync();

        return Ok(ApiResponse<IEnumerable<PhanHoiDto>>.Ok(items));
    }

    [HttpGet("{id:int}")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetById(int id)
    {
        var p = await _db.PhanHois
            .Include(x => x.KhachHang).Include(x => x.SanPham)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.MaPH == id);
        if (p is null) return NotFound(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y."));
        return Ok(ApiResponse<PhanHoiDto>.Ok(ToDto(p)));
    }

    [HttpPost]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Create([FromBody] PhanHoiCreateDto dto)
    {
        if (!User.IsInRole("KhachHang"))
            return Forbid();

        if (!int.TryParse(User.FindFirst("maTK")?.Value, out var maTK)) return Unauthorized();
        var kh = await _db.KhachHangs.Include(customer => customer.TaiKhoan)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(customer => customer.MaTK == maTK && !customer.DaXoa);
        if (kh is null) return Unauthorized(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("TÃ i khoáº£n hiá»‡n táº¡i khÃ´ng thuá»™c khÃ¡ch hÃ ng nÃ o."));
        if (!kh.TaiKhoan.TrangThai) return Unauthorized(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("TÃ i khoáº£n khÃ¡ch hÃ ng khÃ´ng hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng."));

        if (dto.SoSao.HasValue && dto.SoSao.Value is < 1 or > 5)
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Sá»‘ sao pháº£i náº±m trong khoáº£ng tá»« 1 Ä‘áº¿n 5."));

        var ph = new PhanHoi
        {
            MaKH = kh.MaKH, MaSP = dto.MaSP, TieuDe = dto.TieuDe,
            NoiDung = dto.NoiDung, LoaiPhanHoi = dto.LoaiPhanHoi, SoSao = dto.SoSao,
            TrangThai = "ChÆ°a xá»­ lÃ½", NgayGui = DateTime.Now
        };
        _db.PhanHois.Add(ph);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(new { ph.MaPH }, "Gá»­i pháº£n há»“i thÃ nh cÃ´ng."));
    }

    // PATCH /api/phanhoi/{id}/reply  â€” quáº£n lÃ½ pháº£n há»“i
    [HttpPatch("{id:int}/reply")]
    [Authorize(Roles = "Admin,QuanLy")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Reply(int id, [FromBody] PhanHoiReplyDto dto)
    {
        var ph = await _db.PhanHois.FindAsync(id);
        if (ph is null) return NotFound(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y."));
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dto.PhanHoiQuanLy))
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Ná»™i dung phÃºc Ä‘Ã¡p khÃ´ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c Ä‘á»ƒ trá»‘ng."));
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ph.PhanHoiQuanLy) || ph.NgayXuLy.HasValue || ph.TrangThai == "ÄÃ£ xá»­ lÃ½")
            return Conflict(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Pháº£n há»“i nÃ y Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Æ°á»£c phÃºc Ä‘Ã¡p."));

        if (!int.TryParse(User.FindFirst("maTK")?.Value, out var maTK)) return Unauthorized();
        var ql = await _db.QuanLys.FirstOrDefaultAsync(q => q.MaTK == maTK);
        if (ql is null) return Unauthorized(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("TÃ i khoáº£n hiá»‡n táº¡i khÃ´ng thuá»™c quáº£n lÃ½ nÃ o."));

        var reply = dto.PhanHoiQuanLy.Trim();
        var now = DateTime.Now;
        int updated = await _db.PhanHois
            .Where(item => item.MaPH == id && (item.PhanHoiQuanLy == null || item.PhanHoiQuanLy == "")
                && item.NgayXuLy == null && item.TrangThai != "ÄÃ£ xá»­ lÃ½")
            .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters
                .SetProperty(item => item.MaQL, (int?)ql.MaQL)
                .SetProperty(item => item.PhanHoiQuanLy, reply)
                .SetProperty(item => item.TrangThai, "ÄÃ£ xá»­ lÃ½")
                .SetProperty(item => item.NgayXuLy, (DateTime?)now));
        if (updated == 0) return Conflict(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Pháº£n há»“i nÃ y Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Æ°á»£c phÃºc Ä‘Ã¡p."));
        return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(new { NgayXuLy = now }, "ÄÃ£ cáº­p nháº­t pháº£n há»“i."));
    }

    private static PhanHoiDto ToDto(PhanHoi p) => new(
        p.MaPH, p.MaKH, p.KhachHang?.HoTen ?? "",
        p.MaSP, p.SanPham?.TenSP,
        p.TieuDe, p.NoiDung, p.LoaiPhanHoi,
        p.SoSao, p.TrangThai, p.PhanHoiQuanLy, p.NgayGui, p.NgayXuLy);

    private static string NormalizeSearchText(string value)
    {
        var decomposed = value.Replace('Ä‘', 'd').Replace('Ä', 'D').Normalize(System.Text.NormalizationForm.FormD);
        return new string(decomposed
            .Where(character => System.Globalization.CharUnicodeInfo.GetUnicodeCategory(character) != System.Globalization.UnicodeCategory.NonSpacingMark)
            .Where(char.IsLetterOrDigit)
            .Select(char.ToLowerInvariant)
            .ToArray());
    }
}

using FashionCRM.API.Data;
using FashionCRM.API.DTOs;
using FashionCRM.API.Models;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace FashionCRM.API.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/sanpham")]
public class SanPhamController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly AppDbContext _db;
    public SanPhamController(AppDbContext db) => _db = db;

    // GET /api/sanpham
    [HttpGet]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetAll(
        [FromQuery] QueryParams q,
        [FromQuery] int? maDM,
        [FromQuery] decimal? giaMin,
        [FromQuery] decimal? giaMax,
        [FromQuery] bool? trangThai)
    {
        int page = Math.Max(q.Page, 1);
        int pageSize = Math.Clamp(q.PageSize, 1, 100);
        var query = _db.SanPhams.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(s => !s.DaXoa && s.DanhMuc.TrangThai);
        if (!User.IsInRole("Admin") && !User.IsInRole("QuanLy"))
            query = query.Where(s => s.TrangThai);

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(q.Search))
            query = query.Where(s => s.TenSP.Contains(q.Search) ||
                                     s.SoLuongSps.Any(v => v.MauSac.Contains(q.Search)) ||
                                     (s.ChatLieu != null && s.ChatLieu.Contains(q.Search)));
        if (maDM.HasValue)     query = query.Where(s => s.MaDM == maDM.Value);
        if (giaMin.HasValue)   query = query.Where(s => s.SoLuongSps.Max(v => (decimal?)v.GiaBan) >= giaMin.Value);
        if (giaMax.HasValue)   query = query.Where(s => s.SoLuongSps.Max(v => (decimal?)v.GiaBan) <= giaMax.Value);
        if (trangThai.HasValue)query = query.Where(s => s.TrangThai == trangThai);

        query = q.SortBy switch
        {
            "gia"         => q.SortDir == "asc" ? query.OrderBy(s => s.Gia) : query.OrderByDescending(s => s.Gia),
            "tenSP"       => q.SortDir == "asc" ? query.OrderBy(s => s.TenSP) : query.OrderByDescending(s => s.TenSP),
            "soLuongTon"  => q.SortDir == "asc" ? query.OrderBy(s => s.SoLuongSps.Sum(v => (int?)v.SoLuongTon)) : query.OrderByDescending(s => s.SoLuongSps.Sum(v => (int?)v.SoLuongTon)),
            _             => query.OrderByDescending(s => s.NgayTao)
        };

        var total = await query.CountAsync();
        var items = await query
            .Skip((page - 1) * pageSize)
            .Take(pageSize)
            .Select(s => new SanPhamDto(
                s.MaSP, s.MaDM, s.DanhMuc.TenDM, s.TenSP, s.SoLuongSps.Max(v => (decimal?)v.GiaBan) ?? 0m,
                s.SoLuongSps.Sum(v => (int?)v.SoLuongTon) ?? 0, s.MoTa,
                s.HinhAnh ?? s.SoLuongSps.OrderBy(v => v.MaSL).Select(v => v.HinhAnh).FirstOrDefault(),
                s.SoLuongSps.OrderBy(v => v.MaSL).Select(v => v.KichThuoc).FirstOrDefault(),
                s.SoLuongSps.OrderBy(v => v.MaSL).Select(v => v.MauSac).FirstOrDefault(), s.ChatLieu,
                s.TrangThai, s.NgayTao, s.HinhAnhMoTa))
            .ToListAsync();

        return Ok(ApiResponse<PagedResult<SanPhamDto>>.Ok(new PagedResult<SanPhamDto>
        {
            Items = items, TotalItems = total, Page = page, PageSize = pageSize
        }));
    }

    // GET /api/sanpham/{id}
    [HttpGet("{id:int}")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetById(int id)
    {
        var detailQuery = _db.SanPhams.AsNoTracking()
            .Include(x => x.DanhMuc)
            .Include(x => x.SoLuongSps)
            .Where(x => x.MaSP == id && !x.DaXoa && x.DanhMuc.TrangThai);
        if (!User.IsInRole("Admin") && !User.IsInRole("QuanLy"))
            detailQuery = detailQuery.Where(x => x.TrangThai);
        var s = await detailQuery.FirstOrDefaultAsync();
        if (s is null) return NotFound(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y sáº£n pháº©m."));
        return Ok(ApiResponse<SanPhamDto>.Ok(new SanPhamDto(
            s.MaSP, s.MaDM, s.DanhMuc.TenDM, s.TenSP, s.Gia,
            s.SoLuongTon, s.MoTa, s.HinhAnh ?? s.SoLuongSps.OrderBy(v => v.MaSL).Select(v => v.HinhAnh).FirstOrDefault(),
            s.KichThuoc, s.MauSac, s.ChatLieu, s.TrangThai, s.NgayTao, s.HinhAnhMoTa)));
    }

    [HttpPost]

        if (!await _db.DanhMucs.AnyAsync(category => category.MaDM == dto.MaDM && category.TrangThai))

            TrangThai = true, NgayTao = DateTime.Now
        };

        sp.TrangThai = dto.TrangThai;
