using FashionCRM.API.Data;
using FashionCRM.API.DTOs;
using FashionCRM.API.Models;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace FashionCRM.API.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/taikhoan")]
[Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]
public class TaiKhoanController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly AppDbContext _db;
    public TaiKhoanController(AppDbContext db) => _db = db;

    // GET /api/taikhoan
    [HttpGet]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetAll(
        [FromQuery] QueryParams q,
        [FromQuery] int? maVaiTro,
        [FromQuery] bool? trangThai)
    {
        var query = _db.TaiKhoans.Include(t => t.VaiTro).AsQueryable();

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(q.Search))
            query = query.Where(t => t.TenDangNhap.Contains(q.Search));
        if (maVaiTro.HasValue)   query = query.Where(t => t.MaVaiTro == maVaiTro);
        if (trangThai.HasValue)  query = query.Where(t => t.TrangThai == trangThai);

        query = q.SortBy switch
        {
            "tenDangNhap" => q.SortDir == "asc"
                ? query.OrderBy(t => t.TenDangNhap)
                : query.OrderByDescending(t => t.TenDangNhap),
            _ => query.OrderByDescending(t => t.NgayTao)
        };

        var total = await query.CountAsync();
        var items = await query
            .Skip((q.Page - 1) * q.PageSize).Take(q.PageSize)
            .Select(t => new TaiKhoanDto(t.MaTK, t.TenDangNhap, t.VaiTro.TenVaiTro, t.TrangThai, t.NgayTao))
            .ToListAsync();

        return Ok(ApiResponse<PagedResult<TaiKhoanDto>>.Ok(new PagedResult<TaiKhoanDto>
        {
            Items = items, TotalItems = total, Page = q.Page, PageSize = q.PageSize
        }));
    }

    // GET /api/taikhoan/{id}
    [HttpGet("{id:int}")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetById(int id)
    {
        var t = await _db.TaiKhoans.Include(x => x.VaiTro).FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.MaTK == id);
        if (t is null) return NotFound(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y tÃ i khoáº£n."));
        return Ok(ApiResponse<TaiKhoanDto>.Ok(new TaiKhoanDto(t.MaTK, t.TenDangNhap, t.VaiTro.TenVaiTro, t.TrangThai, t.NgayTao)));
    }

    // POST /api/taikhoan
    [HttpPost]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Create([FromBody] TaiKhoanCreateDto dto)
    {
        if (dto.MaVaiTro is not (1 or 2))
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Chá»‰ Ä‘Æ°á»£c táº¡o tÃ i khoáº£n khÃ¡ch hÃ ng hoáº·c quáº£n lÃ½."));
        var username = dto.TenDangNhap?.Trim();
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(username) || username.Length > 50 || username.Any(char.IsWhiteSpace))
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("TÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p pháº£i cÃ³ tá»‘i Ä‘a 50 kÃ½ tá»± vÃ  khÃ´ng chá»©a khoáº£ng tráº¯ng."));
        if (await _db.TaiKhoans.AnyAsync(t => t.TenDangNhap == username))
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("TÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p Ä‘Ã£ tá»“n táº¡i."));

        var tk = new TaiKhoan
        {
            TenDangNhap = username,
            MatKhau     = BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.HashPassword(dto.MatKhau),
            MaVaiTro    = dto.MaVaiTro,
            TrangThai   = true,
            NgayTao     = DateTime.Now
        };
        _db.TaiKhoans.Add(tk);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(new { tk.MaTK }, "Táº¡o tÃ i khoáº£n thÃ nh cÃ´ng."));
    }

    // POST /api/taikhoan/manager - Admin táº¡o tÃ i khoáº£n ná»™i bá»™ cho quáº£n lÃ½
    [HttpPost("manager")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> CreateManager([FromBody] QuanLyAccountCreateDto dto)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dto.TenDangNhap) || dto.TenDangNhap.Any(char.IsWhiteSpace)
            || dto.TenDangNhap.Trim().Length > 50 || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dto.MatKhau) ||
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dto.HoTen))
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("TÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p khÃ´ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c chá»©a khoáº£ng tráº¯ng; máº­t kháº©u vÃ  há» tÃªn lÃ  báº¯t buá»™c."));

        if (await _db.TaiKhoans.AnyAsync(t => t.TenDangNhap == dto.TenDangNhap))
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("TÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p Ä‘Ã£ tá»“n táº¡i."));

        await using var transaction = await _db.Database.BeginTransactionAsync();
        try
        {
            var taiKhoan = new TaiKhoan
            {
                TenDangNhap = dto.TenDangNhap.Trim(),
                MatKhau = BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.HashPassword(dto.MatKhau),
                MaVaiTro = 1,
                TrangThai = true,
                NgayTao = DateTime.Now
            };
            _db.TaiKhoans.Add(taiKhoan);
            await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

            _db.QuanLys.Add(new QuanLy
            {
                MaTK = taiKhoan.MaTK,
                HoTen = dto.HoTen.Trim(),
                Email = dto.Email,
                SoDienThoai = dto.SoDienThoai,
                ChucVu = dto.ChucVu,
                TrangThai = true
            });
            await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
            await transaction.CommitAsync();

            return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(new { taiKhoan.MaTK }, "Táº¡o tÃ i khoáº£n quáº£n lÃ½ thÃ nh cÃ´ng."));
        }
        catch
        {
            await transaction.RollbackAsync();
            throw;
        }
    }

    // PUT /api/taikhoan/{id}
    [HttpPut("{id:int}")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Update(int id, [FromBody] TaiKhoanUpdateDto dto)
    {
        var tk = await _db.TaiKhoans
            .Include(account => account.KhachHang)
            .Include(account => account.QuanLy)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(account => account.MaTK == id);
        if (tk is null) return NotFound(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y."));
        if (tk.MaVaiTro == 3)
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ thay Ä‘á»•i tÃ i khoáº£n Admin há»‡ thá»‘ng."));
        if (dto.MaVaiTro is not (1 or 2))
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Vai trÃ² chá»‰ Ä‘Æ°á»£c chuyá»ƒn giá»¯a KhÃ¡ch hÃ ng vÃ  Quáº£n lÃ½."));
        var previousRole = tk.MaVaiTro;

        if (previousRole == 1 && dto.MaVaiTro == 2)
        {
            var birthDate = tk.QuanLy?.NgaySinh ?? tk.KhachHang?.NgaySinh;
            var gender = tk.QuanLy?.GioiTinh ?? tk.KhachHang?.GioiTinh;
            var latestAllowedBirthDate = DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.Today.AddYears(-16).AddDays(-1));
            if (!birthDate.HasValue || birthDate.Value > latestAllowedBirthDate
                || !new[] { "Nam", "Ná»¯", "KhÃ¡c" }.Contains(gender, StringComparer.Ordinal))
                return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Cáº§n cáº­p nháº­t ngÃ y sinh há»£p lá»‡ vÃ  giá»›i tÃ­nh trong há»“ sÆ¡ quáº£n lÃ½ trÆ°á»›c khi chuyá»ƒn thÃ nh khÃ¡ch hÃ ng."));
        }

        if (dto.MaVaiTro == 1 && tk.QuanLy is null)
        {
            if (tk.KhachHang is null)
                return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("TÃ i khoáº£n khÃ´ng cÃ³ há»“ sÆ¡ Ä‘á»ƒ chuyá»ƒn thÃ nh Quáº£n lÃ½."));
            _db.QuanLys.Add(new QuanLy
            {
                MaTK = tk.MaTK,
                HoTen = tk.KhachHang.HoTen,
                Email = tk.KhachHang.Email,
                SoDienThoai = tk.KhachHang.SoDienThoai,
                NgaySinh = tk.KhachHang.NgaySinh,
                GioiTinh = tk.KhachHang.GioiTinh,
                ChucVu = "Quáº£n lÃ½ cá»­a hÃ ng",
                TrangThai = true
            });
        }
        else if (dto.MaVaiTro == 1 && tk.QuanLy is not null && tk.KhachHang is not null)
        {
            tk.QuanLy.NgaySinh = tk.KhachHang.NgaySinh;
            tk.QuanLy.GioiTinh = tk.KhachHang.GioiTinh;
        }
        else if (dto.MaVaiTro == 2 && tk.KhachHang is null)
        {
            var manager = tk.QuanLy;
            if (manager is null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(manager.Email))
                return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Quáº£n lÃ½ cáº§n cÃ³ email há»£p lá»‡ trÆ°á»›c khi chuyá»ƒn thÃ nh khÃ¡ch hÃ ng."));
            if (await _db.KhachHangs.AnyAsync(customer => customer.Email == manager.Email))
                return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Email há»“ sÆ¡ quáº£n lÃ½ Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Æ°á»£c má»™t khÃ¡ch hÃ ng khÃ¡c sá»­ dá»¥ng."));
            _db.KhachHangs.Add(new KhachHang
            {
                MaTK = tk.MaTK,
                HoTen = manager.HoTen,
                Email = manager.Email,
                SoDienThoai = manager.SoDienThoai,
                NgaySinh = manager.NgaySinh,
                GioiTinh = manager.GioiTinh,
                NgayDangKy = tk.NgayTao,
                DaXoa = false
            });
        }

        if (previousRole == 2 && dto.MaVaiTro == 1 && tk.KhachHang is not null && tk.QuanLy is not null)
        {
            tk.QuanLy.NgaySinh = tk.KhachHang.NgaySinh;
            tk.QuanLy.GioiTinh = tk.KhachHang.GioiTinh;
        }
        else if (previousRole == 1 && dto.MaVaiTro == 2 && tk.QuanLy is not null && tk.KhachHang is not null)
        {
            tk.KhachHang.NgaySinh = tk.QuanLy.NgaySinh ?? tk.KhachHang.NgaySinh;
            tk.KhachHang.GioiTinh = tk.QuanLy.GioiTinh ?? tk.KhachHang.GioiTinh;
        }

        tk.MaVaiTro  = dto.MaVaiTro;
        tk.TrangThai = dto.TrangThai;
        if (tk.QuanLy is not null)
            tk.QuanLy.TrangThai = dto.MaVaiTro == 1 && dto.TrangThai;
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(null!, "Cáº­p nháº­t thÃ nh cÃ´ng."));
    }

    // DELETE /api/taikhoan/{id}
    [HttpDelete("{id:int}")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Delete(int id)
    {
        var tk = await _db.TaiKhoans
            .Include(account => account.KhachHang)
            .Include(account => account.QuanLy)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(account => account.MaTK == id);
        if (tk is null) return NotFound(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y."));
        if (tk.MaVaiTro == 3)
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ xÃ³a tÃ i khoáº£n Admin há»‡ thá»‘ng."));
        if (tk.KhachHang is not null)
        {
            tk.KhachHang.DaXoa = true;
            tk.TrangThai = false;
        }
        else if (tk.QuanLy is not null)
        {
            tk.QuanLy.TrangThai = false;
            tk.TrangThai = false;
        }
        else
        {
            _db.TaiKhoans.Remove(tk);
        }
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(null!, "ÄÃ£ xÃ³a má»m vÃ  khÃ³a tÃ i khoáº£n."));
    }

    // PATCH /api/taikhoan/{id}/lock
    [HttpPatch("{id:int}/lock")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> ToggleLock(int id)
    {
        var tk = await _db.TaiKhoans.FindAsync(id);
        if (tk is null) return NotFound(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y."));
        if (tk.MaVaiTro == 3)
            return BadRequest(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ khÃ³a tÃ i khoáº£n Admin há»‡ thá»‘ng."));
        tk.TrangThai = !tk.TrangThai;
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return Ok(ApiResponse<object>.Ok(new { tk.TrangThai },
            tk.TrangThai ? "ÄÃ£ má»Ÿ khÃ³a tÃ i khoáº£n." : "ÄÃ£ khÃ³a tÃ i khoáº£n."));
    }

FILE: \backend\FashionCRM.API\Data\AppDbContext.cs

using FashionCRM.API.Models;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace FashionCRM.API.Data;

public class AppDbContext : DbContext
{
    public AppDbContext(DbContextOptions<AppDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    public DbSet<VaiTro> VaiTros { get; set; }
    public DbSet<TaiKhoan> TaiKhoans { get; set; }
    public DbSet<KhachHang> KhachHangs { get; set; }
    public DbSet<QuanLy> QuanLys { get; set; }
    public DbSet<DanhMuc> DanhMucs { get; set; }
    public DbSet<KhachHangSoThich> KhachHangSoThiches { get; set; }
    public DbSet<SanPham> SanPhams { get; set; }
    public DbSet<SoLuongSp> SoLuongSps { get; set; }
    public DbSet<PhanHoi> PhanHois { get; set; }
    public DbSet<DanhGia> DanhGias { get; set; }
    public DbSet<KhaoSat> KhaoSats { get; set; }
    public DbSet<CauHoiKhaoSat> CauHoiKhaoSats { get; set; }
    public DbSet<LuaChonCauHoi> LuaChonCauHois { get; set; }
    public DbSet<PhieuKhaoSat> PhieuKhaoSats { get; set; }
    public DbSet<TraLoiKhaoSat> TraLoiKhaoSats { get; set; }

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder mb)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(mb);

        mb.Entity<VaiTro>().ToTable("VAITRO");
        mb.Entity<TaiKhoan>().ToTable("TAIKHOAN");
        mb.Entity<KhachHang>().ToTable("KHACHHANG");
        mb.Entity<QuanLy>().ToTable("QUANLY");
        mb.Entity<DanhMuc>().ToTable("DANHMUC");
        mb.Entity<KhachHangSoThich>().ToTable("KHACHHANG_SOTHICH");
        mb.Entity<SanPham>().ToTable("SANPHAM");
        mb.Entity<SoLuongSp>().ToTable("SOLUONGSP");
        mb.Entity<PhanHoi>().ToTable("PHANHOI");
        mb.Entity<DanhGia>().ToTable("DANHGIA");
        mb.Entity<KhaoSat>().ToTable("KHAOSAT");
        mb.Entity<CauHoiKhaoSat>().ToTable("CAUHOI_KHAOSAT");
        mb.Entity<LuaChonCauHoi>().ToTable("LUACHON_CAUHOI");
        mb.Entity<PhieuKhaoSat>().ToTable("PHIEUKHAOSAT");
        mb.Entity<TraLoiKhaoSat>().ToTable("TRALOI_KHAOSAT");

        mb.Entity<VaiTro>(e =>
        {
            e.HasKey(x => x.MaVaiTro);
            e.HasIndex(x => x.TenVaiTro).IsUnique();
            e.Property(x => x.TenVaiTro).HasMaxLength(50);
        });

        mb.Entity<TaiKhoan>(e =>
        {
            e.HasKey(x => x.MaTK);
            e.HasIndex(x => x.TenDangNhap).IsUnique();
            e.Property(x => x.TenDangNhap).HasMaxLength(50);
            e.Property(x => x.MatKhau).HasMaxLength(255);
            e.HasOne(x => x.VaiTro)
                .WithMany(v => v.TaiKhoans)
                .HasForeignKey(x => x.MaVaiTro);
        });

        mb.Entity<QuanLy>(e =>
        {
            e.HasKey(x => x.MaQL);
            e.HasIndex(x => x.MaTK).IsUnique();
            e.HasOne(x => x.TaiKhoan)
                .WithOne(t => t.QuanLy)
                .HasForeignKey<QuanLy>(x => x.MaTK);
        });

        mb.Entity<KhachHang>(e =>
        {
            e.HasKey(x => x.MaKH);
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Email).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => x.MaTK).IsUnique();
            e.Property(x => x.HoTen).HasMaxLength(100);
            e.Property(x => x.Email).HasMaxLength(100);
            e.Property(x => x.GioiTinh).HasMaxLength(10);
            e.HasOne(x => x.TaiKhoan)
                .WithOne(t => t.KhachHang)
                .HasForeignKey<KhachHang>(x => x.MaTK);
        });

        mb.Entity<DanhMuc>(e =>
        {
            e.HasKey(x => x.MaDM);
            e.HasIndex(x => x.TenDM).IsUnique();
        });

        mb.Entity<KhachHangSoThich>(e =>
        {
            e.HasKey(x => new { x.MaKH, x.MaDM });
            e.Property(x => x.NgayChon).HasDefaultValueSql("GETDATE()");
            e.HasOne(x => x.KhachHang)
                .WithMany(k => k.KhachHangSoThiches)
                .HasForeignKey(x => x.MaKH)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            e.HasOne(x => x.DanhMuc)
                .WithMany(d => d.KhachHangSoThiches)
                .HasForeignKey(x => x.MaDM)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        mb.Entity<SanPham>(e =>
        {
            e.HasKey(x => x.MaSP);
            e.Property(x => x.TenSP).HasMaxLength(200);
            e.Property(x => x.HinhAnh).HasMaxLength(500);
            e.Property(x => x.HinhAnhMoTa).HasMaxLength(500);
            e.HasOne(x => x.DanhMuc)
                .WithMany(d => d.SanPhams)
                .HasForeignKey(x => x.MaDM);
        });

        mb.Entity<SoLuongSp>(e =>
        {
            e.HasKey(x => x.MaSL);
            e.HasIndex(x => x.SKU).IsUnique();
            e.Property(x => x.SKU).HasMaxLength(50);
            e.Property(x => x.KichThuoc).HasMaxLength(20);
            e.Property(x => x.MauSac).HasMaxLength(50);
            e.Property(x => x.GiaBan).HasColumnType("decimal(18,2)");
            e.HasOne(x => x.SanPham)
                .WithMany(s => s.SoLuongSps)
                .HasForeignKey(x => x.MaSP)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        mb.Entity<PhanHoi>(e =>
        {
            e.HasKey(x => x.MaPH);
            e.Property(x => x.TrangThai).HasMaxLength(30);
            e.HasOne(x => x.KhachHang).WithMany(k => k.PhanHois).HasForeignKey(x => x.MaKH);
            e.HasOne(x => x.SanPham).WithMany(s => s.PhanHois).HasForeignKey(x => x.MaSP).IsRequired(false);
            e.HasOne(x => x.QuanLy).WithMany(q => q.PhanHois).HasForeignKey(x => x.MaQL).IsRequired(false);
        });

        mb.Entity<DanhGia>(e =>
        {
            e.HasKey(x => x.MaDG);
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.MaKH, x.MaSP }).IsUnique();
            e.ToTable(table => table.HasCheckConstraint("CK_DANHGIA_SOSAO", "[SoSao] BETWEEN 1 AND 5"));
            e.HasOne(x => x.KhachHang).WithMany(k => k.DanhGias).HasForeignKey(x => x.MaKH);
            e.HasOne(x => x.SanPham).WithMany(s => s.DanhGias).HasForeignKey(x => x.MaSP);
        });

        mb.Entity<KhaoSat>(e =>
        {

// â”€â”€ Pagination wrapper â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
public class PagedResult<T>
{
    public IEnumerable<T> Items  { get; set; } = Enumerable.Empty<T>();
    public int TotalItems        { get; set; }
    public int Page              { get; set; }
    public int PageSize          { get; set; }
    public int TotalPages        => (int)Math.Ceiling((double)TotalItems / PageSize);
}

// â”€â”€ API response envelope â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
public class ApiResponse<T>
{
    public bool Success    { get; set; }
    public string Message  { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public T? Data         { get; set; }

    public static ApiResponse<T> Ok(T data, string msg = "ThÃ nh cÃ´ng")
        => new() { Success = true, Message = msg, Data = data };

    public static ApiResponse<T> Fail(string msg)
        => new() { Success = false, Message = msg };
}

using System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Text;
using FashionCRM.API.Models;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;

namespace FashionCRM.API.Helpers;

public class JwtHelper
{
    private readonly IConfiguration _config;

    public JwtHelper(IConfiguration config) => _config = config;

    public string GenerateToken(TaiKhoan tk, string hoTen, string? email)
    {
        var key = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(_config["Jwt:Key"]!));
        var creds = new SigningCredentials(key, SecurityAlgorithms.HmacSha256);
        var expires = DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(double.Parse(_config["Jwt:ExpireHours"] ?? "8"));
        var role = NormalizeRoleName(tk.VaiTro?.TenVaiTro ?? string.Empty);

        var claims = new[]
        {
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Sub, tk.MaTK.ToString()),
            new Claim("maTK", tk.MaTK.ToString()),
            new Claim("tenDangNhap", tk.TenDangNhap),
            new Claim("hoTen", hoTen),
            new Claim("vaiTro", role),
            new Claim(ClaimTypes.Role, role),
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Email, email ?? string.Empty),
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Jti, Guid.NewGuid().ToString()),
        };

        var token = new JwtSecurityToken(
            issuer: _config["Jwt:Issuer"],
            audience: _config["Jwt:Audience"],
            claims: claims,
            expires: expires,
            signingCredentials: creds
        );

        return new JwtSecurityTokenHandler().WriteToken(token);
    }

    public static string NormalizeRoleName(string roleName)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(roleName)) return "KhachHang";

        var normalized = roleName.Trim();
        if (normalized.Equals("Admin", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || normalized.Contains("Quáº£n trá»‹", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "Admin";

        if (normalized.Equals("QuanLy", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || normalized.Contains("Quáº£n lÃ½", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || normalized.Contains("Manager", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "QuanLy";

        return "KhachHang";
    }
}

using System.Text.Json;
using FashionCRM.API.Data;
using FashionCRM.API.DTOs;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace FashionCRM.API.Middleware;

public sealed class ActiveAccountMiddleware
{
    private readonly RequestDelegate _next;

    public ActiveAccountMiddleware(RequestDelegate next) => _next = next;

    public async Task InvokeAsync(HttpContext context, AppDbContext db)
    {
        if (context.User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true)
        {
            var idValue = context.User.FindFirst("maTK")?.Value;
            var hasId = int.TryParse(idValue, out var accountId);
            var account = hasId
                ? await db.TaiKhoans.AsNoTracking()
                    .Include(item => item.KhachHang)
                    .Include(item => item.QuanLy)
                    .FirstOrDefaultAsync(item => item.MaTK == accountId)
                : null;

            var tokenRole = context.User.FindFirst("vaiTro")?.Value;
            var accountRole = account?.MaVaiTro switch
            {
                1 => "QuanLy",
                2 => "KhachHang",
                3 => "Admin",
                _ => string.Empty
            };
            var profileIsActive = account is not null && (account.MaVaiTro switch
            {
                1 => account.QuanLy?.TrangThai == true,
                2 => account.KhachHang is { DaXoa: false },
                3 => true,
                _ => false
            });

            if (account is null || !account.TrangThai || !profileIsActive
                || !string.Equals(tokenRole, accountRole, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                var message = account is null || !account.TrangThai
                    || account.MaVaiTro == 1 && account.QuanLy?.TrangThai == false
                    || account.MaVaiTro == 2 && account.KhachHang?.DaXoa == true
                    ? "TÃ i khoáº£n Ä‘Ã£ bá»‹ khÃ³a hoáº·c khÃ´ng cÃ²n hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng."
                    : "Quyá»n tÃ i khoáº£n Ä‘Ã£ thay Ä‘á»•i. Vui lÃ²ng Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p láº¡i.";
                context.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status401Unauthorized;
                context.Response.ContentType = "application/json; charset=utf-8";
                await context.Response.WriteAsync(JsonSerializer.Serialize(ApiResponse<object>.Fail(message)));
                return;
            }
        }

        await _next(context);
    }
}

==================================================
using System.Net;
using System.Text.Json;
using FashionCRM.API.DTOs;

namespace FashionCRM.API.Middleware;

public class ExceptionMiddleware
{
    private readonly RequestDelegate _next;
    private readonly ILogger<ExceptionMiddleware> _logger;

    public ExceptionMiddleware(RequestDelegate next, ILogger<ExceptionMiddleware> logger)
    {
        _next   = next;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task InvokeAsync(HttpContext context)
    {
        try
        {
            await _next(context);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Unhandled exception: {Message}", ex.Message);
            context.Response.StatusCode  = (int)HttpStatusCode.InternalServerError;
            context.Response.ContentType = "application/json";
            var response = ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Lá»—i há»‡ thá»‘ng. Vui lÃ²ng thá»­ láº¡i sau.");
            await context.Response.WriteAsync(JsonSerializer.Serialize(response));
        }
    }
}

using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Schema;

namespace FashionCRM.API.Models;

public class SanPham
{
    public int MaSP { get; set; }
    public int MaDM { get; set; }
    public string TenSP { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string? MoTa { get; set; }
    public string? ChatLieu { get; set; }
    public bool TrangThai { get; set; } = true;
    public bool DaXoa { get; set; }
    public DateTime NgayTao { get; set; } = DateTime.Now;
    public string? HinhAnh { get; set; }
    public string? HinhAnhMoTa { get; set; }

    [NotMapped]
    public decimal Gia
    {
        get => SoLuongSps.OrderByDescending(x => x.GiaBan).FirstOrDefault()?.GiaBan ?? 0m;
        set
        {
            if (SoLuongSps.Count == 0)
            {
                SoLuongSps.Add(new SoLuongSp
                {
                    SKU = $"AUTO-{Guid.NewGuid():N}",
                    KichThuoc = "M",
                    MauSac = "Äen",
                    GiaBan = value,
                    SoLuongTon = 0,
                    TrangThai = true
                });
                return;
            }

            var item = SoLuongSps.OrderByDescending(x => x.GiaBan).First();
            item.GiaBan = value;
        }
    }

    [NotMapped]
    public int SoLuongTon
    {
        get => SoLuongSps.Sum(x => x.SoLuongTon);
        set
        {
            if (SoLuongSps.Count == 0)
            {
                SoLuongSps.Add(new SoLuongSp
                {
                    SKU = $"AUTO-{Guid.NewGuid():N}",
                    KichThuoc = "M",
                    MauSac = "Äen",
                    GiaBan = 0m,
                    SoLuongTon = value,
                    TrangThai = true
                });
                return;
            }

            var item = SoLuongSps.First();
            item.SoLuongTon = value;
        }
    }

    [NotMapped]
    public string? KichThuoc
    {
        get => SoLuongSps.FirstOrDefault()?.KichThuoc;
        set
        {
            if (SoLuongSps.Count == 0)
            {
                SoLuongSps.Add(new SoLuongSp
                {
                    SKU = $"AUTO-{Guid.NewGuid():N}",
                    KichThuoc = value ?? "M",
                    MauSac = "Äen",
                    GiaBan = 0m,
                    SoLuongTon = 0,
                    TrangThai = true
                });
                return;
            }

            SoLuongSps.First().KichThuoc = value ?? SoLuongSps.First().KichThuoc;
        }
    }

    [NotMapped]
    public string? MauSac
    {
        get => SoLuongSps.FirstOrDefault()?.MauSac;
        set
        {
            if (SoLuongSps.Count == 0)
            {
                SoLuongSps.Add(new SoLuongSp
                {
                    SKU = $"AUTO-{Guid.NewGuid():N}",
                    KichThuoc = "M",
                    MauSac = value ?? "Äen",
                    GiaBan = 0m,
                    SoLuongTon = 0,
                    TrangThai = true
                });
                return;
            }

            SoLuongSps.First().MauSac = value ?? SoLuongSps.First().MauSac;
        }
    }

    // Navigation
    public DanhMuc DanhMuc { get; set; } = null!;
    public ICollection<SoLuongSp> SoLuongSps { get; set; } = new List<SoLuongSp>();
    public ICollection<PhanHoi> PhanHois { get; set; } = new List<PhanHoi>();
    public ICollection<DanhGia> DanhGias { get; set; } = new List<DanhGia>();
}

public class SoLuongSp
{
    public int MaSL { get; set; }
    public int MaSP { get; set; }
    public string SKU { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string KichThuoc { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string MauSac { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public decimal GiaBan { get; set; }
    public int SoLuongTon { get; set; }
    public string? HinhAnh { get; set; }
    public bool TrangThai { get; set; } = true;

    [NotMapped]
    public decimal Gia => GiaBan;

using System.Text;
using FashionCRM.API.Data;
using FashionCRM.API.Helpers;
using FashionCRM.API.Middleware;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;
using FashionCRM.API.Models;
using Microsoft.OpenApi.Models;
using Microsoft.Extensions.FileProviders;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

// â”€â”€ Database â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
var dbConnectionString = ResolveConnectionString(builder.Configuration);
builder.Services.AddDbContext<AppDbContext>(opts =>
    opts.UseSqlServer(dbConnectionString));

// â”€â”€ JWT Authentication â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
var jwtKey = builder.Configuration["Jwt:Key"]!;
builder.Services
    .AddAuthentication(JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme)
    .AddJwtBearer(opts =>
    {
        opts.TokenValidationParameters = new TokenValidationParameters
        {
            ValidateIssuer           = true,
            ValidateAudience         = true,
            ValidateLifetime         = true,
            ValidateIssuerSigningKey = true,
            ValidIssuer              = builder.Configuration["Jwt:Issuer"],
            ValidAudience            = builder.Configuration["Jwt:Audience"],
            IssuerSigningKey         = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(jwtKey)),
            ClockSkew                = TimeSpan.Zero
        };
    });

builder.Services.AddAuthorization();

// â”€â”€ CORS â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
var allowedOrigins = builder.Configuration.GetSection("Cors:AllowedOrigins").Get<string[]>()
                     ?? new[] { "http://localhost:5500" };

builder.Services.AddCors(opts =>
    opts.AddPolicy("FrontendPolicy", policy =>
        policy.WithOrigins(allowedOrigins)
              .AllowAnyMethod()
              .AllowAnyHeader()
              .AllowCredentials()));

// â”€â”€ Services â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
builder.Services.AddSingleton<JwtHelper>();
builder.Services.AddControllers();
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();

// â”€â”€ Swagger â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen(c =>
{
    c.SwaggerDoc("v1", new OpenApiInfo
    {
        Title       = "Fashion CRM API",
        Version     = "v1",
        Description = "API cho há»‡ thá»‘ng CRM cá»­a hÃ ng thá»i trang"
    });

    // JWT in Swagger UI
    c.AddSecurityDefinition("Bearer", new OpenApiSecurityScheme
    {
        Name         = "Authorization",
        Type         = SecuritySchemeType.Http,
        Scheme       = "Bearer",
        BearerFormat = "JWT",
        In           = ParameterLocation.Header,
        Description  = "Nháº­p token JWT: Bearer {token}"
    });
    c.AddSecurityRequirement(new OpenApiSecurityRequirement
    {
        {
            new OpenApiSecurityScheme
            {
                Reference = new OpenApiReference { Type = ReferenceType.SecurityScheme, Id = "Bearer" }
            },
            Array.Empty<string>()
        }
    });
});

// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
var app = builder.Build();

// â”€â”€ Middleware pipeline â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

        db.Database.EnsureCreated();

    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        var log = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<ILogger<Program>>();

    }
}

static string ResolveConnectionString(IConfiguration config)
{
    var machineName = Environment.MachineName;

    // 1. Kiem tra cau hinh rieng theo ten may (Connection_TENMAY)
    var machineConn = config.GetConnectionString($"Connection_{machineName}");
    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(machineConn))
    {
        Console.WriteLine($"[Database] Tu dong nhan dien may ({machineName}): Su dung Connection_{machineName}");
        return machineConn;
    }

    // 2. Danh sach cac cau hinh du phong / tu dong do
    var candidates = new List<string>();
    var defaultConn = config.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection");
    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(defaultConn)) candidates.Add(defaultConn);

    candidates.Add(@"Server=.\SQLEXPRESS;Database=Fashion_store;Trusted_Connection=True;TrustServerCertificate=True;MultipleActiveResultSets=true;");
    candidates.Add(@"Server=.;Database=Fashion_store;Trusted_Connection=True;TrustServerCertificate=True;MultipleActiveResultSets=true;");
    candidates.Add(@"Server=localhost;Database=Fashion_store;Trusted_Connection=True;TrustServerCertificate=True;MultipleActiveResultSets=true;");
    candidates.Add(@"Server=LAPTOP-GSU7LU5K\MSSQLSERVER01;Database=Fashion_store;User Id=sa;Password=Bibi@0809;TrustServerCertificate=True;");

    foreach (var connStr in candidates.Distinct())
    {
        try
        {
            var testBuilder = new Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnectionStringBuilder(connStr) { ConnectTimeout = 2 };
            using var testConn = new Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnection(testBuilder.ConnectionString);
            testConn.Open();
            Console.WriteLine($"[Database] Tu dong ket noi thanh cong toi SQL Server: {testConn.DataSource} (May: {machineName})");
            return connStr;
        }
        catch { }
    }

    return defaultConn ?? candidates.First();
}

        let currentIdx = 0;
        let scale = 1.0;
        let posX = 0;
        let posY = 0;
        let isDragging = false;
        let startX = 0, startY = 0;

        const viewport = document.getElementById('viewport');
        const diagramImg = document.getElementById('diagramImg');
        const zoomText = document.getElementById('zoomText');
        const workspace = document.getElementById('workspace');
        const btnPng = document.getElementById('btnDownloadPng');
        const btnSvg = document.getElementById('btnDownloadSvg');
        const tabBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn');

        function updateTransform() {
            viewport.style.transform = `translate(${posX}px, ${posY}px) scale(${scale})`;
            zoomText.innerText = Math.round(scale * 100) + '%';
        }

        function switchDiagram(index) {
            currentIdx = index;
            tabBtns.forEach((btn, i) => {
                btn.classList.toggle('active', i === index);
            });

            const diag = diagrams[index];
            const pngPath = `so_do_he_thong/${diag.name}.png`;
            const svgPath = `so_do_he_thong/${diag.name}.svg`;

            diagramImg.src = pngPath;
            btnPng.href = pngPath;
            btnPng.download = `${diag.name}.png`;
            btnSvg.href = svgPath;
            btnSvg.download = `${diag.name}.svg`;

            resetZoom();
        }

        function zoomIn() {
            scale = Math.min(scale * 1.25, 6.0);
            updateTransform();
        }

        function zoomOut() {
            scale = Math.max(scale / 1.25, 0.2);
            updateTransform();
        }

        function resetZoom() {
            scale = 1.0;
            posX = 0;
            posY = 0;
            updateTransform();
        }

        function fitWidth() {
            scale = 1.5;
            posX = 0;
            posY = 0;
            updateTransform();
        }

        function toggleFullscreen() {
            if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
                document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
            } else {
                if (document.exitFullscreen) {
                    document.exitFullscreen();
                }
            }
        }

        // Mouse Wheel Zoom
        workspace.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            const delta = e.deltaY > 0 ? 0.85 : 1.15;
            scale = Math.max(0.2, Math.min(scale * delta, 6.0));
            updateTransform();
        }, { passive: false });

        // Drag & Pan
        workspace.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
            if (e.button === 0) {
                isDragging = true;
                startX = e.clientX - posX;
                startY = e.clientY - posY;

        });

        window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
            if (isDragging) {
                posX = e.clientX - startX;
                posY = e.clientY - startY;
                updateTransform();
            }
        });

        window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
            isDragging = false;

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.Cookies;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Fashion_store.Data;
using Fashion_store.Models;
using Fashion_store.ViewModels;

namespace Fashion_store.Controllers.Admin
{
    [Area("Admin")]
    [Authorize(Roles = "Quáº£n lÃ½, Admin")]
    public class AccountController : Controller
    {
        private readonly FashionStoreDbContext _context;

        public AccountController(FashionStoreDbContext context)
        {
            _context = context;
        }

        // ==========================================
        // 1. ÄÄ‚NG NHáº¬P ADMIN SYSTEM (LOGIN)
        // ==========================================
        [HttpGet]
        [AllowAnonymous]
        public IActionResult Login(string? returnUrl = null, bool locked = false)
        {
            if (User.Identity != null && User.Identity.IsAuthenticated)
            {
                if (User.IsInRole("Quáº£n lÃ½") || User.IsInRole("Admin"))
                    return RedirectToAction("Analytics", "Survey", new { area = "Admin" });

                var deniedModel = new LoginViewModel();
                ModelState.AddModelError(string.Empty, "TÃ i khoáº£n khÃ¡ch hÃ ng khÃ´ng thá»ƒ Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p vÃ o trang quáº£n trá»‹.");
                return View("~/Areas/Admin/Views/Account/Login.cshtml", deniedModel);
            }

            if (locked)
                ModelState.AddModelError(string.Empty, "TÃ i khoáº£n quáº£n lÃ½ cá»§a báº¡n Ä‘Ã£ bá»‹ khÃ³a. Vui lÃ²ng liÃªn há»‡ Admin.");
            ViewData["ReturnUrl"] = returnUrl;
            return View("~/Areas/Admin/Views/Account/Login.cshtml", new LoginViewModel());
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [AllowAnonymous]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Login(LoginViewModel model, string? returnUrl = null)
        {
            ViewData["ReturnUrl"] = returnUrl;

            if (!ModelState.IsValid)
            {
                return View("~/Areas/Admin/Views/Account/Login.cshtml", model);
            }

            string inputUsername = model.TenDangNhap?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;
            string inputPassword = model.MatKhau ?? string.Empty;
            if (inputUsername.Any(char.IsWhiteSpace))
            {
                ModelState.AddModelError(string.Empty, "TÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p hoáº·c máº­t kháº©u khÃ´ng Ä‘Ãºng.");
                model.MatKhau = string.Empty;
                ModelState.Remove("MatKhau");
                return View("~/Areas/Admin/Views/Account/Login.cshtml", model);
            }

            // TÃ¬m tÃ i khoáº£n theo TÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p hoáº·c Email
            var taiKhoan = await _context.TaiKhoan
                .Include(t => t.VaiTro)
                .Include(t => t.QuanLy)
                .Include(t => t.KhachHang)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(t => t.TenDangNhap == inputUsername 
                    || (t.QuanLy != null && t.QuanLy.Email == inputUsername)
                    || (t.KhachHang != null && t.KhachHang.Email == inputUsername));

            if (taiKhoan == null)
            {
                ModelState.AddModelError(string.Empty, "TÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p hoáº·c Email khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i trong há»‡ thá»‘ng.");
                model.MatKhau = string.Empty;
                ModelState.Remove("MatKhau");
                return View("~/Areas/Admin/Views/Account/Login.cshtml", model);
            }

            if (!PasswordHelper.VerifyAndUpgrade(taiKhoan, inputPassword))
            {
                ModelState.AddModelError(string.Empty, "Máº­t kháº©u khÃ´ng chÃ­nh xÃ¡c. Vui lÃ²ng kiá»ƒm tra láº¡i.");
                model.MatKhau = string.Empty;
                ModelState.Remove("MatKhau");
                return View("~/Areas/Admin/Views/Account/Login.cshtml", model);
            }

            if (!taiKhoan.TrangThai || (taiKhoan.MaVaiTro == 1 && taiKhoan.QuanLy?.TrangThai != true))
            {
                ModelState.AddModelError(string.Empty, "TÃ i khoáº£n cá»§a báº¡n Ä‘ang bá»‹ KHÃ“A. Vui lÃ²ng liÃªn há»‡ Quáº£n trá»‹ viÃªn.");
                model.MatKhau = string.Empty;
                ModelState.Remove("MatKhau");
                return View("~/Areas/Admin/Views/Account/Login.cshtml", model);
            }
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();

            if (taiKhoan.MaVaiTro is not (1 or 3))
            {
                ModelState.AddModelError(string.Empty, "Trang quáº£n trá»‹ chá»‰ dÃ nh cho Admin vÃ  Quáº£n lÃ½.");
                model.MatKhau = string.Empty;
                ModelState.Remove("MatKhau");
                return View("~/Areas/Admin/Views/Account/Login.cshtml", model);
            }

            string hoTen = taiKhoan.QuanLy?.HoTen ?? taiKhoan.KhachHang?.HoTen ?? taiKhoan.TenDangNhap;

            var claims = new List<Claim>
            {
                new Claim(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier, taiKhoan.MaTK.ToString()),
                new Claim(ClaimTypes.Name, taiKhoan.TenDangNhap),
                new Claim(ClaimTypes.Role, taiKhoan.VaiTro?.TenVaiTro ?? "KhÃ¡ch hÃ ng"),
                new Claim("HoTen", hoTen),
                new Claim("MaVaiTro", taiKhoan.MaVaiTro.ToString()),
                new Claim("UserType", taiKhoan.QuanLy != null ? "QUANLY" : "KHACHHANG")
            };

            var claimsIdentity = new ClaimsIdentity(claims, CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme);
            var authProperties = new AuthenticationProperties
            {
                IsPersistent = model.RememberMe,
                ExpiresUtc = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.AddHours(8)
            };

            await HttpContext.SignInAsync(
                CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme,
                new ClaimsPrincipal(claimsIdentity),
                authProperties);
            HttpContext.Session.SetInt32("MaTK", taiKhoan.MaTK);
            HttpContext.Session.SetInt32("MaVaiTro", taiKhoan.MaVaiTro);
            if (taiKhoan.KhachHang != null)
            {
                HttpContext.Session.SetInt32("MaKH", taiKhoan.KhachHang.MaKH);
            }
            // =====================================================================

            return RedirectToAction("Analytics", "Survey", new { area = "Admin" });
        }

        // ==========================================
        // 2. KHÃCH HÃ€NG ÄÄ‚NG KÃ TÃ€I KHOáº¢N Má»šI (CRM 4.3)
        // ==========================================
        [HttpPost]
        [AllowAnonymous]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public async Task<IActionResult> RegisterCustomer(RegisterCustomerViewModel model)
        {
            if (!ModelState.IsValid)
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "ThÃ´ng tin Ä‘Äƒng kÃ½ chÆ°a há»£p lá»‡. Vui lÃ²ng kiá»ƒm tra láº¡i.";
                return RedirectToAction(nameof(Login));
            }

            bool existsUsername = await _context.TaiKhoan.AnyAsync(t => t.TenDangNhap == model.TenDangNhap);
            if (existsUsername)
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = $"TÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p '{model.TenDangNhap}' Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Æ°á»£c sá»­ dá»¥ng.";
                return RedirectToAction(nameof(Login));
            }

            bool existsEmail = await _context.KhachHang.AnyAsync(k => k.Email == model.Email);
            if (existsEmail)
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = $"Email '{model.Email}' Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Æ°á»£c Ä‘Äƒng kÃ½ tÃ i khoáº£n khÃ¡ch hÃ ng.";
                return RedirectToAction(nameof(Login));
            }

            var vaiTroKH = await _context.VaiTro.FirstOrDefaultAsync(v => v.TenVaiTro.Contains("KhÃ¡ch"))
                           ?? await _context.VaiTro.FirstOrDefaultAsync(v => v.MaVaiTro == 2);
            int maVaiTro = vaiTroKH?.MaVaiTro ?? 2;

            var taiKhoan = new TaiKhoan
            {
                TenDangNhap = model.TenDangNhap,
                MatKhau = PasswordHelper.Hash(model.MatKhau),
                MaVaiTro = maVaiTro,
                TrangThai = true,
                NgayTao = DateTime.Now
            };

            _context.TaiKhoan.Add(taiKhoan);
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();

            var khachHang = new KhachHang
            {
                MaTK = taiKhoan.MaTK,
                HoTen = model.HoTen,
                Email = model.Email,
                SoDienThoai = model.SoDienThoai,
                NgayDangKy = DateTime.Now,
                DaXoa = false
            };

            _context.KhachHang.Add(khachHang);
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();

            TempData["SuccessMessage"] = "ÄÄƒng kÃ½ tÃ i khoáº£n khÃ¡ch hÃ ng thÃ nh cÃ´ng! Báº¡n cÃ³ thá»ƒ Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p ngay.";
            return RedirectToAction(nameof(Login));
        }

        // ==========================================
        // 3. ÄÄ‚NG XUáº¤T (LOGOUT)
        // ==========================================
        [HttpGet]
        [HttpPost]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Logout()
        {
            HttpContext.Session.Clear();
            await HttpContext.SignOutAsync(CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme);

            return RedirectToAction(nameof(Login), new { area = "Admin", loggedOut = true });
        }

        // ==========================================
        // 4. QUáº¢N LÃ TÃ€I KHOáº¢N & KHÃCH HÃ€NG CRM (ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT)
        // ==========================================
        [HttpGet]
        [ActionName("AccountManagement")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> AccountManagement(string? searchString, string? chucVu, int? roleId, bool? status, string accountType = "KHACHHANG")
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(accountType) || (accountType != "QUANLY" && accountType != "KHACHHANG"))
            {
                accountType = "KHACHHANG";
            }

            ViewBag.IsAdmin = User.IsInRole("Admin") || User.HasClaim("MaVaiTro", "3");
            ViewBag.Roles = await _context.VaiTro.ToListAsync();
            var categories = await _context.DanhMuc
                .AsNoTracking()
                .OrderBy(category => category.TenDM)
                .ToListAsync();
            ViewBag.DanhMucList = categories;
            ViewBag.DanhMucs = categories;
            ViewBag.CurrentSearch = searchString;
            ViewBag.CurrentChucVu = chucVu;
            ViewBag.CurrentRoleId = roleId;
            ViewBag.CurrentStatus = status;
            ViewBag.CurrentAccountType = accountType;

            var query = _context.TaiKhoan
                .Include(t => t.VaiTro)
                .Include(t => t.QuanLy)
                .Include(t => t.KhachHang)
                    .ThenInclude(k => k!.SoThichList)
                        .ThenInclude(st => st!.DanhMuc)
                .Where(t => t.MaVaiTro != 3)
                .AsQueryable();

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(searchString))
            {
                string s = searchString.Trim().ToLower();
                query = query.Where(t => t.TenDangNhap.ToLower().Contains(s)
                    || (t.QuanLy != null && (t.QuanLy.HoTen.ToLower().Contains(s) || (t.QuanLy.Email != null && t.QuanLy.Email.ToLower().Contains(s)) || (t.QuanLy.SoDienThoai != null && t.QuanLy.SoDienThoai.Contains(s))))
                    || (t.KhachHang != null && (t.KhachHang.HoTen.ToLower().Contains(s) || t.KhachHang.Email.ToLower().Contains(s) || (t.KhachHang.SoDienThoai != null && t.KhachHang.SoDienThoai.Contains(s)))));
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(chucVu) && accountType == "QUANLY")
            {
                query = query.Where(t => t.QuanLy != null && t.QuanLy.ChucVu == chucVu);
            }

            if (status.HasValue)
            {
                query = query.Where(t => t.TrangThai == status.Value);
            }

            if (accountType == "QUANLY")
            {
                query = query.Where(t => t.MaVaiTro == 1 && t.QuanLy != null);
            }
            else
            {
                query = query.Where(t => t.MaVaiTro == 2 && t.KhachHang != null && !t.KhachHang.DaXoa);
            }

            var result = await query
                .OrderByDescending(t => t.NgayTao)
                .Select(t => new AccountItemViewModel
                {
                    MaTK = t.MaTK,
                    TenDangNhap = t.TenDangNhap,
                    MaVaiTro = t.MaVaiTro,
                    TenVaiTro = t.VaiTro != null ? t.VaiTro.TenVaiTro : "ChÆ°a phÃ¢n quyá»n",
                    TrangThai = t.TrangThai,
                    NgayTao = t.NgayTao,
                    UserType = t.MaVaiTro == 2 ? "KHACHHANG" : "QUANLY",

                    MaQL = t.QuanLy != null ? t.QuanLy.MaQL : null,
                    ChucVu = t.QuanLy != null ? t.QuanLy.ChucVu : null,

                    MaKH = t.KhachHang != null ? t.KhachHang.MaKH : null,
                    HoTen = t.MaVaiTro == 2 ? (t.KhachHang != null ? t.KhachHang.HoTen : t.TenDangNhap) : (t.QuanLy != null ? t.QuanLy.HoTen : t.TenDangNhap),
                    Email = t.MaVaiTro == 2 ? (t.KhachHang != null ? t.KhachHang.Email : null) : (t.QuanLy != null ? t.QuanLy.Email : null),
                    SoDienThoai = t.MaVaiTro == 2 ? (t.KhachHang != null ? t.KhachHang.SoDienThoai : null) : (t.QuanLy != null ? t.QuanLy.SoDienThoai : null),
                    NgaySinh = t.MaVaiTro == 2
                        ? (t.KhachHang != null ? t.KhachHang.NgaySinh : null)
                        : (t.QuanLy != null ? t.QuanLy.NgaySinh : null),
                    GioiTinh = t.MaVaiTro == 2
                        ? (t.KhachHang != null ? t.KhachHang.GioiTinh : null)
                        : (t.QuanLy != null ? t.QuanLy.GioiTinh : null),
                    DiaChi = t.KhachHang != null ? t.KhachHang.DiaChi : null,
                    SoThich = t.KhachHang != null && t.KhachHang.SoThichList.Any()
                        ? string.Join(", ", t.KhachHang.SoThichList.Select(st => st.DanhMuc != null ? st.DanhMuc.TenDM : ""))
                        : "ChÆ°a chá»n sá»Ÿ thÃ­ch",
                    SoThichList = t.KhachHang != null && t.KhachHang.SoThichList.Any()
                        ? t.KhachHang.SoThichList.Where(st => st.DanhMuc != null).Select(st => st.DanhMuc!.TenDM).ToList()
                        : new List<string>(),
                    SoThichMaDMs = t.KhachHang != null && t.KhachHang.SoThichList.Any()
                        ? t.KhachHang.SoThichList.Select(st => st.MaDM).ToList()
                        : new List<int>()
                })
                .ToListAsync();

            return View("~/Areas/Admin/Views/Account/AccountManagement.cshtml", result);
        }

        // TÆ°Æ¡ng thÃ­ch route Index cÅ© (/Admin/Account hoáº·c /Admin/Account/Index) -> chuyá»ƒn hÆ°á»›ng Ä‘áº¿n AccountManagement
        [HttpGet]
        public IActionResult Index(string? searchString, string? chucVu, int? roleId, bool? status, string accountType = "KHACHHANG")
        {
            return RedirectToAction(nameof(AccountManagement), new { searchString, chucVu, roleId, status, accountType });
        }

        [Authorize(Roles = "Quáº£n lÃ½, Admin")]
        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public async Task<IActionResult> CreateCustomer(CreateCustomerViewModel model)
        {
            if (!ModelState.IsValid || model.TenDangNhap.Any(char.IsWhiteSpace))
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "ThÃ´ng tin nháº­p vÃ o chÆ°a há»£p lá»‡.";
                return RedirectToAction(nameof(AccountManagement));
            }

            bool exists = await _context.TaiKhoan.AnyAsync(t => t.TenDangNhap == model.TenDangNhap);
            if (exists)
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = $"TÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p '{model.TenDangNhap}' Ä‘Ã£ tá»“n táº¡i.";
                return RedirectToAction(nameof(AccountManagement));
            }

            var vaiTroKH = await _context.VaiTro.FirstOrDefaultAsync(v => v.TenVaiTro.Contains("KhÃ¡ch"))
                           ?? await _context.VaiTro.FirstOrDefaultAsync(v => v.MaVaiTro == 2);

            var taiKhoan = new TaiKhoan
            {
                TenDangNhap = model.TenDangNhap,
                MatKhau = PasswordHelper.Hash(model.MatKhau),
                MaVaiTro = vaiTroKH?.MaVaiTro ?? 2,
                TrangThai = model.TrangThai,
                NgayTao = DateTime.Now
            };

            _context.TaiKhoan.Add(taiKhoan);
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();

            var khachHang = new KhachHang
            {
                MaTK = taiKhoan.MaTK,
                HoTen = model.HoTen,
                Email = model.Email,
                SoDienThoai = model.SoDienThoai,
                NgaySinh = model.NgaySinh,
                GioiTinh = model.GioiTinh,
                DiaChi = model.DiaChi,
                NgayDangKy = DateTime.Now,
                DaXoa = false
            };

            _context.KhachHang.Add(khachHang);
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();

            TempData["SuccessMessage"] = $"ThÃªm khÃ¡ch hÃ ng '{model.HoTen}' thÃ nh cÃ´ng!";
            return RedirectToAction(nameof(AccountManagement), new { accountType = "KHACHHANG" });
        }

        // ==========================================
        // 6. THÃŠM TÃ€I KHOáº¢N QUáº¢N LÃ / ADMIN Má»šI
        // ==========================================
        [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]
        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Create(CreateAccountViewModel model)
        {
            if (model.MaVaiTro != 1)
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "Admin chá»‰ cÃ³ thá»ƒ táº¡o tÃ i khoáº£n nhÃ¢n viÃªn Quáº£n lÃ½ táº¡i mÃ n hÃ¬nh nÃ y.";
                return RedirectToAction(nameof(AccountManagement), new { accountType = "QUANLY" });
            }

            if (!ModelState.IsValid || model.TenDangNhap.Any(char.IsWhiteSpace))
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "ThÃ´ng tin nháº­p vÃ o chÆ°a há»£p lá»‡.";
                return RedirectToAction(nameof(AccountManagement));
            }

            bool exists = await _context.TaiKhoan.AnyAsync(t => t.TenDangNhap == model.TenDangNhap);
            if (exists)
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = $"TÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p '{model.TenDangNhap}' Ä‘Ã£ tá»“n táº¡i.";
                return RedirectToAction(nameof(AccountManagement));
            }

            var taiKhoan = new TaiKhoan

            };

            _context.QuanLy.Add(quanLy);
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();

            TempData["SuccessMessage"] = $"Táº¡o tÃ i khoáº£n quáº£n lÃ½ '{model.TenDangNhap}' thÃ nh cÃ´ng!";

        }

        // ==========================================
        // 7. Sá»¬A TÃ€I KHOáº¢N & PHÃ‚N QUYá»€N (EDIT)
        // ==========================================
        [Authorize(Roles = "Quáº£n lÃ½, Admin")]
        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Edit(EditAccountViewModel model)
        {
            var taiKhoan = await _context.TaiKhoan
                .Include(t => t.QuanLy)
                .Include(t => t.KhachHang)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(t => t.MaTK == model.MaTK);
            if (taiKhoan == null)
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y tÃ i khoáº£n cáº§n chá»‰nh sá»­a.";
                return RedirectToAction(nameof(AccountManagement));
            }

            bool isAdmin = User.IsInRole("Admin") || User.HasClaim("MaVaiTro", "3");
            int previousRole = taiKhoan.MaVaiTro;
            if (taiKhoan.MaVaiTro == 3)
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ chá»‰nh sá»­a tÃ i khoáº£n Quáº£n trá»‹ viÃªn há»‡ thá»‘ng (Admin).";
                return RedirectToAction(nameof(AccountManagement));
            }

            if (!isAdmin && (taiKhoan.MaVaiTro != 2 || model.MaVaiTro != 2 || !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.MatKhauMoi)))
            {
                return Forbid();
            }

            if (isAdmin && model.MaVaiTro is not (1 or 2))
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "Vai trÃ² cÃ³ thá»ƒ gÃ¡n lÃ  Quáº£n lÃ½ hoáº·c KhÃ¡ch hÃ ng.";
                return RedirectToAction(nameof(AccountManagement));
            }

            if (isAdmin && previousRole == 1 && model.MaVaiTro == 2)
            {
                var birthDate = model.NgaySinh ?? taiKhoan.QuanLy?.NgaySinh ?? taiKhoan.KhachHang?.NgaySinh;
                var gender = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.GioiTinh)
                    ? taiKhoan.QuanLy?.GioiTinh ?? taiKhoan.KhachHang?.GioiTinh
                    : model.GioiTinh;
                var allowedGenders = new[] { "Nam", "Ná»¯", "KhÃ¡c" };
                if (!birthDate.HasValue || birthDate.Value.Date > DateTime.Today.AddYears(-16).AddDays(-1)
                    || !allowedGenders.Contains(gender, StringComparer.Ordinal))
                {
                    TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "Cáº§n nháº­p ngÃ y sinh há»£p lá»‡ (trÃªn 16 tuá»•i) vÃ  giá»›i tÃ­nh trÆ°á»›c khi chuyá»ƒn tÃ i khoáº£n quáº£n lÃ½ thÃ nh khÃ¡ch hÃ ng.";
                    return RedirectToAction(nameof(AccountManagement), new { accountType = "QUANLY" });
                }
            }

            if (isAdmin)
            {
                taiKhoan.MaVaiTro = model.MaVaiTro;
                taiKhoan.TrangThai = model.TrangThai;
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.MatKhauMoi))
                    taiKhoan.MatKhau = PasswordHelper.Hash(model.MatKhauMoi);
            }

            if (taiKhoan.MaVaiTro == 1)
            {
                var quanLy = taiKhoan.QuanLy;
                if (quanLy == null)
                {
                    quanLy = new QuanLy { MaTK = taiKhoan.MaTK, HoTen = model.HoTen, ChucVu = model.ChucVu ?? "Quáº£n lÃ½ CRM", TrangThai = taiKhoan.TrangThai };
                    _context.QuanLy.Add(quanLy);
                }
                quanLy.HoTen = model.HoTen;
                quanLy.Email = model.Email;
                quanLy.SoDienThoai = model.SoDienThoai;
                quanLy.NgaySinh = model.NgaySinh;
                quanLy.GioiTinh = model.GioiTinh;
                quanLy.ChucVu = model.ChucVu ?? "Quáº£n lÃ½ CRM";
                quanLy.TrangThai = taiKhoan.TrangThai;
            }
            else
            {
                var khachHang = taiKhoan.KhachHang;
                if (khachHang == null)
                {
                    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.Email))
                    {
                        TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "KhÃ¡ch hÃ ng cáº§n cÃ³ email há»£p lá»‡.";
                        return RedirectToAction(nameof(AccountManagement));
                    }
                    khachHang = new KhachHang
                    {
                        MaTK = taiKhoan.MaTK,
                        HoTen = model.HoTen,
                        Email = model.Email,
                        NgaySinh = model.NgaySinh ?? taiKhoan.QuanLy?.NgaySinh,
                        GioiTinh = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.GioiTinh) ? taiKhoan.QuanLy?.GioiTinh : model.GioiTinh,
                        NgayDangKy = DateTime.Now
                    };
                    _context.KhachHang.Add(khachHang);
                }
                khachHang.HoTen = model.HoTen;
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.Email)) khachHang.Email = model.Email;
                khachHang.SoDienThoai = model.SoDienThoai;
                var isManagerToCustomer = previousRole == 1 && taiKhoan.MaVaiTro == 2;
                khachHang.NgaySinh = isManagerToCustomer
                    ? model.NgaySinh ?? taiKhoan.QuanLy?.NgaySinh ?? khachHang.NgaySinh
                    : model.NgaySinh;
                khachHang.GioiTinh = isManagerToCustomer
                    ? (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.GioiTinh) ? taiKhoan.QuanLy?.GioiTinh ?? khachHang.GioiTinh : model.GioiTinh)
                    : model.GioiTinh;
                khachHang.DiaChi = model.DiaChi;
                taiKhoan.KhachHang = khachHang;
            }

            if (previousRole == 2 && taiKhoan.MaVaiTro == 1 && taiKhoan.KhachHang != null && taiKhoan.QuanLy != null)
            {
                taiKhoan.QuanLy.NgaySinh = taiKhoan.KhachHang.NgaySinh;
                taiKhoan.QuanLy.GioiTinh = taiKhoan.KhachHang.GioiTinh;
            }
            if (previousRole == 2 && taiKhoan.KhachHang != null)
            {
                var selectedIds = (model.SoThichIds ?? new List<int>()).Distinct().ToList();
                var existingPreferences = await _context.KhachHangSoThich
                    .Where(preference => preference.MaKH == taiKhoan.KhachHang.MaKH)
                    .ToListAsync();
                var existingPreferenceIds = existingPreferences.Select(preference => preference.MaDM).ToList();
                var validCategories = await _context.DanhMuc
                    .Where(category => selectedIds.Contains(category.MaDM)
                        && (category.TrangThai || existingPreferenceIds.Contains(category.MaDM)))
                    .Select(category => category.MaDM)
                    .ToListAsync();
                if (validCategories.Count != selectedIds.Count)
                {
                    TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "Danh sÃ¡ch sá»Ÿ thÃ­ch cÃ³ danh má»¥c khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡. HÃ£y chá»n danh má»¥c Ä‘ang hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng.";
                    return RedirectToAction(nameof(AccountManagement), new { accountType = "KHACHHANG" });
                }

                _context.KhachHangSoThich.RemoveRange(existingPreferences);
                _context.KhachHangSoThich.AddRange(selectedIds.Select(categoryId => new KhachHangSoThich
                {
                    MaKH = taiKhoan.KhachHang.MaKH,
                    MaDM = categoryId
                }));
            }

            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
            TempData["SuccessMessage"] = "Cáº­p nháº­t phÃ¢n quyá»n & thÃ´ng tin thÃ nh cÃ´ng!";
            string targetTab = taiKhoan.MaVaiTro == 1 ? "QUANLY" : "KHACHHANG";
            return RedirectToAction(nameof(AccountManagement), new { accountType = targetTab });
        }

        // ==========================================
        // 8. KHÃ“A / Má»ž KHÃ“A TÃ€I KHOáº¢N (TOGGLE STATUS)
        // ==========================================
        [Authorize(Roles = "Quáº£n lÃ½, Admin")]
        [HttpPost]
        public async Task<IActionResult> ToggleStatus(int id)
        {
            var taiKhoan = await _context.TaiKhoan.FindAsync(id);
            if (taiKhoan == null)
            {
                return Json(new { success = false, message = "KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y tÃ i khoáº£n." });
            }

            if (taiKhoan.MaVaiTro == 3 || (!User.IsInRole("Admin") && taiKhoan.MaVaiTro != 2))
            {
                return StatusCode(StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden, new { success = false, message = "Quáº£n lÃ½ chá»‰ Ä‘Æ°á»£c khÃ³a hoáº·c má»Ÿ khÃ³a tÃ i khoáº£n khÃ¡ch hÃ ng." });
            }

            taiKhoan.TrangThai = !taiKhoan.TrangThai;
            if (taiKhoan.MaVaiTro == 1)
            {
                var manager = await _context.QuanLy.FirstOrDefaultAsync(item => item.MaTK == taiKhoan.MaTK);
                if (manager != null) manager.TrangThai = taiKhoan.TrangThai;
            }
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();

            string stt = taiKhoan.TrangThai ? "KÃ­ch hoáº¡t" : "KhÃ³a";
            return Json(new { success = true, newStatus = taiKhoan.TrangThai, message = $"ÄÃ£ {stt} tÃ i khoáº£n '{taiKhoan.TenDangNhap}'" });
        }

        // ==========================================
        // 9. XÃ“A TÃ€I KHOáº¢N / KHÃCH HÃ€NG (DELETE)
        // ==========================================
        [Authorize(Roles = "Quáº£n lÃ½, Admin")]
        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Delete(int id)
        {
            var taiKhoan = await _context.TaiKhoan
                .Include(t => t.QuanLy)
                .Include(t => t.KhachHang)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(t => t.MaTK == id);

            if (taiKhoan == null)
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "TÃ i khoáº£n khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i.";
                return RedirectToAction(nameof(AccountManagement));
            }

            bool isAdmin = User.IsInRole("Admin") || User.HasClaim("MaVaiTro", "3");
            if (taiKhoan.MaTK == 1 || taiKhoan.TenDangNhap == "admin" || taiKhoan.MaVaiTro == 3)
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ xÃ³a tÃ i khoáº£n Quáº£n trá»‹ viÃªn há»‡ thá»‘ng (Admin).";
                return RedirectToAction(nameof(AccountManagement));
            }

            if (!isAdmin && (taiKhoan.MaVaiTro != 2 || taiKhoan.KhachHang == null))
            {
                return Forbid();
            }

            string targetTab = taiKhoan.MaVaiTro == 1 ? "QUANLY" : "KHACHHANG";

            bool isCustomer = taiKhoan.MaVaiTro == 2 && taiKhoan.KhachHang != null;
            if (isCustomer)
            {
                taiKhoan.KhachHang!.DaXoa = true;
                taiKhoan.TrangThai = false;
            }

            if (isAdmin && taiKhoan.MaVaiTro == 1 && taiKhoan.QuanLy != null)
            {
                _context.QuanLy.Remove(taiKhoan.QuanLy);
                _context.TaiKhoan.Remove(taiKhoan);
            }

            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
            TempData["SuccessMessage"] = isCustomer
                ? $"ÄÃ£ xÃ³a há»“ sÆ¡ khÃ¡ch hÃ ng '{taiKhoan.TenDangNhap}' khá»i danh sÃ¡ch vÃ  khÃ³a tÃ i khoáº£n."
                : $"ÄÃ£ xÃ³a tÃ i khoáº£n '{taiKhoan.TenDangNhap}' thÃ nh cÃ´ng.";
            return RedirectToAction(nameof(AccountManagement), new { accountType = targetTab });
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;

namespace Fashion_store.Controllers.Admin
{
    [Area("Admin")]
    [Authorize(Roles = "Quáº£n lÃ½, Admin")]
    public class ProductController : Controller
    {
        private readonly FashionStoreDbContext _context;
        private readonly IWebHostEnvironment _environment;

        public ProductController(FashionStoreDbContext context, IWebHostEnvironment environment)
        {
            _context = context;

        // ==========================================
        // 1. TRANG QUÃ¡ÂºÂ¢N LÃƒÂ SÃ¡ÂºÂ¢N PHÃ¡ÂºÂ¨M & DANH MÃ¡Â»Â¤C (PRODUCT MANAGEMENT)
        // ==========================================
        [HttpGet]
        [ActionName("ProductManagement")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> ProductManagement(
            string tab = "SANPHAM",
            string? searchString = null,
            int? maDM = null,
            string? size = null,
            string? color = null,
            string? priceRange = null,
            string? stockStatus = null,
            bool? status = null,
            string sortBy = "date_desc")
        {
            // Danh sÃƒÂ¡ch dÃ¡Â»Â¯ liÃ¡Â»â€¡u hÃ¡Â»â€” trÃ¡Â»Â£ bÃ¡Â»â„¢ lÃ¡Â»Âc & modal
            var danhMucs = await _context.DanhMuc.Where(d => d.TrangThai).OrderBy(d => d.TenDM).ToListAsync();

            ViewBag.CurrentTab = tab;
            ViewBag.DanhMucList = danhMucs;

            // ThÃ¡Â»â€˜ng kÃƒÂª KPI Ã„â€˜Ã¡ÂºÂ§u trang
            ViewBag.TotalProducts = await _context.SanPham.CountAsync();
            ViewBag.TotalStock = await _context.SoLuongSp.SumAsync(s => (int?)s.SoLuongTon) ?? 0;
            ViewBag.LowStockCount = await _context.SoLuongSp.CountAsync(s => s.SoLuongTon <= 10);
            ViewBag.TotalCategories = danhMucs.Count;

            // Danh sÃƒÂ¡ch tÃ¡ÂºÂ¥t cÃ¡ÂºÂ£ Size vÃƒÂ  MÃƒÂ u thÃ¡Â»Â±c tÃ¡ÂºÂ¿ trong kho
            ViewBag.AllSizes = await _context.SoLuongSp.Select(s => s.KichThuoc).Distinct().OrderBy(s => s).ToListAsync();
            ViewBag.AllColors = await _context.SoLuongSp.Select(s => s.MauSac).Distinct().OrderBy(s => s).ToListAsync();

            // LÃ†Â°u trÃ¡ÂºÂ¡ng thÃƒÂ¡i lÃ¡Â»Âc Ã„â€˜Ã¡Â»Æ’ fill lÃ¡ÂºÂ¡i form
            ViewBag.CurrentSearch = searchString;
            ViewBag.CurrentMaDM = maDM;
            ViewBag.CurrentSize = size;
            ViewBag.CurrentColor = color;
            ViewBag.CurrentPriceRange = priceRange;
            ViewBag.CurrentStockStatus = stockStatus;
            ViewBag.CurrentStatus = status;
            ViewBag.CurrentSortBy = sortBy;

            // DÃ¡Â»Â¯ liÃ¡Â»â€¡u cho Tab Danh MÃ¡Â»Â¥c
            ViewBag.Categories = await _context.DanhMuc
                .Include(d => d.SanPhams)
                .OrderBy(d => d.TenDM)
                .ToListAsync();

            // Truy vÃ¡ÂºÂ¥n danh sÃƒÂ¡ch SÃ¡ÂºÂ£n phÃ¡ÂºÂ©m ÃƒÂo kÃƒÂ¨m biÃ¡ÂºÂ¿n thÃ¡Â»Æ’, danh mÃ¡Â»Â¥c
            var query = _context.SanPham
                .Where(s => !s.DaXoa)
                .Include(s => s.DanhMuc)
                .Include(s => s.SoLuongSps)
                .AsQueryable();

            // 1. TÃƒÂ¬m kiÃ¡ÂºÂ¿m nÃƒÂ¢ng cao (TÃƒÂªn ÃƒÂ¡o, SKU, ChÃ¡ÂºÂ¥t liÃ¡Â»â€¡u)
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(searchString))
            {
                string kw = searchString.Trim().ToLower();
                query = query.Where(s => s.TenSP.ToLower().Contains(kw)
                    || (s.ChatLieu != null && s.ChatLieu.ToLower().Contains(kw))
                    || s.SoLuongSps.Any(b => b.SKU.ToLower().Contains(kw)));
            }

            // 2. LÃ¡Â»Âc theo Danh mÃ¡Â»Â¥c
            if (maDM.HasValue)
            {
                query = query.Where(s => s.MaDM == maDM.Value);
            }

            // 3. LÃ¡Â»Âc theo KÃƒÂ­ch thÃ†Â°Ã¡Â»â€ºc
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(size))
            {
                query = query.Where(s => s.SoLuongSps.Any(b => b.KichThuoc == size));
            }

            // 5. LÃ¡Â»Âc theo MÃƒÂ u sÃ¡ÂºÂ¯c
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(color))
            {
                query = query.Where(s => s.SoLuongSps.Any(b => b.MauSac == color));
            }

            // 6. LÃ¡Â»Âc theo KhoÃ¡ÂºÂ£ng giÃƒÂ¡
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(priceRange))
            {
                switch (priceRange)
                {
                    case "under200":
                        query = query.Where(s => s.SoLuongSps.Any(b => b.GiaBan < 200000));
                        break;
                    case "200to400":
                        query = query.Where(s => s.SoLuongSps.Any(b => b.GiaBan >= 200000 && b.GiaBan <= 400000));
                        break;
                    case "above400":
                        query = query.Where(s => s.SoLuongSps.Any(b => b.GiaBan > 400000));
                        break;
                }
            }

            // 7. LÃ¡Â»Âc theo TÃ¡Â»â€œn kho (CÃƒÂ²n hÃƒÂ ng / HÃ¡ÂºÂ¿t hÃƒÂ ng)
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(stockStatus))
            {
                switch (stockStatus)
                {
                    case "in_stock":
                        query = query.Where(s => s.SoLuongSps.Sum(b => b.SoLuongTon) > 0);
                        break;
                    case "out_stock":
                        query = query.Where(s => s.SoLuongSps.Sum(b => b.SoLuongTon) == 0);
                        break;
                }
            }

            // 8. LÃ¡Â»Âc theo TrÃ¡ÂºÂ¡ng thÃƒÂ¡i kinh doanh
            if (status.HasValue)
            {
                query = query.Where(s => s.TrangThai == status.Value);
            }

            // 9. SÃ¡ÂºÂ¯p xÃ¡ÂºÂ¿p (Sorting)
            query = sortBy switch
            {
                "date_asc" => query.OrderBy(s => s.NgayTao),
                "price_asc" => query.OrderBy(s => s.SoLuongSps.Min(b => b.GiaBan)),
                "price_desc" => query.OrderByDescending(s => s.SoLuongSps.Max(b => b.GiaBan)),
                "stock_asc" => query.OrderBy(s => s.SoLuongSps.Sum(b => b.SoLuongTon)),
                "stock_desc" => query.OrderByDescending(s => s.SoLuongSps.Sum(b => b.SoLuongTon)),
                "name_asc" => query.OrderBy(s => s.TenSP),
                "name_desc" => query.OrderByDescending(s => s.TenSP),
                _ => query.OrderByDescending(s => s.NgayTao)
            };

            var productList = await query.Select(s => new ProductItemViewModel
            {
                MaSP = s.MaSP,
                TenSP = s.TenSP,
                MaDM = s.MaDM,
                TenDanhMuc = s.DanhMuc != null ? s.DanhMuc.TenDM : "ChÃ†Â°a phÃƒÂ¢n loÃ¡ÂºÂ¡i",
                ChatLieu = s.ChatLieu,
                MoTa = s.MoTa,
                HinhAnh = s.HinhAnh,
                HinhAnhMoTa = s.HinhAnhMoTa,
                TrangThai = s.TrangThai,
                NgayTao = s.NgayTao,
                BienThes = s.SoLuongSps.ToList()
            }).ToListAsync();

            return View("~/Areas/Admin/Views/Product/ProductManagement.cshtml", productList);
        }

        // TÃ†Â°Ã†Â¡ng thÃƒÂ­ch route Index cÃ…Â© (/Admin/Product hoÃ¡ÂºÂ·c /Admin/Product/Index) -> chuyÃ¡Â»Æ’n hÃ†Â°Ã¡Â»â€ºng Ã„â€˜Ã¡ÂºÂ¿n ProductManagement
