        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        [RequestSizeLimit(12 * 1024 * 1024)]
        [RequestFormLimits(MultipartBodyLengthLimit = 12 * 1024 * 1024)]
        public async Task<IActionResult> SaveProduct(ProductManageViewModel model)
        {
            var thumbnailFile = model.ThumbnailImageFile ?? model.InitialImageFile;
            var thumbnailPath = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.HinhAnh) ? null : model.HinhAnh.Trim();
            var detailPath = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.HinhAnhMoTa) ? null : model.HinhAnhMoTa.Trim();
            if (HasInvalidProductImage(thumbnailFile) || HasInvalidProductImage(model.DetailImageFile)
                || !IsValidProductImagePath(thumbnailPath) || !IsValidProductImagePath(detailPath))
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "áº¢nh pháº£i lÃ  JPG, PNG hoáº·c WEBP khÃ´ng quÃ¡ 5 MB; Ä‘Æ°á»ng dáº«n áº£nh pháº£i báº¯t Ä‘áº§u báº±ng / hoáº·c http(s)://.";
                return RedirectToAction(nameof(ProductManagement));
            }

            if (!ModelState.IsValid)
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "ThÃ´ng tin sáº£n pháº©m chÆ°a há»£p lá»‡. Vui lÃ²ng kiá»ƒm tra láº¡i.";
                return RedirectToAction(nameof(ProductManagement));
            }

            try
            {
                if (!await _context.DanhMuc.AnyAsync(category => category.MaDM == model.MaDM && category.TrangThai))
                {
                    TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "Danh má»¥c khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i hoáº·c Ä‘ang bá»‹ khÃ³a.";
                    return RedirectToAction(nameof(ProductManagement));
                }

                var uploadedThumbnailPath = await SaveProductImageAsync(thumbnailFile);
                var uploadedDetailPath = await SaveProductImageAsync(model.DetailImageFile);
                var savedThumbnailPath = uploadedThumbnailPath ?? thumbnailPath;
                var savedDetailPath = uploadedDetailPath ?? detailPath;
                if (model.MaSP.HasValue && model.MaSP > 0)
                {
                    // CÃ¡ÂºÂ­p nhÃ¡ÂºÂ­t sÃ¡ÂºÂ£n phÃ¡ÂºÂ©m cÃ…Â©
                    var sp = await _context.SanPham.Include(s => s.SoLuongSps).FirstOrDefaultAsync(s => s.MaSP == model.MaSP.Value);
                    if (sp == null)
                    {
                        TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y sáº£n pháº©m cáº§n cáº­p nháº­t.";
                        return RedirectToAction(nameof(ProductManagement));
                    }

                    sp.TenSP = model.TenSP.Trim();
                    sp.MaDM = model.MaDM;
                    sp.ChatLieu = model.ChatLieu?.Trim();
                    sp.MoTa = model.MoTa?.Trim();
                    sp.HinhAnh = savedThumbnailPath ?? sp.HinhAnh;
                    sp.HinhAnhMoTa = savedDetailPath ?? sp.HinhAnhMoTa;
                    sp.TrangThai = model.TrangThai;

                    // CÃ¡ÂºÂ­p nhÃ¡ÂºÂ­t thÃƒÂ´ng sÃ¡Â»â€˜ biÃ¡ÂºÂ¿n thÃ¡Â»Æ’ nÃ¡ÂºÂ¿u sÃ¡ÂºÂ£n phÃ¡ÂºÂ©m chÃ¡Â»â€° cÃƒÂ³ 1 biÃ¡ÂºÂ¿n thÃ¡Â»Æ’ duy nhÃ¡ÂºÂ¥t
                    await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
                    TempData["SuccessMessage"] = $"ÄÃ£ cáº­p nháº­t máº«u Ã¡o '{sp.TenSP}' thÃ nh cÃ´ng.";
                }
                else
                {
                    // ThÃƒÂªm mÃ¡Â»â€ºi sÃ¡ÂºÂ£n phÃ¡ÂºÂ©m
                    var sp = new SanPham
                    {
                        TenSP = model.TenSP.Trim(),
                        MaDM = model.MaDM,
                        ChatLieu = model.ChatLieu?.Trim(),
                        MoTa = model.MoTa?.Trim(),
                        HinhAnh = savedThumbnailPath,
                        HinhAnhMoTa = savedDetailPath,
                        TrangThai = model.TrangThai,
                        NgayTao = DateTime.Now
                    };

                    _context.SanPham.Add(sp);
                    await _context.SaveChangesAsync();

                    // TÃ¡ÂºÂ¡o biÃ¡ÂºÂ¿n thÃ¡Â»Æ’ ban Ã„â€˜Ã¡ÂºÂ§u nÃ¡ÂºÂ¿u ngÃ†Â°Ã¡Â»Âi dÃƒÂ¹ng cÃƒÂ³ nhÃ¡ÂºÂ­p
                    string sku = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.InitialSKU) 
                        ? model.InitialSKU.Trim().ToUpper() 
                        : $"SP{sp.MaSP}-{model.InitialSize?.ToUpper()}-{DateTime.Now:fff}";

                    var variant = new SoLuongSp
                    {
                        MaSP = sp.MaSP,
                        SKU = sku,
                        KichThuoc = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.InitialSize) ? model.InitialSize.Trim().ToUpper() : "M",
                        MauSac = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.InitialColor) ? model.InitialColor.Trim() : "Äen",
                        GiaBan = model.InitialPrice ?? 250000,
                        SoLuongTon = model.InitialStock ?? 50,
                        HinhAnh = savedThumbnailPath,
                        TrangThai = true
                    };

                    _context.SoLuongSp.Add(variant);
                    await _context.SaveChangesAsync();

                    TempData["SuccessMessage"] = $"ÄÃ£ thÃªm máº«u Ã¡o '{sp.TenSP}' thÃ nh cÃ´ng, kÃ¨m biáº¿n thá»ƒ size {variant.KichThuoc}.";

            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = $"KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ lÆ°u sáº£n pháº©m: {ex.Message}";
            }

            return RedirectToAction(nameof(ProductManagement));
        }

        private async Task<string?> SaveProductImageAsync(Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.IFormFile? image)
        {
            if (image == null || image.Length == 0) return null;
            var extension = Path.GetExtension(image.FileName).ToLowerInvariant();
            var fileName = $"{Guid.NewGuid():N}{extension}";
            var uploadDirectory = Path.Combine(_environment.WebRootPath ?? Path.Combine(_environment.ContentRootPath, "wwwroot"), "uploads", "products");
            Directory.CreateDirectory(uploadDirectory);
            var filePath = Path.Combine(uploadDirectory, fileName);
            await using var stream = new FileStream(filePath, FileMode.CreateNew, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.None);
            await image.CopyToAsync(stream);
            return $"/uploads/products/{fileName}";
        }

        private static bool HasInvalidProductImage(Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.IFormFile? image)
        {
            if (image is not { Length: > 0 }) return false;

            var allowedExtensions = new[] { ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".webp" };
            return image.Length > 5L * 1024 * 1024
                || !allowedExtensions.Contains(Path.GetExtension(image.FileName).ToLowerInvariant());
        }

        private static bool IsValidProductImagePath(string? path)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path)) return true;
            if (path.Length > 500) return false;

            if (path.StartsWith("/", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                return !path.StartsWith("//", StringComparison.Ordinal)
                    && !path.Contains('\\')
                    && !path.Split('/', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries).Contains("..", StringComparer.Ordinal);
            }

            return Uri.TryCreate(path, UriKind.Absolute, out var uri)
                && (uri.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttp || uri.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttps);
        }

        [HttpPost]

        public async Task<IActionResult> ToggleStatus(int id)

            sp.TrangThai = !sp.TrangThai;
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();

            TempData["SuccessMessage"] = $"Ã„ÂÃƒÂ£ {(sp.TrangThai ? "bÃ¡ÂºÂ­t kinh doanh" : "tÃ¡ÂºÂ¡m ngÃ¡Â»Â«ng bÃƒÂ¡n")} mÃ¡ÂºÂ«u ÃƒÂ¡o '{sp.TenSP}'.";

        // ==========================================
        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public async Task<IActionResult> DeleteProduct(int id)
        {
            bool isAjax = Request.Headers["X-Requested-With"] == "XMLHttpRequest";
            var product = await _context.SanPham.FirstOrDefaultAsync(item => item.MaSP == id && !item.DaXoa);
            if (product == null)
            {
                if (isAjax) return NotFound(new { success = false, message = "KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y sáº£n pháº©m." });
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y sáº£n pháº©m cáº§n áº©n.";
                return RedirectToAction(nameof(ProductManagement));
            }

            product.DaXoa = true;
            product.TrangThai = false;
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
            string message = $"ÄÃ£ áº©n sáº£n pháº©m '{product.TenSP}'. Pháº£n há»“i vÃ  Ä‘Ã¡nh giÃ¡ Ä‘Æ°á»£c giá»¯ nguyÃªn.";
            if (isAjax) return Json(new { success = true, message });
            TempData["SuccessMessage"] = message;
            return RedirectToAction(nameof(ProductManagement));
        }

        [HttpGet]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetVariants(int productId)
        {
            var sp = await _context.SanPham
                .Include(s => s.DanhMuc)
                .Include(s => s.SoLuongSps)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(s => s.MaSP == productId);

            if (sp == null)
            {
                return NotFound(new { success = false, message = "KhÃƒÂ´ng tÃƒÂ¬m thÃ¡ÂºÂ¥y sÃ¡ÂºÂ£n phÃ¡ÂºÂ©m" });
            }

            var result = new
            {
                success = true,
                maSP = sp.MaSP,
                tenSP = sp.TenSP,
                tenDM = sp.DanhMuc?.TenDM ?? "ChÃ†Â°a phÃƒÂ¢n loÃ¡ÂºÂ¡i",
                chatLieu = sp.ChatLieu ?? "",
                moTa = sp.MoTa ?? "",
                hinhAnh = sp.HinhAnh,
                hinhAnhMoTa = sp.HinhAnhMoTa,
                trangThai = sp.TrangThai,
                maDM = sp.MaDM,
                variants = sp.SoLuongSps.Select(v => new
                {
                    maSL = v.MaSL,
                    sku = v.SKU,
                    kichThuoc = v.KichThuoc,
                    mauSac = v.MauSac,
                    giaBan = v.GiaBan,
                    soLuongTon = v.SoLuongTon,
                    hinhAnh = v.HinhAnh,
                    trangThai = v.TrangThai
                }).ToList()
            };

            return Json(result);
        }

        // ==========================================
        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public async Task<IActionResult> SaveVariant(VariantManageViewModel model)
        {
            bool isAjax = Request.Headers["X-Requested-With"] == "XMLHttpRequest" || (Request.Headers.Accept.ToString()?.Contains("application/json") ?? false);

            if (!ModelState.IsValid)
            {
                var errors = string.Join("; ", ModelState.Values.SelectMany(v => v.Errors).Select(e => e.ErrorMessage));
                if (isAjax) return Json(new { success = false, message = errors });
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = errors;
                return RedirectToAction(nameof(ProductManagement));
            }

            try
            {
                if (model.MaSL.HasValue && model.MaSL.Value > 0)
                {
                    var v = await _context.SoLuongSp.FindAsync(model.MaSL.Value);
                    if (v == null)
                    {
                        if (isAjax) return Json(new { success = false, message = "KhÃƒÂ´ng tÃƒÂ¬m thÃ¡ÂºÂ¥y biÃ¡ÂºÂ¿n thÃ¡Â»Æ’." });
                        TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "KhÃƒÂ´ng tÃƒÂ¬m thÃ¡ÂºÂ¥y biÃ¡ÂºÂ¿n thÃ¡Â»Æ’.";
                        return RedirectToAction(nameof(ProductManagement));
                    }

                    v.SKU = model.SKU.Trim().ToUpper();
                    v.KichThuoc = model.KichThuoc.Trim().ToUpper();
                    v.MauSac = model.MauSac.Trim();
                    v.GiaBan = model.GiaBan;
                    v.SoLuongTon = model.SoLuongTon;
                    v.HinhAnh = model.HinhAnh?.Trim();
                    v.TrangThai = model.TrangThai;

                    await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
                    if (isAjax) return Json(new { success = true, message = $"Ã„ÂÃƒÂ£ cÃ¡ÂºÂ­p nhÃ¡ÂºÂ­t biÃ¡ÂºÂ¿n thÃ¡Â»Æ’ SKU '{v.SKU}' thÃƒÂ nh cÃƒÂ´ng!" });
                    TempData["SuccessMessage"] = $"Ã„ÂÃƒÂ£ cÃ¡ÂºÂ­p nhÃ¡ÂºÂ­t biÃ¡ÂºÂ¿n thÃ¡Â»Æ’ SKU '{v.SKU}' thÃƒÂ nh cÃƒÂ´ng!";
                }
                else
                {
                    bool existsSku = await _context.SoLuongSp.AnyAsync(s => s.SKU == model.SKU.Trim().ToUpper());
                    if (existsSku)
                    {
                        if (isAjax) return Json(new { success = false, message = $"MÃƒÂ£ SKU '{model.SKU}' Ã„â€˜ÃƒÂ£ tÃ¡Â»â€œn tÃ¡ÂºÂ¡i trong hÃ¡Â»â€¡ thÃ¡Â»â€˜ng." });
                        TempData["ErrorMessage"] = $"MÃƒÂ£ SKU '{model.SKU}' Ã„â€˜ÃƒÂ£ tÃ¡Â»â€œn tÃ¡ÂºÂ¡i trong hÃ¡Â»â€¡ thÃ¡Â»â€˜ng.";
                        return RedirectToAction(nameof(ProductManagement));
                    }

                    var v = new SoLuongSp
                    {
                        MaSP = model.MaSP,
                        SKU = model.SKU.Trim().ToUpper(),
                        KichThuoc = model.KichThuoc.Trim().ToUpper(),
                        MauSac = model.MauSac.Trim(),
                        GiaBan = model.GiaBan,
                        SoLuongTon = model.SoLuongTon,
                        HinhAnh = model.HinhAnh?.Trim(),
                        TrangThai = true
                    };

                    _context.SoLuongSp.Add(v);
                    await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
                    if (isAjax) return Json(new { success = true, message = $"Ã„ÂÃƒÂ£ thÃƒÂªm mÃ¡Â»â€ºi biÃ¡ÂºÂ¿n thÃ¡Â»Æ’ Size {v.KichThuoc} - MÃƒÂ u {v.MauSac} thÃƒÂ nh cÃƒÂ´ng!" });
                    TempData["SuccessMessage"] = $"Ã„ÂÃƒÂ£ thÃƒÂªm mÃ¡Â»â€ºi biÃ¡ÂºÂ¿n thÃ¡Â»Æ’ Size {v.KichThuoc} - MÃƒÂ u {v.MauSac} thÃƒÂ nh cÃƒÂ´ng!";
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                if (isAjax) return Json(new { success = false, message = ex.Message });
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = $"LÃ¡Â»â€”i: {ex.Message}";
            }

            return RedirectToAction(nameof(ProductManagement));
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public async Task<IActionResult> DeleteVariant(int id)
        {
            bool isAjax = Request.Headers["X-Requested-With"] == "XMLHttpRequest" || (Request.Headers.Accept.ToString()?.Contains("application/json") ?? false);

            var v = await _context.SoLuongSp.FindAsync(id);
            if (v == null)
            {
                if (isAjax) return Json(new { success = false, message = "KhÃƒÂ´ng tÃƒÂ¬m thÃ¡ÂºÂ¥y biÃ¡ÂºÂ¿n thÃ¡Â»Æ’." });
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "KhÃƒÂ´ng tÃƒÂ¬m thÃ¡ÂºÂ¥y biÃ¡ÂºÂ¿n thÃ¡Â»Æ’.";
                return RedirectToAction(nameof(ProductManagement));
            }

            string sku = v.SKU;
            _context.SoLuongSp.Remove(v);
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();

            if (isAjax) return Json(new { success = true, message = $"Ã„ÂÃƒÂ£ xÃƒÂ³a biÃ¡ÂºÂ¿n thÃ¡Â»Æ’ SKU '{sku}' thÃƒÂ nh cÃƒÂ´ng." });
            TempData["SuccessMessage"] = $"Ã„ÂÃƒÂ£ xÃƒÂ³a biÃ¡ÂºÂ¿n thÃ¡Â»Æ’ SKU '{sku}' thÃƒÂ nh cÃƒÂ´ng.";
            return RedirectToAction(nameof(ProductManagement));
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public async Task<IActionResult> UpdateStock(int maSL, int soLuongTon)
        {
            bool isAjax = Request.Headers["X-Requested-With"] == "XMLHttpRequest" || (Request.Headers.Accept.ToString()?.Contains("application/json") ?? false);

            if (soLuongTon < 0)
            {
                if (isAjax) return Json(new { success = false, message = "SÃ¡Â»â€˜ lÃ†Â°Ã¡Â»Â£ng tÃ¡Â»â€œn khÃƒÂ´ng thÃ¡Â»Æ’ lÃƒÂ  sÃ¡Â»â€˜ ÃƒÂ¢m." });
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "SÃ¡Â»â€˜ lÃ†Â°Ã¡Â»Â£ng tÃ¡Â»â€œn khÃƒÂ´ng thÃ¡Â»Æ’ lÃƒÂ  sÃ¡Â»â€˜ ÃƒÂ¢m.";
                return RedirectToAction(nameof(ProductManagement));
            }

            var v = await _context.SoLuongSp.FindAsync(maSL);
            if (v == null)
            {
                if (isAjax) return Json(new { success = false, message = "KhÃƒÂ´ng tÃƒÂ¬m thÃ¡ÂºÂ¥y biÃ¡ÂºÂ¿n thÃ¡Â»Æ’." });
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "KhÃƒÂ´ng tÃƒÂ¬m thÃ¡ÂºÂ¥y biÃ¡ÂºÂ¿n thÃ¡Â»Æ’.";
                return RedirectToAction(nameof(ProductManagement));
            }

            v.SoLuongTon = soLuongTon;
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();

            if (isAjax)
            {
                var totalStock = await _context.SoLuongSp.Where(s => s.MaSP == v.MaSP).SumAsync(s => s.SoLuongTon);
                return Json(new { success = true, message = $"Ã„ÂÃƒÂ£ cÃ¡ÂºÂ­p nhÃ¡ÂºÂ­t tÃ¡Â»â€œn kho biÃ¡ÂºÂ¿n thÃ¡Â»Æ’ SKU '{v.SKU}' thÃƒÂ nh {soLuongTon} cÃƒÂ¡i.", totalStock = totalStock });
            }

            TempData["SuccessMessage"] = $"Ã„ÂÃƒÂ£ cÃ¡ÂºÂ­p nhÃ¡ÂºÂ­t tÃ¡Â»â€œn kho biÃ¡ÂºÂ¿n thÃ¡Â»Æ’ SKU '{v.SKU}' thÃƒÂ nh {soLuongTon} cÃƒÂ¡i.";
            return RedirectToAction(nameof(ProductManagement));
        }

        // ==========================================
        // 9. QUÃ¡ÂºÂ¢N LÃƒÂ DANH MÃ¡Â»Â¤C ÃƒÂO (CRUD)
        // ==========================================
        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public async Task<IActionResult> SaveCategory(CategoryManageViewModel model)
        {
            if (!ModelState.IsValid)
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "TÃªn danh má»¥c khÃ´ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c Ä‘á»ƒ trá»‘ng.";
                return RedirectToAction(nameof(ProductManagement), new { tab = "DANHMUC" });
            }

            try
            {
                string categoryName = model.TenDM.Trim();
                bool duplicateName = await _context.DanhMuc.AnyAsync(category =>
                    category.MaDM != (model.MaDM ?? 0) && category.TenDM.ToLower() == categoryName.ToLower());
                if (duplicateName)
                {
                    TempData["ErrorMessage"] = $"Danh má»¥c '{categoryName}' Ä‘Ã£ tá»“n táº¡i.";
                    return RedirectToAction(nameof(ProductManagement), new { tab = "DANHMUC" });
                }

                if (model.MaDM.HasValue && model.MaDM.Value > 0)
                {
                    var dm = await _context.DanhMuc.FindAsync(model.MaDM.Value);
                    if (dm == null)
                    {
                        TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y danh má»¥c.";
                        return RedirectToAction(nameof(ProductManagement), new { tab = "DANHMUC" });
                    }

                    dm.TenDM = categoryName;
                    dm.MoTa = model.MoTa?.Trim();
                    dm.TrangThai = model.TrangThai;

                    await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
                    TempData["SuccessMessage"] = $"ÄÃ£ cáº­p nháº­t danh má»¥c '{dm.TenDM}' thÃ nh cÃ´ng.";
                }
                else
                {
                    var dm = new DanhMuc
                    {
                        TenDM = categoryName,
                        MoTa = model.MoTa?.Trim(),
                        TrangThai = model.TrangThai
                    };

                    _context.DanhMuc.Add(dm);
                    await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
                    TempData["SuccessMessage"] = $"ÄÃ£ thÃªm má»›i danh má»¥c '{dm.TenDM}' thÃ nh cÃ´ng.";
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = $"KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ lÆ°u danh má»¥c: {ex.Message}";
            }

            return RedirectToAction(nameof(ProductManagement), new { tab = "DANHMUC" });
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public async Task<IActionResult> ToggleCategoryStatus(int id)
        {
            var category = await _context.DanhMuc.FindAsync(id);
            if (category == null)
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y danh má»¥c.";
                return RedirectToAction(nameof(ProductManagement), new { tab = "DANHMUC" });
            }

            category.TrangThai = !category.TrangThai;
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
            TempData[category.TrangThai ? "SuccessMessage" : "ErrorMessage"] = category.TrangThai
                ? $"ÄÃ£ má»Ÿ danh má»¥c '{category.TenDM}' cho khÃ¡ch hÃ ng."
                : $"ÄÃ£ khÃ³a danh má»¥c '{category.TenDM}'. Danh má»¥c nÃ y sáº½ khÃ´ng hiá»ƒn thá»‹ cho khÃ¡ch hÃ ng.";
            return RedirectToAction(nameof(ProductManagement), new { tab = "DANHMUC" });
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public async Task<IActionResult> DeleteCategory(int id)
        {
            var dm = await _context.DanhMuc.Include(d => d.SanPhams).FirstOrDefaultAsync(d => d.MaDM == id);
            if (dm == null)
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "KhÃƒÂ´ng tÃƒÂ¬m thÃ¡ÂºÂ¥y danh mÃ¡Â»Â¥c.";
                return RedirectToAction(nameof(ProductManagement), new { tab = "DANHMUC" });
            }

            if (dm.SanPhams.Any())
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = $"KhÃƒÂ´ng thÃ¡Â»Æ’ xÃƒÂ³a danh mÃ¡Â»Â¥c '{dm.TenDM}' vÃƒÂ¬ Ã„â€˜ang cÃƒÂ³ {dm.SanPhams.Count} sÃ¡ÂºÂ£n phÃ¡ÂºÂ©m liÃƒÂªn kÃ¡ÂºÂ¿t.";
                return RedirectToAction(nameof(ProductManagement), new { tab = "DANHMUC" });
            }

            string tenDM = dm.TenDM;
            _context.DanhMuc.Remove(dm);
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();

            TempData["SuccessMessage"] = $"Ã„ÂÃƒÂ£ xÃƒÂ³a danh mÃ¡Â»Â¥c '{tenDM}' thÃƒÂ nh cÃƒÂ´ng.";
            return RedirectToAction(nameof(ProductManagement), new { tab = "DANHMUC" });
        }
    }

        [HttpGet]
        public async Task<IActionResult> SurveyFeedback()
        {
            await SurveyExpirationService.CloseExpiredSurveysAsync(_context, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

            ViewBag.IsAdmin = User.IsInRole("Admin") || User.HasClaim("MaVaiTro", "3");
            if (!ViewBag.IsAdmin)
            {
                var accountIdValue = User.FindFirstValue(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier);
                if (int.TryParse(accountIdValue, out int accountId))
                {
                    ViewBag.CurrentManagerId = await _context.QuanLy
                        .Where(manager => manager.MaTK == accountId)
                        .Select(manager => (int?)manager.MaQL)
                        .FirstOrDefaultAsync();
                }
            }

            ViewBag.Surveys = await _context.KhaoSat
                .Include(k => k.CauHoiKhaoSats)
                    .ThenInclude(c => c.LuaChonCauHois)
                .Include(k => k.PhieuKhaoSats)
                .OrderByDescending(k => k.NgayBatDau)
                .ToListAsync();

            ViewBag.Feedbacks = await _context.PhanHoi
                .Include(p => p.KhachHang)
                .Include(p => p.SanPham)
                .OrderByDescending(p => p.NgayGui)
                .ToListAsync();

            ViewBag.Products = await _context.SanPham.Where(s => s.TrangThai).ToListAsync();

            return View("~/Views/Admin/Survey/SurveyFeedback.cshtml");
        }

        // 2. BACKEND LÆ¯U BÃ€I KHáº¢O SÃT VÃ€O CSDL VÃ€ PHÃT PHIáº¾U Tá»šI TOÃ€N Bá»˜ KHÃCH HÃ€NG

        [HttpPost]
        [Authorize(Roles = "Quáº£n lÃ½, Admin")]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public async Task<IActionResult> CreateSurveyApi([FromBody] CreateSurveyRequestDto model)
        {
            if (model == null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.TenKhaoSat))
            {
                return Json(new { success = false, message = "Vui lÃ²ng nháº­p tÃªn bÃ i kháº£o sÃ¡t." });
            }

            var allowedQuestionTypes = new[] { "Má»™t lá»±a chá»n", "Nhiá»u lá»±a chá»n", "Tá»± luáº­n", "ÄÃ¡nh giÃ¡ sao" };
            if (model.TenKhaoSat.Trim().Length > 200)
            {
                return Json(new { success = false, message = "TÃªn bÃ i kháº£o sÃ¡t khÃ´ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c vÆ°á»£t quÃ¡ 200 kÃ½ tá»±." });
            }

            if (model.NgayBatDau == default || model.NgayKetThuc == default
                || model.NgayBatDau < DateTime.Now.AddMinutes(-1)
                || model.NgayKetThuc <= model.NgayBatDau)
            {
                return Json(new { success = false, message = "Vui lÃ²ng chá»n thá»i gian báº¯t Ä‘áº§u tá»« hiá»‡n táº¡i trá»Ÿ Ä‘i vÃ  káº¿t thÃºc sau thá»i gian báº¯t Ä‘áº§u." });
            }

            if (model.Questions == null || model.Questions.Count == 0)
            {
                return Json(new { success = false, message = "BÃ i kháº£o sÃ¡t cáº§n Ã­t nháº¥t má»™t cÃ¢u há»i." });
            }

            foreach (var question in model.Questions)
            {
                if (question == null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(question.NoiDung)
                    || question.NoiDung.Trim().Length > 1000
                    || !allowedQuestionTypes.Contains(question.LoaiCauHoi, StringComparer.Ordinal))
                {
                    return Json(new { success = false, message = "CÃ³ cÃ¢u há»i thiáº¿u ná»™i dung, quÃ¡ dÃ i hoáº·c cÃ³ loáº¡i cÃ¢u há»i khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡." });
                }

                if (question.LoaiCauHoi == "Má»™t lá»±a chá»n" || question.LoaiCauHoi == "Nhiá»u lá»±a chá»n")
                {
                    var options = question.Options?
                        .Where(option => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(option))
                        .Select(option => option.Trim())
                        .ToList() ?? new List<string>();

                    if (options.Count < 2 || options.Any(option => option.Length > 500)
                        || options.Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).Count() != options.Count)
                    {
                        return Json(new { success = false, message = "Má»—i cÃ¢u há»i lá»±a chá»n cáº§n Ã­t nháº¥t hai phÆ°Æ¡ng Ã¡n khÃ¡c nhau, tá»‘i Ä‘a 500 kÃ½ tá»± má»—i phÆ°Æ¡ng Ã¡n." });
                    }

                    question.Options = options;
                }
            }

            var accountIdValue = User.FindFirstValue(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier);
            if (!int.TryParse(accountIdValue, out int maTK))
            {
                return Forbid();
            }

            var quanLy = await _context.QuanLy.FirstOrDefaultAsync(q => q.MaTK == maTK);
            if (quanLy == null)
            {
                return Forbid();
            }

            var questions = model.Questions.Select((question, index) => new CauHoiKhaoSat
            {
                NoiDung = question.NoiDung.Trim(),
                LoaiCauHoi = question.LoaiCauHoi,
                ThuTu = index + 1,
                BatBuoc = true,
                LuaChonCauHois = (question.Options ?? new List<string>())
                    .Where(option => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(option))
                    .Select((option, optionIndex) => new LuaChonCauHoi { NoiDung = option.Trim(), ThuTu = optionIndex + 1 })
                    .ToList()
            }).ToList();

            var khaoSat = new KhaoSat
            {
                MaQL = quanLy.MaQL,
                TenKhaoSat = model.TenKhaoSat.Trim(),
                MoTa = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.MoTa) ? null : model.MoTa.Trim(),
                NgayBatDau = model.NgayBatDau,
                NgayKetThuc = model.NgayKetThuc,
                TrangThai = true,
                CauHoiKhaoSats = questions
            };

            await using var transaction = await _context.Database.BeginTransactionAsync();
            _context.KhaoSat.Add(khaoSat);
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();

            var activeCustomers = await _context.KhachHang
                .Where(k => !k.DaXoa
                    && k.TaiKhoan != null
                    && k.TaiKhoan.TrangThai
                    && k.TaiKhoan.MaVaiTro == 2)
                .ToListAsync();
            foreach (var kh in activeCustomers)
            {
                _context.PhieuKhaoSat.Add(new PhieuKhaoSat
                {
                    MaKS = khaoSat.MaKS,
                    MaKH = kh.MaKH,
                    NgayBatDau = DateTime.Now,
                    TrangThai = "Äang lÃ m"
                });
            }
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
            await transaction.CommitAsync();

            var message = $"ÄÃ£ táº¡o kháº£o sÃ¡t; phiáº¿u sáº½ hiá»‡n cho {activeCustomers.Count} khÃ¡ch hÃ ng Ä‘ang hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng khi tá»›i giá» báº¯t Ä‘áº§u.";
            return Json(new { success = true, message });
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [Authorize(Roles = "Quáº£n lÃ½, Admin")]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public async Task<IActionResult> CloseSurvey(int id)
        {
            var survey = await _context.KhaoSat.FirstOrDefaultAsync(item => item.MaKS == id);
            if (survey == null)
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y kháº£o sÃ¡t cáº§n Ä‘Ã³ng.";
                return RedirectToAction(nameof(SurveyFeedback));
            }

            if (!User.IsInRole("Admin") && !User.HasClaim("MaVaiTro", "3"))
            {
                var accountIdValue = User.FindFirstValue(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier);
                if (!int.TryParse(accountIdValue, out int accountId))
                    return Forbid();

                var managerId = await _context.QuanLy
                    .Where(manager => manager.MaTK == accountId)
                    .Select(manager => (int?)manager.MaQL)
                    .FirstOrDefaultAsync();
                if (managerId == null || survey.MaQL != managerId.Value)
                    return Forbid();
            }

            survey.TrangThai = false;
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
            TempData["SuccessMessage"] = "ÄÃ£ Ä‘Ã³ng kháº£o sÃ¡t.";
            return RedirectToAction(nameof(SurveyFeedback));
        }

                    .SetProperty(item => item.TrangThai, "ÄÃ£ xá»­ lÃ½")

        // ==============================================================================
        // 5. TRANG 3: BÃO CÃO THá»NG KÃŠ CRM TÃNH TOÃN 100% Tá»ª CSDL
        // ==============================================================================
        [HttpGet]
        [Authorize(Roles = "Quáº£n lÃ½, Admin")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Analytics()
        {
            // A. Äáº¿m tá»•ng sá»‘ khÃ¡ch hÃ ng
            int totalCustomers = await _context.KhachHang
                .CountAsync(customer => !customer.DaXoa && customer.TaiKhoan != null && customer.TaiKhoan.MaVaiTro == 2);
            ViewBag.TotalCustomers = totalCustomers;

            // B. TÃ­nh tá»· lá»‡ nhÃ³m tuá»•i
            var customerBirthDates = await _context.KhachHang
                .Where(k => !k.DaXoa && k.TaiKhoan != null && k.TaiKhoan.MaVaiTro == 2
                    && k.NgaySinh.HasValue && k.NgaySinh.Value <= DateTime.Today)
                .Select(k => k.NgaySinh!.Value)
                .ToListAsync();

            var today = DateTime.Today;
            int countUnder18 = 0, count18To24 = 0, count25To35 = 0, countOver35 = 0;

            foreach (var birthDate in customerBirthDates)
            {
                int age = today.Year - birthDate.Year;
                if (birthDate.Date > today.AddYears(-age)) age--;

                if (age < 18) countUnder18++;
                else if (age <= 24) count18To24++;
                else if (age <= 35) count25To35++;
                else countOver35++;
            }

            int ageDataCount = customerBirthDates.Count;
            double pctUnder18 = ageDataCount == 0 ? 0 : Math.Round((double)countUnder18 * 100.0 / ageDataCount, 1);
            double pct18To24  = ageDataCount == 0 ? 0 : Math.Round((double)count18To24 * 100.0 / ageDataCount, 1);
            double pct25To35  = ageDataCount == 0 ? 0 : Math.Round((double)count25To35 * 100.0 / ageDataCount, 1);
            double pctOver35  = ageDataCount == 0 ? 0 : Math.Round((double)countOver35 * 100.0 / ageDataCount, 1);

            ViewBag.AgeLabels = new string[] { "DÆ°á»›i 18 tuá»•i", "18 - 24 tuá»•i", "25 - 35 tuá»•i", "TrÃªn 35 tuá»•i" };
            ViewBag.AgePercents = new double[] { pctUnder18, pct18To24, pct25To35, pctOver35 };
            ViewBag.AgeDataCount = ageDataCount;

            if (ageDataCount > 0)
            {
                var ageGroups = new[]
                {
                    (Name: "DÆ°á»›i 18 tuá»•i", Percent: pctUnder18),
                    (Name: "18 - 24 tuá»•i", Percent: pct18To24),
                    (Name: "25 - 35 tuá»•i", Percent: pct25To35),
                    (Name: "TrÃªn 35 tuá»•i", Percent: pctOver35)
                };
                var topAge = ageGroups.OrderByDescending(group => group.Percent).First();
                ViewBag.TopAgeGroup = topAge.Name;
                ViewBag.TopAgePercent = topAge.Percent;
            }
            else
            {
                ViewBag.TopAgeGroup = "ChÆ°a cÃ³ dá»¯ liá»‡u";
                ViewBag.TopAgePercent = 0;
            }

            // C. Láº¥y 100% danh má»¥c sá»Ÿ thÃ­ch tá»« CSDL
            var styleLabels = new List<string>();
            var stylePercents = new List<double>();
            string? topStyleName = null;
            double maxStyleVal = 0;
            bool hasStyleData = false;
            string styleDataMessage = "ChÆ°a cÃ³ dá»¯ liá»‡u sá»Ÿ thÃ­ch khÃ¡ch hÃ ng Ä‘á»ƒ thá»‘ng kÃª.";
            var connection = _context.Database.GetDbConnection();
            bool connectionWasOpen = connection.State == ConnectionState.Open;

            try
            {
                if (!connectionWasOpen)
                    await connection.OpenAsync();

                using var cmd = connection.CreateCommand();
                cmd.CommandText = @"
                    SELECT
                        dm.TenDM,
                        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kh.DaXoa = 0 AND tk.MaVaiTro = 2 THEN ks.MaKH END) AS SoLuong
                    FROM DANHMUC dm
                    LEFT JOIN KHACHHANG_SOTHICH ks ON dm.MaDM = ks.MaDM
                    LEFT JOIN KHACHHANG kh ON kh.MaKH = ks.MaKH
                    LEFT JOIN TAIKHOAN tk ON tk.MaTK = kh.MaTK
                    WHERE dm.TrangThai = 1
                    GROUP BY dm.MaDM, dm.TenDM
                    ORDER BY SoLuong DESC";

                using var reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync();
                var allStyles = new List<(string Name, int Count)>();

                while (await reader.ReadAsync())
                {
                    allStyles.Add((reader.GetString(0), reader.GetInt32(1)));
                }

                if (allStyles.Any(item => item.Count > 0))
                {
                    foreach (var item in allStyles)
                    {
                        double pct = totalCustomers == 0 ? 0 : Math.Round((double)item.Count * 100.0 / totalCustomers, 1);
                        styleLabels.Add(item.Name);
                        stylePercents.Add(pct);
                    }

                    topStyleName = allStyles[0].Name;
                    maxStyleVal = stylePercents[0];
                    hasStyleData = true;
                    styleDataMessage = string.Empty;
                }
            }
            catch
            {
                styleLabels.Clear();
                stylePercents.Clear();
                topStyleName = null;
                maxStyleVal = 0;
                styleDataMessage = "KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ truy váº¥n dá»¯ liá»‡u sá»Ÿ thÃ­ch khÃ¡ch hÃ ng. Vui lÃ²ng kiá»ƒm tra dá»¯ liá»‡u vÃ  káº¿t ná»‘i cÆ¡ sá»Ÿ dá»¯ liá»‡u.";
            }
            finally
            {
                if (!connectionWasOpen && connection.State == ConnectionState.Open)
                {
                    await connection.CloseAsync();
                }
            }

            ViewBag.StyleLabels = styleLabels.ToArray();
            ViewBag.StylePercents = stylePercents.ToArray();
            ViewBag.TopStyle = topStyleName;
            ViewBag.TopStylePercent = maxStyleVal;
            ViewBag.HasStyleData = hasStyleData;
            ViewBag.StyleDataMessage = styleDataMessage;

            // D. CÃ¡c kháº£o sÃ¡t Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Ã³ng hoáº·c háº¿t háº¡n cÃ³ thá»ƒ thá»‘ng kÃª.
            var now = DateTime.Now;
            ViewBag.ClosedSurveys = await _context.KhaoSat
                .Where(survey => !survey.TrangThai || survey.NgayKetThuc < now)
                .Include(survey => survey.PhieuKhaoSats)
                .OrderByDescending(survey => survey.NgayBatDau)
                .ToListAsync();

            return View("~/Views/Admin/Survey/Analytics.cshtml");
        }

        [HttpGet]
        [Authorize(Roles = "Quáº£n lÃ½, Admin")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Statistics(int id)
        {
            var statistics = await BuildStatisticsAsync(id);
            if (statistics == null) return NotFound();
            if (statistics.NgayKetThuc >= DateTime.Now
                && await _context.KhaoSat.AnyAsync(survey => survey.MaKS == id && survey.TrangThai))
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "Chá»‰ cÃ³ thá»ƒ thá»‘ng kÃª kháº£o sÃ¡t Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Ã³ng hoáº·c háº¿t háº¡n.";
                return RedirectToAction(nameof(Analytics));
            }

            return View("~/Views/Admin/Survey/Statistics.cshtml", statistics);
        }

        [HttpGet]
        [Authorize(Roles = "Quáº£n lÃ½, Admin")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> ExportStatistics(int id)
        {
            var statistics = await BuildStatisticsAsync(id);
            if (statistics == null) return NotFound();
            if (statistics.NgayKetThuc >= DateTime.Now
                && await _context.KhaoSat.AnyAsync(survey => survey.MaKS == id && survey.TrangThai))
                return BadRequest("Chá»‰ cÃ³ thá»ƒ xuáº¥t thá»‘ng kÃª kháº£o sÃ¡t Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Ã³ng hoáº·c háº¿t háº¡n.");

            var reportDirectory = Path.Combine(_environment.ContentRootPath, "App_Data", "SurveyReports");
            Directory.CreateDirectory(reportDirectory);
            var reportPath = Path.Combine(reportDirectory, $"survey-{id}.xlsx");
            var reportBytes = SurveyExcelReportBuilder.Create(statistics);
            var temporaryPath = Path.Combine(reportDirectory, $"survey-{id}-{Guid.NewGuid():N}.tmp");
            try
            {
                await System.IO.File.WriteAllBytesAsync(temporaryPath, reportBytes, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
                System.IO.File.Move(temporaryPath, reportPath, overwrite: true);
            }
            finally
            {
                if (System.IO.File.Exists(temporaryPath)) System.IO.File.Delete(temporaryPath);
            }

            return PhysicalFile(reportPath,
                "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
                $"khaosat-{id}-thong-ke.xlsx");
        }

        private async Task<SurveyStatisticsViewModel?> BuildStatisticsAsync(int surveyId)
        {
            var survey = await _context.KhaoSat.AsNoTracking()
                .Include(item => item.CauHoiKhaoSats).ThenInclude(question => question.LuaChonCauHois)
                .Include(item => item.PhieuKhaoSats).ThenInclude(ticket => ticket.TraLoiKhaoSats)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(item => item.MaKS == surveyId);
            if (survey == null) return null;

            var completedTickets = survey.PhieuKhaoSats
                .Where(ticket => ticket.TrangThai == "ÄÃ£ hoÃ n thÃ nh")
                .ToList();
            var questions = new List<SurveyQuestionStatisticsViewModel>();

            foreach (var question in survey.CauHoiKhaoSats.OrderBy(item => item.ThuTu))
            {
                var answers = completedTickets
                    .SelectMany(ticket => ticket.TraLoiKhaoSats
                        .Where(answer => answer.MaCauHoi == question.MaCauHoi)
                        .Select(answer => (Ticket: ticket, Answer: answer)))
                    .ToList();

                if (question.LoaiCauHoi is "Má»™t lá»±a chá»n" or "Nhiá»u lá»±a chá»n")
                {
                    var respondentCount = answers.Select(row => row.Ticket.MaPhieuKS).Distinct().Count();
                    questions.Add(new SurveyQuestionStatisticsViewModel
                    {
                        MaCauHoi = question.MaCauHoi,
                        ThuTu = question.ThuTu,
                        NoiDung = question.NoiDung,
                        LoaiCauHoi = question.LoaiCauHoi,
                        SoNguoiTraLoi = respondentCount,
                        LuaChons = question.LuaChonCauHois.OrderBy(option => option.ThuTu).Select(option =>
                        {
                            var count = answers.Where(row => row.Answer.MaLuaChon == option.MaLuaChon)
                                .Select(row => row.Ticket.MaPhieuKS).Distinct().Count();
                            return new SurveyOptionStatisticsViewModel
                            {
                                MaLuaChon = option.MaLuaChon,
                                NoiDung = option.NoiDung,
                                SoLuotChon = count,
                                TyLe = respondentCount == 0 ? 0 : (double)count * 100 / respondentCount
                            };
                        }).ToList()
                    });
                }
                else if (question.LoaiCauHoi == "ÄÃ¡nh giÃ¡ sao")
                {
                    var starAnswers = answers.Where(row => row.Answer.SoSao is >= 1 and <= 5).ToList();
                    var respondentCount = starAnswers.Select(row => row.Ticket.MaPhieuKS).Distinct().Count();
                    questions.Add(new SurveyQuestionStatisticsViewModel
                    {
                        MaCauHoi = question.MaCauHoi,
                        ThuTu = question.ThuTu,
                        NoiDung = question.NoiDung,
                        LoaiCauHoi = question.LoaiCauHoi,
                        SoNguoiTraLoi = respondentCount,
                        DiemTrungBinh = respondentCount == 0 ? null : starAnswers.Average(row => row.Answer.SoSao!.Value),
                        LuaChons = Enumerable.Range(1, 5).Select(star =>
                        {
                            var count = starAnswers.Where(row => row.Answer.SoSao == star)
                                .Select(row => row.Ticket.MaPhieuKS).Distinct().Count();
                            return new SurveyOptionStatisticsViewModel
                            {
                                NoiDung = $"{star} sao",
                                SoLuotChon = count,
                                TyLe = respondentCount == 0 ? 0 : (double)count * 100 / respondentCount
                            };
                        }).ToList()
                    });
                }
                else
                {
                    var textAnswers = answers
                        .Where(row => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(row.Answer.NoiDungTraLoi))
                        .OrderBy(row => row.Ticket.NgayNop)
                        .Select(row => new SurveyTextAnswerViewModel
                        {
                            MaPhieuKS = row.Ticket.MaPhieuKS,
                            NgayNop = row.Answer.NgayNop ?? row.Ticket.NgayNop,
                            NoiDung = row.Answer.NoiDungTraLoi!.Trim()
                        }).ToList();
                    questions.Add(new SurveyQuestionStatisticsViewModel
                    {
                        MaCauHoi = question.MaCauHoi,
                        ThuTu = question.ThuTu,
                        NoiDung = question.NoiDung,
                        LoaiCauHoi = question.LoaiCauHoi,
                        SoNguoiTraLoi = textAnswers.Select(answer => answer.MaPhieuKS).Distinct().Count(),
                        TraLoiTuLuan = textAnswers
                    });
                }
            }

            return new SurveyStatisticsViewModel
            {
                MaKS = survey.MaKS,
                TenKhaoSat = survey.TenKhaoSat,
                MoTa = survey.MoTa,
                NgayBatDau = survey.NgayBatDau,
                NgayKetThuc = survey.NgayKetThuc,
                TongSoPhieu = survey.PhieuKhaoSats.Count,
                SoPhieuHoanThanh = completedTickets.Count,
                CauHoi = questions
            };
        }
    }

    }

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Fashion_store.Data;
using Fashion_store.Models;

namespace Fashion_store.Controllers.Api
{
    [Route("api/[controller]")]
    [ApiController]
    public class DanhMucApiController : ControllerBase
    {
        private readonly FashionStoreDbContext _context;

        public DanhMucApiController(FashionStoreDbContext context)
        {
            _context = context;
        }

        // 1. GET: api/DanhMucApi - Láº¥y danh sÃ¡ch danh má»¥c
        [HttpGet]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetAll()
        {
            var list = await _context.DanhMuc
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Where(d => d.TrangThai)
                .Select(d => new
                {
                    d.MaDM,
                    d.TenDM,
                    d.MoTa,
                    d.TrangThai,
                    SoLuongSanPham = d.SanPhams.Count
                })
                .ToListAsync();

            return Ok(list);
        }

        // 2. GET: api/DanhMucApi/5 - Láº¥y chi tiáº¿t danh má»¥c
        [HttpGet("{id}")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetById(int id)
        {
            var item = await _context.DanhMuc
                .AsNoTracking()
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(d => d.MaDM == id && d.TrangThai);

            if (item == null) return NotFound(new { message = "KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y danh má»¥c" });
            return Ok(item);
        }

        // 3. POST: api/DanhMucApi - ThÃªm danh má»¥c má»›i
        [HttpPost]
        [Authorize(Roles = "Admin, Quáº£n lÃ½")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Create([FromBody] DanhMuc model)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.TenDM))
                return BadRequest(new { message = "TÃªn danh má»¥c khÃ´ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c Ä‘á»ƒ trá»‘ng" });

            _context.DanhMuc.Add(model);
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
            return CreatedAtAction(nameof(GetById), new { id = model.MaDM }, model);
        }

        // 4. PUT: api/DanhMucApi/5 - Cáº­p nháº­t danh má»¥c
        [HttpPut("{id}")]
        [Authorize(Roles = "Admin, Quáº£n lÃ½")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Update(int id, [FromBody] DanhMuc model)
        {
            var item = await _context.DanhMuc.FindAsync(id);
            if (item == null) return NotFound(new { message = "KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y danh má»¥c" });

            item.TenDM = model.TenDM;
            item.MoTa = model.MoTa;
            item.TrangThai = model.TrangThai;

            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
            return Ok(new { message = "Cáº­p nháº­t thÃ nh cÃ´ng", data = item });
        }

        // 5. DELETE: api/DanhMucApi/5 - XÃ³a danh má»¥c
        [HttpDelete("{id}")]
        [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Delete(int id)
        {
            var item = await _context.DanhMuc.Include(d => d.SanPhams).FirstOrDefaultAsync(d => d.MaDM == id);
            if (item == null) return NotFound(new { message = "KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y danh má»¥c" });

            if (item.SanPhams.Any())
                return BadRequest(new { message = "KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ xÃ³a vÃ¬ danh má»¥c Ä‘ang chá»©a sáº£n pháº©m" });

            _context.DanhMuc.Remove(item);
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
            return Ok(new { message = "ÄÃ£ xÃ³a danh má»¥c thÃ nh cÃ´ng" });
        }
    }
}

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Fashion_store.Data;

namespace Fashion_store.Controllers.Api
{
    [Route("api/[controller]")]
    [ApiController]
    [Authorize(Roles = "Admin, Quáº£n lÃ½")]
    public class KhachHangApiController : ControllerBase
    {
        private readonly FashionStoreDbContext _context;

        public KhachHangApiController(FashionStoreDbContext context)
        {
            _context = context;
        }

        // 1. GET: api/KhachHangApi - Quáº£n lÃ½ xem danh sÃ¡ch khÃ¡ch hÃ ng
        [HttpGet]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetAll()
        {
            var list = await _context.KhachHang
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Where(k => !k.DaXoa)
                .Select(k => new
                {
                    k.MaKH,
                    k.HoTen,
                    k.Email,
                    k.SoDienThoai,
                    k.GioiTinh,
                    k.NgaySinh,
                    k.DiaChi,
                    k.NgayDangKy,
                    TrangThaiTaiKhoan = k.TaiKhoan != null && k.TaiKhoan.TrangThai ? "Hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng" : "ÄÃ£ khÃ³a"
                }).ToListAsync();

            return Ok(list);
        }

        // 2. PUT: api/KhachHangApi/5/khoa - KhÃ³a / Má»Ÿ khÃ³a tÃ i khoáº£n khÃ¡ch hÃ ng
        [HttpPut("{id}/khoa")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> ToggleKhoa(int id)
        {
            var khachHang = await _context.KhachHang
                .Include(k => k.TaiKhoan)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(k => k.MaKH == id);

            if (khachHang == null || khachHang.TaiKhoan == null)
                return NotFound(new { message = "KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y khÃ¡ch hÃ ng hoáº·c tÃ i khoáº£n" });

            khachHang.TaiKhoan.TrangThai = !khachHang.TaiKhoan.TrangThai;
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();

            return Ok(new
            {
                message = khachHang.TaiKhoan.TrangThai ? "ÄÃ£ má»Ÿ khÃ³a tÃ i khoáº£n" : "ÄÃ£ khÃ³a tÃ i khoáº£n",
                trangThaiMoi = khachHang.TaiKhoan.TrangThai
            });
        }

        // 3. GET: api/KhachHangApi/thong-ke-do-tuoi - BÃ¡o cÃ¡o thá»‘ng kÃª Ä‘á»™ tuá»•i khÃ¡ch hÃ ng
        [HttpGet("thong-ke-do-tuoi")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> ThongKeDoTuoi()
        {
            var danhSach = await _context.KhachHang
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Where(k => !k.DaXoa && k.NgaySinh.HasValue)
                .Select(k => k.NgaySinh!.Value)
                .ToListAsync();

            var now = DateTime.Now;
            int duoi18 = 0;
            int tu18Den25 = 0;
            int tu26Den35 = 0;
            int tren35 = 0;

            foreach (var ns in danhSach)
            {
                int tuoi = now.Year - ns.Year;
                if (ns.Date > now.AddYears(-tuoi)) tuoi--;

                if (tuoi < 18) duoi18++;
                else if (tuoi <= 25) tu18Den25++;
                else if (tuoi <= 35) tu26Den35++;
                else tren35++;
            }

            return Ok(new
            {
                TongSoKhachHangCoNgaySinh = danhSach.Count,
                TiLeDoTuoi = new
                {
                    Duoi18Tuoi = duoi18,
                    Tu18Den25Tuoi = tu18Den25,
                    Tu26Den35Tuoi = tu26Den35,
                    Tren35Tuoi = tren35
                }
            });
        }
    }
}

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Fashion_store.Data;
using Fashion_store.Models;
using System.Security.Claims;

namespace Fashion_store.Controllers.Api
{
    [Route("api/[controller]")]
    [ApiController]
    [Authorize]
    public class KhaoSatApiController : ControllerBase
    {
        private readonly FashionStoreDbContext _context;

        public KhaoSatApiController(FashionStoreDbContext context)
        {
            _context = context;
        }

        // 1. GET: api/KhaoSatApi - Danh sÃ¡ch cÃ¡c chiáº¿n dá»‹ch kháº£o sÃ¡t
        [HttpGet]
        [Authorize(Roles = "Admin, Quáº£n lÃ½")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetAll()
        {
            var list = await _context.KhaoSat
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Select(k => new
                {
                    k.MaKS,
                    k.TenKhaoSat,
                    k.MoTa,
                    k.NgayBatDau,
                    k.NgayKetThuc,
                    k.TrangThai,
                    SoCauHoi = k.CauHoiKhaoSats.Count,
                    SoPhieuDaNop = k.PhieuKhaoSats.Count(p => p.TrangThai == "ÄÃ£ hoÃ n thÃ nh")
                })
                .ToListAsync();

            return Ok(list);
        }

        // 2. GET: api/KhaoSatApi/5/cau-hoi - Láº¥y toÃ n bá»™ cÃ¢u há»i vÃ  Ä‘Ã¡p Ã¡n lá»±a chá»n
        [HttpGet("{id}/cau-hoi")]
        [Authorize(Roles = "Admin, Quáº£n lÃ½, KhÃ¡ch hÃ ng")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetCauHoi(int id)
        {
            if (User.IsInRole("KhÃ¡ch hÃ ng"))
            {
                if (!int.TryParse(User.FindFirstValue(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier), out int accountId)) return Unauthorized();
                var customerId = await _context.KhachHang
                    .Where(customer => customer.MaTK == accountId && !customer.DaXoa && customer.TaiKhoan != null && customer.TaiKhoan.TrangThai)
                    .Select(customer => (int?)customer.MaKH).FirstOrDefaultAsync();
                if (customerId == null || !await _context.PhieuKhaoSat.AnyAsync(ticket => ticket.MaKS == id && ticket.MaKH == customerId))
                    return Forbid();
            }

            var khaoSat = await _context.KhaoSat
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Include(k => k.CauHoiKhaoSats)
                    .ThenInclude(c => c.LuaChonCauHois)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(k => k.MaKS == id);

            if (khaoSat == null) return NotFound(new { message = "KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y kháº£o sÃ¡t" });

            return Ok(new
            {
                khaoSat.MaKS,
                khaoSat.TenKhaoSat,
                khaoSat.MoTa,
                CauHoi = khaoSat.CauHoiKhaoSats.OrderBy(c => c.ThuTu).Select(c => new
                {
                    c.MaCauHoi,
                    c.NoiDung,
                    c.LoaiCauHoi,
                    c.BatBuoc,
                    LuaChon = c.LuaChonCauHois.OrderBy(l => l.ThuTu).Select(l => new
                    {
                        l.MaLuaChon,
                        l.NoiDung
                    })
                })
            });
        }

        // 3. POST: api/KhaoSatApi/nop-bai - KhÃ¡ch hÃ ng ná»™p káº¿t quáº£ lÃ m kháº£o sÃ¡t
        [HttpPost("nop-bai")]
        [Authorize(Roles = "KhÃ¡ch hÃ ng")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> NopBai([FromBody] NopKhaoSatDto model)
        {
            if (model.MaKS <= 0) return BadRequest(new { message = "MÃ£ kháº£o sÃ¡t khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡." });
            if (!int.TryParse(User.FindFirstValue(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier), out int accountId)) return Unauthorized();

            var customer = await _context.KhachHang.Include(item => item.TaiKhoan)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(item => item.MaTK == accountId && !item.DaXoa);
            if (customer?.TaiKhoan == null || !customer.TaiKhoan.TrangThai) return Unauthorized();

            var now = DateTime.Now;
            var ticket = await _context.PhieuKhaoSat.Include(item => item.KhaoSat)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(item => item.MaKS == model.MaKS && item.MaKH == customer.MaKH);
            if (ticket == null) return NotFound(new { message = "KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y phiáº¿u kháº£o sÃ¡t Ä‘Ã£ phÃ¡t cho tÃ i khoáº£n nÃ y." });
            if (ticket.TrangThai == "ÄÃ£ hoÃ n thÃ nh") return Conflict(new { message = "Phiáº¿u kháº£o sÃ¡t nÃ y Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Æ°á»£c ná»™p." });
            if (ticket.KhaoSat == null || !ticket.KhaoSat.TrangThai || ticket.KhaoSat.NgayBatDau > now || ticket.KhaoSat.NgayKetThuc < now)
                return BadRequest(new { message = "Kháº£o sÃ¡t chÆ°a má»Ÿ hoáº·c Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Ã³ng." });

            var questions = await _context.CauHoiKhaoSat.Include(question => question.LuaChonCauHois)
                .Where(question => question.MaKS == model.MaKS).ToListAsync();
            var answers = model.CauTraLoi ?? new List<TraLoiDto>();
            if (answers.GroupBy(answer => answer.MaCauHoi).Any(group => group.Count() > 1)
                || answers.Any(answer => questions.All(question => question.MaCauHoi != answer.MaCauHoi)))
                return BadRequest(new { message = "CÃ¢u tráº£ lá»i cÃ³ cÃ¢u há»i khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡ hoáº·c bá»‹ láº·p." });

            var answerEntities = new List<TraLoiKhaoSat>();
            foreach (var question in questions)
            {
                var answer = answers.FirstOrDefault(item => item.MaCauHoi == question.MaCauHoi);
                if (question.LoaiCauHoi is "Má»™t lá»±a chá»n" or "Nhiá»u lá»±a chá»n")
                {
                    if (!answer?.MaLuaChon.HasValue ?? true)
                    {
                        if (question.BatBuoc) return BadRequest(new { message = "Vui lÃ²ng tráº£ lá»i Ä‘áº§y Ä‘á»§ cÃ¡c cÃ¢u há»i báº¯t buá»™c." });
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (!question.LuaChonCauHois.Any(option => option.MaLuaChon == answer!.MaLuaChon))
                        return BadRequest(new { message = "PhÆ°Æ¡ng Ã¡n tráº£ lá»i khÃ´ng thuá»™c cÃ¢u há»i Ä‘Ã£ chá»n." });
                    answerEntities.Add(new TraLoiKhaoSat { MaCauHoi = question.MaCauHoi, MaLuaChon = answer!.MaLuaChon, NgayNop = now });
                }
                else if (question.LoaiCauHoi == "ÄÃ¡nh giÃ¡ sao")
                {
                    if (answer?.SoSao is null)
                    {
                        if (question.BatBuoc) return BadRequest(new { message = "Vui lÃ²ng tráº£ lá»i Ä‘áº§y Ä‘á»§ cÃ¡c cÃ¢u há»i báº¯t buá»™c." });
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (answer.SoSao is < 1 or > 5) return BadRequest(new { message = "Sá»‘ sao pháº£i náº±m trong khoáº£ng tá»« 1 Ä‘áº¿n 5." });
                    answerEntities.Add(new TraLoiKhaoSat { MaCauHoi = question.MaCauHoi, SoSao = answer.SoSao, NgayNop = now });
                }
                else if (question.LoaiCauHoi == "Tá»± luáº­n")
                {
                    var content = answer?.NoiDungTraLoi?.Trim();
                    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(content))
                    {
                        if (question.BatBuoc) return BadRequest(new { message = "Vui lÃ²ng tráº£ lá»i Ä‘áº§y Ä‘á»§ cÃ¡c cÃ¢u há»i báº¯t buá»™c." });
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (content.Length > 4000) return BadRequest(new { message = "CÃ¢u tráº£ lá»i khÃ´ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c vÆ°á»£t quÃ¡ 4.000 kÃ½ tá»±." });
                    answerEntities.Add(new TraLoiKhaoSat { MaCauHoi = question.MaCauHoi, NoiDungTraLoi = content, NgayNop = now });
                }
                else return BadRequest(new { message = "Kháº£o sÃ¡t chá»©a loáº¡i cÃ¢u há»i khÃ´ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c há»— trá»£." });
            }

            ticket.NgayNop = now;
            ticket.TrangThai = "ÄÃ£ hoÃ n thÃ nh";
            foreach (var answer in answerEntities) answer.MaPhieuKS = ticket.MaPhieuKS;
            _context.TraLoiKhaoSat.AddRange(answerEntities);
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();

            return Ok(new { message = "Ná»™p bÃ i kháº£o sÃ¡t thÃ nh cÃ´ng", maPhieuKS = ticket.MaPhieuKS, ngayNop = now });
        }

        // 4. GET: api/KhaoSatApi/5/thong-ke - BÃ¡o cÃ¡o thá»‘ng kÃª káº¿t quáº£ kháº£o sÃ¡t
        [HttpGet("{id}/thong-ke")]
        [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> ThongKe(int id)
        {
            var khaoSat = await _context.KhaoSat
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Include(k => k.CauHoiKhaoSats)
                    .ThenInclude(c => c.LuaChonCauHois)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(k => k.MaKS == id);

            if (khaoSat == null) return NotFound(new { message = "KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y kháº£o sÃ¡t" });

            int tongSoPhieu = await _context.PhieuKhaoSat.CountAsync(p => p.MaKS == id && p.TrangThai == "ÄÃ£ hoÃ n thÃ nh");

            var thongKeCauHoi = await _context.CauHoiKhaoSat
                .Where(c => c.MaKS == id)
                .Select(c => new
                {
                    c.MaCauHoi,
                    c.NoiDung,
                    c.LoaiCauHoi,
                    CacLuaChon = c.LuaChonCauHois.Select(l => new
                    {
                        l.MaLuaChon,
                        l.NoiDung,
                        SoLuotChon = _context.TraLoiKhaoSat.Count(t => t.MaCauHoi == c.MaCauHoi && t.MaLuaChon == l.MaLuaChon)
                    })
                }).ToListAsync();

            return Ok(new
            {
                khaoSat.MaKS,
                khaoSat.TenKhaoSat,
                TongSoPhieuNop = tongSoPhieu,
                ChiTietThongKe = thongKeCauHoi
            });
        }
    }

    public class NopKhaoSatDto
    {
        public int MaKS { get; set; }
        public int MaKH { get; set; }
        public List<TraLoiDto> CauTraLoi { get; set; } = new();
    }

    {
        public int MaCauHoi { get; set; }
        public int? MaLuaChon { get; set; }
        public string? NoiDungTraLoi { get; set; }
        public int? SoSao { get; set; }
    }

    public class PhanHoiApiController : ControllerBase

        private readonly FashionStoreDbContext _context;

        public PhanHoiApiController(FashionStoreDbContext context)

            _context = context;
        }

        // 1. GET: api/PhanHoiApi - Quáº£n lÃ½ xem danh sÃ¡ch pháº£n há»“i (cÃ³ lá»c theo sá»‘ sao hoáº·c tráº¡ng thÃ¡i)
        [HttpGet]
        [Authorize(Roles = "Admin, Quáº£n lÃ½")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetAll([FromQuery] int? soSao, [FromQuery] string? trangThai)
        {
            var query = _context.PhanHoi.AsNoTracking().AsQueryable();

            if (soSao.HasValue)
                query = query.Where(p => p.SoSao == soSao.Value);

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(trangThai))
                query = query.Where(p => p.TrangThai == trangThai);

            var list = await query
                .OrderByDescending(p => p.NgayGui)
                .Select(p => new
                {
                    p.MaPH,
                    TenKhachHang = p.KhachHang != null ? p.KhachHang.HoTen : "áº¨n danh",
                    TenSanPham = p.SanPham != null ? p.SanPham.TenSP : "Chung",
                    p.TieuDe,
                    p.NoiDung,
                    p.SoSao,
                    p.TrangThai,
                    p.PhanHoiQuanLy,
                    p.NgayGui,
                    p.NgayXuLy
                }).ToListAsync();

            return Ok(list);
        }

        // 2. POST: api/PhanHoiApi - KhÃ¡ch hÃ ng gá»­i Ä‘Ã¡nh giÃ¡ / pháº£n há»“i
        [HttpPost]
        [Authorize(Roles = "KhÃ¡ch hÃ ng")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GuiPhanHoi([FromBody] GuiPhanHoiDto model)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.NoiDung))
                return BadRequest(new { message = "Ná»™i dung pháº£n há»“i khÃ´ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c Ä‘á»ƒ trá»‘ng" });

            if (!int.TryParse(User.FindFirstValue(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier), out var maTK)) return Unauthorized();
            var customer = await _context.KhachHang.Include(kh => kh.TaiKhoan)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(kh => kh.MaTK == maTK && !kh.DaXoa);
            if (customer == null || customer.TaiKhoan == null || !customer.TaiKhoan.TrangThai) return Unauthorized();

            if (model.SoSao.HasValue && model.SoSao.Value is < 1 or > 5)
                return BadRequest(new { message = "Sá»‘ sao pháº£i náº±m trong khoáº£ng tá»« 1 Ä‘áº¿n 5." });
            if (model.MaSP.HasValue && !await _context.SanPham.AnyAsync(product =>
                    product.MaSP == model.MaSP.Value && product.TrangThai && !product.DaXoa))
                return BadRequest(new { message = "Sáº£n pháº©m khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i hoáº·c Ä‘Ã£ ngá»«ng kinh doanh." });

            var phanHoi = new PhanHoi
            {
                MaKH = customer.MaKH,
                MaSP = model.MaSP,
                TieuDe = model.TieuDe,
                NoiDung = model.NoiDung,
                SoSao = model.SoSao,
                LoaiPhanHoi = model.LoaiPhanHoi ?? "ÄÃ¡nh giÃ¡ sáº£n pháº©m",
                TrangThai = "ChÆ°a xá»­ lÃ½",
                NgayGui = DateTime.Now
            };

            _context.PhanHoi.Add(phanHoi);
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();

            return Ok(new { message = "Gá»­i pháº£n há»“i thÃ nh cÃ´ng", maPhanHoi = phanHoi.MaPH });
        }

        // 3. PUT: api/PhanHoiApi/5/tra-loi - Quáº£n lÃ½ pháº£n há»“i láº¡i Ã½ kiáº¿n khÃ¡ch hÃ ng
        [HttpPut("{id}/tra-loi")]
        [Authorize(Roles = "Admin, Quáº£n lÃ½")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> TraLoiPhanHoi(int id, [FromBody] TraLoiPhanHoiDto model)
        {
            var phanHoi = await _context.PhanHoi.FindAsync(id);
            if (phanHoi == null) return NotFound(new { message = "KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y pháº£n há»“i" });
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.NoiDungTraLoi))
                return BadRequest(new { message = "Ná»™i dung phÃºc Ä‘Ã¡p khÃ´ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c Ä‘á»ƒ trá»‘ng." });
            if (model.NoiDungTraLoi.Trim().Length > 2000)
                return BadRequest(new { message = "Ná»™i dung phÃºc Ä‘Ã¡p khÃ´ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c vÆ°á»£t quÃ¡ 2.000 kÃ½ tá»±." });
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(phanHoi.PhanHoiQuanLy) || phanHoi.NgayXuLy.HasValue || phanHoi.TrangThai == "ÄÃ£ xá»­ lÃ½")
                return Conflict(new { message = "Pháº£n há»“i nÃ y Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Æ°á»£c phÃºc Ä‘Ã¡p." });

            if (!int.TryParse(User.FindFirstValue(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier), out var maTK)) return Unauthorized();
            var manager = await _context.QuanLy.FirstOrDefaultAsync(item => item.MaTK == maTK);
            if (manager == null) return Forbid();

            var reply = model.NoiDungTraLoi.Trim();
            var now = DateTime.Now;
            var updated = await _context.PhanHoi
                .Where(item => item.MaPH == id
                    && (item.PhanHoiQuanLy == null || item.PhanHoiQuanLy == "")
                    && item.NgayXuLy == null
                    && item.TrangThai != "ÄÃ£ xá»­ lÃ½")
                .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters
                    .SetProperty(item => item.MaQL, (int?)manager.MaQL)
                    .SetProperty(item => item.PhanHoiQuanLy, reply)
                    .SetProperty(item => item.TrangThai, "ÄÃ£ xá»­ lÃ½")
                    .SetProperty(item => item.NgayXuLy, (DateTime?)now));
            if (updated == 0)
                return Conflict(new { message = "Pháº£n há»“i nÃ y vá»«a Ä‘Æ°á»£c phÃºc Ä‘Ã¡p bá»Ÿi má»™t quáº£n lÃ½ khÃ¡c." });
            return Ok(new { message = "ÄÃ£ cáº­p nháº­t cÃ¢u tráº£ lá»i cho khÃ¡ch hÃ ng" });
        }

        // 4. DELETE: api/PhanHoiApi/5 - XÃ³a pháº£n há»“i (Äáº·t á»Ÿ Ä‘Ã¢y má»›i chuáº©n trong class)
        [HttpDelete("{id}")]
        [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Delete(int id)
        {
            var phanHoi = await _context.PhanHoi.FindAsync(id);
            if (phanHoi == null) return NotFound(new { message = "KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y pháº£n há»“i Ä‘á»ƒ xÃ³a" });

            _context.PhanHoi.Remove(phanHoi);
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
            return Ok(new { message = "ÄÃ£ xÃ³a pháº£n há»“i thÃ nh cÃ´ng" });
        }

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Fashion_store.Data;
using Fashion_store.Models;

namespace Fashion_store.Controllers.Api
{
    [Route("api/[controller]")]
    [ApiController]
    public class SanPhamApiController : ControllerBase
    {
        private readonly FashionStoreDbContext _context;

        public SanPhamApiController(FashionStoreDbContext context)
        {
            _context = context;
        }

        // GET: api/SanPhamApi?search=ao&maDM=1 - Lá»c vÃ  tÃ¬m kiáº¿m sáº£n pháº©m
        [HttpGet]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetAll([FromQuery] string? search, [FromQuery] int? maDM)
        {
            var query = _context.SanPham.AsNoTracking()
                .Where(product => product.TrangThai && !product.DaXoa && product.DanhMuc != null && product.DanhMuc.TrangThai);

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(search))
                query = query.Where(s => s.TenSP.Contains(search) || (s.ChatLieu != null && s.ChatLieu.Contains(search)));

            if (maDM.HasValue)
                query = query.Where(s => s.MaDM == maDM.Value);

            var list = await query.Select(s => new
            {
                s.MaSP,
                s.TenSP,
                s.MaDM,
                TenDanhMuc = s.DanhMuc != null ? s.DanhMuc.TenDM : null,
                s.ChatLieu,
                s.MoTa,
                s.HinhAnh,
                s.HinhAnhMoTa,
                s.TrangThai,
                s.NgayTao,
                TongTonKho = s.SoLuongSps.Sum(sl => sl.SoLuongTon)
            }).ToListAsync();

            return Ok(list);
        }

        // GET: api/SanPhamApi/5 - Chi tiáº¿t sáº£n pháº©m kÃ¨m size/mÃ u
        [HttpGet("{id}")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetById(int id)
        {
            var item = await _context.SanPham
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Include(s => s.DanhMuc)
                .Include(s => s.SoLuongSps)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(s => s.MaSP == id && s.TrangThai && !s.DaXoa && s.DanhMuc != null && s.DanhMuc.TrangThai);

            if (item == null) return NotFound(new { message = "KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y sáº£n pháº©m" });

            return Ok(new
            {
                item.MaSP,
                item.TenSP,
                item.MaDM,
                TenDanhMuc = item.DanhMuc?.TenDM,
                item.MoTa,
                item.ChatLieu,
                item.HinhAnh,
                item.HinhAnhMoTa,
                item.TrangThai,
                item.NgayTao,
                ChiTietTonKho = item.SoLuongSps.Select(sl => new
                {
                    sl.MaSL,
                    sl.SKU,
                    sl.KichThuoc,
                    sl.MauSac,
                    sl.GiaBan,
                    sl.SoLuongTon
                })
            });
        }
    }
}
