using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.Cookies;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Fashion_store.Data;
using Fashion_store.Models;
using Fashion_store.ViewModels;

namespace Fashion_store.Controllers
{
    public class AccountController : Controller
    {
        private readonly FashionStoreDbContext _context;

        public AccountController(FashionStoreDbContext context)
        {
            _context = context;
        }

        // ==========================================
        // ÄÄ‚NG NHáº¬P KHÃCH HÃ€NG (CUSTOMER STOREFRONT)
        // ==========================================

        [HttpGet]
        [AllowAnonymous]
        public IActionResult Login(string? returnUrl = null, bool locked = false)
        {
            if (User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true)
            {
                if (User.HasClaim("MaVaiTro", "2")) return RedirectToAction("Index", "Home");
                return RedirectToAction("AccountManagement", "Account", new { area = "Admin" });
            }
            if (locked)
                ModelState.AddModelError(string.Empty, "TÃ i khoáº£n cá»§a báº¡n Ä‘Ã£ bá»‹ khÃ³a. Vui lÃ²ng liÃªn há»‡ bá»™ pháº­n há»— trá»£.");
            ViewData["ReturnUrl"] = returnUrl;
            return View("~/Views/Account/Login.cshtml", new LoginViewModel());
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [AllowAnonymous]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Login(LoginViewModel model, string? returnUrl = null)
        {
            ViewData["ReturnUrl"] = returnUrl;

            if (!ModelState.IsValid)
            {
                return View("~/Views/Account/Login.cshtml", model);
            }

            string inputUsername = model.TenDangNhap?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;
            string inputPassword = model.MatKhau ?? string.Empty;
            if (inputUsername.Any(char.IsWhiteSpace))
            {
                ModelState.AddModelError(string.Empty, "TÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p hoáº·c máº­t kháº©u khÃ´ng Ä‘Ãºng.");
                model.MatKhau = string.Empty;
                ModelState.Remove("MatKhau");
                return View("~/Views/Account/Login.cshtml", model);
            }

            // TÃ¬m tÃ i khoáº£n KhÃ¡ch hÃ ng theo TÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p hoáº·c Email
            var taiKhoan = await _context.TaiKhoan
                .Include(t => t.VaiTro)
                .Include(t => t.KhachHang)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(t => t.TenDangNhap == inputUsername 
                    || (t.KhachHang != null && t.KhachHang.Email == inputUsername));

            if (taiKhoan == null)
            {
                ModelState.AddModelError(string.Empty, "TÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p hoáº·c Email khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i trong há»‡ thá»‘ng.");
                model.MatKhau = string.Empty;
                ModelState.Remove("MatKhau");
                return View("~/Views/Account/Login.cshtml", model);
            }

            if (taiKhoan.MaVaiTro != 2 || taiKhoan.KhachHang == null)
            {
                ModelState.AddModelError(string.Empty, "TÃ i khoáº£n Admin hoáº·c Quáº£n lÃ½ khÃ´ng thá»ƒ Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p táº¡i trang khÃ¡ch hÃ ng.");
                model.MatKhau = string.Empty;
                ModelState.Remove("MatKhau");
                return View("~/Views/Account/Login.cshtml", model);
            }

            if (!taiKhoan.TrangThai || taiKhoan.KhachHang.DaXoa)
            {
                ModelState.AddModelError(string.Empty, "TÃ i khoáº£n cá»§a báº¡n Ä‘Ã£ bá»‹ khÃ³a. Vui lÃ²ng liÃªn há»‡ bá»™ pháº­n há»— trá»£.");
                model.MatKhau = string.Empty;
                ModelState.Remove("MatKhau");
                return View("~/Views/Account/Login.cshtml", model);
            }

            if (!PasswordHelper.VerifyAndUpgrade(taiKhoan, inputPassword))
            {
                ModelState.AddModelError(string.Empty, "Máº­t kháº©u khÃ´ng chÃ­nh xÃ¡c. Vui lÃ²ng kiá»ƒm tra láº¡i.");
                model.MatKhau = string.Empty;
                ModelState.Remove("MatKhau");
                return View("~/Views/Account/Login.cshtml", model);
            }

            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();

            string hoTen = taiKhoan.KhachHang?.HoTen ?? taiKhoan.TenDangNhap;

            var claims = new List<Claim>
            {
                new Claim(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier, taiKhoan.MaTK.ToString()),
                new Claim(ClaimTypes.Name, taiKhoan.TenDangNhap),
                new Claim(ClaimTypes.Role, taiKhoan.VaiTro?.TenVaiTro ?? "KhÃ¡ch hÃ ng"),
                new Claim("HoTen", hoTen),
                new Claim("MaVaiTro", taiKhoan.MaVaiTro.ToString()),
                new Claim("UserType", "KHACHHANG")
            };

            var claimsIdentity = new ClaimsIdentity(claims, CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme);
            var authProperties = new AuthenticationProperties
            {
                IsPersistent = model.RememberMe,
                ExpiresUtc = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.AddHours(8)
            };

            await HttpContext.SignInAsync(
                CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme,
                new ClaimsPrincipal(claimsIdentity),
                authProperties);

            bool hasPreferences = await _context.KhachHangSoThich.AnyAsync(x => x.MaKH == taiKhoan.KhachHang!.MaKH);
            if (!hasPreferences)
                return RedirectToAction(nameof(Preferences));

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(returnUrl) && Url.IsLocalUrl(returnUrl))
            {
                return Redirect(returnUrl);
            }

            // Chuyá»ƒn vá» Trang chá»§ KhÃ¡ch hÃ ng
            return RedirectToAction("Index", "Home");
        }

        [HttpGet]
        [Authorize(Roles = "KhÃ¡ch hÃ ng")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Preferences()
        {
            var accountId = User.FindFirstValue(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier);
            if (!int.TryParse(accountId, out var maTK)) return Challenge();
            var khachHang = await _context.KhachHang
                .Include(k => k.SoThichList)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(k => k.MaTK == maTK && !k.DaXoa);
            if (khachHang == null) return Forbid();

            ViewBag.Categories = await _context.DanhMuc.Where(d => d.TrangThai).OrderBy(d => d.MaDM).ToListAsync();
            ViewBag.SelectedIds = khachHang.SoThichList.Select(s => s.MaDM).ToHashSet();
            return View("~/Views/Account/Preferences.cshtml");
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [Authorize(Roles = "KhÃ¡ch hÃ ng")]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Preferences(List<int> selectedCategoryIds)
        {
            var accountId = User.FindFirstValue(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier);
            if (!int.TryParse(accountId, out var maTK)) return Challenge();
            var khachHang = await _context.KhachHang
                .Include(k => k.SoThichList)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(k => k.MaTK == maTK && !k.DaXoa);
            if (khachHang == null) return Forbid();

            var ids = selectedCategoryIds.Distinct().ToList();
            var categories = await _context.DanhMuc
                .Where(d => ids.Contains(d.MaDM) && d.TrangThai)
                .ToListAsync();
            if (ids.Count == 0 || ids.Count > 5 || categories.Count != ids.Count)
            {
                ModelState.AddModelError(string.Empty, "HÃ£y chá»n tá»« 1 Ä‘áº¿n 5 sá»Ÿ thÃ­ch há»£p lá»‡.");
                ViewBag.Categories = await _context.DanhMuc.Where(d => d.TrangThai).OrderBy(d => d.MaDM).ToListAsync();
                ViewBag.SelectedIds = ids.ToHashSet();
                return View("~/Views/Account/Preferences.cshtml");
            }

            _context.KhachHangSoThich.RemoveRange(khachHang.SoThichList);
            _context.KhachHangSoThich.AddRange(categories.Select(d => new KhachHangSoThich
            {
                MaKH = khachHang.MaKH,
                MaDM = d.MaDM
            }));
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
            TempData["SuccessMessage"] = "ÄÃ£ lÆ°u sá»Ÿ thÃ­ch cá»§a báº¡n.";
            return RedirectToAction("Index", "Home");
        }

        // ==========================================
        // ÄÄ‚NG KÃ TÃ€I KHOáº¢N KHÃCH HÃ€NG (CRM 4.3)
        // ==========================================

        [HttpPost]
        [AllowAnonymous]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public async Task<IActionResult> RegisterCustomer(RegisterCustomerViewModel model)
        {
            if (!ModelState.IsValid || model.TenDangNhap.Any(char.IsWhiteSpace))
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "ThÃ´ng tin Ä‘Äƒng kÃ½ chÆ°a há»£p lá»‡. Vui lÃ²ng kiá»ƒm tra láº¡i.";
                return View("~/Views/Account/Login.cshtml");
            }

            bool existsUsername = await _context.TaiKhoan.AnyAsync(t => t.TenDangNhap == model.TenDangNhap);
            if (existsUsername)
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = $"TÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p '{model.TenDangNhap}' Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Æ°á»£c sá»­ dá»¥ng.";
                return View("~/Views/Account/Login.cshtml");
            }

            bool existsEmail = await _context.KhachHang.AnyAsync(k => k.Email == model.Email);
            if (existsEmail)
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = $"Email '{model.Email}' Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Æ°á»£c Ä‘Äƒng kÃ½.";
                return View("~/Views/Account/Login.cshtml");
            }

            var vaiTroKH = await _context.VaiTro.FirstOrDefaultAsync(v => v.TenVaiTro.Contains("KhÃ¡ch"))
                           ?? await _context.VaiTro.FirstOrDefaultAsync(v => v.MaVaiTro == 2);

            var taiKhoan = new TaiKhoan
            {
                TenDangNhap = model.TenDangNhap,
                MatKhau = PasswordHelper.Hash(model.MatKhau),
                MaVaiTro = vaiTroKH?.MaVaiTro ?? 2,
                TrangThai = true,
                NgayTao = DateTime.Now
            };

            _context.TaiKhoan.Add(taiKhoan);
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();

            var khachHang = new KhachHang
            {
                MaTK = taiKhoan.MaTK,
                HoTen = model.HoTen,
                Email = model.Email,
                SoDienThoai = model.SoDienThoai,
                NgayDangKy = DateTime.Now,
                DaXoa = false
            };

            _context.KhachHang.Add(khachHang);
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();

            TempData["SuccessMessage"] = "ÄÄƒng kÃ½ tÃ i khoáº£n khÃ¡ch hÃ ng thÃ nh cÃ´ng! Vui lÃ²ng Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p.";
            return RedirectToAction(nameof(Login));
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [HttpGet]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Logout()
        {
            HttpContext.Session.Clear();
            await HttpContext.SignOutAsync(CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme);
            return RedirectToAction(nameof(Login), new { area = "", loggedOut = true });
        }
    }

        private async Task<(bool IsValid, int MaKH, string ErrorMessage)> CheckCustomerRoleAsync()
        {
            if (User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated != true)
            {
                return (false, 0, "Vui lÃ²ng Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p báº±ng tÃ i khoáº£n KhÃ¡ch hÃ ng Ä‘á»ƒ tiáº¿p tá»¥c.");
            }

            var accountIdValue = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
            if (!int.TryParse(accountIdValue, out int maTK))
            {
                return (false, 0, "KhÃ´ng xÃ¡c Ä‘á»‹nh Ä‘Æ°á»£c tÃ i khoáº£n Ä‘ang Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p.");
            }

            var taiKhoan = await _context.TaiKhoan
                .AsNoTracking()
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(t => t.MaTK == maTK);

            if (taiKhoan == null || !taiKhoan.TrangThai)
            {
                return (false, 0, "TÃ i khoáº£n khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i hoáº·c Ä‘Ã£ bá»‹ khÃ³a.");
            }

            if (taiKhoan.MaVaiTro != 2)
            {
                return (false, 0, "Khu vá»±c khÃ¡ch hÃ ng chá»‰ dÃ nh cho tÃ i khoáº£n KhÃ¡ch hÃ ng.");
            }

            var khachHang = await _context.KhachHang
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(k => k.MaTK == maTK && !k.DaXoa);

            if (khachHang == null)
            {
                return (false, 0, "KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y há»“ sÆ¡ khÃ¡ch hÃ ng Ä‘ang hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng.");
            }

            // Äá»“ng bá»™ Session phá»¥c vá»¥ banner kháº£o sÃ¡t; mÃ£ KH váº«n Ä‘Æ°á»£c tra tá»« tÃ i khoáº£n Ä‘Ã£ xÃ¡c thá»±c.
            HttpContext.Session.SetInt32("MaTK", maTK);
            HttpContext.Session.SetInt32("MaVaiTro", taiKhoan.MaVaiTro);
            HttpContext.Session.SetInt32("MaKH", khachHang.MaKH);

            return (true, khachHang.MaKH, string.Empty);
        }
        private async Task EnsureCurrentCustomerTicketsAsync(int maKH)
        {
            var now = DateTime.Now;
            var openSurveyIds = await _context.KhaoSat
                .Where(survey => survey.TrangThai && survey.NgayBatDau <= now && survey.NgayKetThuc >= now)
                .Select(survey => survey.MaKS)
                .ToListAsync();
            if (openSurveyIds.Count == 0) return;

            var existingSurveyIds = await _context.PhieuKhaoSat
                .Where(ticket => ticket.MaKH == maKH && openSurveyIds.Contains(ticket.MaKS))
                .Select(ticket => ticket.MaKS)
                .ToListAsync();
            var missingSurveyIds = openSurveyIds.Except(existingSurveyIds).ToList();
            foreach (var surveyId in missingSurveyIds)
            {
                _context.PhieuKhaoSat.Add(new PhieuKhaoSat
                {
                    MaKS = surveyId,
                    MaKH = maKH,
                    NgayBatDau = now,
                    TrangThai = "Äang lÃ m"
                });
            }
            if (missingSurveyIds.Count > 0) await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
        }

        // API KIá»‚M TRA PHIáº¾U KHáº¢O SÃT CHÆ¯A LÃ€M (DÃ¹ng cho Banner thÃ´ng bÃ¡o)

        [HttpGet]
        public async Task<IActionResult> CheckPendingSurvey()
        {
            // Kiá»ƒm tra nghiÃªm ngáº·t MaVaiTro == 2 (KhÃ¡ch hÃ ng)
            var check = await CheckCustomerRoleAsync();
            if (!check.IsValid)
            {
                return Json(new { hasSurvey = false });
            }

            int currentCustomerId = check.MaKH;
            await EnsureCurrentCustomerTicketsAsync(currentCustomerId);
            var now = DateTime.Now;

            var pendingTicket = await _context.PhieuKhaoSat
                .Include(p => p.KhaoSat)
                .Where(p => p.MaKH == currentCustomerId && 
                            p.TrangThai == "Äang lÃ m" && 
                            p.KhaoSat != null && 
                            p.KhaoSat.TrangThai &&
                            p.KhaoSat.NgayBatDau <= now &&
                            p.KhaoSat.NgayKetThuc >= now)
                .OrderByDescending(p => p.NgayBatDau)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync();

            if (pendingTicket == null)
            {
                return Json(new { hasSurvey = false });
            }

            return Json(new
            {
                hasSurvey = true,
                maPhieuKS = pendingTicket.MaPhieuKS,
                tenKhaoSat = pendingTicket.KhaoSat?.TenKhaoSat,
                moTa = pendingTicket.KhaoSat?.MoTa
            });
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Feedback(CustomerFeedbackViewModel model)
        {
            var check = await CheckCustomerRoleAsync();
            if (!check.IsValid)
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = check.ErrorMessage;
                return RedirectToAction("Login", "Account", new
                {
                    area = "",
                    returnUrl = Url.Action(nameof(Feedback), "CustomerSurvey")
                });
            }

            var allowedFeedbackTypes = new[]
            {
                "Cháº¥t lÆ°á»£ng sáº£n pháº©m",
                "Dá»‹ch vá»¥ cá»­a hÃ ng",
                "GÃ³p Ã½ máº«u má»›i",
                "KhÃ¡c"
            };

            if (!allowedFeedbackTypes.Contains(model.LoaiPhanHoi, StringComparer.Ordinal))
            {
                ModelState.AddModelError(nameof(model.LoaiPhanHoi), "Loáº¡i pháº£n há»“i khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡.");
            }

            if (model.MaSP.HasValue && await _context.PhanHoi.AnyAsync(feedback =>
                    feedback.MaKH == check.MaKH && feedback.MaSP == model.MaSP.Value && feedback.SoSao != null))
            {
                ModelState.AddModelError(nameof(model.MaSP), "Báº¡n Ä‘Ã£ gá»­i Ä‘Ã¡nh giÃ¡ cho sáº£n pháº©m nÃ y rá»“i.");
            }

            if (!ModelState.IsValid)
            {
                await LoadFeedbackProductsAsync();
                return View(model);
            }

            _context.PhanHoi.Add(new PhanHoi
            {
                // KhÃ´ng nháº­n MaKH tá»« form/request; luÃ´n gáº¯n vá»›i há»“ sÆ¡ tra tá»« claim Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p.
                MaKH = check.MaKH,
                MaSP = model.MaSP,
                TieuDe = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.TieuDe) ? null : model.TieuDe.Trim(),
                NoiDung = model.NoiDung.Trim(),
                LoaiPhanHoi = model.LoaiPhanHoi,
                SoSao = model.SoSao,
                TrangThai = "ChÆ°a xá»­ lÃ½",
                NgayGui = DateTime.Now
            });

            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
            TempData["SuccessMessage"] = "Pháº£n há»“i Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Æ°á»£c gá»­i. Cáº£m Æ¡n báº¡n Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Ã³ng gÃ³p Ã½ kiáº¿n!";
            return RedirectToAction(nameof(Feedback));
        }

        private async Task LoadFeedbackProductsAsync()
        {
            ViewBag.Products = await _context.SanPham.AsNoTracking()
                .Where(product => product.TrangThai && !product.DaXoa)
                .OrderBy(product => product.TenSP)
                .Select(product => new FeedbackProductOption { MaSP = product.MaSP, TenSP = product.TenSP })
                .ToListAsync();
        }

        [HttpGet]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Index()
        {
            var check = await CheckCustomerRoleAsync();
            if (!check.IsValid)
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = check.ErrorMessage;
                return RedirectToAction("Login", "Account");
            }

            int currentCustomerId = check.MaKH;
            await EnsureCurrentCustomerTicketsAsync(currentCustomerId);
            var now = DateTime.Now;

            var allTickets = await _context.PhieuKhaoSat
                .Include(p => p.KhaoSat)
                    .ThenInclude(k => k!.CauHoiKhaoSats)
                        .ThenInclude(question => question.LuaChonCauHois)
                .Include(p => p.TraLoiKhaoSats)
                .Where(p => p.MaKH == currentCustomerId)
                .OrderByDescending(p => p.NgayBatDau)
                .ToListAsync();

            var viewModel = new CustomerSurveyListViewModel
            {
                PhieuDangLam = allTickets
                    .Where(p => p.TrangThai == "Äang lÃ m" && 
                               p.KhaoSat != null && p.KhaoSat.TrangThai &&
                               p.KhaoSat.NgayBatDau <= now &&
                               p.KhaoSat.NgayKetThuc >= now)
                    .ToList(),
                PhieuDaHoanThanh = allTickets
                    .Where(p => p.TrangThai == "ÄÃ£ hoÃ n thÃ nh")
                    .ToList(),
                PhieuDaDong = allTickets
                    .Where(p => p.TrangThai == "Äang lÃ m" && p.KhaoSat != null
                        && (!p.KhaoSat.TrangThai || p.KhaoSat.NgayBatDau > now || p.KhaoSat.NgayKetThuc < now))
                    .ToList()
            };

            return View(viewModel);
        }

        [HttpGet]
        public async Task<IActionResult> DoSurvey(int id)
        {
            var check = await CheckCustomerRoleAsync();
            if (!check.IsValid)
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = check.ErrorMessage;
                return RedirectToAction("Login", "Account");
            }

            int currentCustomerId = check.MaKH;

            var phieu = await _context.PhieuKhaoSat
                .Include(p => p.KhaoSat)
                    .ThenInclude(k => k!.CauHoiKhaoSats.OrderBy(c => c.ThuTu))
                        .ThenInclude(c => c.LuaChonCauHois.OrderBy(l => l.ThuTu))
                .Include(p => p.TraLoiKhaoSats)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(p => p.MaPhieuKS == id && p.MaKH == currentCustomerId);

            if (phieu == null)
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y phiáº¿u kháº£o sÃ¡t nÃ y hoáº·c báº¡n khÃ´ng cÃ³ quyá»n truy cáº­p.";
                return RedirectToAction(nameof(Index));
            }

            if (phieu.KhaoSat == null)
            {
                TempData["ErrorMessage"] = "KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y bÃ i kháº£o sÃ¡t.";
                return RedirectToAction(nameof(Index));
            }

            var now = DateTime.Now;
            ViewBag.IsReadOnly = phieu.TrangThai == "ÄÃ£ hoÃ n thÃ nh"
                || !phieu.KhaoSat.TrangThai
                || phieu.KhaoSat.NgayBatDau > now
                || phieu.KhaoSat.NgayKetThuc < now;
            return View(phieu);
        }

        // =========================================================================
        // 3. Xá»¬ LÃ Ná»˜P BÃ€I KHáº¢O SÃT (SUBMIT SURVEY)
        // =========================================================================
        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public async Task<IActionResult> SubmitSurvey([FromBody] SubmitSurveyDto model)
        {
            if (model == null || model.MaPhieuKS <= 0)
            {
                return Json(new { success = false, message = "Dá»¯ liá»‡u kháº£o sÃ¡t khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡." });
            }

            var check = await CheckCustomerRoleAsync();
            if (!check.IsValid)
            {
                return Json(new { success = false, message = check.ErrorMessage });
            }

            int currentCustomerId = check.MaKH;

            var phieu = await _context.PhieuKhaoSat
                .Include(p => p.KhaoSat)
                    .ThenInclude(k => k!.CauHoiKhaoSats)
                        .ThenInclude(question => question.LuaChonCauHois)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(p => p.MaPhieuKS == model.MaPhieuKS && p.MaKH == currentCustomerId);

            if (phieu == null)
            {
                return Json(new { success = false, message = "KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y thÃ´ng tin phiáº¿u kháº£o sÃ¡t." });
            }

            if (phieu.TrangThai == "ÄÃ£ hoÃ n thÃ nh")
            {
                return Json(new { success = false, message = "Phiáº¿u kháº£o sÃ¡t nÃ y Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Æ°á»£c ná»™p trÆ°á»›c Ä‘Ã³." });
            }

            var now = DateTime.Now;
            if (phieu.KhaoSat == null || !phieu.KhaoSat.TrangThai
                || phieu.KhaoSat.NgayBatDau > now
                || phieu.KhaoSat.NgayKetThuc < now)
            {
                return Json(new { success = false, message = "BÃ i kháº£o sÃ¡t hiá»‡n chÆ°a má»Ÿ hoáº·c Ä‘Ã£ háº¿t háº¡n." });
            }

            var questions = phieu.KhaoSat.CauHoiKhaoSats.ToList();
            var submittedAnswers = model.Answers ?? new List<AnswerItemDto>();
            if (submittedAnswers.GroupBy(answer => answer.MaCauHoi).Any(group => group.Count() > 1)
                || submittedAnswers.Any(answer => questions.All(question => question.MaCauHoi != answer.MaCauHoi)))
            {
                return Json(new { success = false, message = "CÃ¢u tráº£ lá»i chá»©a cÃ¢u há»i khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡." });
            }

            var answerByQuestion = submittedAnswers.ToDictionary(answer => answer.MaCauHoi);
            var traLoiSet = _context.Set<TraLoiKhaoSat>();

            foreach (var question in questions)
            {
                answerByQuestion.TryGetValue(question.MaCauHoi, out var answer);

                if (question.LoaiCauHoi == "Má»™t lá»±a chá»n")
                {
                    if (answer?.MaLuaChon == null)
                    {
                        if (question.BatBuoc)
                            return Json(new { success = false, message = "Vui lÃ²ng tráº£ lá»i Ä‘áº§y Ä‘á»§ cÃ¡c cÃ¢u há»i báº¯t buá»™c." });
                        continue;
                    }

                    var selectedOption = question.LuaChonCauHois
                        .FirstOrDefault(option => option.MaLuaChon == answer!.MaLuaChon!.Value);
                    if (selectedOption == null)
                    {
                        return Json(new { success = false, message = "Má»™t phÆ°Æ¡ng Ã¡n tráº£ lá»i khÃ´ng thuá»™c cÃ¢u há»i Ä‘Ã£ chá»n." });
                    }

                    traLoiSet.Add(new TraLoiKhaoSat
                    {
                        MaPhieuKS = phieu.MaPhieuKS,
                        MaCauHoi = question.MaCauHoi,
                        MaLuaChon = selectedOption.MaLuaChon,
                        NgayNop = now
                    });
                }
                else if (question.LoaiCauHoi == "Nhiá»u lá»±a chá»n")
                {
                    var selectedIds = answer?.DanhSachMaLuaChon ?? new List<int>();
                    var allowedIds = question.LuaChonCauHois.Select(option => option.MaLuaChon).ToHashSet();
                    if (selectedIds.Distinct().Count() != selectedIds.Count || selectedIds.Any(id => !allowedIds.Contains(id)))
                    {
                        return Json(new { success = false, message = "Má»™t hoáº·c nhiá»u phÆ°Æ¡ng Ã¡n tráº£ lá»i khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡." });
                    }
                    if (question.BatBuoc && selectedIds.Count == 0)
                    {
                        return Json(new { success = false, message = "Vui lÃ²ng tráº£ lá»i Ä‘áº§y Ä‘á»§ cÃ¡c cÃ¢u há»i báº¯t buá»™c." });
                    }

                    foreach (var optionId in selectedIds)
                    {
                        traLoiSet.Add(new TraLoiKhaoSat
                        {
                            MaPhieuKS = phieu.MaPhieuKS,
                            MaCauHoi = question.MaCauHoi,
                            MaLuaChon = optionId,
                            NgayNop = now
                        });
                    }
                }
                else if (question.LoaiCauHoi == "ÄÃ¡nh giÃ¡ sao")
                {
                    if (answer?.SoSao == null)
                    {
                        if (question.BatBuoc)
                            return Json(new { success = false, message = "Vui lÃ²ng tráº£ lá»i Ä‘áº§y Ä‘á»§ cÃ¡c cÃ¢u há»i báº¯t buá»™c." });
                        continue;
                    }
                    int rating = answer!.SoSao!.Value;
                    if (rating < 1 || rating > 5)
                    {
                        return Json(new { success = false, message = "Sá»‘ sao pháº£i náº±m trong khoáº£ng tá»« 1 Ä‘áº¿n 5." });
                    }

                    traLoiSet.Add(new TraLoiKhaoSat
                    {
                        MaPhieuKS = phieu.MaPhieuKS,
                        MaCauHoi = question.MaCauHoi,
                        SoSao = rating,
                        NgayNop = now
                    });
                }
                else if (question.LoaiCauHoi == "Tá»± luáº­n")
                {
                    var text = answer?.NoiDungTraLoi?.Trim();
                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
                    {
                        if (question.BatBuoc)
                            return Json(new { success = false, message = "Vui lÃ²ng tráº£ lá»i Ä‘áº§y Ä‘á»§ cÃ¡c cÃ¢u há»i báº¯t buá»™c." });
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (text.Length > 4000)
                    {
                        return Json(new { success = false, message = "CÃ¢u tráº£ lá»i tá»± luáº­n khÃ´ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c vÆ°á»£t quÃ¡ 4.000 kÃ½ tá»±." });
                    }

                    traLoiSet.Add(new TraLoiKhaoSat
                    {
                        MaPhieuKS = phieu.MaPhieuKS,
                        MaCauHoi = question.MaCauHoi,
                        NoiDungTraLoi = text,
                        NgayNop = now
                    });
                }
                else
                {
                    return Json(new { success = false, message = "BÃ i kháº£o sÃ¡t chá»©a loáº¡i cÃ¢u há»i khÃ´ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c há»— trá»£." });
                }
            }

            phieu.TrangThai = "ÄÃ£ hoÃ n thÃ nh";
            phieu.NgayNop = DateTime.Now;

            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();

            return Json(new { 
                success = true, 
                message = "Cáº£m Æ¡n báº¡n Ä‘Ã£ tham gia Ä‘Ã³ng gÃ³p Ã½ kiáº¿n vá» máº«u Ã¡o má»›i!"
            });
        }
    }
}

using System.Diagnostics;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Fashion_store.Models;

namespace Fashion_store.Controllers;

public class HomeController : Controller
{
    public IActionResult Index()
    {
        return View();
    }

    public IActionResult Privacy()
    {
        return View();
    }

    [ResponseCache(Duration = 0, Location = ResponseCacheLocation.None, NoStore = true)]
    public IActionResult Error()
    {
        return View(new ErrorViewModel { RequestId = Activity.Current?.Id ?? HttpContext.TraceIdentifier });
    }
}

using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Fashion_store.Models;

namespace Fashion_store.Data
{
    public class FashionStoreDbContext : DbContext
    {
        public FashionStoreDbContext(DbContextOptions<FashionStoreDbContext> options)
            : base(options)
        {
        }

        public DbSet<VaiTro> VaiTro { get; set; }
        public DbSet<TaiKhoan> TaiKhoan { get; set; }
        public DbSet<QuanLy> QuanLy { get; set; }
        public DbSet<KhachHang> KhachHang { get; set; }
        public DbSet<DanhMuc> DanhMuc { get; set; }
        public DbSet<SanPham> SanPham { get; set; }
        public DbSet<SoLuongSp> SoLuongSp { get; set; }
        public DbSet<KhaoSat> KhaoSat { get; set; }
        public DbSet<CauHoiKhaoSat> CauHoiKhaoSat { get; set; }
        public DbSet<LuaChonCauHoi> LuaChonCauHoi { get; set; }
        public DbSet<PhieuKhaoSat> PhieuKhaoSat { get; set; }
        public DbSet<PhanHoi> PhanHoi { get; set; }
        public DbSet<TraLoiKhaoSat> TraLoiKhaoSat { get; set; }

        public DbSet<KhachHangSoThich> KhachHangSoThich { get; set; }

        protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
        {
            base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);

            // Báº£ng KHACHHANG_SOTHICH
            modelBuilder.Entity<KhachHangSoThich>(entity =>
            {
                entity.ToTable("KHACHHANG_SOTHICH");
                entity.HasKey(e => new { e.MaKH, e.MaDM });

                entity.HasOne(d => d.KhachHang)
                    .WithMany(p => p.SoThichList)
                    .HasForeignKey(d => d.MaKH)
                    .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);

                entity.HasOne(d => d.DanhMuc)
                    .WithMany(p => p.KhachHangSoThichs)
                    .HasForeignKey(d => d.MaDM)
                    .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            });

            // Báº£ng VAITRO
            modelBuilder.Entity<VaiTro>(entity =>
            {
                entity.ToTable("VAITRO");
                entity.HasKey(e => e.MaVaiTro);
                entity.Property(e => e.TenVaiTro).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(50);
            });

            // Báº£ng TAIKHOAN
            modelBuilder.Entity<TaiKhoan>(entity =>
            {
                entity.ToTable("TAIKHOAN");
                entity.HasKey(e => e.MaTK);
                entity.Property(e => e.TenDangNhap).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(50);
                entity.Property(e => e.MatKhau).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(255);

                entity.HasOne(d => d.VaiTro)
                    .WithMany(p => p.TaiKhoans)
                    .HasForeignKey(d => d.MaVaiTro)
                    .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.ClientSetNull)
                    .HasConstraintName("FK_TAIKHOAN_VAITRO");
            });

            // Báº£ng QUANLY
            modelBuilder.Entity<QuanLy>(entity =>
            {
                entity.ToTable("QUANLY");
                entity.HasKey(e => e.MaQL);
                entity.Property(e => e.HoTen).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(100);

                entity.HasOne(d => d.TaiKhoan)
                    .WithOne(p => p.QuanLy)
                    .HasForeignKey<QuanLy>(d => d.MaTK)
                    .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade)
                    .HasConstraintName("FK_QUANLY_TAIKHOAN");
            });

            // Báº£ng KHACHHANG
            modelBuilder.Entity<KhachHang>(entity =>
            {
                entity.ToTable("KHACHHANG");
                entity.HasKey(e => e.MaKH);
                entity.Property(e => e.HoTen).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(100);
                entity.Property(e => e.Email).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(100);

                entity.HasOne(d => d.TaiKhoan)
                    .WithOne(p => p.KhachHang)
                    .HasForeignKey<KhachHang>(d => d.MaTK)
                    .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade)
                    .HasConstraintName("FK_KHACHHANG_TAIKHOAN");
            });

            // Báº£ng DANHMUC
            modelBuilder.Entity<DanhMuc>(entity =>
            {
                entity.ToTable("DANHMUC");
                entity.HasKey(e => e.MaDM);
                entity.Property(e => e.TenDM).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(100);
            });

            // Báº£ng SANPHAM
            modelBuilder.Entity<SanPham>(entity =>
            {
                entity.ToTable("SANPHAM");
                entity.HasKey(e => e.MaSP);
                entity.Property(e => e.TenSP).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(200);

                entity.HasOne(d => d.DanhMuc)
                    .WithMany(p => p.SanPhams)
                    .HasForeignKey(d => d.MaDM)
                    .HasConstraintName("FK_SANPHAM_DANHMUC");
            });

            // Báº£ng SOLUONGSP (Biáº¿n thá»ƒ)
            modelBuilder.Entity<SoLuongSp>(entity =>
            {
                entity.ToTable("SOLUONGSP");
                entity.HasKey(e => e.MaSL);
                entity.Property(e => e.SKU).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(50);
                entity.Property(e => e.GiaBan).HasColumnType("decimal(18, 2)");

                entity.HasOne(d => d.SanPham)
                    .WithMany(p => p.SoLuongSps)
                    .HasForeignKey(d => d.MaSP)
                    .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade)
                    .HasConstraintName("FK_SOLUONGSP_SANPHAM");
            });

            // Báº£ng PHANHOI
            modelBuilder.Entity<PhanHoi>(entity =>
            {
                entity.ToTable("PHANHOI");
                entity.HasKey(e => e.MaPH);

                entity.HasOne(d => d.SanPham)
                    .WithMany()
                    .HasForeignKey(d => d.MaSP)
                    .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.SetNull)
                    .HasConstraintName("FK_PHANHOI_SANPHAM");
            });
        }
    }
}

let currentStar  = 0;

// Character count for title

  document.getElementById('tieude-count').textContent = this.value.length;

async function loadFeedbackProducts() {
  const select = document.getElementById('fb-sp');
  try {
    const response = await Http.get(`${API.reviews}/eligible-products`);
    const products = response?.Data?.Items || [];
    products.forEach(product => {
      const option = document.createElement('option');
      option.value = product.MaSP;
      option.textContent = product.TenSP;
      select.appendChild(option);
    });
  } catch (error) {
    Toast.warning('KhÃ´ng táº£i Ä‘Æ°á»£c danh sÃ¡ch sáº£n pháº©m. Báº¡n váº«n cÃ³ thá»ƒ gá»­i pháº£n há»“i chung.');
  }
}

function updateStarVisibility() {
  const showStars = Boolean(document.getElementById('fb-sp').value);
  document.getElementById('star-group').style.display = showStars ? 'block' : 'none';
  if (!showStars) {
    currentStar = 0;
    document.getElementById('fb-sao').value = 0;
    updateStars(0);
    document.getElementById('err-star').textContent = '';
  }
}

function setStar(n) {
  currentStar = n;
  document.getElementById('fb-sao').value = n;
  updateStars(n);
}
function hoverStar(n) { updateStars(n, true); }
function unhoverStar() { updateStars(currentStar); }
function updateStars(n, hover=false) {
  document.querySelectorAll('#star-rating span').forEach((s,i) => {
    s.classList.toggle(hover ? 'hover' : 'active', i < n);
    if (!hover) s.classList.remove('hover');
  });
}

function resetForm() {
  currentStar = 0;
  ['fb-sp','fb-tieude','fb-noidung'].forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).value='');
  ['tieude-count','noidung-count'].forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).textContent='0');
  document.getElementById('star-group').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('err-star').textContent = '';
  updateStars(0);
}

function validate() {
  let ok = true;
  if (!document.getElementById('fb-tieude').value.trim()) { document.getElementById('err-tieude').textContent='Vui lÃ²ng nháº­p tiÃªu Ä‘á»'; ok=false; }
  else document.getElementById('err-tieude').textContent='';
  if (!document.getElementById('fb-noidung').value.trim()) { document.getElementById('err-noidung').textContent='Vui lÃ²ng nháº­p ná»™i dung'; ok=false; }
  else document.getElementById('err-noidung').textContent='';
  return ok;
}

async function submitFeedback() {
  if (!validate()) return;
  const btn = document.querySelector('[onclick="submitFeedback()"]');
  btn.disabled=true; btn.textContent='â³ Äang gá»­i...';
  try {
    const maSP = Number(document.getElementById('fb-sp').value) || null;
    const tieuDe = document.getElementById('fb-tieude').value.trim();
    const noiDung = document.getElementById('fb-noidung').value.trim();
    const isProductReview = maSP && currentStar > 0;
    const response = isProductReview
      ? await Http.post(API.reviews, { MaKH: 0, MaSP: maSP, SoSao: currentStar, NoiDung: `${tieuDe}\n${noiDung}` })
      : await Http.post(API.feedbacks, { MaKH: 0, MaSP: maSP, TieuDe: tieuDe, NoiDung: noiDung, LoaiPhanHoi: maSP ? 'GÃ³p Ã½ sáº£n pháº©m' : 'GÃ³p Ã½ chung' });
    if (!response?.Success) throw new Error(response?.Message || 'Gá»­i ná»™i dung tháº¥t báº¡i.');
    Toast.success(isProductReview ? 'ÄÃ£ gá»­i Ä‘Ã¡nh giÃ¡ sáº£n pháº©m.' : 'ÄÃ£ gá»­i pháº£n há»“i thÃ nh cÃ´ng.');
    resetForm();
    if (document.getElementById('fb-history').style.display !== 'none') await loadHistory();
  } catch (error) {
    Toast.error(error.message || 'KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ gá»­i pháº£n há»“i.');
  } finally {
    btn.disabled=false; btn.textContent='ðŸ“¤ Gá»­i pháº£n há»“i';
  }
}

// History
let history = [];
async function loadHistory() {
  const [feedbackResult, reviewResult] = await Promise.allSettled([
    Http.get(`${API.feedbacks}/my`),
    Http.get(`${API.reviews}/my`)
  ]);
  const feedbackItems = feedbackResult.status === 'fulfilled' && Array.isArray(feedbackResult.value?.Data)
    ? feedbackResult.value.Data
    : [];
  const reviewItems = reviewResult.status === 'fulfilled' && Array.isArray(reviewResult.value?.Data)
    ? reviewResult.value.Data
    : [];

  history = [
    ...feedbackItems.map(item => ({
      isReview: false,
      tieuDe: item.TieuDe || 'Pháº£n há»“i khÃ´ng cÃ³ tiÃªu Ä‘á»',
      loai: item.LoaiPhanHoi || 'KhÃ¡c',
      trangThai: item.TrangThai,
      ngay: item.NgayGui,
      noiDung: item.NoiDung || '',
      phanHoi: item.PhanHoiQuanLy || ''
    })),
    ...reviewItems.map(item => {
      const [title, ...content] = String(item.NoiDung || '').split('\n');
      return {
        isReview: true,
        tieuDe: title || `ÄÃ¡nh giÃ¡ ${item.TenSP || `sáº£n pháº©m #${item.MaSP}`}`,
        loai: item.TenSP || `Sáº£n pháº©m #${item.MaSP}`,
        trangThai: 'ÄÃ£ gá»­i',
        ngay: item.NgayDanhGia,
        noiDung: content.join('\n') || title,
        stars: Number(item.SoSao) || 0,
        phanHoi: ''
      };
    })
  ].sort((left, right) => new Date(right.ngay) - new Date(left.ngay));

  if (feedbackResult.status === 'rejected' && reviewResult.status === 'rejected')
    Toast.error('KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ táº£i lá»‹ch sá»­ pháº£n há»“i.');
  renderHistory();
}
function toggleHistory() {
  const div = document.getElementById('fb-history');
  const show = div.style.display === 'none';
  div.style.display = show ? 'block' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('history-toggle').textContent = show ? 'áº¨n lá»‹ch sá»­' : 'Xem lá»‹ch sá»­';
  if (show && !history.length) loadHistory();
}
function renderHistory() {
  document.getElementById('history-list').innerHTML = history.map(h=>`
    <div style="padding:14px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)">
      <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px">
        <strong style="font-size:14px">${escapeFeedbackHtml(h.tieuDe)}</strong>
        ${h.isReview ? '<span class="badge badge-success">ÄÃ£ gá»­i</span>' : Format.feedbackStatus(h.trangThai)}
      </div>
      <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);margin-top:4px">${escapeFeedbackHtml(h.loai)} â€¢ ${Format.datetime(h.ngay)}</div>
      ${h.stars ? `<div style="margin-top:6px;color:#f59e0b">${'â˜…'.repeat(h.stars)}${'â˜†'.repeat(5-h.stars)}</div>` : ''}
      ${h.noiDung ? `<p style="margin:8px 0 0;white-space:pre-wrap">${escapeFeedbackHtml(h.noiDung)}</p>` : ''}
      ${h.phanHoi?`<div style="background:#f0fdf4;border-radius:var(--radius);padding:10px;margin-top:8px;font-size:13px;color:#15803d;border-left:3px solid var(--success)">ðŸ’¬ <strong>Pháº£n há»“i tá»« cá»­a hÃ ng:</strong> ${escapeFeedbackHtml(h.phanHoi)}</div>`:''}
    </div>`).join('') || `<div class="empty-state" style="padding:40px"><div class="empty-icon">ðŸ’¬</div><h3>ChÆ°a cÃ³ pháº£n há»“i</h3></div>`;
}
function escapeFeedbackHtml(value) {
  return String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, character => ({
    '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;'
  })[character]);
}

async function loadStoreData() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('featured-grid');
  grid.innerHTML = '<p class="store-message">Äang táº£i sáº£n pháº©m...</p>';
  try {
    const [categoryResponse, productResponse] = await Promise.all([
      Http.get(API.categories, { trangThai: true }),
      Http.get(API.products, { page: 1, pageSize: 100, trangThai: true }),
    ]);
    const categoryRows = Array.isArray(categoryResponse?.Data) ? categoryResponse.Data : [];
    const productRows = productResponse?.Data?.Items || [];
    PRODUCTS = productRows.filter(product => product.TrangThai !== false).map(normalizeProduct);
    CATEGORIES = categoryRows.filter(category => category.TrangThai !== false).map(category => ({
      id: Number(category.MaDM),
      name: category.TenDM || 'Danh má»¥c',
      count: PRODUCTS.filter(product => product.categoryId === Number(category.MaDM)).length,
    }));
    renderCategories();
    renderFeatured('');
  } catch (error) {
    grid.innerHTML = `<p class="store-message">${escapeHTML(error.message || 'KhÃ´ng táº£i Ä‘Æ°á»£c sáº£n pháº©m. HÃ£y kiá»ƒm tra káº¿t ná»‘i mÃ¡y chá»§.')}</p>`;
    document.getElementById('cat-grid').innerHTML = '<span class="store-message">ChÆ°a táº£i Ä‘Æ°á»£c danh má»¥c.</span>';
  } finally {
    document.getElementById('loading-overlay')?.classList.remove('show');
  }
}

function normalizeProduct(product) {
  const sizes = parseOptions(product.KichThuoc, ['S', 'M', 'L', 'XL']);
  const colors = parseOptions(product.MauSac, ['Máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh']);
  return {
    id: Number(product.MaSP),
    categoryId: Number(product.MaDM),
    cat: product.TenDM || 'Sáº£n pháº©m',
    name: product.TenSP || 'Sáº£n pháº©m thá»i trang',
    price: Number(product.Gia) || 0,
    stock: Number(product.SoLuongTon) || 0,
    image: resolveProductImage(product.HinhAnh),
    detailImage: resolveProductImage(product.HinhAnhMoTa) || resolveProductImage(product.HinhAnh),
    desc: product.MoTa || 'Thiáº¿t káº¿ dÃ nh cho phong cÃ¡ch thÆ°á»ng ngÃ y.',
    sizes,
    colors,
    icon: 'â—‡',
    createdAt: product.NgayTao,
  };
}

function parseOptions(value, fallback) {
  const options = String(value || '').split(/[,;|]/).map(item => item.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  return options.length ? options : fallback;
}

function resolveProductImage(value) {
  const image = String(value || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/');
  if (!image) return '';
  if (/^(https?:|data:)/i.test(image)) return image;
  const path = image.startsWith('/') ? image : '/' + (image.startsWith('./') ? image.slice(2) : image);
  return new URL(path, API_BASE).toString();
}

function escapeHTML(value) {
  return String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, character => ({
    '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;',
  })[character]);
}

function renderCategories() {
  const links = CATEGORIES.map(category => `
    <a href="products.html?cat=${encodeURIComponent(category.name)}">
      <span>${escapeHTML(category.name)}</span><small>${category.count}</small>
    </a>`).join('');
  document.getElementById('cat-grid').innerHTML = links || '<span class="store-message">ChÆ°a cÃ³ danh má»¥c sáº£n pháº©m.</span>';

  const nav = document.getElementById('category-nav');
  nav.innerHTML = `<a href="home.html" class="active">Trang chá»§</a>
    <a href="products.html">Táº¥t cáº£ sáº£n pháº©m</a><a href="#collections">Danh má»¥c</a>`;

  document.getElementById('footer-categories').innerHTML = CATEGORIES.map(category =>
    `<a href="products.html?cat=${encodeURIComponent(category.name)}">${escapeHTML(category.name)}</a>`).join('');

  const chips = document.getElementById('feat-chips');
  chips.innerHTML = `<button class="cat-chip active" type="button" data-cat="">Táº¥t cáº£</button>${CATEGORIES.map(category =>
    `<button class="cat-chip" type="button" data-cat="${escapeHTML(category.name)}">${escapeHTML(category.name)}</button>`).join('')}`;
  chips.querySelectorAll('.cat-chip').forEach(button =>
    button.addEventListener('click', () => renderFeatured(button.dataset.cat)));
}

/* ===== FEATURED ===== */
function renderFeatured(cat) {
  currentCatFilter = cat;
  document.querySelectorAll('#feat-chips .cat-chip').forEach(c =>
    c.classList.toggle('active', c.dataset.cat === cat));
  const list = (cat ? PRODUCTS.filter(p => p.cat === cat) : PRODUCTS).slice(0, 8);
  document.getElementById('featured-grid').innerHTML =
    list.length ? list.map(renderProductCard).join('') :
    `<p class="store-message">${PRODUCTS.length ? 'Danh má»¥c nÃ y chÆ°a cÃ³ sáº£n pháº©m.' : 'ChÆ°a cÃ³ sáº£n pháº©m trong cá»­a hÃ ng.'}</p>`;
}

/* ===== PRODUCT CARD ===== */
function renderProductCard(p) {
  const inWL     = wishlist.includes(p.id);
  return `
    <div class="product-card" onclick="viewProduct(${p.id})">
      <div class="product-img">

        <div class="product-actions">
          <button class="product-action-btn ${inWL?'active':''}"
            onclick="event.stopPropagation();toggleWish(${p.id})"
            title="YÃªu thÃ­ch">${inWL ? 'â™¥' : 'â™¡'}</button>
          <button class="product-action-btn" ${p.stock < 1 ? 'disabled' : ''}
            onclick="event.stopPropagation();quickAdd(${p.id})" title="ThÃªm vÃ o giá»">ï¼‹</button>
        </div>

      <div class="product-info">

        <div class="product-stock">${p.stock > 0 ? 'CÃ²n hÃ ng' : 'Táº¡m háº¿t hÃ ng'}</div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
}

/* ===== PRODUCT DETAIL ===== */
function viewProduct(id) {
  const p = PRODUCTS.find(p => p.id === id);
  if (!p) return;
  selectedSize[id] = p.sizes[0];
  document.getElementById('pd-title').textContent = p.name;

        <p class="pd-desc">${escapeHTML(p.desc)}</p>
        <div style="margin-bottom:18px">

          <button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:14px 16px;border-radius:var(--radius-md)" onclick="toggleWish(${id});this.textContent=wishlist.includes(${id})?'â¤ï¸':'ðŸ¤'">

function selectSize(id, s, el) {
  selectedSize[id] = s;
  document.getElementById(`sel-size-${id}`).textContent = s;
  el.closest('.size-chips').querySelectorAll('.size-chip').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected'));
  el.classList.add('selected');
}
function addFromDetail(id) {
  const p = PRODUCTS.find(product => product.id === id);
  if (!p || p.stock < 1) { Toast.warning('Sáº£n pháº©m hiá»‡n Ä‘Ã£ háº¿t hÃ ng.'); return; }
  const size = selectedSize[id] || p.sizes[0];
  const cartId = `${id}_${size}`;
  const existing = cart.find(item => item.cartId === cartId);
  if (existing && existing.qty >= p.stock) { Toast.warning('Sá»‘ lÆ°á»£ng trong giá» Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘áº¡t tá»“n kho.'); return; }
  if (existing) existing.qty++;
  else cart.push({ cartId, id, name:p.name, price:p.price, icon:p.icon, image:p.image, size, qty:1 });
  updateCartUI();
  Modal.close('modal-product');
  openCart();
  Toast.success(`ÄÃ£ thÃªm "${p.name}" vÃ o giá»!`);
}

/* Giá» hÃ ng demo chá»‰ lÆ°u trÃªn trÃ¬nh duyá»‡t, khÃ´ng gá»­i dá»¯ liá»‡u lÃªn API. */
function updateCartUI() {
  const total = cart.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price * item.qty, 0);
  const count = cart.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.qty, 0);
  document.getElementById('cart-count').textContent = count;
  document.getElementById('cart-header-count').textContent = `(${count})`;
  document.getElementById('cart-subtotal').textContent = Format.currency(total);
  document.getElementById('cart-total').textContent = Format.currency(total);
  Storage.set('crm_cart', cart);
  const body = document.getElementById('cart-body');
  if (!cart.length) {
    body.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state" style="padding:64px 20px"><div class="empty-icon">ðŸ›’</div><h3>Giá» hÃ ng trá»‘ng</h3><p>ThÃªm sáº£n pháº©m Ä‘á»ƒ báº¯t Ä‘áº§u mua sáº¯m</p></div>';
    return;
  }
  body.innerHTML = cart.map(item => `
    <div class="cart-item">
      <div class="cart-item-img">${item.image ? `<img src="${escapeHTML(item.image)}" alt="${escapeHTML(item.name)}">` : escapeHTML(item.icon || 'â—‡')}</div>
      <div class="cart-item-info">
        <div class="cart-item-name">${escapeHTML(item.name)}</div>
        <div class="cart-item-meta">Size: ${escapeHTML(item.size)}</div>
        <div class="cart-item-price">${Format.currency(item.price)}</div>
        <div class="qty-control">
          <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty('${item.cartId}',-1)">âˆ’</button>
          <span class="qty-num">${item.qty}</span>
          <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty('${item.cartId}',1)">+</button>
          <button class="remove-btn" onclick="removeCart('${item.cartId}')">ðŸ—‘ï¸</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>`).join('');
}
function quickAdd(id) {
  const product = PRODUCTS.find(item => item.id === id);
  if (!product || product.stock < 1) { Toast.warning('Sáº£n pháº©m hiá»‡n Ä‘Ã£ háº¿t hÃ ng.'); return; }
  const cartId = `${id}_${product.sizes[0]}`;
  const existing = cart.find(item => item.cartId === cartId);
  if (existing && existing.qty >= product.stock) { Toast.warning('Sá»‘ lÆ°á»£ng trong giá» Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘áº¡t tá»“n kho.'); return; }
  if (existing) existing.qty++;
  else cart.push({ cartId, id, name:product.name, price:product.price, icon:product.icon, image:product.image, size:product.sizes[0], qty:1 });
  updateCartUI();
  openCart();
  Toast.success(`ÄÃ£ thÃªm "${product.name}" vÃ o giá»!`);
}
function changeQty(cartId, delta) {
  const item = cart.find(entry => entry.cartId === cartId);
  if (!item) return;
  const product = PRODUCTS.find(entry => entry.id === item.id);
  if (delta > 0 && product && item.qty >= product.stock) { Toast.warning('Sá»‘ lÆ°á»£ng trong giá» Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘áº¡t tá»“n kho.'); return; }
  item.qty += delta;
  if (item.qty <= 0) cart = cart.filter(entry => entry.cartId !== cartId);
  updateCartUI();
}
function removeCart(cartId) { cart = cart.filter(item => item.cartId !== cartId); updateCartUI(); }
function openCart() { document.getElementById('cart-overlay').classList.add('open'); document.getElementById('cart-sidebar').classList.add('open'); }
function closeCart() { document.getElementById('cart-overlay').classList.remove('open'); document.getElementById('cart-sidebar').classList.remove('open'); }
function checkout() {
  if (!cart.length) { Toast.warning('Giá» hÃ ng Ä‘ang trá»‘ng!'); return; }
  Toast.info('ÄÃ¢y lÃ  giao diá»‡n demo: Ä‘Æ¡n chÆ°a Ä‘Æ°á»£c gá»­i hoáº·c lÆ°u vÃ o há»‡ thá»‘ng.');
}

/* ===== WISHLIST ===== */
function toggleWish(id) {
  const p = PRODUCTS.find(p => p.id === id);
  if (wishlist.includes(id)) {
    wishlist = wishlist.filter(x => x !== id);
    Toast.info(`Bá» yÃªu thÃ­ch "${p.name}"`);
  } else {
    wishlist.push(id);
    Toast.success(`ÄÃ£ thÃªm "${p.name}" vÃ o yÃªu thÃ­ch!`);
  }
  updateWishlistUI();
  renderFeatured(currentCatFilter);
}
function updateWishlistUI() {
  const count = wishlist.length;
  const dot = document.getElementById('wishlist-count');
  dot.style.display = count ? 'flex' : 'none';
  dot.textContent   = count;
  Storage.set('crm_wishlist', wishlist);
}
function toggleWishlistPanel() { window.location = 'profile.html#wishlist'; }

/* ===== SEARCH ===== */
function searchProducts() {
  const q = document.getElementById('header-search').value.trim();
  if (q) window.location = `products.html?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`;
}

/* ===== COUNTDOWN ===== */
function startCountdown() {
  const end = new Date();
  end.setHours(23, 59, 59, 0);
  function tick() {
    const diff = end - new Date();
    if (diff <= 0) { clearInterval(timer); return; }
    const h = Math.floor(diff/3600000);
    const m = Math.floor((diff%3600000)/60000);
    const s = Math.floor((diff%60000)/1000);
    document.getElementById('cd-h').textContent = String(h).padStart(2,'0');
    document.getElementById('cd-m').textContent = String(m).padStart(2,'0');
    document.getElementById('cd-s').textContent = String(s).padStart(2,'0');
  }
  tick();
  const timer = setInterval(tick, 1000);
}

/* ===== BACK TO TOP ===== */
function initBackToTop() {
  const btn = document.getElementById('back-top');
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    btn.classList.toggle('show', window.scrollY > 400);
  });
}

    if (!Auth.requireRole('KhachHang')) throw new Error('Customer login is required.');
    let categories = [];

    async function loadPreferences() {
      try {
        const result = await Http.get(`${API.customers}/me/preferences`);
        categories = result.Data?.Categories || [];
        const selected = new Set(result.Data?.SelectedMaDMs || []);
        const container = document.getElementById('options');
        container.replaceChildren();
        categories.forEach(category => {
          const label = document.createElement('label');
          label.className = 'preference-option';
          const checkbox = document.createElement('input');
          checkbox.type = 'checkbox';
          checkbox.name = 'preferences';
          checkbox.value = String(category.MaDM);
          checkbox.checked = selected.has(category.MaDM);
          const text = document.createElement('span');
          text.textContent = category.TenDM;
          label.append(checkbox, text);
          container.append(label);
        });
      } catch (error) {
        showError(error.message || 'KhÃ´ng táº£i Ä‘Æ°á»£c danh má»¥c sá»Ÿ thÃ­ch.');
      }
    }

    async function savePreferences() {
      const ids = [...document.querySelectorAll('input[name="preferences"]:checked')].map(input => Number(input.value));
      if (ids.length === 0) {
        showError('Chá»n Ã­t nháº¥t má»™t danh má»¥c sá»Ÿ thÃ­ch.');
        return;
      }
      const button = document.getElementById('save-button');
      button.disabled = true;
      try {
        await Http.put(`${API.customers}/me/preferences`, { MaDMs: ids });
        const user = Auth.getUser() || {};
        Auth.login({ ...user, hasPreferences: true }, Auth.getToken());
        window.location.href = Auth.resolvePage('customer/home.html');
      } catch (error) {
        showError(error.message || 'KhÃ´ng lÆ°u Ä‘Æ°á»£c sá»Ÿ thÃ­ch.');
        button.disabled = false;
      }
    }

    function showError(message) {
      const element = document.getElementById('error');
      element.textContent = message;
      element.style.display = 'block';
    }

    loadPreferences();
  </script>

<script>
const PRODUCTS = [];

let cart      = Storage.get('crm_cart') || [];
let wishlist  = Storage.get('crm_wishlist') || [];
let filtered  = [...PRODUCTS];
let currentPage = 1, currentView = 'grid';
const PAGE_SIZE = 8;

/* ===== READ URL PARAMS ===== */
const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
let currentCategory = params.get('cat') || '';
let selectedSize = {};
if (params.get('q')) document.getElementById('header-search').value = params.get('q');

/* ===== AUTH ===== */
function renderAuthArea() {
  CustomerMenu.render('auth-area');
}

function escapeHTML(value) {
  return String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, character => ({
    '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;',
  })[character]);
}

function parseOptions(value, fallback) {
  const options = String(value || '').split(/[,;|]/).map(item => item.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  return options.length ? options : fallback;
}

function resolveProductImage(value) {
  const image = String(value || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/');
  if (!image) return '';
  if (/^(https?:|data:)/i.test(image)) return image;
  const path = image.startsWith('/') ? image : '/' + (image.startsWith('./') ? image.slice(2) : image);
  return new URL(path, API_BASE).toString();
}

function normalizeProduct(product) {
  return {
    id: Number(product.MaSP),
    categoryId: Number(product.MaDM),
    cat: product.TenDM || 'Sáº£n pháº©m',
    name: product.TenSP || 'Sáº£n pháº©m thá»i trang',
    price: Number(product.Gia) || 0,
    stock: Number(product.SoLuongTon) || 0,
    image: resolveProductImage(product.HinhAnh),
    detailImage: resolveProductImage(product.HinhAnhMoTa) || resolveProductImage(product.HinhAnh),
    desc: product.MoTa || 'Thiáº¿t káº¿ dÃ nh cho phong cÃ¡ch thÆ°á»ng ngÃ y.',
    sizes: parseOptions(product.KichThuoc, ['S', 'M', 'L', 'XL']),
    colors: parseOptions(product.MauSac, ['Máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh']),
    createdAt: product.NgayTao,
    icon: 'â—‡',
  };
}

async function loadProducts() {
  const container = document.getElementById('products-container');
  container.innerHTML = '<p class="products-loading">Äang táº£i sáº£n pháº©m...</p>';
  try {
    const response = await Http.get(API.products, { page: 1, pageSize: 100, trangThai: true });
    const rows = response?.Data?.Items || [];
    PRODUCTS.splice(0, PRODUCTS.length, ...rows.filter(product => product.TrangThai !== false).map(normalizeProduct));
    applyFilters();
  } catch (error) {
    document.getElementById('result-count').textContent = '';
    container.innerHTML = `<p class="products-error">${escapeHTML(error.message || 'KhÃ´ng táº£i Ä‘Æ°á»£c sáº£n pháº©m. HÃ£y kiá»ƒm tra káº¿t ná»‘i mÃ¡y chá»§.')}</p>`;
  }
}

async function loadCategories() {
  const response = await Http.get(API.categories, { trangThai: true });
  const select = document.getElementById('f-category');
  const rows = Array.isArray(response?.Data) ? response.Data : [];
  select.innerHTML = '<option value="">Táº¥t cáº£ danh má»¥c</option>' + rows
    .map(category => `<option value="${escapeHTML(category.TenDM)}">${escapeHTML(category.TenDM)}</option>`).join('');
  if (rows.some(category => category.TenDM === currentCategory)) select.value = currentCategory;
  else currentCategory = '';
}

/* ===== FILTERS ===== */
function applyFilters() {
  const pMin = Number(document.getElementById('f-pmin').value) || 0;
  const maxValue = Number(document.getElementById('f-pmax').value);
  const pMax = maxValue || Infinity;
  const inStock = document.getElementById('f-stock').checked;
  const sortV = document.getElementById('f-sort').value;
  const q = document.getElementById('header-search').value.trim().toLowerCase();

  filtered = PRODUCTS.filter(p => {
    if (currentCategory && p.cat !== currentCategory) return false;
    if (p.price < pMin || p.price > pMax) return false;
    if (inStock && p.stock < 1) return false;
    if (q && !`${p.name} ${p.cat} ${p.desc}`.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return false;
    return true;
  });

  if (sortV) {
    filtered.sort((a, b) => {
      if (sortV === 'price_asc') return a.price - b.price;
      if (sortV === 'price_desc') return b.price - a.price;
      if (sortV === 'name_asc') return a.name.localeCompare(b.name, 'vi');
        if (sortV === 'stock_desc') return b.stock - a.stock;
        return new Date(b.createdAt || 0) - new Date(a.createdAt || 0);
    });
  }

  currentPage = 1;
  const title = currentCategory || (q ? `Káº¿t quáº£ cho â€œ${q}â€` : 'Táº¥t cáº£ sáº£n pháº©m');
  document.getElementById('page-title').textContent = title;
  renderActiveChips(pMin, pMax < Infinity ? pMax : 0, inStock, q);
  render();
}

function setPrice(min, max) {
  document.getElementById('f-pmin').value = min || '';
  document.getElementById('f-pmax').value = max || '';
  applyFilters();
}

function resetFilters() {
  currentCategory = '';
  document.getElementById('f-category').value = '';
  document.getElementById('f-pmin').value = '';
  document.getElementById('f-pmax').value = '';
  document.getElementById('f-stock').checked = false;
  document.getElementById('f-sort').value = '';
  document.getElementById('header-search').value = '';
  applyFilters();
}

function renderActiveChips(pMin, pMax, inStock, q) {
  const chips = [];
  const mk = (label, clear) =>
    `<div class="filter-chip">${label}<button onclick="${clear}">Ã—</button></div>`;
  if (currentCategory) chips.push(mk(escapeHTML(currentCategory), `currentCategory='';applyFilters()`));
  if (pMin) chips.push(mk(`Tá»« ${Format.currency(pMin)}`, `document.getElementById('f-pmin').value='';applyFilters()`));
  if (pMax) chips.push(mk(`Äáº¿n ${Format.currency(pMax)}`, `document.getElementById('f-pmax').value='';applyFilters()`));
  if (inStock) chips.push(mk('CÃ²n hÃ ng', `document.getElementById('f-stock').checked=false;applyFilters()`));
  if (q) chips.push(mk(`â€œ${escapeHTML(q)}â€`, `document.getElementById('header-search').value='';applyFilters()`));
  document.getElementById('active-filters').innerHTML = chips.join('');
}

/* ===== RENDER ===== */
function render() {
  const start  = (currentPage-1) * PAGE_SIZE;
  const page   = filtered.slice(start, start+PAGE_SIZE);
  const cont   = document.getElementById('products-container');
  document.getElementById('result-count').textContent = `${filtered.length} sáº£n pháº©m`;

  if (!page.length) {
    cont.innerHTML = `
      <div class="empty-state" style="padding:80px 20px;background:#fff;border-radius:var(--radius-xl);border:1px solid var(--border)">
        <div class="empty-icon">ðŸ”</div>

function renderPagination() {
  const pages = Math.ceil(filtered.length/PAGE_SIZE) || 1;
  const el = document.getElementById('pagination');
  if (pages <= 1) { el.innerHTML=''; return; }
  let h = `<button class="page-btn" ${currentPage===1?'disabled':''} onclick="goPage(${currentPage-1})">â€¹</button>`;
  for (let i=1;i<=pages;i++) h += `<button class="page-btn ${i===currentPage?'active':''}" onclick="goPage(${i})">${i}</button>`;
  h += `<button class="page-btn" ${currentPage===pages?'disabled':''} onclick="goPage(${currentPage+1})">â€º</button>`;
  el.innerHTML = h;
}
function goPage(p) { currentPage=p; render(); window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'}); }

  document.getElementById('btn-grid').classList.toggle('active', v==='grid');

  render();
}

function viewProduct(id) {
  const p = PRODUCTS.find(p=>p.id===id);
  if (!p) return;
  document.getElementById('pd-title').textContent = p.name;
  document.getElementById('pd-body').innerHTML = `

        <div class="pd-price">${Format.currency(p.price)}</div>
        <p class="pd-desc">${escapeHTML(p.desc)}</p>
        <p class="pd-stock">${p.stock > 0 ? `CÃ²n ${p.stock} sáº£n pháº©m` : 'Táº¡m háº¿t hÃ ng'}</p>
        <div style="margin-bottom:18px">
          <div class="pd-section-title">KÃ­ch thÆ°á»›c: <span id="sel-${id}" style="color:var(--shop-accent);font-weight:800">${p.sizes[0]}</span></div>
          <div class="size-chips">${p.sizes.map(s=>`<button type="button" class="size-chip ${s===p.sizes[0]?'selected':''}" onclick="selSz(${id},'${escapeHTML(s)}',this)">${escapeHTML(s)}</button>`).join('')}</div>
        </div>

          <div class="pd-section-title">MÃ u sáº¯c</div>
          <div class="color-chips">${p.colors.map((c,i)=>`<span class="color-chip ${i===0?'selected':''}" onclick="document.querySelectorAll('#pd-body .color-chip').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('selected'));this.classList.add('selected')">${escapeHTML(c)}</span>`).join('')}</div>

          <button class="btn btn-dark btn-lg" ${p.stock < 1 ? 'disabled' : ''} style="flex:1;min-width:140px;border-radius:var(--radius-md)" onclick="addDetail(${id})">ThÃªm vÃ o giá» â†’</button>
          <button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:14px;border-radius:var(--radius-md)" onclick="toggleWish(${id});render()">${wishlist.includes(id)?'â¤ï¸':'ðŸ¤'}</button>
        </div>
      </div>

  Modal.open('modal-product');

function selSz(id, size, element) {
  selectedSize[id] = size;
  document.getElementById(`sel-${id}`).textContent = size;
  element.closest('.size-chips').querySelectorAll('.size-chip').forEach(chip => chip.classList.remove('selected'));
  element.classList.add('selected');
}
function addDetail(id) {
  const product = PRODUCTS.find(item => item.id === id);
  if (!product || product.stock < 1) { Toast.warning('Sáº£n pháº©m hiá»‡n Ä‘Ã£ háº¿t hÃ ng.'); return; }
  const size = selectedSize[id] || product.sizes[0];
  const cartId = `${id}_${size}`;
  const existing = cart.find(item => item.cartId === cartId);
  if (existing && existing.qty >= product.stock) { Toast.warning('Sá»‘ lÆ°á»£ng trong giá» Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘áº¡t tá»“n kho.'); return; }
  if (existing) existing.qty++;
  else cart.push({ cartId, id, name:product.name, price:product.price, icon:product.icon, image:product.image, size, qty:1 });
  updateCartUI();
  Modal.close('modal-product');
  openCart();
  Toast.success(`ÄÃ£ thÃªm "${product.name}" vÃ o giá»!`);
}

/* Giá» hÃ ng demo chá»‰ lÆ°u trÃªn trÃ¬nh duyá»‡t, khÃ´ng gá»­i dá»¯ liá»‡u lÃªn API. */
function updateCartUI() {
  const total = cart.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price * item.qty, 0);
  const count = cart.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.qty, 0);
  document.getElementById('cart-count').textContent = count;
  document.getElementById('cart-header-count').textContent = `(${count})`;
  document.getElementById('cart-subtotal').textContent = Format.currency(total);
  document.getElementById('cart-total').textContent = Format.currency(total);
  Storage.set('crm_cart', cart);
  const body = document.getElementById('cart-body');
  if (!cart.length) {
    body.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state" style="padding:60px 20px"><div class="empty-icon">ðŸ›’</div><h3>Giá» hÃ ng trá»‘ng</h3></div>';
    return;
  }
  body.innerHTML = cart.map(item => `
    <div class="cart-item">
      <div class="cart-item-img">${item.image ? `<img src="${escapeHTML(item.image)}" alt="${escapeHTML(item.name)}">` : escapeHTML(item.icon || 'â—‡')}</div>
      <div class="cart-item-info">
        <div class="cart-item-name">${escapeHTML(item.name)}</div>
        <div class="cart-item-meta">Size: ${escapeHTML(item.size)}</div>
        <div class="cart-item-price">${Format.currency(item.price)}</div>
        <div class="qty-control">
          <button class="qty-btn" onclick="chQty('${item.cartId}',-1)">âˆ’</button>
          <span class="qty-num">${item.qty}</span>
          <button class="qty-btn" onclick="chQty('${item.cartId}',1)">+</button>
          <button class="remove-btn" onclick="rmCart('${item.cartId}')">ðŸ—‘ï¸</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>`).join('');
}
function quickAdd(id) {
  const product = PRODUCTS.find(item => item.id === id);
  if (!product || product.stock < 1) { Toast.warning('Sáº£n pháº©m hiá»‡n Ä‘Ã£ háº¿t hÃ ng.'); return; }
  const cartId = `${id}_${product.sizes[0]}`;
  const existing = cart.find(item => item.cartId === cartId);
  if (existing && existing.qty >= product.stock) { Toast.warning('Sá»‘ lÆ°á»£ng trong giá» Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘áº¡t tá»“n kho.'); return; }
  if (existing) existing.qty++;
  else cart.push({ cartId, id, name:product.name, price:product.price, icon:product.icon, image:product.image, size:product.sizes[0], qty:1 });
  updateCartUI();
  openCart();
  Toast.success(`ÄÃ£ thÃªm "${product.name}" vÃ o giá»!`);
}
function chQty(cartId, delta) {
  const item = cart.find(entry => entry.cartId === cartId);
  if (!item) return;
  const product = PRODUCTS.find(entry => entry.id === item.id);
  if (delta > 0 && product && item.qty >= product.stock) { Toast.warning('Sá»‘ lÆ°á»£ng trong giá» Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘áº¡t tá»“n kho.'); return; }
  item.qty += delta;
  if (item.qty <= 0) cart = cart.filter(entry => entry.cartId !== cartId);
  updateCartUI();
}
function rmCart(cartId) { cart = cart.filter(item => item.cartId !== cartId); updateCartUI(); }
function openCart() { document.getElementById('cart-overlay').classList.add('open'); document.getElementById('cart-sidebar').classList.add('open'); }
function closeCart() { document.getElementById('cart-overlay').classList.remove('open'); document.getElementById('cart-sidebar').classList.remove('open'); }
function checkout() {
  if (!cart.length) { Toast.warning('Giá» hÃ ng Ä‘ang trá»‘ng!'); return; }
  Toast.info('ÄÃ¢y lÃ  giao diá»‡n demo: Ä‘Æ¡n chÆ°a Ä‘Æ°á»£c gá»­i hoáº·c lÆ°u vÃ o há»‡ thá»‘ng.');
}

/* ===== WISHLIST ===== */
function toggleWish(id){const p=PRODUCTS.find(p=>p.id===id);if(!p)return;if(wishlist.includes(id)){wishlist=wishlist.filter(x=>x!==id);Toast.info(`Bá» yÃªu thÃ­ch "${p.name}"`);}else{wishlist.push(id);Toast.success(`ÄÃ£ thÃªm "${p.name}" vÃ o yÃªu thÃ­ch!`);}Storage.set('crm_wishlist',wishlist);render();}

/* ===== BACK TO TOP ===== */

function syncHeaderInfo() {
  const displayName = user.hoTen || user.tenDangNhap || '---';
  const email = user.email || '---';
  const initials = displayName.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
  document.getElementById('p-avatar').textContent = initials;
  document.getElementById('p-name').textContent = displayName;
  document.getElementById('p-email').textContent = email;

async function loadCurrentCustomerProfile() {
  const fallbackUser = Auth.getUser() || user;
  try {
    const res = await Http.get(`${API_BASE}/khachhang/me`);
    const data = res?.Data || {};
    try {
      const preferences = await Http.get(`${API.customers}/me/preferences`);
      profileState.preferenceCategories = preferences.Data?.Categories || [];
      profileState.selectedPreferenceIds = preferences.Data?.SelectedMaDMs || [];
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn('Load customer preferences failed:', error);
      profileState.preferenceCategories = [];
      profileState.selectedPreferenceIds = [];
    }
    const nextUser = {
      ...fallbackUser,
      hoTen: data.HoTen || fallbackUser.hoTen || fallbackUser.tenDangNhap || '',
      email: data.Email || fallbackUser.email || '',
      sdt: data.SoDienThoai || fallbackUser.sdt || '',
      ngaySinh: data.NgaySinh || fallbackUser.ngaySinh || '',
      gioiTinh: data.GioiTinh || fallbackUser.gioiTinh || 'Nam',
      diaChi: data.DiaChi || fallbackUser.diaChi || '',
      soThich: data.SoThich || fallbackUser.soThich || '',
    };
    user = nextUser;
    Auth.login(nextUser, Auth.getToken());
    syncHeaderInfo();
    return nextUser;
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('Load profile failed, using cached user data:', error);
    user = fallbackUser;
    syncHeaderInfo();
    return fallbackUser;
  }
}

const TABS = {info:tabInfo, wishlist:tabWishlist, password:tabPassword};
function showTab(tab, el) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.profile-nav-item[data-tab]').forEach(i => i.classList.remove('active'));
  if (el) el.classList.add('active');
  (TABS[tab] || tabInfo)();
  history.replaceState(null,'',`#${tab}`);
}

async function initCustomerProfile() {
  try {
    await loadCurrentCustomerProfile();
    await loadCustomerFeedbackCount();
    const tab = (location.hash || '#info').replace('#', '');
    const item = document.querySelector(`.profile-nav-item[data-tab="${tab}"]`);
    showTab(tab, item);
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('Profile init failed:', error);
    showTab('info');
  }
}

function toggleEdit() {
  if (editMode) {
    cancelEdit();
    return;
  }
  editSnapshot = { ...user, preferenceIds: [...profileState.selectedPreferenceIds] };
  editMode = true;
  const fields = ['p-hoten','p-email-f','p-sdt','p-dob','p-gender','p-addr'];
  fields.forEach(id => { const el=document.getElementById(id); if(el) el.disabled=!editMode; });
  document.querySelectorAll('input[name="p-interest"]').forEach(el => { el.disabled = !editMode; });
  document.getElementById('save-row').style.display    = editMode ? 'flex' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('edit-btn').textContent      = editMode ? 'â† Há»§y chá»‰nh sá»­a' : 'âœï¸ Chá»‰nh sá»­a';
}
function cancelEdit() {
  if (editSnapshot) user = { ...editSnapshot };
  if (editSnapshot?.preferenceIds) profileState.selectedPreferenceIds = [...editSnapshot.preferenceIds];
  editSnapshot = null;
  Auth.login(user, Auth.getToken());
  syncHeaderInfo();
  tabInfo();
}
async function saveInfo() {
  const payload = {
    hoTen: document.getElementById('p-hoten').value.trim(),
    email: document.getElementById('p-email-f').value.trim(),
    soDienThoai: document.getElementById('p-sdt').value.trim(),
    ngaySinh: document.getElementById('p-dob').value || null,
    gioiTinh: document.getElementById('p-gender').value || 'Nam',
    diaChi: document.getElementById('p-addr').value.trim()
  };
  const selectedIds = [...document.querySelectorAll('input[name="p-interest"]:checked')].map(input => Number(input.value));
  if (selectedIds.length === 0) {
    Toast.warning('Chá»n Ã­t nháº¥t má»™t danh má»¥c sá»Ÿ thÃ­ch.');
    return;
  }

  try {
    const res = await Http.put(`${API_BASE}/khachhang/me`, payload);
    if (!res?.Success) throw new Error(res?.Message || 'MÃ¡y chá»§ chÆ°a xÃ¡c nháº­n lÆ°u thÃ´ng tin.');
    const preferenceResult = await Http.put(`${API.customers}/me/preferences`, { MaDMs: selectedIds });
    if (!preferenceResult?.Success) throw new Error(preferenceResult?.Message || 'KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ cáº­p nháº­t sá»Ÿ thÃ­ch.');
    const data = res?.Data || {};
    user = {
      ...user,
      hoTen: data.HoTen || payload.hoTen,
      email: data.Email || payload.email,
      sdt: data.SoDienThoai || payload.soDienThoai,
      ngaySinh: data.NgaySinh || payload.ngaySinh,
      gioiTinh: data.GioiTinh || payload.gioiTinh,
      diaChi: data.DiaChi || payload.diaChi,
      soThich: preferenceResult.Data?.SoThich || '',
    };
    profileState.selectedPreferenceIds = selectedIds;
    Auth.login(user, Auth.getToken());
    syncHeaderInfo();
    Toast.success(res?.Message || 'Cáº­p nháº­t thÃ´ng tin thÃ nh cÃ´ng!');
    tabInfo();
    showTab('info');
  } catch (error) {
    Toast.error(error.message || 'Cáº­p nháº­t thÃ´ng tin tháº¥t báº¡i.');
  }
}

function escapeProfileHtml(value) {
  return String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, character => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[character]));
}

/* Giá» hÃ ng demo chá»‰ lÆ°u trÃªn trÃ¬nh duyá»‡t, khÃ´ng gá»­i dá»¯ liá»‡u lÃªn API. */
function updateCartUI() {
  const total = cart.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price * item.qty, 0);
  const count = cart.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.qty, 0);
  document.getElementById('cart-count').textContent = count;
  document.getElementById('cart-header-count').textContent = `(${count})`;
  document.getElementById('cart-subtotal').textContent = Format.currency(total);
  document.getElementById('cart-total').textContent = Format.currency(total);
  Storage.set('crm_cart', cart);
  const body = document.getElementById('cart-body');
  if (!cart.length) {
    body.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-box"><div class="ei">ðŸ›’</div><h3>Giá» hÃ ng trá»‘ng</h3><a href="products.html" class="btn btn-dark btn-sm" style="margin-top:16px;border-radius:var(--radius-full)">Mua sáº¯m ngay â†’</a></div>';
    return;
  }
  body.innerHTML = cart.map(item => `
    <div class="cart-item">
      <div class="cart-item-img">${item.image ? `<img src="${escapeProfileHtml(item.image)}" alt="${escapeProfileHtml(item.name)}">` : escapeProfileHtml(item.icon || 'â—‡')}</div>
      <div class="cart-item-info">
        <div class="cart-item-name">${escapeProfileHtml(item.name)}</div>
        <div class="cart-item-meta">Size: ${escapeProfileHtml(item.size)}</div>
        <div class="cart-item-price">${Format.currency(item.price)}</div>
        <div class="qty-control">
          <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeCartQty('${item.cartId}',-1)">âˆ’</button>
          <span class="qty-num">${item.qty}</span>
          <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeCartQty('${item.cartId}',1)">+</button>
          <button class="remove-btn" onclick="removeCartItem('${item.cartId}')">ðŸ—‘ï¸</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>`).join('');
}
function changeCartQty(cartId, delta) {
  const item = cart.find(entry => entry.cartId === cartId);
  if (!item) return;
  item.qty += delta;
  if (item.qty <= 0) cart = cart.filter(entry => entry.cartId !== cartId);
  updateCartUI();
}
function removeCartItem(cartId) { cart = cart.filter(item => item.cartId !== cartId); updateCartUI(); }
function openCart() { document.getElementById('cart-overlay').classList.add('open'); document.getElementById('cart-sidebar').classList.add('open'); }
function closeCart() { document.getElementById('cart-overlay').classList.remove('open'); document.getElementById('cart-sidebar').classList.remove('open'); }
function checkout() {
  if (!cart.length) { Toast.warning('Giá» hÃ ng Ä‘ang trá»‘ng!'); return; }
  Toast.info('ÄÃ¢y lÃ  giao diá»‡n demo: Ä‘Æ¡n chÆ°a Ä‘Æ°á»£c gá»­i hoáº·c lÆ°u vÃ o há»‡ thá»‘ng.');
}

async function loadCustomerFeedbackCount() {
  const [feedbackResult, reviewResult] = await Promise.allSettled([
    Http.get(`${API_BASE}/phanhoi/my`),
    Http.get(`${API_BASE}/danhgia/my`)
  ]);
  const feedbackItems = feedbackResult.status === 'fulfilled' && Array.isArray(feedbackResult.value?.Data)
    ? feedbackResult.value.Data
    : [];
  const reviewItems = reviewResult.status === 'fulfilled' && Array.isArray(reviewResult.value?.Data)
    ? reviewResult.value.Data
    : [];
  document.getElementById('p-feedback-count').textContent = feedbackItems.length + reviewItems.length;
}

function removeWish(id) {
  let w = Storage.get('crm_wishlist') || [];
  w = w.filter(x => x !== id);
  Storage.set('crm_wishlist', w);
  document.getElementById('p-wish-count').textContent = w.length;
  Toast.info('ÄÃ£ xÃ³a khá»i yÃªu thÃ­ch');
