function tglPw(id, btn) {
  const inp = document.getElementById(id);
  inp.type = inp.type === 'password' ? 'text' : 'password';
  btn.textContent = inp.type === 'password' ? 'ðŸ‘ï¸' : 'ðŸ™ˆ';
}
function checkNewPw() {
  const v    = document.getElementById('pw-new').value;
  const fill = document.getElementById('pw-strength-fill');
  const txt  = document.getElementById('pw-strength-txt');
  if (!v) { fill.className='pw-fill'; txt.textContent=''; return; }
  let score = 0;
  if (v.length >= 8) score++;
  if (/[A-Z]/.test(v)) score++;
  if (/[0-9]/.test(v)) score++;
  if (/[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(v)) score++;
  fill.className = 'pw-fill ' + (score<=1?'weak':score<=2?'medium':'strong');
  const labels = {weak:'Yáº¿u', medium:'Trung bÃ¬nh', strong:'Máº¡nh âœ“'};
  const colors = {weak:'var(--danger)', medium:'var(--warning)', strong:'var(--success)'};
  const cls    = score<=1?'weak':score<=2?'medium':'strong';
  txt.textContent = labels[cls];
  txt.style.color = colors[cls];
}
function changePw() {
  const cur  = document.getElementById('pw-cur').value;
  const nw   = document.getElementById('pw-new').value;
  const conf = document.getElementById('pw-conf').value;
  if (!cur || !nw || !conf) { Toast.error('Vui lÃ²ng Ä‘iá»n Ä‘áº§y Ä‘á»§ thÃ´ng tin'); return; }
  if (nw.length < 8)        { Toast.error('Máº­t kháº©u má»›i tá»‘i thiá»ƒu 8 kÃ½ tá»±'); return; }
  if (nw !== conf)           { Toast.error('Máº­t kháº©u xÃ¡c nháº­n khÃ´ng khá»›p'); return; }

  const btn = document.querySelector('[onclick="changePw()"]');
  btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'â³ Äang xá»­ lÃ½...';

  Http.post(`${API_BASE}/auth/change-password`, { MatKhauCu: cur, MatKhauMoi: nw })
    .then(res => {
      if (!res.Success) throw new Error(res.Message || 'Äá»•i máº­t kháº©u tháº¥t báº¡i.');
      Toast.success('Äá»•i máº­t kháº©u thÃ nh cÃ´ng!');
      tabPassword();
    })
    .catch(err => {
      Toast.error(err.message || 'ÄÃ£ xáº£y ra lá»—i.');
      btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'ðŸ” Äá»•i máº­t kháº©u';
    });
}

}

function renderInterestGrid() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('interest-grid');
  if (!grid) return;
  if (!interestOptions.length) {
    grid.innerHTML = '<p class="form-hint">Hiá»‡n chÆ°a cÃ³ danh má»¥c sá»Ÿ thÃ­ch Ä‘ang hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng.</p>';

function escapeRegisterHtml(value) {
  return String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, character => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[character]));
}

async function loadInterestCategories() {
  const response = await Http.get(API.categories, { trangThai: true });
  interestOptions = response.Data || [];
  interestCategoriesLoaded = true;
  renderInterestGrid();
}

const PROGRESS = {1:'33%', 2:'66%', 3:'100%'};
function goStep(n) {
  [1,2,3].forEach(i => {
    const body = document.getElementById(`step-${i}`);
    const si   = document.getElementById(`si-${i}`);
    const sd   = document.getElementById(`sd-${i}`);
    body.style.display = i === n ? 'block' : 'none';
    si.className = `step-item ${i < n ? 'done' : i === n ? 'active' : 'pending'}`;
    if (i < n)  { sd.textContent = 'âœ“'; }
    else if (i === n) { sd.textContent = String(i); }
    else { sd.textContent = String(i); }
  });
  document.getElementById('progress-bar').style.width = PROGRESS[n];
}

        Http.get(`${API.login.replace('/login', '/availability')}`, { username }),
        Http.get(`${API.login.replace('/login', '/availability')}`, { email }),
      ]);
      const usernameAvailable = Boolean(usernameCheck.Data?.Available);
      const emailAvailable = Boolean(emailCheck.Data?.Available);
      setFieldError('r-user', 'e-user', usernameAvailable ? '' : (usernameCheck.Data?.Reason || 'TÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p Ä‘Ã£ tá»“n táº¡i.'));
      setFieldError('r-email', 'e-email', emailAvailable ? '' : (emailCheck.Data?.Reason || 'Email Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Æ°á»£c sá»­ dá»¥ng.'));
      if (!usernameAvailable || !emailAvailable) return;

      document.getElementById('user-hint').textContent = 'âœ“ TÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p cÃ³ thá»ƒ sá»­ dá»¥ng';
      document.getElementById('user-hint').style.color = '#16a34a';
      document.getElementById('email-hint').textContent = 'âœ“ Email cÃ³ thá»ƒ sá»­ dá»¥ng';
      document.getElementById('email-hint').style.color = '#16a34a';
      goStep(2);
    } catch (error) {
      accountError.textContent = 'KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ káº¿t ná»‘i mÃ¡y chá»§ Ä‘Äƒng kÃ½. HÃ£y cháº¡y run.bat, kiá»ƒm tra API rá»“i thá»­ láº¡i.';
    } finally {
      button.disabled = false;
      button.textContent = 'Tiáº¿p theo â†’';
    }
    return;
  }

  if (n === 3 && !validateStep2()) return;
  goStep(n);
}

/* ===== VALIDATE ===== */
function setFieldError(inputId, errorId, message) {
  document.getElementById(errorId).textContent = message;
  document.getElementById(inputId).classList.toggle('error', Boolean(message));
}

function validateStep1() {
  let ok = true;
  const fields = [
    {id:'r-user',  err:'e-user',  test: v => v.trim().length >= 4 && v.trim().length <= 50 && !/\s/.test(v.trim()), msg:'TÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p pháº£i cÃ³ tá»« 4 Ä‘áº¿n 50 kÃ½ tá»± vÃ  khÃ´ng chá»©a khoáº£ng tráº¯ng.'},
    {id:'r-email', err:'e-email', test: v => v.trim().length <= 100 && /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(v.trim()), msg:'Email khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡ hoáº·c vÆ°á»£t quÃ¡ 100 kÃ½ tá»±.'},
    {id:'r-pw',    err:'e-pw',    test: v => v.length >= 8, msg:'Tá»‘i thiá»ƒu 8 kÃ½ tá»±'},
    {id:'r-conf',  err:'e-conf',  test: v => v === document.getElementById('r-pw').value, msg:'Máº­t kháº©u khÃ´ng khá»›p'},
  ];
  fields.forEach(f => {
    const v = document.getElementById(f.id).value;
    if (!f.test(v)) { setFieldError(f.id, f.err, f.msg); ok = false; }
    else { setFieldError(f.id, f.err, ''); }
  });
  return ok;
}
function validateStep2() {
  let ok = true;
  const name = document.getElementById('r-name').value.trim();
  const phone = document.getElementById('r-sdt').value.trim();
  const birthDate = document.getElementById('r-dob').value;
  const address = document.getElementById('r-addr').value.trim();

  const nameError = !name ? 'Vui lÃ²ng nháº­p há» tÃªn.' : (name.length > 100 ? 'Há» tÃªn khÃ´ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c vÆ°á»£t quÃ¡ 100 kÃ½ tá»±.' : '');
  const phoneError = phone && !/^\d{9,11}$/.test(phone) ? 'Sá»‘ Ä‘iá»‡n thoáº¡i pháº£i cÃ³ tá»« 9 Ä‘áº¿n 11 chá»¯ sá»‘.' : '';
  const today = new Date();
  today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const parsedBirthDate = birthDate ? new Date(`${birthDate}T00:00:00`) : null;
  const birthDateError = parsedBirthDate && parsedBirthDate > today ? 'NgÃ y sinh khÃ´ng thá»ƒ náº±m trong tÆ°Æ¡ng lai.' : '';
  const addressError = address.length > 255 ? 'Äá»‹a chá»‰ khÃ´ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c vÆ°á»£t quÃ¡ 255 kÃ½ tá»±.' : '';

  setFieldError('r-name', 'e-name', nameError);
  setFieldError('r-sdt', 'e-phone', phoneError);
  setFieldError('r-dob', 'e-dob', birthDateError);
  setFieldError('r-addr', 'e-addr', addressError);
  ok = !nameError && !phoneError && !birthDateError && !addressError;
  return ok;
}

/* ===== LIVE FEEDBACK ===== */
function checkUser() {
  const v = document.getElementById('r-user').value.trim();
  const h = document.getElementById('user-hint');
  userCheckVersion++;
  const version = userCheckVersion;
  clearTimeout(userCheckTimer);
  if (!v) { h.textContent=''; return; }
  if (v.length < 4) { h.textContent=`Cáº§n ${4-v.length} kÃ½ tá»± ná»¯a`; h.style.color='#d97706'; return; }
  h.textContent='Äang kiá»ƒm tra tÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p...'; h.style.color='#64748b';
  userCheckTimer = setTimeout(async () => {
    try {
      const result = await Http.get(`${API.login.replace('/login', '/availability')}`, { username: v });
      if (version !== userCheckVersion) return;
      h.textContent = result.Data?.Available ? 'âœ“ TÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p cÃ³ thá»ƒ sá»­ dá»¥ng' : (result.Data?.Reason || 'TÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p Ä‘Ã£ tá»“n táº¡i.');
      h.style.color = result.Data?.Available ? '#16a34a' : '#dc2626';
    } catch (error) {
      if (version === userCheckVersion) { h.textContent = error.message || 'KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ kiá»ƒm tra tÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p.'; h.style.color = '#dc2626'; }
    }
  }, 300);
}

function checkEmail() {
  const value = document.getElementById('r-email').value.trim();
  const hint = document.getElementById('email-hint');
  emailCheckVersion++;
  const version = emailCheckVersion;
  clearTimeout(emailCheckTimer);
  if (!value) { hint.textContent = ''; return; }
  if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value)) { hint.textContent = 'Email khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡.'; hint.style.color = '#dc2626'; return; }
  hint.textContent = 'Äang kiá»ƒm tra email...'; hint.style.color = '#64748b';
  emailCheckTimer = setTimeout(async () => {
    try {
      const result = await Http.get(`${API.login.replace('/login', '/availability')}`, { email: value });
      if (version !== emailCheckVersion) return;
      hint.textContent = result.Data?.Available ? 'âœ“ Email cÃ³ thá»ƒ sá»­ dá»¥ng' : (result.Data?.Reason || 'Email Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Æ°á»£c sá»­ dá»¥ng.');
      hint.style.color = result.Data?.Available ? '#16a34a' : '#dc2626';
    } catch (error) {
      if (version === emailCheckVersion) { hint.textContent = error.message || 'KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ kiá»ƒm tra email.'; hint.style.color = '#dc2626'; }
    }
  }, 300);
}
function checkPw() {
  const v    = document.getElementById('r-pw').value;
  const fill = document.getElementById('pw-fill');
  const txt  = document.getElementById('pw-text');
  fill.className = 'pw-strength-fill';
  if (!v) { txt.textContent=''; return; }
  let score = 0;
  if (v.length >= 8)           score++;
  if (/[A-Z]/.test(v))         score++;
  if (/[0-9]/.test(v))         score++;
  if (/[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(v)) score++;
  if (score <= 1) { fill.classList.add('weak');   txt.textContent='Máº­t kháº©u yáº¿u';    txt.className='pw-strength-text weak'; }
  else if (score<=2){ fill.classList.add('medium');txt.textContent='Máº­t kháº©u trung bÃ¬nh'; txt.className='pw-strength-text medium'; }
  else { fill.classList.add('strong'); txt.textContent='Máº­t kháº©u máº¡nh âœ“'; txt.className='pw-strength-text strong'; }
}
function togglePw(id, btn) {
  const inp = document.getElementById(id);
  inp.type  = inp.type === 'password' ? 'text' : 'password';
  btn.textContent = inp.type === 'password' ? 'ðŸ‘ï¸' : 'ðŸ™ˆ';
}

/* ===== INTERESTS ===== */
function toggleInterest(el, categoryId) {
  if (selInterests.includes(categoryId)) {
    selInterests = selInterests.filter(x => x !== categoryId);
    el.classList.remove('sel');
  } else {
    selInterests.push(categoryId);
    el.classList.add('sel');
  }
}

async function submit() {
  if (!validateStep2()) { goStep(2); return; }
  if (!interestCategoriesLoaded) {
    Toast.error('ChÆ°a táº£i Ä‘Æ°á»£c danh má»¥c sá»Ÿ thÃ­ch. HÃ£y táº£i láº¡i trang rá»“i thá»­ Ä‘Äƒng kÃ½ láº¡i.');
    return;
  }

  const btn = document.getElementById('submit-btn');
  btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'â³ Äang táº¡o tÃ i khoáº£n...';
  try {
    // Äá»c ngÃ y sinh (DateOnly format: YYYY-MM-DD)
    const dobRaw = document.getElementById('r-dob').value; // "YYYY-MM-DD" hoáº·c ""

    const body = {
      TenDangNhap: document.getElementById('r-user').value.trim(),
      MatKhau:     document.getElementById('r-pw').value,
      HoTen:       document.getElementById('r-name').value.trim(),
      Email:       document.getElementById('r-email').value.trim(),
      SoDienThoai: document.getElementById('r-sdt').value.trim() || null,
      NgaySinh:    dobRaw || null,   // backend nháº­n DateOnly? â€” gá»­i string ISO
      GioiTinh:    document.querySelector('input[name="r-gender"]:checked')?.value || null,
      DiaChi:      document.getElementById('r-addr').value.trim() || null,
      MaDMs:       selInterests,
    };

    const res = await Http.post(API.login.replace('/login', '/register'), body);
    if (!res.Success) throw new Error(res.Message || 'ÄÄƒng kÃ½ tháº¥t báº¡i.');

    const d = res.Data;
    Auth.login({
      maTK:        d.MaTK,
      tenDangNhap: d.TenDangNhap,
      hoTen:       d.HoTen,
      email:       d.Email,
      vaiTro:      d.VaiTro,
      hasPreferences: d.HasPreferences,
    }, d.Token);

    // Show success screen
    [1,2,3].forEach(i => document.getElementById(`step-${i}`).style.display='none');
    document.getElementById('success-view').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('progress-bar').style.width = '100%';
    [1,2,3].forEach(i => {
      document.getElementById(`si-${i}`).className='step-item done';
      document.getElementById(`sd-${i}`).textContent='âœ“';
    });
    setTimeout(() => Auth.redirectByRole(), 2000);
  } catch(err) {
    const message = err.message || 'ÄÃ£ xáº£y ra lá»—i, vui lÃ²ng thá»­ láº¡i.';
    if (/tÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p/i.test(message)) {
      setFieldError('r-user', 'e-user', message);
      goStep(1);
    } else if (/email/i.test(message)) {
      setFieldError('r-email', 'e-email', message);
      goStep(1);
    } else if (/há» tÃªn/i.test(message)) {
      setFieldError('r-name', 'e-name', message);
      goStep(2);
    } else if (/sá»‘ Ä‘iá»‡n thoáº¡i/i.test(message)) {
      setFieldError('r-sdt', 'e-phone', message);
      goStep(2);
    } else if (/ngÃ y sinh/i.test(message)) {
      setFieldError('r-dob', 'e-dob', message);
      goStep(2);
    }
    Toast.error(message);
    btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'âœ“ Táº¡o tÃ i khoáº£n';
  }
}

let SURVEYS = [];

function hasAnswer(answer) {
  if (Array.isArray(answer)) return answer.length > 0;
  if (typeof answer === 'string') return answer.trim().length > 0;
  return answer !== undefined && answer !== null;
}

async function loadSurveys() {
  try {
    const response = await Http.get(`${API_BASE}/khaosat/my`);
    const assigned = Array.isArray(response?.Data) ? response.Data : [];
    SURVEYS = assigned.map(item => ({
      id: item.KhaoSat.MaKS,
      phieuId: item.MaPhieuKS,
      ten: item.KhaoSat.TenKhaoSat,
      moTa: item.KhaoSat.MoTa || '',
      ngayBatDau: item.KhaoSat.NgayBatDau,
      ngayKetThuc: item.KhaoSat.NgayKetThuc,
      done: item.TrangThai === 'ÄÃ£ hoÃ n thÃ nh',
      isOpen: item.IsOpen === true,
      cauHois: (item.CauHois || []).map(question => {
        const options = (question.LuaChons || []).map(option => option.NoiDung);
        const optionIds = (question.LuaChons || []).map(option => option.MaLuaChon);
        const saved = question.TraLois || [];
        const selectedIds = saved.map(answer => answer.MaLuaChon).filter(Number.isInteger);
        let savedAnswer = null;
        if (question.LoaiCauHoi === 'Má»™t lá»±a chá»n') {
          const selectedIndex = optionIds.findIndex(id => selectedIds.includes(id));
          if (selectedIndex >= 0) savedAnswer = options[selectedIndex];
        } else if (question.LoaiCauHoi === 'Nhiá»u lá»±a chá»n') {
          savedAnswer = optionIds.flatMap((id, index) => selectedIds.includes(id) ? [options[index]] : []);
          if (!savedAnswer.length) savedAnswer = null;
        } else if (question.LoaiCauHoi === 'ÄÃ¡nh giÃ¡ sao') {
          savedAnswer = Number(saved.find(answer => answer.SoSao)?.SoSao) || null;
        } else {
          savedAnswer = saved.find(answer => answer.NoiDungTraLoi)?.NoiDungTraLoi || null;
        }
        return {
          id: question.MaCauHoi,
          noi: question.NoiDung,
          loai: question.LoaiCauHoi,
          batBuoc: question.BatBuoc,
          options,
          optionIds,
          savedAnswer
        };
      })
    }));
  } catch (error) {
    SURVEYS = [];
    Toast.error(error.message || 'KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ táº£i danh sÃ¡ch kháº£o sÃ¡t.');
  }
  renderList();
}

  btn.classList.add('active');

    return `

        </div>
        ${canAnswer ? `<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="startSurvey(${s.id})">LÃ m ngay â†’</button>` :
          `<button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onclick="startSurvey(${s.id})">${s.done ? 'Xem cÃ¢u tráº£ lá»i' : 'Xem kháº£o sÃ¡t'}</button>`}
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}

function escapeSurveyHtml(value) {
  return String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, character => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[character]));
}
function formatSurveyDate(value) {
  if (!value) return 'â€”';
  const date = new Date(value);
  return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? 'â€”' : date.toLocaleString('vi-VN');
}

function startSurvey(id) {
  activeSurvey = SURVEYS.find(survey => survey.id === id);
  if (!activeSurvey) return;
  activeSurvey.readOnly = activeSurvey.done || !activeSurvey.isOpen;
  answers = {};
  starValues = {};
  activeSurvey.cauHois.forEach(question => {
    if (hasAnswer(question.savedAnswer)) answers[question.id] = question.savedAnswer;
    if (question.loai === 'ÄÃ¡nh giÃ¡ sao' && question.savedAnswer) starValues[question.id] = question.savedAnswer;
  });
  document.getElementById('form-title').textContent = activeSurvey.ten;
  document.getElementById('form-desc').textContent = activeSurvey.moTa;
  const status = document.getElementById('form-status');
  status.style.display = activeSurvey.readOnly ? 'block' : 'none';
  status.textContent = activeSurvey.done
    ? 'Phiáº¿u Ä‘Ã£ ná»™p. Báº¡n cÃ³ thá»ƒ xem láº¡i cÃ¢u tráº£ lá»i nhÆ°ng khÃ´ng thá»ƒ sá»­a.'
    : activeSurvey.isOpen ? '' : 'Kháº£o sÃ¡t chÆ°a má»Ÿ hoáº·c Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Ã³ng. Ná»™i dung chá»‰ xem, khÃ´ng thá»ƒ gá»­i cÃ¢u tráº£ lá»i.';
  document.getElementById('submit-survey-btn').style.display = activeSurvey.readOnly ? 'none' : 'inline-flex';
  renderQuestions();
  document.getElementById('survey-list-view').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('survey-form-view').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('thankyou-view').style.display = 'none';
  updateProgress();
}

'background:var(--primary);border-color:var(--primary)' : ''}" id="check-box-${question.id}-${optionIndex}">${selected ? '<span style="color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:700">âœ“</span>' : ''}</div>

const starLabels = ['','â­ Ráº¥t tá»‡','â­â­ Tá»‡','â­â­â­ BÃ¬nh thÆ°á»ng','â­â­â­â­ Tá»‘t','â­â­â­â­â­ Tuyá»‡t vá»i!'];

function setStarAnswer(qid, n) {
  if (!activeSurvey || activeSurvey.readOnly) return;
  starValues[qid] = n; answers[qid] = n;
  const stars = document.querySelectorAll(`#stars-${qid} span`);
  stars.forEach((s,i) => s.classList.toggle('active', i<n));
  document.getElementById(`star-label-${qid}`).textContent = starLabels[n] || '';
  updateProgress();
}
function hoverStarAnswer(qid, n)  { if (!activeSurvey?.readOnly) document.querySelectorAll(`#stars-${qid} span`).forEach((s,i)=>s.classList.toggle('hov',i<n)); }
function unhoverStarAnswer(qid)   { document.querySelectorAll(`#stars-${qid} span`).forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('hov')); }

function selectRadio(el, qid, optionIndex) {
  if (!activeSurvey || activeSurvey.readOnly) return;
  const question = activeSurvey.cauHois.find(item => item.id === qid);
  const val = question?.options[optionIndex];
  document.querySelectorAll(`[data-radio-qid="${qid}"]`).forEach((o,i) => {
    o.classList.remove('selected');
    const dot = document.getElementById(`radio-dot-${qid}-${i}`);
    if (dot) dot.style.background = '';
  });
  el.classList.add('selected');
  const idx = [...document.querySelectorAll(`[data-radio-qid="${qid}"]`)].indexOf(el);
  const dot = document.getElementById(`radio-dot-${qid}-${idx}`);
  if (dot) { dot.style.background='var(--primary)'; dot.style.borderColor='var(--primary)'; }
  answers[qid] = val; updateProgress();
}

function selectCheck(el, qid, optionIndex) {
  if (!activeSurvey || activeSurvey.readOnly) return;
  const question = activeSurvey.cauHois.find(item => item.id === qid);
  const val = question?.options[optionIndex];
  const oi = optionIndex;
  if (!Array.isArray(answers[qid])) answers[qid] = [];
  el.classList.toggle('selected');
  const box = document.getElementById(`check-box-${qid}-${oi}`);
  if (el.classList.contains('selected')) {
    answers[qid].push(val);
    if (box) { box.style.background='var(--primary)'; box.style.borderColor='var(--primary)'; box.innerHTML='<span style="color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:700">âœ“</span>'; }
  } else {
    answers[qid] = answers[qid].filter(v=>v!==val);
    if (box) { box.style.background=''; box.style.borderColor='var(--border)'; box.innerHTML=''; }
  }
  updateProgress();
}

function updateProgress() {
  const total     = activeSurvey.cauHois.length;
  const answered  = activeSurvey.cauHois.filter(q => hasAnswer(answers[q.id])).length;
  document.getElementById('progress-text').textContent = `${answered} / ${total} cÃ¢u`;
  document.getElementById('progress-bar').style.width  = `${(answered/total)*100}%`;
}

async function submitSurvey() {
  // Validate required
  const missing = activeSurvey.cauHois.filter(q => {
    if (!q.batBuoc) return false;
    return !hasAnswer(answers[q.id]);
  });
  if (missing.length) {
    Toast.warning(`Vui lÃ²ng tráº£ lá»i ${missing.length} cÃ¢u báº¯t buá»™c (cÃ³ dáº¥u *)`);
    document.getElementById(`qb-${missing[0].id}`)?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'center'});
    return;
  }

  if (activeSurvey.readOnly || !activeSurvey.isOpen) return;
  const btn = document.getElementById('submit-survey-btn');
  btn.disabled=true; btn.textContent='â³ Äang ná»™p...';
  const traLois = activeSurvey.cauHois.flatMap(question => {
    const answer = answers[question.id];
    if (!hasAnswer(answer)) return [];
    if (Array.isArray(answer)) {
      return answer.map(value => ({
        MaCauHoi: question.id,
        MaLuaChon: question.optionIds?.[question.options.indexOf(value)] || null,
        NoiDungTraLoi: null,
        SoSao: null
      }));
    }
    const optionIndex = question.options?.indexOf(answer) ?? -1;
    return [{
      MaCauHoi: question.id,
      MaLuaChon: optionIndex >= 0 ? question.optionIds?.[optionIndex] || null : null,
      NoiDungTraLoi: question.loai === 'Tá»± luáº­n' ? answer.trim() : null,
      SoSao: question.loai === 'ÄÃ¡nh giÃ¡ sao' ? Number(answer) : null
    }];
  });

  try {
    const response = await Http.post(`${API_BASE}/khaosat/submit`, {
      MaPhieuKS: activeSurvey.phieuId,
      TraLois: traLois
    });
    if (!response?.Success) throw new Error(response?.Message || 'MÃ¡y chá»§ chÆ°a xÃ¡c nháº­n ná»™p kháº£o sÃ¡t.');
  } catch (error) {
    Toast.error(error.message || 'KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ ná»™p kháº£o sÃ¡t.');
    btn.disabled=false; btn.textContent='âœ… Ná»™p kháº£o sÃ¡t';
    return;
  }

  // Mark done
  activeSurvey.done = true;
  activeSurvey.cauHois.forEach(question => { question.savedAnswer = answers[question.id] ?? null; });
  document.getElementById('survey-form-view').style.display='none';
  document.getElementById('thankyou-view').style.display='block';
  btn.disabled=false; btn.textContent='âœ… Ná»™p kháº£o sÃ¡t';
}

function backToList() {
  document.getElementById('survey-list-view').style.display='block';
  document.getElementById('survey-form-view').style.display='none';
  document.getElementById('thankyou-view').style.display='none';
  activeSurvey=null; answers={}; starValues={};
  renderList();
}

// ===== LOCAL STORAGE HELPERS =====
const Storage = {
  set: (key, value) => localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value)),
  get: (key) => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key)); } catch { return null; } },
  remove: (key) => localStorage.removeItem(key),
  clear: () => localStorage.clear(),
};

// ===== AUTH HELPERS =====
const Auth = {
  getUser:  () => Storage.get('crm_user'),
  getToken: () => Storage.get('crm_token'),
  isLoggedIn: () => !!Storage.get('crm_token'),

  normalizeRole(role) {
    if (!role) return '';
    const value = String(role).trim();
    const normalized = value.toLowerCase();
    if (normalized === 'admin') return 'Admin';
    if (['quanly', 'quáº£n lÃ½', 'manager'].includes(normalized)) return 'QuanLy';
    if (['khachhang', 'khÃ¡ch hÃ ng', 'customer', 'user'].includes(normalized)) return 'KhachHang';
    return value;
  },

  resolvePage(page) {
    const nested = /\/(customer|manager)\//.test(window.location.pathname);
    const relative = nested ? `../${page}` : `./${page}`;
    return new URL(relative, window.location.href).toString();
  },

  login(user, token) {
    const normalizedUser = {
      ...user,
      vaiTro: Auth.normalizeRole(user?.vaiTro ?? user?.VaiTro),
      VaiTro: Auth.normalizeRole(user?.vaiTro ?? user?.VaiTro),
    };
    Storage.set('crm_user', normalizedUser);
    Storage.set('crm_token', token);
  },

  logout(reason = '') {
    Storage.remove('crm_user');
    Storage.remove('crm_token');
    sessionStorage.clear();
    const loginUrl = new URL(Auth.resolvePage('login.html'));
    loginUrl.searchParams.set('loggedOut', '1');
    if (/khÃ³a|khoa|locked|inactive/i.test(String(reason))) {
      loginUrl.searchParams.set('reason', 'locked');
    }
    window.location.href = loginUrl.toString();
  },

  requireRole(...roles) {
    const user = Auth.getUser();
    if (!user) {
      window.location.href = Auth.resolvePage('login.html');
      return false;
    }
    const userRole = Auth.normalizeRole(user.vaiTro ?? user.VaiTro);
    if (!roles.includes(userRole)) {
      Toast.error('Báº¡n khÃ´ng cÃ³ quyá»n truy cáº­p trang nÃ y.');
      setTimeout(() => Auth.logout(), 1500);
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  },

  redirectByRole() {
    const user = Auth.getUser();
    if (!user) return;

    const role = Auth.normalizeRole(user.vaiTro ?? user.VaiTro);
    if (role === 'KhachHang' && user.hasPreferences === false) {
      window.location.href = Auth.resolvePage('customer/preferences.html');
      return;
    }
    const map = {
      'Admin': 'manager/dashboard.html',
      'QuanLy': 'manager/dashboard.html',
      'KhachHang': 'customer/home.html',
    };

    const dest = map[role];
    if (dest) window.location.href = Auth.resolvePage(dest);
  }
};

window.addEventListener('storage', event => {
  if (event.key === 'crm_token' && event.oldValue && !event.newValue) {
    sessionStorage.clear();
    window.location.href = Auth.resolvePage('login.html');
  }
});

function requireCustomerPreferences() {
  const user = Auth.getUser();
  if (!Auth.isLoggedIn() || Auth.normalizeRole(user?.vaiTro ?? user?.VaiTro) !== 'KhachHang') return;
  if (/\/customer\/preferences\.html$/i.test(window.location.pathname) || user.hasPreferences === true) return;

  Http.get(`${API.customers}/me/preferences`).then(response => {
    const hasPreferences = Boolean(response.Data?.HasPreferences);
    if (!hasPreferences) {
      Auth.login({ ...user, hasPreferences: false }, Auth.getToken());
      window.location.href = Auth.resolvePage('customer/preferences.html');
    } else {
      Auth.login({ ...user, hasPreferences: true }, Auth.getToken());
    }
  }).catch(() => {});
}

function startSurveyNoticePolling() {
  if (window.__crmSurveyNoticePollingStarted) return;
  window.__crmSurveyNoticePollingStarted = true;
  if (/\/customer\/surveys\.html$/i.test(window.location.pathname)) {
    document.getElementById('crm-survey-notice')?.remove();
    return;
  }

  const checkForOpenSurvey = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await Http.get(`${API.surveys}/my`);
      const ticket = (response?.Data || []).find(item =>
        item.IsOpen === true && item.TrangThai !== 'ÄÃ£ hoÃ n thÃ nh');
      if (!ticket) {
        document.getElementById('crm-survey-notice')?.remove();
        return;
      }
      if (sessionStorage.getItem(`declined_survey_${ticket.MaPhieuKS}`) === 'true') {
        document.getElementById('crm-survey-notice')?.remove();
        return;
      }

      let notice = document.getElementById('crm-survey-notice');
      if (!notice) {
        notice = document.createElement('div');
        notice.id = 'crm-survey-notice';
        notice.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:12px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:10000;max-width:min(720px,calc(100vw - 24px));width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:14px 18px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #bfdbfe;border-bottom:3px solid #2563eb;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(15,23,42,.18)';
        document.body.appendChild(notice);
      }
      notice.replaceChildren();
      const copy = document.createElement('div');
      const title = document.createElement('strong');
      title.textContent = `Báº¡n cÃ³ kháº£o sÃ¡t má»›i: ${ticket.KhaoSat?.TenKhaoSat || 'Máº«u Ã¡o má»›i'}`;
      const description = document.createElement('div');
      description.textContent = ticket.KhaoSat?.MoTa || 'Chia sáº» Ã½ kiáº¿n cá»§a báº¡n vá»›i Fashion Store.';
      description.style.cssText = 'font-size:13px;color:#64748b;margin-top:3px';
      copy.append(title, description);
      const actions = document.createElement('div');
      actions.style.cssText = 'display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-shrink:0';
      const open = document.createElement('a');
      open.className = 'btn btn-primary btn-sm';
      open.href = Auth.resolvePage('customer/surveys.html');
      open.textContent = 'LÃ m kháº£o sÃ¡t';
      const dismiss = document.createElement('button');
      dismiss.type = 'button';
      dismiss.className = 'btn btn-ghost btn-sm';
      dismiss.textContent = 'Äá»ƒ sau';
      dismiss.addEventListener('click', () => {
        sessionStorage.setItem(`declined_survey_${ticket.MaPhieuKS}`, 'true');
        notice.remove();
      }, { once: true });
      actions.append(open, dismiss);
      notice.append(copy, actions);
    } catch (error) {
      // Ignore transient API/network failures; the survey list remains available.
    }
  };

  checkForOpenSurvey();
  window.setInterval(checkForOpenSurvey, 60000);
}

// ===== HTTP CLIENT =====
const Http = {
  _headers() {
    const h = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
    const t = Auth.getToken();
    if (t) h['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${t}`;
    return h;
  },

  _pascalize(value) {
    if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(item => Http._pascalize(item));
    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return value;
    return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).map(([key, item]) => [
      key.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + key.slice(1),
      Http._pascalize(item),
    ]));
  },

  async _handle(res, preserveUnauthorized = false) {
    const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
    if (res.status === 401) {
      if (!preserveUnauthorized) Auth.logout(data.message || data.Message || '');
      throw new Error(data.message || data.Message || 'PhiÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p Ä‘Ã£ háº¿t háº¡n. Vui lÃ²ng Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p láº¡i.');
    }
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.message || data.Message || `Lá»—i ${res.status}`);
    return Http._pascalize(data);
  },

  get:    (url, params) => {
    const u = params ? `${url}?${new URLSearchParams(params)}` : url;
    return fetch(u, { headers: Http._headers() }).then(Http._handle);
  },
  post:   (url, body)   => fetch(url, { method: 'POST',   headers: Http._headers(), body: JSON.stringify(body) }).then(res => Http._handle(res, url === API.login)),
  put:    (url, body)   => fetch(url, { method: 'PUT',    headers: Http._headers(), body: JSON.stringify(body) }).then(Http._handle),
  delete: (url)         => fetch(url, { method: 'DELETE', headers: Http._headers() }).then(Http._handle),
  patch:  (url, body)   => fetch(url, { method: 'PATCH',  headers: Http._headers(), body: JSON.stringify(body) }).then(Http._handle),
};

// ===== TOAST =====
const Toast = {
  _container: null,
  _init() {
    if (!this._container) {
      this._container = document.createElement('div');
      this._container.id = 'toast-container';
      document.body.appendChild(this._container);
    }
  },
  _show(type, msg, duration = 3500) {
    this._init();
    const icons = { success: 'âœ…', error: 'âŒ', warning: 'âš ï¸', info: 'â„¹ï¸' };
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = `toast toast-${type}`;
    el.innerHTML = `
      <span class="toast-icon">${icons[type]}</span>
      <span class="toast-msg">${msg}</span>
      <button class="toast-close" onclick="this.parentElement.remove()">Ã—</button>`;
    this._container.appendChild(el);
    setTimeout(() => el.style.transition = 'opacity .4s', duration - 400);
    setTimeout(() => { el.style.opacity = '0'; setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 400); }, duration);
  },
  success: (msg) => Toast._show('success', msg),
  error:   (msg) => Toast._show('error', msg),
  warning: (msg) => Toast._show('warning', msg),
  info:    (msg) => Toast._show('info', msg),
};

const Modal = {
  open(id)  { document.getElementById(id)?.classList.add('active'); },
  close(id) { document.getElementById(id)?.classList.remove('active'); },
  confirm(title, msg, onConfirm) {
    const id = '__confirm_modal';
    let el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!el) {
      el = document.createElement('div');
      el.id = id;
      el.className = 'modal-overlay';
      el.innerHTML = `
        <div class="modal">
          <div class="modal-header"><h3 class="modal-title" id="${id}_title"></h3></div>
          <div class="modal-body"><p id="${id}_msg"></p></div>
          <div class="modal-footer">
            <button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="Modal.close('${id}')">Há»§y</button>
            <button class="btn btn-danger"    id="${id}_confirm">XÃ¡c nháº­n</button>
          </div>
        </div>`;
      document.body.appendChild(el);
    }
    document.getElementById(`${id}_title`).textContent = title;
    document.getElementById(`${id}_msg`).textContent   = msg;
    document.getElementById(`${id}_confirm`).onclick   = () => { Modal.close(id); onConfirm(); };
    Modal.open(id);
  }
};

const Format = {

  date:     (v) => v ? new Date(v).toLocaleDateString('vi-VN') : 'â€”',
  datetime: (v) => v ? new Date(v).toLocaleString('vi-VN') : 'â€”',
  phone:    (v) => v || 'â€”',

  statusBadge(status, map) {
    const entry = map[status] || { label: status, class: 'badge-secondary' };
    return `<span class="badge ${entry.class}">${entry.label}</span>`;
  },

  feedbackStatus(s) {

      'Äang xá»­ lÃ½': { label: 'Äang xá»­ lÃ½', class: 'badge-warning' },
      'ÄÃ£ xá»­ lÃ½':   { label: 'ÄÃ£ xá»­ lÃ½',   class: 'badge-success' },
      'ÄÃ£ Ä‘Ã³ng':    { label: 'ÄÃ£ Ä‘Ã³ng',     class: 'badge-secondary'},
    };
    return Format.statusBadge(s, map);
  },

  stars(n) {
    return 'â˜…'.repeat(n) + 'â˜†'.repeat(5 - n);

// ===== PAGINATION =====
class Paginator {
  constructor(containerSel, onChange) {
    this.container = document.querySelector(containerSel);
    this.onChange  = onChange;
    this.page      = 1;
    this.total     = 0;
    this.pageSize  = 10;
  }

  render() {
    if (!this.container) return;
    const pages = Math.ceil(this.total / this.pageSize) || 1;
    let html = `
      <button class="page-btn" onclick="this.getRootNode().host?._pager?.go(${this.page-1})" 
        ${this.page===1?'disabled':''}>â€¹</button>`;
    for (let i = 1; i <= pages; i++) {
      if (pages > 7 && Math.abs(i - this.page) > 2 && i !== 1 && i !== pages) {
        if (i === 2 || i === pages - 1) html += `<span style="padding:0 4px">â€¦</span>`;
        continue;
      }
      html += `<button class="page-btn ${i===this.page?'active':''}" data-p="${i}">${i}</button>`;
    }
    html += `<button class="page-btn" ${this.page===pages?'disabled':''}>â€º</button>`;
    this.container.innerHTML = html;
    this.container.querySelectorAll('[data-p]').forEach(b =>
      b.addEventListener('click', () => this.go(+b.dataset.p)));
    const btns = this.container.querySelectorAll('.page-btn:not([data-p])');
    btns[0].addEventListener('click', () => this.go(this.page - 1));
    btns[btns.length-1].addEventListener('click', () => this.go(this.page + 1));
  }

  go(p) {
    const pages = Math.ceil(this.total / this.pageSize) || 1;
    if (p < 1 || p > pages) return;
    this.page = p;
    this.render();
    this.onChange(p);
  }

  setTotal(total) { this.total = total; this.page = 1; this.render(); }
}

// ===== CHART HELPERS (sá»­ dá»¥ng Chart.js CDN) =====
const ChartHelper = {
  pie(canvasId, labels, data, colors) {
    const ctx = document.getElementById(canvasId)?.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;
    return new Chart(ctx, {
      type: 'doughnut',
      data: { labels, datasets: [{ data, backgroundColor: colors, borderWidth: 2 }] },
      options: { responsive: true, plugins: { legend: { position: 'bottom' } } }
    });
  },
  bar(canvasId, labels, datasets, title) {
    const ctx = document.getElementById(canvasId)?.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;
    return new Chart(ctx, {
      type: 'bar',
      data: { labels, datasets },
      options: {
        responsive: true,
        plugins: { legend: { display: datasets.length > 1 }, title: { display: !!title, text: title } },
        scales: { y: { beginAtZero: true } }
      }
    });
  },
  line(canvasId, labels, datasets) {
    const ctx = document.getElementById(canvasId)?.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;
    return new Chart(ctx, {
      type: 'line',
      data: { labels, datasets: datasets.map(d => ({ ...d, tension: 0.3, fill: false })) },
      options: { responsive: true, scales: { y: { beginAtZero: true } } }
    });
  }
};

const $ = (sel, ctx = document) => ctx.querySelector(sel);
const $$ = (sel, ctx = document) => [...ctx.querySelectorAll(sel)];

function renderSidebarUser() {
  const user = Auth.getUser();
  if (!user) return;
  const nameEl  = document.getElementById('sidebar-user-name');
  const roleEl  = document.getElementById('sidebar-user-role');
  const avatarEl = document.getElementById('sidebar-avatar');
  if (nameEl)  nameEl.textContent  = user.hoTen || user.tenDangNhap;
  if (roleEl)  roleEl.textContent  = user.vaiTro;
  if (avatarEl) avatarEl.textContent = (user.hoTen || user.tenDangNhap || 'U')[0].toUpperCase();
}

function highlightActiveNav() {
  const path = window.location.pathname.split('/').pop();
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(el => {
    const href = el.getAttribute('href') || '';
    el.classList.toggle('active', href.includes(path));
  });
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  renderSidebarUser();
  highlightActiveNav();
});

function updatePreview() {
  const ht = document.getElementById('inp-hoten').value.trim();
  const em = document.getElementById('inp-email').value.trim();
  const sd = document.getElementById('inp-sdt').value.trim();
  const ns = document.getElementById('inp-ngaysinh').value;
  const dc = document.getElementById('inp-diachi').value.trim();
  const gt = document.querySelector('input[name="gt"]:checked')?.value;

  document.getElementById('prev-avatar').textContent = ht ? ht[0].toUpperCase() : '?';
  document.getElementById('prev-avatar').style.background = gt === 'Ná»¯' ? '#ec4899' : '#2563eb';
  document.getElementById('prev-name').textContent  = ht || 'ChÆ°a nháº­p tÃªn';
  document.getElementById('prev-email').textContent = em || 'ChÆ°a nháº­p email';
  document.getElementById('prev-sdt').textContent   = sd || 'â€”';
  document.getElementById('prev-ns').textContent    = ns ? Format.date(ns) : 'â€”';
  document.getElementById('prev-dc').textContent    = dc || 'â€”';

  // Auto-generate username from name
  if (ht && !document.getElementById('inp-username').value) {
    const slug = ht.toLowerCase()
      .normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'')
      .replace(/Ä‘/g,'d').replace(/[^a-z0-9 ]/g,'').trim().replace(/\s+/g,'_');
    document.getElementById('inp-username').value = slug;
  }
}

function validate() {
  let ok = true;
  const rules = [
    { id: 'inp-hoten',    err: 'err-hoten',    msg: 'Vui lÃ²ng nháº­p há» tÃªn',      check: v => v.trim().length > 0 },
    { id: 'inp-email',    err: 'err-email',    msg: 'Email khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡',        check: v => /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(v) },
    { id: 'inp-username', err: 'err-username', msg: 'Vui lÃ²ng nháº­p tÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p', check: v => v.trim().length > 0 },
    { id: 'inp-matkhau',  err: 'err-matkhau',  msg: 'Máº­t kháº©u tá»‘i thiá»ƒu 8 kÃ½ tá»±', check: v => v.length >= 8 },
  ];
  rules.forEach(r => {
    const v = document.getElementById(r.id).value;
    const errEl = document.getElementById(r.err);
    if (!r.check(v)) { errEl.textContent = r.msg; document.getElementById(r.id).classList.add('error'); ok = false; }
    else              { errEl.textContent = '';    document.getElementById(r.id).classList.remove('error'); }
  });
  return ok;
}

async function submitForm() {
  if (!validate()) return;
  const btn = document.querySelector('[onclick="submitForm()"]');
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.textContent = 'â³ Äang xá»­ lÃ½...';
  try {
    const response = await Http.post(`${API.customers}/create-with-account`, {
      TenDangNhap: document.getElementById('inp-username').value.trim(),
      MatKhau: document.getElementById('inp-matkhau').value,
      HoTen: document.getElementById('inp-hoten').value.trim(),
      Email: document.getElementById('inp-email').value.trim(),
      SoDienThoai: document.getElementById('inp-sdt').value.trim() || null,
      NgaySinh: document.getElementById('inp-ngaysinh').value || null,
      GioiTinh: document.querySelector('input[name="gt"]:checked')?.value || null,
      DiaChi: document.getElementById('inp-diachi').value.trim() || null,
    });
    if (response?.Success === false) throw new Error(response.Message || 'ThÃªm khÃ¡ch hÃ ng tháº¥t báº¡i.');
    Toast.success('ThÃªm khÃ¡ch hÃ ng thÃ nh cÃ´ng!');
    setTimeout(() => window.location.href = 'customers.html', 1200);
  } catch (err) {

const PAGE_SIZE = 8;

function getAge(ngaySinh) {
  return new Date().getFullYear() - new Date(ngaySinh).getFullYear();
}

function filterKH() {
  const q    = document.getElementById('search-input').value.trim().toLowerCase();
  const gt   = document.getElementById('f-gt').value;
  const age  = document.getElementById('f-age').value;
  const st   = document.getElementById('f-st').value;
  const sort = document.getElementById('f-sort').value.split('_');

  filtered = customers.filter(c => {
    if (q && !c.hoTen.toLowerCase().includes(q) && !c.email.includes(q) &&
        !c.sdt.includes(q) && !c.soThich.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return false;
    if (gt && c.gioiTinh !== gt) return false;
    if (st !== '' && String(c.trangThaiTK) !== st) return false;
    if (age) {
      const a = getAge(c.ngaySinh);
      if (age === '18-24' && (a < 18 || a > 24)) return false;
      if (age === '25-34' && (a < 25 || a > 34)) return false;
      if (age === '35-44' && (a < 35 || a > 44)) return false;
      if (age === '45+' && a < 45) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }).sort((a, b) => {
    const [col, dir] = sort;
    let av = a[col], bv = b[col];
    if (typeof av === 'string') { av = av.toLowerCase(); bv = bv.toLowerCase(); }
    return dir === 'asc' ? (av < bv ? -1 : 1) : (av > bv ? -1 : 1);
  });

  currentPage = 1;
  updateCounts();
  render();
}

function resetFilters() {
  ['search-input','f-gt','f-age','f-st'].forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).value = '');
  document.getElementById('f-sort').value = 'ngayDangKy_desc';
  filterKH();
}

function updateCounts() {
  document.getElementById('cnt-total').textContent  = customers.length;
  document.getElementById('cnt-active').textContent = customers.filter(c => c.trangThaiTK).length;
  document.getElementById('cnt-locked').textContent = customers.filter(c => !c.trangThaiTK).length;
  document.getElementById('cnt-shown').textContent  = filtered.length;
}

}

function renderPagination(contId) {
  const pages = Math.ceil(filtered.length / PAGE_SIZE) || 1;
  const cont  = document.getElementById(contId);
  if (pages <= 1) { cont.innerHTML = ''; return; }
  let html = `<button class="page-btn" ${currentPage===1?'disabled':''} onclick="goPage(${currentPage-1})">â€¹</button>`;
  for (let i = 1; i <= pages; i++) {
    if (pages > 6 && Math.abs(i - currentPage) > 2 && i !== 1 && i !== pages) { if (i===2||i===pages-1) html+=`<span style="padding:0 4px">â€¦</span>`; continue; }
    html += `<button class="page-btn ${i===currentPage?'active':''}" onclick="goPage(${i})">${i}</button>`;
  }
  html += `<button class="page-btn" ${currentPage===pages?'disabled':''} onclick="goPage(${currentPage+1})">â€º</button>`;
  cont.innerHTML = html;
}

function goPage(p) {
  const pages = Math.ceil(filtered.length / PAGE_SIZE) || 1;
  if (p < 1 || p > pages) return;
  currentPage = p; render();
}

function setView(v) {
  currentView = v;
  document.getElementById('view-list').style.display = v === 'list' ? 'block' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('view-card').style.display = v === 'card' ? 'block' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('btn-list').className = `btn btn-sm ${v==='list'?'btn-primary':'btn-ghost'}`;
  document.getElementById('btn-card').className = `btn btn-sm ${v==='card'?'btn-primary':'btn-ghost'}`;
}

function editKH(id) {
  const c = customers.find(c => c.maKH === id);
  document.getElementById('edit-kh-id').value         = id;
  document.getElementById('inp-kh-hoten').value       = c.hoTen;
  document.getElementById('inp-kh-email').value       = c.email;
  document.getElementById('inp-kh-sdt').value         = c.sdt;
  document.getElementById('inp-kh-ngaysinh').value    = c.ngaySinh;
  document.getElementById('inp-kh-gt').value          = c.gioiTinh;
  document.getElementById('inp-kh-diachi').value      = c.diaChi;
  document.getElementById('inp-kh-sothich').value     = c.soThich;
  Modal.open('modal-edit-kh');
}

function saveEditKH() {
  const id = +document.getElementById('edit-kh-id').value;
  const c  = customers.find(c => c.maKH === id);
  c.hoTen    = document.getElementById('inp-kh-hoten').value.trim();
  c.email    = document.getElementById('inp-kh-email').value.trim();
  c.sdt      = document.getElementById('inp-kh-sdt').value.trim();

  c.gioiTinh = document.getElementById('inp-kh-gt').value;

  c.soThich  = document.getElementById('inp-kh-sothich').value.trim();
  Toast.success('ÄÃ£ cáº­p nháº­t thÃ´ng tin khÃ¡ch hÃ ng!');
  Modal.close('modal-edit-kh');
  filterKH();
}

function toggleLock(id) {
  const c = customers.find(c => c.maKH === id);
  const action = c.trangThaiTK ? 'khÃ³a' : 'má»Ÿ khÃ³a';
  Modal.confirm(`${c.trangThaiTK?'KhÃ³a':'Má»Ÿ khÃ³a'} tÃ i khoáº£n`, `Báº¡n muá»‘n ${action} tÃ i khoáº£n cá»§a ${c.hoTen}?`, () => {
    c.trangThaiTK = c.trangThaiTK ? 0 : 1;
    Toast.info(`TÃ i khoáº£n ${c.hoTen} Ä‘Ã£ ${c.trangThaiTK?'Ä‘Æ°á»£c má»Ÿ khÃ³a':'bá»‹ khÃ³a'}.`);
    filterKH();
  });
}

function deleteKH(id) {
  const c = customers.find(c => c.maKH === id);
  Modal.confirm('XÃ³a khÃ¡ch hÃ ng', `XÃ³a khÃ¡ch hÃ ng "${c.hoTen}"? HÃ nh Ä‘á»™ng khÃ´ng thá»ƒ hoÃ n tÃ¡c.`, () => {

    filterKH();
  });
}

let filtered = [...feedbacks], currentStatus = '', selectedId = null;

function updateCounts() {
  document.getElementById('cnt-all').textContent  = feedbacks.length;
  document.getElementById('cnt-chua').textContent = feedbacks.filter(f=>f.trangThai==='ChÆ°a xá»­ lÃ½').length;
  document.getElementById('cnt-dang').textContent = feedbacks.filter(f=>f.trangThai==='Äang xá»­ lÃ½').length;
  document.getElementById('cnt-da').textContent   = feedbacks.filter(f=>f.trangThai==='ÄÃ£ xá»­ lÃ½').length;
  document.getElementById('cnt-dong').textContent = feedbacks.filter(f=>f.trangThai==='ÄÃ£ Ä‘Ã³ng').length;
  document.getElementById('badge-fb').textContent = feedbacks.filter(f=>f.trangThai==='ChÆ°a xá»­ lÃ½').length;
}

function filterFB() {
  const q    = normalizeFeedbackSearch(document.getElementById('search-input').value);
  const loai = document.getElementById('f-loai').value;
  const sort = document.getElementById('f-sort').value.split('_');
  const df   = document.getElementById('f-date-from').value;

  filtered = feedbacks.filter(f => {
    if (currentStatus && f.trangThai !== currentStatus) return false;
    if (q && !normalizeFeedbackSearch(`${f.khachHang} ${f.tenSP} ${f.tieuDe} ${f.noiDung} ${f.phanHoiQL||''}`).includes(q)) return false;
    if (loai && f.loai !== loai) return false;
    if (df && f.ngayGui < df) return false;
    return true;
  }).sort((a, b) => sort[1] === 'desc' ? b.ngayGui.localeCompare(a.ngayGui) : a.ngayGui.localeCompare(b.ngayGui));

  document.getElementById('list-info').textContent = `${filtered.length} pháº£n há»“i`;
  renderList();
  updateCounts();
}

function normalizeFeedbackSearch(value) {
  return String(value || '').replace(/[Ä‘Ä]/g, letter => letter === 'Ä‘' ? 'd' : 'D')
    .normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .toLocaleLowerCase('vi').replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]/gu, '');
}

async function loadFeedbacks() {
  const overlay = document.getElementById('loading-overlay');
  try {
    const response = await Http.get(API.feedbacks, { page: 1, pageSize: 100, sortDir: 'desc' });
    feedbacks = (response?.Data?.Items || []).map(item => ({
      maPH: item.MaPH, khachHang: item.HoTenKH || 'KhÃ¡ch hÃ ng', tenSP: item.TenSP || '',
      tieuDe: item.TieuDe || '(KhÃ´ng cÃ³ tiÃªu Ä‘á»)', noiDung: item.NoiDung || '',
      loai: item.LoaiPhanHoi || 'GÃ³p Ã½ khÃ¡c', soSao: item.SoSao, trangThai: item.TrangThai,
      phanHoiQL: item.PhanHoiQuanLy || '', ngayGui: item.NgayGui, ngayXuLy: item.NgayXuLy,
    }));
    filterFB();
  } catch (error) {
    Toast.error(error.message || 'KhÃ´ng táº£i Ä‘Æ°á»£c danh sÃ¡ch pháº£n há»“i.');
    document.getElementById('fb-list').innerHTML = '<div class="alert alert-danger">KhÃ´ng táº£i Ä‘Æ°á»£c pháº£n há»“i tá»« mÃ¡y chá»§.</div>';
  } finally {
    if (overlay) overlay.style.display = 'none';
  }
}

function resetFilters() {
  ['search-input','f-loai','f-date-from'].forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).value = '');
  document.getElementById('f-sort').value = 'ngayGui_desc';
  filterFB();
}

const statusClass = { 'ChÆ°a xá»­ lÃ½':'chua', 'Äang xá»­ lÃ½':'dang', 'ÄÃ£ xá»­ lÃ½':'da', 'ÄÃ£ Ä‘Ã³ng':'dong' };
const loaiIcon    = { 'Khiáº¿u náº¡i':'âš ï¸', 'GÃ³p Ã½ sáº£n pháº©m':'ðŸ’¡', 'Há»i thÃ´ng tin':'â“', 'Khen ngá»£i':'â­' };
function escapeFeedbackHtml(value) {
  return String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, character => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[character]));
}

function renderList() {
  const cont = document.getElementById('fb-list');
  if (!filtered.length) {
    cont.innerHTML = `<div class="empty-state" style="padding:40px 20px"><div class="empty-icon">ðŸ’¬</div><h3>KhÃ´ng cÃ³ pháº£n há»“i</h3></div>`;
    return;
  }
  cont.innerHTML = filtered.map(f => `
    <div class="fb-card ${statusClass[f.trangThai]||''}"
         style="border-radius:0;border-left-width:4px;cursor:pointer;${selectedId===f.maPH?'background:#eff6ff;':''}"
         onclick="selectFB(${f.maPH})">
      <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:6px">
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px">
          <span>${loaiIcon[f.loai]||'ðŸ’¬'}</span>
          <strong style="font-size:13px;line-height:1.3">${escapeFeedbackHtml(f.tieuDe)}</strong>
        </div>
        ${Format.feedbackStatus(f.trangThai)}
      </div>
      <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted)">ðŸ‘¤ ${escapeFeedbackHtml(f.khachHang)} ${f.tenSP?`â€¢ ðŸ›ï¸ ${escapeFeedbackHtml(f.tenSP)}`:''}</div>
      <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);margin-top:2px">ðŸ“… ${Format.datetime(f.ngayGui)} â€¢ ${escapeFeedbackHtml(f.loai)}</div>
      <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text);margin-top:6px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;opacity:.7">${escapeFeedbackHtml(f.noiDung)}</div>
    </div>`).join('');
}

async function submitReply(id) {
  const text = document.getElementById('reply-text')?.value.trim();
  if (!text) { Toast.warning('Vui lÃ²ng nháº­p ná»™i dung pháº£n há»“i'); return; }
  const f = feedbacks.find(f => f.maPH === id);
  try {
    const response = await Http.patch(`${API.feedbacks}/${id}/reply`, { phanHoiQuanLy: text });
    f.phanHoiQL = text;
    f.ngayXuLy = response?.Data?.NgayXuLy || new Date().toISOString();
    f.trangThai = 'ÄÃ£ xá»­ lÃ½';
    Toast.success('ÄÃ£ gá»­i phÃºc Ä‘Ã¡p. Pháº£n há»“i nÃ y khÃ´ng thá»ƒ tráº£ lá»i láº§n hai.');
    filterFB();
    selectFB(id);
  } catch (error) {
    Toast.error(error.message || 'KhÃ´ng gá»­i Ä‘Æ°á»£c phÃºc Ä‘Ã¡p.');
  }
}

function exportCSV() {
  const rows = [['MÃ£ PH','KhÃ¡ch hÃ ng','Sáº£n pháº©m','TiÃªu Ä‘á»','Loáº¡i','Tráº¡ng thÃ¡i','NgÃ y gá»­i','Pháº£n há»“i QL']];
  filtered.forEach(f => rows.push([f.maPH, f.khachHang, f.tenSP||'', f.tieuDe, f.loai, f.trangThai, f.ngayGui, f.phanHoiQL||'']));
  const csv  = rows.map(r => r.map(c=>`"${String(c).replace(/"/g,'""')}"`).join(',')).join('\n');
  const blob = new Blob(['\uFEFF'+csv],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8'});
  const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download='phanhoi.csv';a.click();
  Toast.info('ÄÃ£ xuáº¥t CSV!');
}

<script>
Auth.requireRole('QuanLy', 'Admin');

let surveys = [];

function escapeHtml(value) {
  return String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, ch => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[ch]));
}
function displayDate(value) {
  if (!value) return 'â€”';
  const date = new Date(value);
  return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? 'â€”' : date.toLocaleString('vi-VN');
}
function showTab(tabId, button) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(tab => tab.classList.toggle('active', tab.id === tabId));
  document.querySelectorAll('.tabs .tab-btn').forEach(tabButton => tabButton.classList.toggle('active', tabButton === button));
}

function filterSurveys() {
  const query = document.getElementById('ks-search').value.trim().toLowerCase();
  const status = document.getElementById('ks-filter-st').value;
  renderSurveyList(surveys.filter(survey =>
    (!query || survey.TenKhaoSat.toLowerCase().includes(query))
    && (status === '' || String(survey.TrangThai) === status)));
}

function renderSurveyList(list) {
  const container = document.getElementById('survey-list');
  if (!list.length) {
    container.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><div class="empty-icon">ðŸ“</div><h3>KhÃ´ng cÃ³ kháº£o sÃ¡t</h3></div>';
    return;
  }
  container.innerHTML = list.map(survey => {
    const recipients = Number(survey.SoPhieu || 0);
    const complete = Number(survey.SoPhieuHoanThanh || 0);
    const status = Boolean(survey.TrangThai);
    return `<div class="card" style="margin-bottom:16px"><div class="card-body">
      <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px">
        <div style="flex:1;min-width:260px">
          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:4px">
            <h3 style="font-size:16px;font-weight:600">${escapeHtml(survey.TenKhaoSat)}</h3>
            <span class="badge ${status?'badge-success':'badge-secondary'}">${status?'ðŸŸ¢ Äang má»Ÿ':'âš« ÄÃ£ Ä‘Ã³ng'}</span>
          </div>
          <p style="font-size:13px;color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:8px">${escapeHtml(survey.MoTa || '')}</p>
          <div style="display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:13px">
            <span>ðŸ“… ${displayDate(survey.NgayBatDau)} â†’ ${displayDate(survey.NgayKetThuc)}</span>
            <span>â“ ${Number(survey.SoCauHoi || 0)} cÃ¢u há»i</span>
            <span>ðŸ“¨ ${recipients} phiáº¿u</span>
            <span>âœ… ${complete} hoÃ n thÃ nh</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center">
          ${status ? `<button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onclick="closeSurvey(${Number(survey.MaKS)})" style="color:var(--danger)">ðŸ”’ ÄÃ³ng kháº£o sÃ¡t</button>` : ''}
        </div>

}

async function loadSurveys() {
  try {
    const response = await Http.get(API.surveys, { page: 1, pageSize: 100 });
    if (!response?.Success) throw new Error(response?.Message || 'KhÃ´ng táº£i Ä‘Æ°á»£c danh sÃ¡ch kháº£o sÃ¡t.');
    surveys = response.Data?.Items || [];
    filterSurveys();
  } catch (error) {
    surveys = [];
    renderSurveyList([]);
    Toast.error(error.message || 'KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ táº£i kháº£o sÃ¡t tá»« mÃ¡y chá»§.');
  }
}

function openCreateSurvey() {
  questions = [];
  qIdCounter = 1;
  document.getElementById('ks-ten').value = '';
  document.getElementById('ks-mota').value = '';
  document.getElementById('ks-ngay-bd').value = '';
  document.getElementById('ks-ngay-kt').value = '';
  renderQuestions();
  document.getElementById('tab-builder-btn').style.display = 'inline-block';
  showTab('tab-builder', document.getElementById('tab-builder-btn'));
}

function addQuestion() {
  questions.push({ id: qIdCounter++, noiDung: '', loai: 'Má»™t lá»±a chá»n', batBuoc: true, options: [] });
  renderQuestions();
}
function removeQuestion(id) {
  questions = questions.filter(question => question.id !== id);
  renderQuestions();
}
function addOption(id) {
  questions.find(question => question.id === id)?.options.push('');
  renderQuestions();
}
function removeOption(id, index) {
  questions.find(question => question.id === id)?.options.splice(index, 1);
  renderQuestions();
}
function renderQuestions() {
  document.getElementById('q-count').textContent = questions.length;
  const container = document.getElementById('questions-container');
  document.getElementById('empty-questions').style.display = questions.length ? 'none' : 'block';
  const types = ['Má»™t lá»±a chá»n', 'Nhiá»u lá»±a chá»n', 'Tá»± luáº­n', 'ÄÃ¡nh giÃ¡ sao'];
  const icons = {'Má»™t lá»±a chá»n':'âšª','Nhiá»u lá»±a chá»n':'â˜‘ï¸','Tá»± luáº­n':'âœï¸','ÄÃ¡nh giÃ¡ sao':'â­'};
  container.innerHTML = questions.map((question, index) => `
    <div class="question-block" id="qblock-${question.id}">
      <div class="q-header">
        <span class="q-num">Q${index + 1}</span>
        <input type="text" class="form-control" data-question-text="${question.id}" value="${escapeHtml(question.noiDung)}" maxlength="1000" style="flex:1" placeholder="Nháº­p ná»™i dung cÃ¢u há»i...">
        <select class="form-control" data-question-type="${question.id}" style="width:180px">
          ${types.map(type => `<option value="${type}" ${type === question.loai ? 'selected' : ''}>${icons[type]} ${type}</option>`).join('')}
        </select>
        <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap">
          <input type="checkbox" data-question-required="${question.id}" ${question.batBuoc ? 'checked' : ''}> Báº¯t buá»™c
        </label>
        <button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" style="color:var(--danger)" onclick="removeQuestion(${question.id})">ðŸ—‘ï¸</button>
      </div>
      ${(question.loai === 'Má»™t lá»±a chá»n' || question.loai === 'Nhiá»u lá»±a chá»n') ? `
        <div style="padding-left:8px">
          ${question.options.map((option, optionIndex) => `
            <div class="option-row">
              <span style="color:var(--text-muted);font-size:16px">${question.loai === 'Má»™t lá»±a chá»n' ? 'âšª' : 'â˜'}</span>
              <input type="text" class="form-control" data-option-text="${question.id}" data-option-index="${optionIndex}" value="${escapeHtml(option)}" maxlength="500" placeholder="Nháº­p phÆ°Æ¡ng Ã¡n">
              <button class="btn btn-ghost btn-icon" style="color:var(--danger);padding:4px 8px" onclick="removeOption(${question.id},${optionIndex})">Ã—</button>
            </div>`).join('')}
          <button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onclick="addOption(${question.id})" style="margin-top:4px">âž• ThÃªm lá»±a chá»n</button>
        </div>` : ''}
      ${question.loai === 'Tá»± luáº­n' ? '<p style="padding-left:8px;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:13px">KhÃ¡ch hÃ ng sáº½ nháº­p cÃ¢u tráº£ lá»i dáº¡ng vÄƒn báº£n.</p>' : ''}
      ${question.loai === 'ÄÃ¡nh giÃ¡ sao' ? '<p style="padding-left:8px;font-size:24px;color:#f59e0b">â˜…â˜…â˜…â˜…â˜… <span style="font-size:13px;color:var(--text-muted)">KhÃ¡ch hÃ ng chá»n 1â€“5 sao</span></p>' : ''}
    </div>`).join('');

  container.querySelectorAll('[data-question-text]').forEach(input => input.addEventListener('input', event => {
    const question = questions.find(item => item.id === Number(event.target.dataset.questionText));
    if (question) question.noiDung = event.target.value;
  }));
  container.querySelectorAll('[data-question-type]').forEach(select => select.addEventListener('change', event => {
    const question = questions.find(item => item.id === Number(event.target.dataset.questionType));
    if (question) { question.loai = event.target.value; renderQuestions(); }
  }));
  container.querySelectorAll('[data-question-required]').forEach(input => input.addEventListener('change', event => {
    const question = questions.find(item => item.id === Number(event.target.dataset.questionRequired));
    if (question) question.batBuoc = event.target.checked;
  }));
  container.querySelectorAll('[data-option-text]').forEach(input => input.addEventListener('input', event => {
    const question = questions.find(item => item.id === Number(event.target.dataset.optionText));
    if (question) question.options[Number(event.target.dataset.optionIndex)] = event.target.value;
  }));
}

async function publishSurvey() {
  const title = document.getElementById('ks-ten').value.trim();
  const description = document.getElementById('ks-mota').value.trim();
  const start = document.getElementById('ks-ngay-bd').value;
  const end = document.getElementById('ks-ngay-kt').value;
  if (!title || title.length > 200) { Toast.error('Nháº­p tÃªn kháº£o sÃ¡t (tá»‘i Ä‘a 200 kÃ½ tá»±).'); return; }
  if (!start || !end || new Date(start) < new Date() || new Date(end) <= new Date(start)) {
    Toast.error('Chá»n thá»i gian báº¯t Ä‘áº§u tá»« hiá»‡n táº¡i trá»Ÿ Ä‘i vÃ  thá»i gian káº¿t thÃºc sau thá»i gian báº¯t Ä‘áº§u.'); return;
  }
  if (!questions.length || questions.some(question => !question.noiDung.trim())) {
    Toast.error('Nháº­p ná»™i dung cho Ã­t nháº¥t má»™t cÃ¢u há»i vÃ  khÃ´ng Ä‘á»ƒ trá»‘ng cÃ¢u há»i.'); return;
  }
  const surveyQuestions = [];
  for (const question of questions) {
    const options = question.options.map(option => option.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    if (['Má»™t lá»±a chá»n', 'Nhiá»u lá»±a chá»n'].includes(question.loai)) {
      if (options.length < 2 || new Set(options.map(value => value.toLocaleLowerCase())).size !== options.length) {
        Toast.error(`CÃ¢u há»i "${question.noiDung}" cáº§n Ã­t nháº¥t hai phÆ°Æ¡ng Ã¡n khÃ¡c nhau.`); return;
      }
    }
    surveyQuestions.push({ NoiDung: question.noiDung.trim(), LoaiCauHoi: question.loai, ThuTu: surveyQuestions.length + 1, BatBuoc: question.batBuoc, LuaChons: options });
  }
  if (!confirm('Táº¡o kháº£o sÃ¡t vÃ  phÃ¡t phiáº¿u cho khÃ¡ch hÃ ng cÃ³ tÃ i khoáº£n Ä‘ang hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng? KhÃ¡ch má»›i sáº½ nháº­n phiáº¿u khi kháº£o sÃ¡t Ä‘ang má»Ÿ.')) return;

  const button = document.querySelector('[onclick="publishSurvey()"]');
  button.disabled = true;
  try {
    const response = await Http.post(API.surveys, {
      MaQL: 0,
      TenKhaoSat: title,
      MoTa: description || null,
      NgayBatDau: start,
      NgayKetThuc: end,
      CauHois: surveyQuestions
    });
    if (!response?.Success) throw new Error(response?.Message || 'KhÃ´ng táº¡o Ä‘Æ°á»£c kháº£o sÃ¡t.');
    Toast.success(response.Message || 'ÄÃ£ táº¡o kháº£o sÃ¡t.');
    document.getElementById('tab-builder-btn').style.display = 'none';
    showTab('tab-list', document.querySelector('.tabs .tab-btn'));
    await loadSurveys();
  } catch (error) {
    Toast.error(error.message || 'KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ táº¡o kháº£o sÃ¡t.');
  } finally {
    button.disabled = false;
  }
}

async function closeSurvey(id) {
  if (!confirm('ÄÃ³ng kháº£o sÃ¡t nÃ y? KhÃ¡ch hÃ ng sáº½ khÃ´ng thá»ƒ ná»™p hoáº·c sá»­a cÃ¢u tráº£ lá»i.')) return;
  try {
    const response = await Http.post(`${API.surveys}/${id}/close`, {});
    if (!response?.Success) throw new Error(response?.Message || 'KhÃ´ng Ä‘Ã³ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c kháº£o sÃ¡t.');
    Toast.success(response.Message || 'ÄÃ£ Ä‘Ã³ng kháº£o sÃ¡t.');
    await loadSurveys();
  } catch (error) {
    Toast.error(error.message || 'KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ Ä‘Ã³ng kháº£o sÃ¡t.');
  }
}

loadSurveys();

if (Auth.isLoggedIn()) {
  const existingUser = Auth.getUser() || {};
  if (Auth.normalizeRole(existingUser.vaiTro ?? existingUser.VaiTro) === 'KhachHang' && existingUser.hasPreferences == null) {
    Http.get(`${API.customers}/me/preferences`).then(result => {
      Auth.login({ ...existingUser, hasPreferences: Boolean(result.Data?.HasPreferences) }, Auth.getToken());
      Auth.redirectByRole();
    }).catch(() => {});
  } else {
    Auth.redirectByRole();
  }
}

const loginReason = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('reason');
if (loginReason === 'locked') {
  document.getElementById('error-msg').textContent = 'TÃ i khoáº£n Ä‘Ã£ bá»‹ khÃ³a. Vui lÃ²ng liÃªn há»‡ bá»™ pháº­n há»— trá»£.';
  document.getElementById('error-alert').classList.add('show');
}

  const clearLoginFields = () => {
    document.getElementById('username').value = '';
    document.getElementById('password').value = '';

function clearErrors() {
  ['err-user','err-pass'].forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).textContent = '');
  ['username','password'].forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('error'));
  document.getElementById('error-alert').classList.remove('show');
}

function validate() {
  let ok = true;
  const u = document.getElementById('username').value.trim();
  const p = document.getElementById('password').value;
  clearErrors();

  if (!u || u.length < 4) {
    document.getElementById('err-user').textContent = 'TÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p pháº£i cÃ³ Ã­t nháº¥t 4 kÃ½ tá»±';
    document.getElementById('username').classList.add('error');
    ok = false;
  } else if (/\s/.test(u)) {
    document.getElementById('err-user').textContent = 'TÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p khÃ´ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c chá»©a khoáº£ng tráº¯ng';
    document.getElementById('username').classList.add('error');
    ok = false;
  }

  if (!p || p.length < 6) {
    document.getElementById('err-pass').textContent = 'Máº­t kháº©u pháº£i cÃ³ Ã­t nháº¥t 6 kÃ½ tá»±';
    document.getElementById('password').classList.add('error');
    ok = false;
  }

  return ok;
}

document.getElementById('login-form').addEventListener('submit', async e => {
  e.preventDefault();
  if (!validate()) return;

  const btn = document.getElementById('login-btn');
  const btnText = document.getElementById('btn-text');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('btn-spinner');
  const arrow = document.getElementById('btn-arrow');

  btn.disabled = true;
  btnText.textContent = 'Äang Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p...';
  spinner.style.display = 'inline-block';
  arrow.style.display = 'none';

  try {
    const body = {
      TenDangNhap: document.getElementById('username').value.trim(),
      MatKhau: document.getElementById('password').value,
    };

    const res = await Http.post(API.login, body);
    if (!res.Success) throw new Error(res.Message || 'ÄÄƒng nháº­p tháº¥t báº¡i.');

    const d = res.Data;
    Auth.login({
      maTK: d.MaTK,
      tenDangNhap: d.TenDangNhap,
      hoTen: d.HoTen,
      email: d.Email,
      vaiTro: d.VaiTro,
      hasPreferences: d.HasPreferences,
    }, d.Token);

    btnText.textContent = 'âœ“ ThÃ nh cÃ´ng!';
    btn.style.background = '#16a34a';
    btn.style.color = '#fff';
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
    Auth.redirectByRole();
  } catch (err) {
    const message = err instanceof TypeError
      ? `KhÃ´ng káº¿t ná»‘i Ä‘Æ°á»£c API táº¡i ${API_BASE}. HÃ£y cháº¡y run.bat vÃ  kiá»ƒm tra cá»­a sá»• Backend API cÃ³ nghe cá»•ng 5000.`
      : (err.message || 'ÄÄƒng nháº­p tháº¥t báº¡i. Vui lÃ²ng thá»­ láº¡i.');
    document.getElementById('error-msg').textContent = message;
    document.getElementById('error-alert').classList.add('show');
    document.getElementById('password').value = '';
    btn.disabled = false;
    btnText.textContent = 'ÄÄƒng nháº­p';
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
    arrow.style.display = 'inline';
  }
});

FILE: \Models\PasswordHelper.cs

namespace Fashion_store.Models;

public static class PasswordHelper
{
    public static bool VerifyAndUpgrade(TaiKhoan account, string providedPassword)
    {
        if (account.MatKhau.StartsWith("$2", StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            try { return BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.Verify(providedPassword, account.MatKhau); }
            catch { return false; }
        }

        if (!string.Equals(account.MatKhau, providedPassword, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            return false;

        account.MatKhau = BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.HashPassword(providedPassword);
        return true;
    }

    public static string Hash(string password) => BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.HashPassword(password);
}

FILE: \Services\ActiveCookieAccountMiddleware.cs
==================================================
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Text.Json;
using Fashion_store.Data;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.Cookies;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace Fashion_store.Services;

public sealed class ActiveCookieAccountMiddleware
{
    private readonly RequestDelegate _next;

    public ActiveCookieAccountMiddleware(RequestDelegate next) => _next = next;

    public async Task InvokeAsync(HttpContext context, FashionStoreDbContext db)
    {
        if (context.User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true)
        {
            var idValue = context.User.FindFirstValue(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier);
            var hasId = int.TryParse(idValue, out var accountId);
            var account = hasId
                ? await db.TaiKhoan.AsNoTracking()
                    .Include(item => item.QuanLy)
                    .Include(item => item.KhachHang)
                    .FirstOrDefaultAsync(item => item.MaTK == accountId)
                : null;

            var roleClaim = context.User.FindFirstValue("MaVaiTro");
            var roleMatches = int.TryParse(roleClaim, out var claimedRole)
                && account?.MaVaiTro == claimedRole;
            var profileIsActive = account is not null && (account.MaVaiTro switch
            {
                1 => account.QuanLy?.TrangThai == true,
                2 => account.KhachHang is { DaXoa: false },
                3 => true,
                _ => false
            });

            if (account is null || !account.TrangThai || !profileIsActive || !roleMatches)
            {
                var isLocked = account is not null
                    && (!account.TrangThai
                        || account.MaVaiTro == 1 && account.QuanLy?.TrangThai == false
                        || account.MaVaiTro == 2 && account.KhachHang?.DaXoa == true);
                var message = isLocked
                    ? "TÃ i khoáº£n Ä‘Ã£ bá»‹ khÃ³a hoáº·c khÃ´ng cÃ²n hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng."
                    : "PhiÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p khÃ´ng cÃ²n há»£p lá»‡. Vui lÃ²ng Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p láº¡i.";
                var isStaff = account?.MaVaiTro is 1 or 3
                    || context.User.IsInRole("Quáº£n lÃ½")
                    || context.User.IsInRole("Admin");

                context.Session.Clear();
                await context.SignOutAsync(CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme);
                context.User = new ClaimsPrincipal(new ClaimsIdentity());

                if (context.Request.Path.StartsWithSegments("/api"))
                {
                    context.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status401Unauthorized;
                    context.Response.ContentType = "application/json; charset=utf-8";
                    await context.Response.WriteAsync(JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { success = false, message }));
                    return;
                }

                var loginPath = isStaff ? "/Admin/Account/Login" : "/Account/Login";
                var query = isLocked ? "?locked=true" : string.Empty;
                context.Response.Redirect(loginPath + query);
                return;
            }
        }

        await _next(context);
    }
}

FILE: \Services\SurveyExcelReportBuilder.cs

using System.Globalization;
using System.IO.Compression;
using System.Text;
using System.Xml;
using System.Xml.Linq;
using Fashion_store.Models;

namespace Fashion_store.Services;

/// <summary>Creates a dependency-free XLSX report with native Excel column charts.</summary>
public static class SurveyExcelReportBuilder
{
    private static readonly XNamespace Main = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main";
    private static readonly XNamespace OfficeRel = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships";
    private static readonly XNamespace PackageRel = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships";
    private static readonly XNamespace ContentType = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types";
    private static readonly XNamespace Chart = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/chart";
    private static readonly XNamespace Drawing = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main";
    private static readonly XNamespace SheetDrawing = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/spreadsheetDrawing";

    public static byte[] Create(SurveyStatisticsViewModel report)
    {
        var sheets = new[] { CreateOverview(report), CreateResults(report) };
        var charts = sheets.SelectMany(sheet => sheet.Charts).ToList();
        for (var index = 0; index < charts.Count; index++) charts[index].ChartIndex = index + 1;
        using var output = new MemoryStream();
        using (var archive = new ZipArchive(output, ZipArchiveMode.Create, leaveOpen: true))
        {
            AddXml(archive, "[Content_Types].xml", ContentTypesXml(sheets, charts));
            AddXml(archive, "_rels/.rels", PackageRelationshipsXml());
            AddXml(archive, "xl/workbook.xml", WorkbookXml(sheets));
            AddXml(archive, "xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels", WorkbookRelationshipsXml(sheets));
            AddXml(archive, "xl/styles.xml", StylesXml());
            for (var index = 0; index < sheets.Length; index++)
            {
                var sheetNumber = index + 1;
                var sheet = sheets[index];
                AddXml(archive, $"xl/worksheets/sheet{sheetNumber}.xml", WorksheetXml(sheet));
                if (sheet.Charts.Count == 0) continue;
                AddXml(archive, $"xl/worksheets/_rels/sheet{sheetNumber}.xml.rels", WorksheetRelationshipsXml(sheetNumber));
                AddXml(archive, $"xl/drawings/drawing{sheetNumber}.xml", DrawingXml(sheet.Charts));
                AddXml(archive, $"xl/drawings/_rels/drawing{sheetNumber}.xml.rels", DrawingRelationshipsXml(sheet.Charts));
                foreach (var chart in sheet.Charts)
                    AddXml(archive, $"xl/charts/chart{chart.ChartIndex}.xml", ChartXml(sheet.Name, chart));
            }
        }
        return output.ToArray();
    }

    private static SheetData CreateOverview(SurveyStatisticsViewModel report)
    {
        var sheet = new SheetData("Tá»•ng quan");
        sheet.Text(1, 1, $"BÃ¡o cÃ¡o kháº£o sÃ¡t: {report.TenKhaoSat}", 1);
