        sheet.Text(4, 1, "Báº¯t Ä‘áº§u"); sheet.Date(4, 2, report.NgayBatDau);
        sheet.Text(5, 1, "Káº¿t thÃºc"); sheet.Date(5, 2, report.NgayKetThuc);
        sheet.Text(6, 1, "MÃ´ táº£"); sheet.Text(6, 2, report.MoTa ?? "", 4); sheet.Merge("B6:D6");
        sheet.Text(8, 1, "Tá»•ng quan phiáº¿u", 2); sheet.Text(8, 2, "Sá»‘ lÆ°á»£ng", 3); sheet.Merge("A8:B8");
        sheet.Text(9, 1, "ÄÃ£ hoÃ n thÃ nh", 4); sheet.Number(9, 2, report.SoPhieuHoanThanh, 7);
        sheet.Text(10, 1, "ChÆ°a hoÃ n thÃ nh", 4); sheet.Number(10, 2, Math.Max(0, report.TongSoPhieu - report.SoPhieuHoanThanh), 7);
        sheet.Text(12, 1, "Tá»· lá»‡ hoÃ n thÃ nh", 4); sheet.Number(12, 2, report.TyLeHoanThanh / 100, 5);
        sheet.Text(13, 1, "Sá»‘ cÃ¢u há»i", 4); sheet.Number(13, 2, report.CauHoi.Count, 7);
        sheet.Text(15, 1, "Tá»· lá»‡ lá»±a chá»n tÃ­nh trÃªn sá»‘ ngÆ°á»i tráº£ lá»i cÃ¢u há»i; cÃ¢u nhiá»u lá»±a chá»n cÃ³ thá»ƒ cÃ³ tá»•ng tá»· lá»‡ trÃªn 100%.", 4);
        sheet.Merge("A15:D15");
        sheet.Charts.Add(new ChartData
        {
            Title = "TÃ¬nh tráº¡ng hoÃ n thÃ nh kháº£o sÃ¡t", SeriesName = "Sá»‘ phiáº¿u",
            HeaderRow = 8, DataStartRow = 9, DataEndRow = 10,
            Labels = new[] { "ÄÃ£ hoÃ n thÃ nh", "ChÆ°a hoÃ n thÃ nh" },
            Values = new[] { (double)report.SoPhieuHoanThanh, (double)Math.Max(0, report.TongSoPhieu - report.SoPhieuHoanThanh) },
            AnchorRow = 1, AnchorColumn = 4
        });
        return sheet;
    }

    private static SheetData CreateResults(SurveyStatisticsViewModel report)
    {
        var sheet = new SheetData("Káº¿t quáº£");
        sheet.Text(1, 1, $"Káº¿t quáº£ kháº£o sÃ¡t: {report.TenKhaoSat}", 1);
        sheet.Merge("A1:D1");
        sheet.Text(2, 1, "Tá»•ng há»£p tá»« cÃ¡c phiáº¿u Ä‘Ã£ hoÃ n thÃ nh trong SQL Server.", 4);
        sheet.Merge("A2:D2");
        var row = 4;
        foreach (var question in report.CauHoi.OrderBy(item => item.ThuTu))
        {
            var titleRow = row;
            sheet.Text(titleRow, 1, $"CÃ¢u {question.ThuTu}: {question.NoiDung}", 2);
            sheet.Merge($"A{titleRow}:C{titleRow}");
            sheet.Text(titleRow + 1, 1, $"Loáº¡i cÃ¢u há»i: {question.LoaiCauHoi}", 4);
            sheet.Text(titleRow + 1, 2, "Sá»‘ ngÆ°á»i tráº£ lá»i:", 4);
            sheet.Number(titleRow + 1, 3, question.SoNguoiTraLoi, 7);

            if (question.LoaiCauHoi == "Tá»± luáº­n")
            {
                var header = titleRow + 3;
                sheet.Text(header, 1, "MÃ£ phiáº¿u", 3);
                sheet.Text(header, 2, "NgÃ y ná»™p", 3);
                sheet.Text(header, 3, "CÃ¢u tráº£ lá»i", 3);
                if (question.TraLoiTuLuan.Count == 0)
                {
                    sheet.Text(header + 1, 1, "ChÆ°a cÃ³ cÃ¢u tráº£ lá»i tá»± luáº­n.", 4);
                    row = header + 3;
                    continue;
                }
                var answerRow = header + 1;
                foreach (var answer in question.TraLoiTuLuan)
                {
                    sheet.Number(answerRow, 1, answer.MaPhieuKS, 7);
                    if (answer.NgayNop.HasValue) sheet.Date(answerRow, 2, answer.NgayNop.Value);
                    sheet.Text(answerRow, 3, answer.NoiDung, 4);
                    answerRow++;
                }
                row = answerRow + 2;
                continue;
            }

            if (question.LoaiCauHoi == "ÄÃ¡nh giÃ¡ sao")
            {
                sheet.Text(titleRow + 2, 1, "Äiá»ƒm trung bÃ¬nh", 4);
                if (question.DiemTrungBinh.HasValue) sheet.Number(titleRow + 2, 2, question.DiemTrungBinh.Value, 7);
            }
            var headerRow = titleRow + (question.LoaiCauHoi == "ÄÃ¡nh giÃ¡ sao" ? 4 : 3);
            sheet.Text(headerRow, 1, question.LoaiCauHoi == "ÄÃ¡nh giÃ¡ sao" ? "Má»©c sao" : "PhÆ°Æ¡ng Ã¡n", 3);
            sheet.Text(headerRow, 2, "Sá»‘ lÆ°á»£t chá»n", 3);
            sheet.Text(headerRow, 3, "Tá»· lá»‡", 3);
            var firstDataRow = headerRow + 1;
            var lastDataRow = firstDataRow + question.LuaChons.Count - 1;
            for (var index = 0; index < question.LuaChons.Count; index++)
            {
                var option = question.LuaChons[index];
                var dataRow = firstDataRow + index;
                sheet.Text(dataRow, 1, option.NoiDung, 4);
                sheet.Number(dataRow, 2, option.SoLuotChon, 7);
                sheet.Number(dataRow, 3, option.TyLe / 100, 5);
            }
            if (question.LuaChons.Count > 0)
            {
                sheet.Charts.Add(new ChartData
                {
                    Title = question.LoaiCauHoi == "ÄÃ¡nh giÃ¡ sao" ? $"PhÃ¢n bá»‘ sao - CÃ¢u {question.ThuTu}" : $"LÆ°á»£t chá»n - CÃ¢u {question.ThuTu}",
                    SeriesName = "Sá»‘ lÆ°á»£t chá»n", HeaderRow = headerRow,
                    DataStartRow = firstDataRow, DataEndRow = lastDataRow,
                    Labels = question.LuaChons.Select(option => option.NoiDung).ToArray(),
                    Values = question.LuaChons.Select(option => (double)option.SoLuotChon).ToArray(),
                    AnchorRow = titleRow - 1, AnchorColumn = 4
                });
            }
            row = Math.Max(lastDataRow + 2, titleRow + 17);
        }
        return sheet;
    }

    private static XDocument ContentTypesXml(IReadOnlyList<SheetData> sheets, IReadOnlyList<ChartData> charts)
    {

            new XElement(ContentType + "Default", new XAttribute("Extension", "rels"), new XAttribute("ContentType", "application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml")),
            new XElement(ContentType + "Default", new XAttribute("Extension", "xml"), new XAttribute("ContentType", "application/xml")),
            new XElement(ContentType + "Override", new XAttribute("PartName", "/xl/workbook.xml"), new XAttribute("ContentType", "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet.main+xml")),
            new XElement(ContentType + "Override", new XAttribute("PartName", "/xl/styles.xml"), new XAttribute("ContentType", "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.styles+xml")));
        for (var index = 0; index < sheets.Count; index++)
        {
            root.Add(new XElement(ContentType + "Override", new XAttribute("PartName", $"/xl/worksheets/sheet{index + 1}.xml"), new XAttribute("ContentType", "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.worksheet+xml")));
            if (sheets[index].Charts.Count > 0)
                root.Add(new XElement(ContentType + "Override", new XAttribute("PartName", $"/xl/drawings/drawing{index + 1}.xml"), new XAttribute("ContentType", "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.drawing+xml")));
        }
        foreach (var chart in charts)
            root.Add(new XElement(ContentType + "Override", new XAttribute("PartName", $"/xl/charts/chart{chart.ChartIndex}.xml"), new XAttribute("ContentType", "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.drawingml.chart+xml")));
        return new XDocument(new XDeclaration("1.0", "UTF-8", "yes"), root);
    }

    private static XDocument WorksheetXml(SheetData sheet)
    {
        var maxRow = Math.Max(1, sheet.Cells.Keys.DefaultIfEmpty(1).Max());
        var maxColumn = Math.Max(4, sheet.Cells.Values.SelectMany(row => row.Keys).DefaultIfEmpty(1).Max());
        var sheetData = new XElement(Main + "sheetData");
        foreach (var row in sheet.Cells)
        {
            var rowElement = new XElement(Main + "row", new XAttribute("r", row.Key));
            foreach (var cell in row.Value)
            {
                var cellElement = new XElement(Main + "c", new XAttribute("r", $"{ColumnName(cell.Key)}{row.Key}"));
                if (cell.Value.Style > 0) cellElement.Add(new XAttribute("s", cell.Value.Style));
                if (cell.Value.Number.HasValue)
                    cellElement.Add(new XElement(Main + "v", cell.Value.Number.Value.ToString("G17", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
                else
                {
                    cellElement.Add(new XAttribute("t", "inlineStr"));
                    cellElement.Add(new XElement(Main + "is",
                        new XElement(Main + "t", new XAttribute(XNamespace.Xml + "space", "preserve"), CleanXml(cell.Value.Text ?? ""))));
                }
                rowElement.Add(cellElement);
            }
            sheetData.Add(rowElement);
        }

        var children = new List<object>
        {
            new XElement(Main + "dimension", new XAttribute("ref", $"A1:{ColumnName(maxColumn)}{maxRow}")),
            new XElement(Main + "sheetViews", new XElement(Main + "sheetView", new XAttribute("workbookViewId", 0))),
            new XElement(Main + "sheetFormatPr", new XAttribute("defaultRowHeight", 18)),
            new XElement(Main + "cols",
                new XElement(Main + "col", new XAttribute("min", 1), new XAttribute("max", 1), new XAttribute("width", 42), new XAttribute("customWidth", 1)),
                new XElement(Main + "col", new XAttribute("min", 2), new XAttribute("max", 2), new XAttribute("width", 20), new XAttribute("customWidth", 1)),
                new XElement(Main + "col", new XAttribute("min", 3), new XAttribute("max", 3), new XAttribute("width", 64), new XAttribute("customWidth", 1)),
                new XElement(Main + "col", new XAttribute("min", 4), new XAttribute("max", 4), new XAttribute("width", 18), new XAttribute("customWidth", 1)),
                new XElement(Main + "col", new XAttribute("min", 5), new XAttribute("max", 12), new XAttribute("width", 12), new XAttribute("customWidth", 1))),
            sheetData
        };
        if (sheet.Merged.Count > 0)
            children.Add(new XElement(Main + "mergeCells", new XAttribute("count", sheet.Merged.Count), sheet.Merged.Select(reference => new XElement(Main + "mergeCell", new XAttribute("ref", reference)))));
        if (sheet.Charts.Count > 0) children.Add(new XElement(Main + "drawing", new XAttribute(OfficeRel + "id", "rId1")));
        return new XDocument(new XDeclaration("1.0", "UTF-8", "yes"),
            new XElement(Main + "worksheet", new XAttribute(XNamespace.Xmlns + "r", OfficeRel), children));
    }

    private static XElement Format(uint numberFormat, int font, int fill, int border, params XAttribute[] alignment)
    {

            new XAttribute("numFmtId", numberFormat), new XAttribute("fontId", font),
            new XAttribute("fillId", fill), new XAttribute("borderId", border),
            new XAttribute("xfId", 0), new XAttribute("applyFont", 1),
            new XAttribute("applyFill", 1), new XAttribute("applyBorder", 1));
        if (numberFormat != 0) element.Add(new XAttribute("applyNumberFormat", 1));
        if (alignment.Length > 0)
        {
            element.Add(new XAttribute("applyAlignment", 1));
            element.Add(new XElement(Main + "alignment", alignment));
        }
        return element;
    }

    private static XDocument ChartXml(string sheetName, ChartData chart)
    {
        var axisId = 48650112u + (uint)(chart.ChartIndex * 2);
        var valueAxisId = axisId + 1;
        var sheet = $"'{sheetName.Replace("'", "''", StringComparison.Ordinal)}'";
        var seriesNameFormula = $"{sheet}!$B${chart.HeaderRow}";
        var categoryFormula = $"{sheet}!$A${chart.DataStartRow}:$A${chart.DataEndRow}";
        var valueFormula = $"{sheet}!$B${chart.DataStartRow}:$B${chart.DataEndRow}";
        var series = new XElement(Chart + "ser",
            new XElement(Chart + "idx", new XAttribute("val", 0)),
            new XElement(Chart + "order", new XAttribute("val", 0)),
            new XElement(Chart + "tx", new XElement(Chart + "strRef", new XElement(Chart + "f", seriesNameFormula),
                new XElement(Chart + "strCache", new XElement(Chart + "ptCount", new XAttribute("val", 1)),
                    new XElement(Chart + "pt", new XAttribute("idx", 0), new XElement(Chart + "v", CleanXml(chart.SeriesName)))))),
            new XElement(Chart + "cat", new XElement(Chart + "strRef", new XElement(Chart + "f", categoryFormula), StringCache(chart.Labels))),
            new XElement(Chart + "val", new XElement(Chart + "numRef", new XElement(Chart + "f", valueFormula), NumberCache(chart.Values))));
        var title = new XElement(Chart + "title",
            new XElement(Chart + "tx", new XElement(Chart + "rich",
                new XElement(Drawing + "bodyPr"), new XElement(Drawing + "lstStyle"),
                new XElement(Drawing + "p",
                    new XElement(Drawing + "pPr", new XElement(Drawing + "defRPr", new XAttribute("lang", "vi-VN"))),
                    new XElement(Drawing + "r", new XElement(Drawing + "rPr", new XAttribute("lang", "vi-VN"), new XAttribute("sz", 1300), new XAttribute("b", 1)),
                        new XElement(Drawing + "t", CleanXml(chart.Title))),
                    new XElement(Drawing + "endParaRPr", new XAttribute("lang", "vi-VN"))))),
            new XElement(Chart + "overlay", new XAttribute("val", 0)));
        var bar = new XElement(Chart + "barChart",
            new XElement(Chart + "barDir", new XAttribute("val", "col")),
            new XElement(Chart + "grouping", new XAttribute("val", "clustered")),
            new XElement(Chart + "varyColors", new XAttribute("val", 0)), series,
            new XElement(Chart + "gapWidth", new XAttribute("val", 80)),
            new XElement(Chart + "axId", new XAttribute("val", axisId)),
            new XElement(Chart + "axId", new XAttribute("val", valueAxisId)));
        var categoryAxis = new XElement(Chart + "catAx",
            new XElement(Chart + "axId", new XAttribute("val", axisId)),
            new XElement(Chart + "scaling", new XElement(Chart + "orientation", new XAttribute("val", "minMax"))),
            new XElement(Chart + "delete", new XAttribute("val", 0)), new XElement(Chart + "axPos", new XAttribute("val", "b")),
            new XElement(Chart + "tickLblPos", new XAttribute("val", "nextTo")),
            new XElement(Chart + "crossAx", new XAttribute("val", valueAxisId)), new XElement(Chart + "crosses", new XAttribute("val", "autoZero")),
            new XElement(Chart + "auto", new XAttribute("val", 1)), new XElement(Chart + "lblAlgn", new XAttribute("val", "ctr")),
            new XElement(Chart + "lblOffset", new XAttribute("val", 100)));
        var valueAxis = new XElement(Chart + "valAx",
            new XElement(Chart + "axId", new XAttribute("val", valueAxisId)),
            new XElement(Chart + "scaling", new XElement(Chart + "orientation", new XAttribute("val", "minMax"))),
            new XElement(Chart + "delete", new XAttribute("val", 0)), new XElement(Chart + "axPos", new XAttribute("val", "l")),
            new XElement(Chart + "majorGridlines", new XElement(Chart + "spPr", new XElement(Drawing + "ln", new XAttribute("w", 9525),
                new XElement(Drawing + "solidFill", new XElement(Drawing + "srgbClr", new XAttribute("val", "D9E2F3")))))),
            new XElement(Chart + "numFmt", new XAttribute("formatCode", "0"), new XAttribute("sourceLinked", 1)),
            new XElement(Chart + "tickLblPos", new XAttribute("val", "nextTo")),
            new XElement(Chart + "crossAx", new XAttribute("val", axisId)), new XElement(Chart + "crosses", new XAttribute("val", "autoZero")),
            new XElement(Chart + "crossBetween", new XAttribute("val", "between")));
        return new XDocument(new XDeclaration("1.0", "UTF-8", "yes"),
            new XElement(Chart + "chartSpace", new XAttribute(XNamespace.Xmlns + "a", Drawing),
                new XElement(Chart + "lang", new XAttribute("val", "vi-VN")), new XElement(Chart + "style", new XAttribute("val", 10)),

                    new XElement(Chart + "plotArea", new XElement(Chart + "layout"), bar, categoryAxis, valueAxis),

                    new XElement(Chart + "plotVisOnly", new XAttribute("val", 1)),

    private static XElement StringCache(IReadOnlyList<string> values) => new(Chart + "strCache",
        new XElement(Chart + "ptCount", new XAttribute("val", values.Count)),
        values.Select((value, index) => new XElement(Chart + "pt", new XAttribute("idx", index), new XElement(Chart + "v", CleanXml(value)))));

    private static XElement NumberCache(IReadOnlyList<double> values) => new(Chart + "numCache",
        new XElement(Chart + "formatCode", "General"), new XElement(Chart + "ptCount", new XAttribute("val", values.Count)),
        values.Select((value, index) => new XElement(Chart + "pt", new XAttribute("idx", index),
            new XElement(Chart + "v", value.ToString("G17", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)))));

    private static void AddXml(ZipArchive archive, string path, XDocument document)
    {
        var entry = archive.CreateEntry(path, CompressionLevel.Optimal);
        using var stream = entry.Open();
        using var writer = XmlWriter.Create(stream, new XmlWriterSettings { Encoding = new UTF8Encoding(false), Indent = false });
        document.Save(writer);
    }

    private static string ColumnName(int column)
    {
        var result = "";
        while (column > 0) { column--; result = (char)('A' + column % 26) + result; column /= 26; }
        return result;
    }

    private static string CleanXml(string value) => string.Concat(value.Where(XmlConvert.IsXmlChar));
    private static double ExcelSerial(DateTime date) => (date - new DateTime(1899, 12, 30)).TotalDays;

    private sealed class SheetData(string name)
    {
        public string Name { get; } = name;
        public SortedDictionary<int, SortedDictionary<int, CellData>> Cells { get; } = new();
        public List<string> Merged { get; } = new();
        public List<ChartData> Charts { get; } = new();
        public void Text(int row, int column, string value, int style = 0) => Set(row, column, new CellData(CleanXml(value), null, style));
        public void Number(int row, int column, double value, int style = 0) => Set(row, column, new CellData(null, value, style));
        public void Date(int row, int column, DateTime date) => Number(row, column, ExcelSerial(date), 6);
        public void Merge(string range) => Merged.Add(range);
        private void Set(int row, int column, CellData cell)
        {
            if (!Cells.TryGetValue(row, out var rowCells)) Cells[row] = rowCells = new SortedDictionary<int, CellData>();
            rowCells[column] = cell;
        }
    }

    private sealed record CellData(string? Text, double? Number, int Style);
    private sealed class ChartData
    {
        public int ChartIndex { get; set; }
        public string Title { get; init; } = "";
        public string SeriesName { get; init; } = "";
        public int HeaderRow { get; init; }
        public int DataStartRow { get; init; }
        public int DataEndRow { get; init; }
        public IReadOnlyList<string> Labels { get; init; } = Array.Empty<string>();
        public IReadOnlyList<double> Values { get; init; } = Array.Empty<double>();
        public int AnchorRow { get; init; }
        public int AnchorColumn { get; init; }
    }
}

using Fashion_store.Data;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace Fashion_store.Services;

public sealed class SurveyExpirationService : BackgroundService
{
    private static readonly TimeSpan CheckInterval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30);
    private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopeFactory;
    private readonly ILogger<SurveyExpirationService> _logger;

    public SurveyExpirationService(IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory, ILogger<SurveyExpirationService> logger)
    {
        _scopeFactory = scopeFactory;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public static Task<int> CloseExpiredSurveysAsync(
        FashionStoreDbContext context,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var now = DateTime.Now;
        return context.KhaoSat
            .Where(survey => survey.TrangThai && survey.NgayKetThuc < now)
            .ExecuteUpdateAsync(update => update.SetProperty(survey => survey.TrangThai, false), cancellationToken);
    }

    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        using var timer = new PeriodicTimer(CheckInterval);
        do
        {
            try
            {
                await using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();
                var context = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<FashionStoreDbContext>();
                var closedCount = await CloseExpiredSurveysAsync(context, stoppingToken);
                if (closedCount > 0)
                    _logger.LogInformation("Automatically closed {SurveyCount} expired surveys.", closedCount);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) when (stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                break;
            }
            catch (Exception exception)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning(exception, "Could not close expired surveys; will retry at the next interval.");
            }
        }
        while (await timer.WaitForNextTickAsync(stoppingToken));
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using Fashion_store.Models;

namespace Fashion_store.ViewModels
{
    // ViewModel hiá»ƒn thá»‹ má»™t dÃ²ng sáº£n pháº©m Ã¡o trÃªn báº£ng
    public class ProductItemViewModel
    {
        public int MaSP { get; set; }
        public string TenSP { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public int MaDM { get; set; }
        public string TenDanhMuc { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string? ChatLieu { get; set; }
        public string? MoTa { get; set; }
        public string? HinhAnh { get; set; }
        public string? HinhAnhMoTa { get; set; }
        public bool TrangThai { get; set; }
        public DateTime NgayTao { get; set; }

        public List<SoLuongSp> BienThes { get; set; } = new List<SoLuongSp>();

        public int TongTonKho => BienThes.Sum(b => b.SoLuongTon);
        public decimal GiaMin => BienThes.Any() ? BienThes.Min(b => b.GiaBan) : 0;
        public decimal GiaMax => BienThes.Any() ? BienThes.Max(b => b.GiaBan) : 0;
        public List<string> KichThuocs => BienThes.Select(b => b.KichThuoc).Distinct().ToList();
        public List<string> MauSacs => BienThes.Select(b => b.MauSac).Distinct().ToList();
        public string? HinhAnhDaiDien => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(HinhAnh)
            ? HinhAnh
            : BienThes.FirstOrDefault(b => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(b.HinhAnh))?.HinhAnh;
    }

        function switchTab(tab) {
            const loginBtn = document.getElementById('tabLoginBtn');
            const regBtn = document.getElementById('tabRegisterBtn');
            const loginPanel = document.getElementById('loginTabPanel');
            const regPanel = document.getElementById('registerTabPanel');

            if (tab === 'login') {
                loginBtn.classList.add('active');
                regBtn.classList.remove('active');
                loginPanel.classList.add('active');
                regPanel.classList.remove('active');
            } else {
                regBtn.classList.add('active');
                loginBtn.classList.remove('active');
                regPanel.classList.add('active');
                loginPanel.classList.remove('active');
            }
        }

    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.2/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
    <script>
        Chart.defaults.color = '#475569';
        Chart.defaults.borderColor = 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.1)';

        // =========================================================================
        // HÃ€M SINH MÃ€U RANDOM PHÃ‚N BIá»†T RÃ• RÃ€NG
        // - Dá»±a vÃ o Ä‘Ãºng sá»‘ lÆ°á»£ng danh má»¥c (count)
        // - KhÃ´ng dÃ¹ng danh sÃ¡ch mÃ u cá»‘ Ä‘á»‹nh
        // - Chia Ä‘á»u gÃ³c xoay HSL 360 Ä‘á»™ kÃ¨m random Ä‘iá»ƒm báº¯t Ä‘áº§u -> mÃ u vá»«a Ä‘a dáº¡ng,
        //   vá»«a rá»±c rá»¡ vÃ  tÃ¡ch báº¡ch rÃµ rá»‡t trÃªn ná»n Ä‘en
        // =========================================================================
        function generateDistinctRandomColors(count) {
            const colors = [];
            const randomStartHue = Math.floor(Math.random() * 360);
            const step = 360 / Math.max(count, 1);

            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                const hue = Math.round((randomStartHue + i * step) % 360);
                colors.push(`hsl(${hue}, 80%, 60%)`);
            }
            return colors;
        }

        // Dá»¯ liá»‡u tá»« Controller
        const ageLabelsData = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(ageLabels));
        const agePercentsData = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(agePercents));

        const styleLabelsData = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(styleLabels));
        const stylePercentsData = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(stylePercents));

        // 1. Biá»ƒu Ä‘á»“ trÃ²n Äá»™ Tuá»•i
        const ageChartCanvas = document.getElementById('chartAge');
        if (ageChartCanvas) new Chart(ageChartCanvas.getContext('2d'), {
            type: 'doughnut',
            data: {
                labels: ageLabelsData,
                datasets: [{
                    data: agePercentsData,
                    backgroundColor: generateDistinctRandomColors(ageLabelsData.length),
                    borderWidth: 2,
                    borderColor: '#ffffff'

    <script>
        let questionIndex = 0;

        // HÃ m thÃªm card cÃ¢u há»i (ÄÃºng giao diá»‡n áº£nh 1)
        function addQuestionCard(defaultType = "Má»™t lá»±a chá»n") {
            questionIndex++;
            const qId = questionIndex;
            const container = document.getElementById('questions-wrapper');

            const card = document.createElement('div');
            card.className = 'question-card shadow-sm';
            card.id = `q-card-${qId}`;

            const optionsHtml = '';

            card.innerHTML = `
                <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-2">
                    <span class="fw-bold text-dark fs-6">CÃ¢u há»i ${qId}</span>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-delete-q" onclick="removeQuestionCard('q-card-${qId}')">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can me-1"></i> XÃ³a
                    </button>
                </div>

                <div class="row g-2 mb-3">
                    <div class="col-md-9">
                        <input type="text" class="form-control q-content" id="q-content-${qId}" maxlength="1000" placeholder="Nháº­p ná»™i dung cÃ¢u há»i..." required />
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-md-3">
                        <select class="form-select q-type" id="q-type-${qId}" onchange="changeQuestionType(${qId}, this.value)">
                            <option value="Má»™t lá»±a chá»n" ${defaultType === 'Má»™t lá»±a chá»n' ? 'selected' : ''}>Tráº¯c nghiá»‡m 1 lá»±a chá»n</option>
                            <option value="Nhiá»u lá»±a chá»n" ${defaultType === 'Nhiá»u lá»±a chá»n' ? 'selected' : ''}>Tráº¯c nghiá»‡m nhiá»u lá»±a chá»n</option>
                            <option value="Tá»± luáº­n" ${defaultType === 'Tá»± luáº­n' ? 'selected' : ''}>Ã kiáº¿n Ä‘Ã³ng gÃ³p (Tá»± luáº­n)</option>
                            <option value="ÄÃ¡nh giÃ¡ sao" ${defaultType === 'ÄÃ¡nh giÃ¡ sao' ? 'selected' : ''}>Thang Ä‘iá»ƒm ÄÃ¡nh giÃ¡ sao (1-5)</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div id="options-block-${qId}">
                    <div class="small fw-semibold text-secondary mb-2">CÃ¡c phÆ°Æ¡ng Ã¡n lá»±a chá»n:</div>
                    <div id="options-container-${qId}">
                        ${optionsHtml}
                    </div>
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm mt-2 fw-semibold" onclick="addOptionRow(${qId})">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-plus me-1"></i> ThÃªm lá»±a chá»n
                    </button>
                </div>
            `;

            container.appendChild(card);
            changeQuestionType(qId, defaultType);
        }

        // XÃ³a cÃ¢u há»i
        function removeQuestionCard(cardId) {
            const card = document.getElementById(cardId);
            if (card) card.remove();
        }

        // ThÃªm lá»±a chá»n cho cÃ¢u há»i
        function addOptionRow(qId) {
            const container = document.getElementById(`options-container-${qId}`);
            const count = container.children.length + 1;
            const rowId = `opt-row-${qId}-${count}`;

            const row = document.createElement('div');
            row.className = 'option-row';
            row.id = rowId;
            row.innerHTML = `
                <i class="fa-regular fa-circle-dot text-secondary"></i>
                <input type="text" class="form-control form-control-sm opt-val-${qId}" placeholder="Nháº­p Ä‘Ã¡p Ã¡n lá»±a chá»n..." />
                <button type="button" class="btn-remove-opt" onclick="removeOptionRow('${rowId}')">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i>
                </button>
            `;
            container.appendChild(row);
        }

        // XÃ³a lá»±a chá»n
        function removeOptionRow(rowId) {
            const row = document.getElementById(rowId);
            if (row) row.remove();
        }

        // Äá»•i loáº¡i cÃ¢u há»i: náº¿u chá»n Tá»± luáº­n hoáº·c ÄÃ¡nh giÃ¡ sao thÃ¬ áº©n lá»±a chá»n
        function changeQuestionType(qId, val) {
            const optBlock = document.getElementById(`options-block-${qId}`);
            if (val === 'Tá»± luáº­n' || val === 'ÄÃ¡nh giÃ¡ sao') {
                optBlock.style.display = 'none';
            } else {
                optBlock.style.display = 'block';
            }
        }

        // Gá»­i toÃ n bá»™ dá»¯ liá»‡u kháº£o sÃ¡t lÃªn Backend C#
        function submitCreateSurvey() {
            const title = document.getElementById('survey-title').value.trim();
            const desc = document.getElementById('survey-desc').value.trim();
            const start = document.getElementById('survey-start').value;
            const end = document.getElementById('survey-end').value;

            if (!title) {
                alert("Vui lÃ²ng nháº­p tÃªn bÃ i kháº£o sÃ¡t!");
                return;
            }

            if (!start || !end || new Date(end) <= new Date(start) || new Date(start) < new Date()) {
                alert("HÃ£y chá»n thá»i gian báº¯t Ä‘áº§u tá»« hiá»‡n táº¡i trá»Ÿ Ä‘i vÃ  thá»i gian káº¿t thÃºc sau thá»i Ä‘iá»ƒm báº¯t Ä‘áº§u.");
                return;
            }

            const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.question-card');
            if (cards.length === 0) {
                alert("BÃ i kháº£o sÃ¡t pháº£i cÃ³ Ã­t nháº¥t 1 cÃ¢u há»i!");
                return;
            }

            const questions = [];
            for (const card of cards) {
                const qContent = card.querySelector('.q-content').value.trim();
                const qType = card.querySelector('.q-type').value;
                const optInputs = card.querySelectorAll(`input[class*="opt-val-"]`);
                const options = [];
                optInputs.forEach(input => {
                    if (input.value.trim()) options.push(input.value.trim());
                });

                if (!qContent) {
                    alert("Vui lÃ²ng nháº­p ná»™i dung cho táº¥t cáº£ cÃ¢u há»i.");
                    return;
                }
                if ((qType === 'Má»™t lá»±a chá»n' || qType === 'Nhiá»u lá»±a chá»n') && options.length < 2) {
                    alert(`CÃ¢u há»i "${qContent}" cáº§n Ã­t nháº¥t 2 phÆ°Æ¡ng Ã¡n.`);
                    return;
                }

                questions.push({ noiDung: qContent, loaiCauHoi: qType, options });
            }

            if (!confirm("XÃ¡c nháº­n táº¡o kháº£o sÃ¡t vÃ  cáº¥p phiáº¿u cho cÃ¡c tÃ i khoáº£n khÃ¡ch hÃ ng Ä‘ang hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng? Kháº£o sÃ¡t sáº½ má»Ÿ vÃ o thá»i gian báº¯t Ä‘áº§u Ä‘Ã£ chá»n.")) return;

            const payload = {
                tenKhaoSat: title,
                moTa: desc,
                ngayBatDau: start,
                ngayKetThuc: end,
                questions: questions
            };

            // Gá»i backend lÆ°u dá»¯ liá»‡u vÃ  cáº¥p phiáº¿u kháº£o sÃ¡t.
            fetch('/Admin/Survey/CreateSurveyApi', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'RequestVerificationToken': document.querySelector('#surveyCreateAntiForgeryForm input[name="__RequestVerificationToken"]').value
                },
                body: JSON.stringify(payload)
            })
            .then(res => res.json())
            .then(data => {
                if (data.success) {
                    alert(data.message);
                    window.location.reload();
                } else {
                    alert("Lá»—i: " + data.message);
                }
            })
            .catch(err => {
                alert("Lá»—i káº¿t ná»‘i mÃ¡y chá»§: " + err);
            });
        }

        // Lá»c báº£ng pháº£n há»“i theo Tá»« khÃ³a, Tráº¡ng thÃ¡i VÃ€ Sá»‘ sao â­
        function filterFeedbackTable() {
            const normalize = value => String(value || '').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').replace(/Ä‘/g, 'd').replace(/Ä/g, 'D').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
            const keyword = normalize(document.getElementById('feedback-search').value);
            const statusFilter = document.getElementById('filter-status').value;
            const ratingFilter = document.getElementById('filter-rating').value;
            const rows = document.querySelectorAll('#feedback-table tbody tr');

            rows.forEach(row => {
                const content = normalize(row.getAttribute('data-content'));
                const status = row.getAttribute('data-status');
                const ratingValue = (row.getAttribute('data-rating') || '').trim();
                const rating = ratingValue ? Number.parseInt(ratingValue, 10) : null;

                const matchKeyword = !keyword || content.includes(keyword);
                
                let matchStatus = (statusFilter === 'ALL' || status === statusFilter);

                let matchRating = true;
                if (ratingFilter === '5') matchRating = (rating === 5);
                else if (ratingFilter === '4') matchRating = (rating === 4);
                else if (ratingFilter === '3') matchRating = (rating === 3);
                else if (ratingFilter === '1-2') matchRating = (rating !== null && rating <= 2);
                else if (ratingFilter === 'UNRATED') matchRating = (rating === null);

                if (matchKeyword && matchStatus && matchRating) {
                    row.style.display = '';
                } else {
                    row.style.display = 'none';
                }
            });
        }

<script>
    // Xá»­ lÃ½ chá»n sá»‘ sao
    function setRating(qId, stars) {
        document.getElementById('rating_input_' + qId).value = stars;
        const starBox = document.getElementById('star_box_' + qId);
        starBox.setAttribute('data-rating', stars);

        const starIcons = starBox.querySelectorAll('i');
        starIcons.forEach(icon => {
            const starVal = parseInt(icon.getAttribute('data-star'));
            if (starVal <= stars) {
                icon.classList.add('active');
            } else {
                icon.classList.remove('active');
            }
        });

        const textDesc = document.getElementById('rating_text_' + qId);
        const descriptions = ['', 'Ráº¥t khÃ´ng hÃ i lÃ²ng (1 sao)', 'KhÃ´ng hÃ i lÃ²ng (2 sao)', 'BÃ¬nh thÆ°á»ng (3 sao)', 'HÃ i lÃ²ng (4 sao)', 'Ráº¥t hÃ i lÃ²ng (5 sao)'];
        textDesc.innerText = descriptions[stars] || '';
    }

    // Xá»­ lÃ½ gá»­i bÃ i kháº£o sÃ¡t qua AJAX
    async function submitSurvey() {
        const maPhieuKS = parseInt(document.getElementById('maPhieuKS').value);
        const questionCards = document.querySelectorAll('.question-card');
        const answers = [];

        // Duyá»‡t tá»«ng cÃ¢u há»i Ä‘á»ƒ láº¥y dá»¯ liá»‡u vÃ  kiá»ƒm tra báº¯t buá»™c
        for (const card of questionCards) {
            const qid = parseInt(card.getAttribute('data-qid'));
            const qtype = card.getAttribute('data-qtype');
            const isRequired = card.getAttribute('data-required') === 'true';

            if (qtype === 'Má»™t lá»±a chá»n') {
                const checked = card.querySelector(`input[name="radio_${qid}"]:checked`);
                if (isRequired && !checked) {
                    Swal.fire('ChÃº Ã½', 'Vui lÃ²ng chá»n cÃ¢u tráº£ lá»i cho cÃ¢u há»i báº¯t buá»™c!', 'warning');
                    card.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
                    return;
                }
                if (checked) {
                    answers.push({
                        maCauHoi: qid,
                        loaiCauHoi: qtype,
                        maLuaChon: parseInt(checked.value)
                    });
                }
            } 
            else if (qtype === 'Nhiá»u lá»±a chá»n') {
                const checkedList = card.querySelectorAll(`input[name="chk_${qid}"]:checked`);
                if (isRequired && checkedList.length === 0) {
                    Swal.fire('ChÃº Ã½', 'Vui lÃ²ng chá»n Ã­t nháº¥t 1 phÆ°Æ¡ng Ã¡n cho cÃ¢u há»i báº¯t buá»™c!', 'warning');
                    card.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
                    return;
                }
                if (checkedList.length > 0) {
                    const ids = [];
                    checkedList.forEach(c => ids.push(parseInt(c.value)));
                    answers.push({
                        maCauHoi: qid,
                        loaiCauHoi: qtype,
                        danhSachMaLuaChon: ids
                    });
                }
            } 
            else if (qtype === 'ÄÃ¡nh giÃ¡ sao') {
                const rating = parseInt(document.getElementById('rating_input_' + qid).value);
                if (isRequired && rating <= 0) {
                    Swal.fire('ChÃº Ã½', 'Vui lÃ²ng chá»n sá»‘ sao Ä‘Ã¡nh giÃ¡ cho cÃ¢u há»i báº¯t buá»™c!', 'warning');
                    card.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
                    return;
                }
                if (rating > 0) {
                    answers.push({
                        maCauHoi: qid,
                        loaiCauHoi: qtype,
                        soSao: rating
                    });
                }
            } 
            else if (qtype === 'Tá»± luáº­n') {
                const text = document.getElementById('text_' + qid).value.trim();
                if (isRequired && text.length === 0) {
                    Swal.fire('ChÃº Ã½', 'Vui lÃ²ng Ä‘iá»n ná»™i dung cho cÃ¢u há»i tá»± luáº­n báº¯t buá»™c!', 'warning');
                    card.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
                    return;
                }
                if (text.length > 0) {
                    answers.push({
                        maCauHoi: qid,
                        loaiCauHoi: qtype,
                        noiDungTraLoi: text
                    });
                }
            }
        }

        // Táº¡o payload gá»­i lÃªn server
        const payload = {
            maPhieuKS: maPhieuKS,
            answers: answers
        };

        const btnSubmit = document.getElementById('btnSubmitSurvey');
        btnSubmit.disabled = true;
        btnSubmit.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin me-2"></i>Äang gá»­i...';

        try {
            const res = await fetch('/CustomerSurvey/SubmitSurvey', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'RequestVerificationToken': document.querySelector('#surveyForm input[name="__RequestVerificationToken"]').value
                },
                body: JSON.stringify(payload)
            });

            const data = await res.json();
            if (data.success) {
                Swal.fire({
                    icon: 'success',
                    title: 'ThÃ nh CÃ´ng!',
                    text: data.message,
                    confirmButtonText: 'Xem danh sÃ¡ch kháº£o sÃ¡t',
                    confirmButtonColor: '#0d6efd'
                }).then(() => {
                    window.location.href = '/CustomerSurvey/Index';
                });
            } else {
                Swal.fire('Lá»—i', data.message || 'KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ gá»­i bÃ i kháº£o sÃ¡t.', 'error');
                btnSubmit.disabled = false;
                btnSubmit.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-paper-plane me-2"></i>Ná»™p Phiáº¿u Kháº£o SÃ¡t';
            }
        } catch (err) {
            console.error(err);
            Swal.fire('Lá»—i', 'ÄÃ£ xáº£y ra lá»—i káº¿t ná»‘i Ä‘áº¿n mÃ¡y chá»§. Vui lÃ²ng thá»­ láº¡i!', 'error');
            btnSubmit.disabled = false;
            btnSubmit.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-paper-plane me-2"></i>Ná»™p Phiáº¿u Kháº£o SÃ¡t';
        }
    }
</script>

                let currentSurveyTicketId = null;
                async function checkPendingSurveyNotice() {
                    try {
                        const response = await fetch('/CustomerSurvey/CheckPendingSurvey');
                        const data = await response.json();

                        if (!data.hasSurvey || !data.maPhieuKS) return;
                        currentSurveyTicketId = data.maPhieuKS;
                        if (sessionStorage.getItem('declined_survey_' + currentSurveyTicketId) === 'true') return;
                        document.getElementById('surveyNoticeTitle').innerText = 'Quý khách có 1 bài khảo sát: ' + (data.tenKhaoSat || 'Mẫu áo mới');

                        document.getElementById('btnGoToSurvey').href = '/CustomerSurvey/DoSurvey/' + encodeURIComponent(data.maPhieuKS);
                        document.getElementById('surveyDropBanner').classList.add('slide-down');
                    } catch (error) {
                        console.error("Lỗi khi kiểm tra khảo sát:", error);
                    }

                document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {

                    window.setInterval(checkPendingSurveyNotice, 60000);
                });

-- BÆ¯á»šC 2: Táº O THÆ¯ Má»¤C LÆ¯U TRá»® BACKUP Báº°NG XP_CMDSHELL (Náº¾U CÃ“ QUYá»€N) HOáº¶C Sá»¬ Dá»¤NG ÄÆ¯á»œNG DáºªN C:\SQL_Backup\
-- LÆ°u Ã½: Äáº£m báº£o thÆ° má»¥c C:\SQL_Backup\ Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Æ°á»£c táº¡o trÃªn mÃ¡y chá»§ SQL Server.
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
EXEC sp_configure 'show advanced options', 1;
RECONFIGURE;
EXEC sp_configure 'xp_cmdshell', 1;
RECONFIGURE;

-- Táº¡o thÆ° má»¥c sao lÆ°u C:\SQL_Backup náº¿u chÆ°a tá»“n táº¡i
EXEC master..xp_cmdshell 'cmd.exe /c "if not exist C:\SQL_Backup mkdir C:\SQL_Backup"';
GO

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BÆ¯á»šC 3: SCRIPT Ká»ŠCH Báº¢N 1 - SAO LÆ¯U TOÃ€N Bá»˜ (FULL BACKUP)
-- Má»¥cl Ä‘Ã­ch: LÆ°u trá»¯ toÃ n bá»™ dá»¯ liá»‡u, cáº¥u trÃºc báº£ng, index, trigger, stored procedure.
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PRINT N'==> 2. Äang thá»±c hiá»‡n FULL BACKUP...';
GO

DECLARE @FullBackupPath NVARCHAR(500);
SET @FullBackupPath = N'C:\SQL_Backup\Fashion_store_Full_' 
    + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), GETDATE(), 120), '-', ''), ':', ''), ' ', '_') 
    + '.bak';

-- Sao lÆ°u vÃ o file cÃ³ gáº¯n Timestamp Ä‘á»™ng
BACKUP DATABASE Fashion_store
TO DISK = @FullBackupPath
WITH 
    FORMAT,                  -- Khá»Ÿi táº¡o láº¡i thiáº¿t bá»‹ sao lÆ°u
    INIT,                    -- Ghi Ä‘Ã¨ táº­p tin sao lÆ°u cÅ© náº¿u trÃ¹ng tÃªn
    NAME = N'Fashion_store-Full Database Backup',
    DESCRIPTION = N'Báº£n sao lÆ°u toÃ n bá»™ CSDL Fashion_store',
    COMPRESSION,             -- NÃ©n file sao lÆ°u giÃºp giáº£m dung lÆ°á»£ng á»• Ä‘Ä©a
    STATS = 10;              -- Hiá»ƒn thá»‹ tiáº¿n Ä‘á»™ má»—i 10%
GO

-- Äá»“ng thá»i táº¡o 1 báº£n Cá»‘ Ä‘á»‹nh tÃªn Ä‘á»ƒ dá»… Restore cho bÃ i táº­p/Ä‘á»“ Ã¡n
BACKUP DATABASE Fashion_store
TO DISK = N'C:\SQL_Backup\Fashion_store_Full.bak'
WITH FORMAT, INIT, NAME = N'Fashion_store Full Fixed Backup', COMPRESSION, STATS = 10;
GO

PRINT N'==> HoÃ n táº¥t Full Backup táº¡i C:\SQL_Backup\Fashion_store_Full.bak';
GO

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BÆ¯á»šC 4: SCRIPT Ká»ŠCH Báº¢N 2 - SAO LÆ¯U VI SAI (DIFFERENTIAL BACKUP)
-- Má»¥c Ä‘Ã­ch: Chá»‰ sao lÆ°u cÃ¡c thay Ä‘á»•i dá»¯ liá»‡u phÃ¡t sinh tá»« sau báº£n Full Backup gáº§n nháº¥t.
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PRINT N'==> 3. Äang thá»±c hiá»‡n DIFFERENTIAL BACKUP...';
GO

BACKUP DATABASE Fashion_store
TO DISK = N'C:\SQL_Backup\Fashion_store_Diff.bak'
WITH 
    DIFFERENTIAL,            -- ÄÃ¡nh dáº¥u sao lÆ°u vi sai
    FORMAT, 
    INIT, 
    NAME = N'Fashion_store Differential Backup',
    DESCRIPTION = N'Báº£n sao lÆ°u vi sai CSDL Fashion_store',
    COMPRESSION,
    STATS = 10;
GO

PRINT N'==> HoÃ n táº¥t Differential Backup táº¡i C:\SQL_Backup\Fashion_store_Diff.bak';
GO

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BÆ¯á»šC 5: SCRIPT Ká»ŠCH Báº¢N 3 - SAO LÆ¯U NHáº¬T KÃ GIAO Dá»ŠCH (TRANSACTION LOG BACKUP)
-- Má»¥c Ä‘Ã­ch: Ghi láº¡i toÃ n bá»™ lá»‹ch sá»­ giao dá»‹ch (Insert/Update/Delete) há»— trá»£ Point-in-Time Recovery.
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PRINT N'==> 4. Äang thá»±c hiá»‡n TRANSACTION LOG BACKUP...';
GO

BACKUP LOG Fashion_store
TO DISK = N'C:\SQL_Backup\Fashion_store_Log.trn'
WITH 
    FORMAT, 
    INIT, 
    NAME = N'Fashion_store Transaction Log Backup',
    DESCRIPTION = N'Báº£n sao lÆ°u Transaction Log CSDL Fashion_store',
    COMPRESSION,
    STATS = 10;
GO

PRINT N'==> HoÃ n táº¥t Log Backup táº¡i C:\SQL_Backup\Fashion_store_Log.trn';
GO

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BÆ¯á»šC 6: KIá»‚M TRA TÃNH TOÃ€N Váº¸N Cá»¦A CÃC Báº¢N SAO LÆ¯U
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PRINT N'==> 5. Kiá»ƒm tra tÃ­nh há»£p lá»‡ cá»§a file Backup (RESTORE VERIFYONLY)...';

RESTORE VERIFYONLY FROM DISK = N'C:\SQL_Backup\Fashion_store_Full.bak';
RESTORE HEADERONLY FROM DISK = N'C:\SQL_Backup\Fashion_store_Full.bak';
RESTORE FILELISTONLY FROM DISK = N'C:\SQL_Backup\Fashion_store_Full.bak';
GO

DECLARE @tTen VARCHAR(50), @tTenHT NVARCHAR(100), @tEmail VARCHAR(100), @tSDT VARCHAR(15), @tNS DATE, @tDC NVARCHAR(255), @tTT BIT;
DECLARE @curMaTK INT;

DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT TenDN, HoTen, Email, SDT, NgaySinh, DiaChi, TrangThai FROM @KhachHangTable;
OPEN c;
FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @tTen, @tTenHT, @tEmail, @tSDT, @tNS, @tDC, @tTT;

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO TAIKHOAN (TenDangNhap, MatKhau, MaVaiTro, TrangThai, NgayTao)
    VALUES (@tTen, '12345678', 2, @tTT, GETDATE());
    SET @curMaTK = SCOPE_IDENTITY();

    INSERT INTO KHACHHANG (MaTK, HoTen, Email, SoDienThoai, NgaySinh, GioiTinh, DiaChi, NgayDangKy, DaXoa)
    VALUES (@curMaTK, @tTenHT, @tEmail, @tSDT, @tNS, N'Nam', @tDC, GETDATE(), 0);

    FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @tTen, @tTenHT, @tEmail, @tSDT, @tNS, @tDC, @tTT;
END;
CLOSE c;
DEALLOCATE c;

-- Tá»± Ä‘á»™ng Ä‘iá»n Ä‘Æ°á»ng dáº«n áº£nh cho toÃ n bá»™ 36 Sáº£n pháº©m
DECLARE @i INT = 1;
WHILE @i <= 36
BEGIN
    UPDATE SANPHAM
    SET HinhAnh = '/images/products/sp' + CAST(@i AS VARCHAR(5)) + '_thumb.jpg',
        HinhAnhMoTa = '/images/products/sp' + CAST(@i AS VARCHAR(5)) + '_detail.jpg'
    WHERE MaSP = @i;
    SET @i = @i + 1;
END;

-- 4.7. Tá»± Ä‘á»™ng sinh Size, MÃ u, Tá»“n kho & GiÃ¡ vÃ o báº£ng SOLUONGSP cho 36 sáº£n pháº©m
INSERT INTO SOLUONGSP (MaSP, SKU, KichThuoc, MauSac, GiaBan, SoLuongTon, TrangThai, HinhAnh)
SELECT 
    sp.MaSP,
    CONCAT('SKU-SP', sp.MaSP, '-', v.Size),
    v.Size,
    v.Color,
    CASE 
        WHEN sp.MaDM = 1 THEN 220000 
        WHEN sp.MaDM = 2 THEN 320000 
        WHEN sp.MaDM = 3 THEN 380000 
        WHEN sp.MaDM = 4 THEN 450000 
        ELSE 390000                  
    END AS GiaBan,
    50 AS SoLuongTon, 
    1 AS TrangThai,
    sp.HinhAnh
FROM SANPHAM sp
CROSS JOIN (
    VALUES (N'M', N'Äen'), (N'L', N'Tráº¯ng'), (N'XL', N'Xanh Navy')
) AS v(Size, Color);

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.Cookies;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.FileProviders;
using Fashion_store.Data;
using Fashion_store.Services;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

// Add services to the container.
builder.Services.AddControllersWithViews();
// ÄÄƒng kÃ½ Swagger
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen(c =>
{
    c.SwaggerDoc("v1", new Microsoft.OpenApi.OpenApiInfo
    {
        Title = "Fashion Store API",
        Version = "v1",
        Description = "TÃ i liá»‡u API cho Äá»“ Ã¡n Há»‡ thá»‘ng thÃ´ng tin doanh nghiá»‡p - Fashion Store"
    });

    // Máº¹o xá»­ lÃ½ dá»± Ã¡n MVC: TrÃ¡nh lá»—i trÃ¹ng route náº¿u cÃ³ cÃ¡c Action MVC trÃ¹ng tÃªn
    c.ResolveConflictingActions(apiDescriptions => apiDescriptions.First());
});

builder.Services.AddDistributedMemoryCache();
builder.Services.AddSession(options =>
{
    options.IdleTimeout = TimeSpan.FromHours(8);
    options.Cookie.HttpOnly = true;
    options.Cookie.IsEssential = true;
});

// Cáº¥u hÃ¬nh EF Core SQL Server
var connectionString = ResolveConnectionString(builder.Configuration);
builder.Services.AddDbContext<FashionStoreDbContext>(options =>
    options.UseSqlServer(connectionString));
builder.Services.AddHostedService<SurveyExpirationService>();

// Cáº¥u hÃ¬nh Authentication & Cookie
builder.Services.AddAuthentication(CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme)
    .AddCookie(options =>
    {
        options.LoginPath = "/Admin/Account/Login";
        options.LogoutPath = "/Admin/Account/Logout";
        options.AccessDeniedPath = "/Admin/Account/Login";
        options.ExpireTimeSpan = TimeSpan.FromHours(8);
    });

var app = builder.Build();
// Báº­t giao diá»‡n Swagger UI
app.UseSwagger();
app.UseSwaggerUI(c =>
{
    c.SwaggerEndpoint("/swagger/v1/swagger.json", "Fashion Store API v1");
    c.RoutePrefix = "swagger"; // ÄÆ°á»ng dáº«n truy cáº­p sáº½ lÃ : /swagger
});

// Configure the HTTP request pipeline.
if (!app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.UseExceptionHandler("/Home/Error");
    app.UseHsts();
}

app.UseHttpsRedirection();
app.UseStaticFiles();
var frontendPath = Path.Combine(app.Environment.ContentRootPath, "frontend");
if (Directory.Exists(frontendPath))
{
    app.UseStaticFiles(new StaticFileOptions
    {
        FileProvider = new PhysicalFileProvider(frontendPath),
        RequestPath = "/frontend"
    });
}

app.UseRouting();

app.UseSession();
app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseMiddleware<ActiveCookieAccountMiddleware>();
app.UseAuthorization();

// Route cho Admin Area
app.MapControllerRoute(
    name: "areas",
    pattern: "{area:exists}/{controller=Account}/{action=Index}/{id?}");

// Route cho cÃ¡c controller phÃ­a storefront nhÆ° CustomerSurveyController.
// KhÃ´ng Ä‘áº·t máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh area=Admin á»Ÿ Ä‘Ã¢y Ä‘á»ƒ cÃ¡c Ä‘Æ°á»ng dáº«n /CustomerSurvey/... khÃ´ng bá»‹ lá»‡ch Area.
app.MapControllerRoute(
    name: "storefront",
    pattern: "{controller}/{action=Index}/{id?}");

// Route Máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh
app.MapControllerRoute(
    name: "default",
    pattern: "{controller=Account}/{action=Login}/{id?}",
    defaults: new { area = "Admin" });

app.Run();

static string ResolveConnectionString(IConfiguration config)
{
    var machineName = Environment.MachineName;

    // 1. Kiem tra cau hinh rieng theo ten may (Connection_TENMAY)
    var machineConn = config.GetConnectionString($"Connection_{machineName}");
    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(machineConn))
    {
        Console.WriteLine($"[Database] Tu dong nhan dien may ({machineName}): Su dung Connection_{machineName}");
        return machineConn;
    }

    // 2. Danh sach cac cau hinh du phong / tu dong do
    var candidates = new List<string>();
    var defaultConn = config.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection");
    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(defaultConn)) candidates.Add(defaultConn);

    candidates.Add(@"Server=.\SQLEXPRESS;Database=Fashion_store;Trusted_Connection=True;TrustServerCertificate=True;MultipleActiveResultSets=true;");
    candidates.Add(@"Server=.;Database=Fashion_store;Trusted_Connection=True;TrustServerCertificate=True;MultipleActiveResultSets=true;");
    candidates.Add(@"Server=localhost;Database=Fashion_store;Trusted_Connection=True;TrustServerCertificate=True;MultipleActiveResultSets=true;");
    candidates.Add(@"Server=LAPTOP-GSU7LU5K\MSSQLSERVER01;Database=Fashion_store;User Id=sa;Password=Bibi@0809;TrustServerCertificate=True;");

    foreach (var connStr in candidates.Distinct())
    {
        try
        {
            var testBuilder = new Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnectionStringBuilder(connStr) { ConnectTimeout = 2 };
            using var testConn = new Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnection(testBuilder.ConnectionString);
            testConn.Open();
            Console.WriteLine($"[Database] Tu dong ket noi thanh cong toi SQL Server: {testConn.DataSource} (May: {machineName})");
            return connStr;
        }
        catch { }
    }

    return defaultConn ?? candidates.First();
}

-- Ká»ŠCH Báº¢N 1: KHÃ”I PHá»¤C CÆ  Báº¢N Tá»ª Báº¢N FULL BACKUP (GHI ÄÃˆ CSDL CÅ¨)
-- Sá»­ dá»¥ng khi CSDL bá»‹ lá»—i náº·ng hoáº·c muá»‘n tráº£ dá»¯ liá»‡u vá» má»‘c Full Backup.

PRINT N'==============================================================================';
PRINT N'Ká»ŠCH Báº¢N 1: KHÃ”I PHá»¤C Tá»ª Báº¢N SAO LÆ¯U TOÃ€N Bá»˜ (FULL BACKUP)';
PRINT N'==============================================================================';

-- 1. Ngáº¯t toÃ n bá»™ káº¿t ná»‘i hiá»‡n táº¡i Ä‘áº¿n CSDL Fashion_store (náº¿u CSDL Ä‘ang tá»“n táº¡i)
IF EXISTS (SELECT name FROM sys.databases WHERE name = N'Fashion_store')
BEGIN
    PRINT N'==> Ngáº¯t káº¿t ná»‘i ngÆ°á»i dÃ¹ng hiá»‡n táº¡i vÃ  chuyá»ƒn CSDL sang SINGLE_USER mode...';
    ALTER DATABASE Fashion_store SET SINGLE_USER WITH ROLLBACK IMMEDIATE;
END
GO

-- 2. KhÃ´i phá»¥c tá»« file Full Backup
PRINT N'==> Thá»±c hiá»‡n khÃ´i phá»¥c Full Backup vá»›i tÃ¹y chá»n REPLACE...';
RESTORE DATABASE Fashion_store
FROM DISK = N'C:\SQL_Backup\Fashion_store_Full.bak'
WITH 
    REPLACE,                 -- Ghi Ä‘Ã¨ lÃªn CSDL cÅ© náº¿u Ä‘Ã£ tá»“n táº¡i
    RECOVERY,                -- Sáºµn sÃ ng cho ngÆ°á»i dÃ¹ng truy váº¥n ngay sau khi xong
    STATS = 10;
GO

-- 3. ÄÆ°a CSDL trá»Ÿ láº¡i cháº¿ Ä‘á»™ nhiá»u ngÆ°á»i dÃ¹ng (MULTI_USER)
ALTER DATABASE Fashion_store SET MULTI_USER;
GO
PRINT N'==> HoÃ n táº¥t Ká»‹ch báº£n 1: KhÃ´i phá»¥c Full Backup thÃ nh cÃ´ng!';
GO


-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Ká»ŠCH Báº¢N 2: KHÃ”I PHá»¤C THá»¨ Tá»° THEO CHUá»–I (FULL -> DIFFERENTIAL -> TRANSACTION LOG)
-- Ãp dá»¥ng Ä‘á»ƒ khÃ´i phá»¥c tá»‘i Ä‘a dá»¯ liá»‡u Ä‘áº¿n thá»i Ä‘iá»ƒm sá»± cá»‘ má»›i nháº¥t xáº£y ra.
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PRINT N'==============================================================================';
PRINT N'Ká»ŠCH Báº¢N 2: KHÃ”I PHá»¤C THEO CHUá»–I (FULL + DIFF + LOG BACKUP)';
PRINT N'==============================================================================';
GO

-- 1. Ngáº¯t káº¿t ná»‘i ngÆ°á»i dÃ¹ng
IF EXISTS (SELECT name FROM sys.databases WHERE name = N'Fashion_store')
BEGIN
    ALTER DATABASE Fashion_store SET SINGLE_USER WITH ROLLBACK IMMEDIATE;
END
GO

-- 2. BÆ°á»›c 2.1: KhÃ´i phá»¥c báº£n FULL BACKUP vá»›i NORECOVERY (Giá»¯ CSDL á»Ÿ tráº¡ng thÃ¡i Restoring)
PRINT N'==> 2.1 Restore Full Backup (WITH NORECOVERY)...';
RESTORE DATABASE Fashion_store
FROM DISK = N'C:\SQL_Backup\Fashion_store_Full.bak'
WITH 
    REPLACE, 
    NORECOVERY,              -- Cho phÃ©p khÃ´i phá»¥c tiáº¿p cÃ¡c báº£n backup sau
    STATS = 10;
GO

-- 3. BÆ°á»›c 2.2: KhÃ´i phá»¥c báº£n DIFFERENTIAL BACKUP vá»›i NORECOVERY
PRINT N'==> 2.2 Restore Differential Backup (WITH NORECOVERY)...';
RESTORE DATABASE Fashion_store
FROM DISK = N'C:\SQL_Backup\Fashion_store_Diff.bak'
WITH 
    NORECOVERY,              -- Tiáº¿p tá»¥c chá» báº£n Log Backup
    STATS = 10;
GO

-- 4. BÆ°á»›c 2.3: KhÃ´i phá»¥c báº£n TRANSACTION LOG BACKUP vá»›i RECOVERY (HoÃ n táº¥t chuá»—i)
PRINT N'==> 2.3 Restore Transaction Log Backup (WITH RECOVERY)...';
RESTORE LOG Fashion_store
FROM DISK = N'C:\SQL_Backup\Fashion_store_Log.trn'
WITH 
    RECOVERY,                -- ÄÃ¡nh dáº¥u hoÃ n táº¥t quÃ¡ trÃ¬nh Restore, má»Ÿ CSDL cho ngÆ°á»i dÃ¹ng
    STATS = 10;
GO

-- 5. Tráº£ láº¡i cháº¿ Ä‘á»™ MULTI_USER
ALTER DATABASE Fashion_store SET MULTI_USER;
GO
PRINT N'==> HoÃ n táº¥t Ká»‹ch báº£n 2: KhÃ´i phá»¥c chuá»—i (Full + Diff + Log) thÃ nh cÃ´ng!';
GO


-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Ká»ŠCH Báº¢N 3: KHÃ”I PHá»¤C SANG Má»˜T CSDL Má»šI HOáº¶C SANG MÃY KHÃC (Sá»¬ Dá»¤NG WITH MOVE)
-- GiÃºp khÃ´i phá»¥c CSDL thÃ nh "Fashion_store_Test" hoáº·c chuyá»ƒn file data/log sang Ä‘Æ°á»ng dáº«n má»›i.
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PRINT N'==============================================================================';
PRINT N'Ká»ŠCH Báº¢N 3: KHÃ”I PHá»¤C SANG CSDL Má»šI (Fashion_store_Test) Vá»šI TÃ™Y CHá»ŒN WITH MOVE';
PRINT N'==============================================================================';
GO

-- 1. Xem tÃªn Logical Name cá»§a táº­p tin dá»¯ liá»‡u (.mdf) vÃ  nháº­t kÃ½ (.ldf) trong báº£n sao lÆ°u
PRINT N'==> Danh sÃ¡ch Logical Name trong file Backup:';
RESTORE FILELISTONLY FROM DISK = N'C:\SQL_Backup\Fashion_store_Full.bak';
GO

-- 2. Tiáº¿n hÃ nh Restore sang Database má»›i vá»›i tÃªn Fashion_store_Test
PRINT N'==> KhÃ´i phá»¥c thÃ nh Fashion_store_Test...';
RESTORE DATABASE Fashion_store_Test
FROM DISK = N'C:\SQL_Backup\Fashion_store_Full.bak'
WITH 
    MOVE N'Fashion_store' TO N'C:\SQL_Backup\Fashion_store_Test.mdf',
    MOVE N'Fashion_store_log' TO N'C:\SQL_Backup\Fashion_store_Test_log.ldf',
    REPLACE,
    RECOVERY,
    STATS = 10;
GO

PRINT N'==> HoÃ n táº¥t Ká»‹ch báº£n 3: ÄÃ£ táº¡o CSDL Fashion_store_Test tá»« báº£n sao lÆ°u!';
GO

PRINT N'==============================================================================';
PRINT N'Táº¤T Cáº¢ CÃC Ká»ŠCH Báº¢N RESTORE ÄÃƒ ÄÆ¯á»¢C CHUáº¨N Bá»Š VÃ€ KIá»‚M TRA THÃ€NH CÃ”NG!';
PRINT N'==============================================================================';
